15:32: Said He O’ Iblees! “What hindereth thee that thou art not with those who prostrate in obeisance?
15:33: He said: “I am not one to prostrate in obeisance unto man (for) Thou created him of the essence of black mud fashioned in shape.
15:34: Said He: “Then get thou out of it, for verily thou art the driven away accursed,
15:35: And verily on thee is (My) curse until the Judgment Day.
15:36: He said: “My Lord! Respite me till the day when they are raised.
15:37: Said He: “Then verily thou art of the respited ones,
15:38: Till the day of the time made known.
15:39: He said: “My Lord! because Thou hast left me to stray, certainly will I adorn unto them the path of error, and certainly will I cause them all to go astray,
15:40: Save Thy (devoted) servants, of them the freed ones.
15:41: Said He: “This is a right way unto Me
15:42: Verily, (as regards) My (devoted) servants, There is not for thee over them any authority except the one who followeth thee, of the deviators
15:43: And verily Hell is certainly the promised abode for them all,
15:44: For it (the Hell) are seven gates; for each of those (gates) shall be a separate party (of the sinners) assigned.
15:45: Verily the pious ones shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains;
15:46: (The angels saying unto them:) “Enter ye therein in Peace, Secure
15:47: And We will root out whatever rancour be in their hearts, (they shall be} as brothers, on dignified couches, face to face.
15:48: Shall not touch them therein any weariness, nor shall they ever be cast out of it.
15:49: Announce thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto My servants that Verily I, am the most Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful,
15:50: And that My chastisement that is the chastisement grievous.
15:51: And inform them of the guests of Abraham
15:52: When they entered in unto him, said they: “Peace.” He said: “Verily we feel afraid of you!
15:53: Said they: “Fear thou not! Verily we bear unto thee the glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
15:54: He said: “Bear ye unto me the glad tidings (of a son) while, old age hath touched me? of what then bear ye unto me the glad tidings?
15:55: They said: “We bear unto thee the glad tidings in truth, so be thou not of the despairing ones.
15:56: Said he: “And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord but those who are astray?
15:57: He said: “What is your business, then, O’ messengers (of God)?
15:58: Said they: “Verily we are sent unto a guilty people,
15:59: Except the family of Lot; Verily we will deliver them all
15:60: Except his wife; we are certain that she shall be of those who remain behind (in the wrath of God).
15:61: So when came the messenger unto the family of Lot,
15:62: He said: “Verily ye are people unknown.
15:63: Said they: “Nay, come we unto thee with that in which they have been doubting
15:64: And come we unto thee with the truth, and verily we are certainly truthful
15:65: So go thou forth with thy followers in a part of the night and thyself follow their rear, and let not any one of you turn back, and go ye forth whither ye are bidden
15:66: And We revealed unto him this decree (of Ours) that the roots of these shall be cut off in the morning.
15:67: And came the people of the town rejoicing
15:68: He said: “Verily these are my guests, therefore disgrace me not,
15:69: Fear ye (the wrath of) God, and put me not to shame.
15:70: Said they: “Have we not for bidden thee against (protecting) other people.
15:71: Said he: (Here) are these my daughters (ye may wed them) if ye desire to do so;
15:72: And verily by thy life (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) certainly they were in their intoxication (of their lust) wandering bewildered
15:73: So the (violent) blast seized them (while) entering upon the dawn,
15:74: Thus did We turn it upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay;
15:75: Verily in this are signs for those who scan heedfully.
15:76: And verily it is on a (high) way that (still) stands.
15:77: Verily in this there is a sign for the believers.
15:78: And verily the inhabitants of El-Aika too were most surely unjust ones.
15:79: We inflicted retribution on them, and indeed they were both on a (high) way, (still) open.
15:80: And indeed the inhabitants of Hijr (the Rock), belied the messengers (of God),
15:81: And We brought forth unto them Our signs, but from them they turned away,
15:82: And they hewed in the mountains abodes and felt (themselves) secure.
15:83: So seized them the (violent) blast in the morning,
15:84: And availed them not what they did earn;
15:85: And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them two but with truth; and verily the hour (of reckoning) is certainly to come, so (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) forgive (the people) with gracious forgiveness.
15:86: Verily thy Lord, He is the Great Creator, the All-Knowing.
15:87: And indeed We have given thee (the) seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Great Qur’an.
15:88: Strain not thine eyes at what We have provided with some of them pairs among them to enjoy, and grieve not for them and lower thy wing (be gentle) unto the believers.
15:89: And say thou: “Verily, I am an open warner (from God)
15:90: Even so as We did send down on those who did foster divisions,
15:91: Those rendered the Qur’an into parts.
15:92: So, by thy Lord, certainly We would question them all,
15:93: As to what they used to do.
15:94: Therefore declare thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) openly what thou art bidden, and turn thou away from the polytheists.
15:95: Verily, We are sufficient for thee against the scoffers,
15:96: Those who set up with God another god, presently they shall know.
15:97: And indeed We know that straiteneth thy breast at what they say,
15:98: But celebrate thou the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves (unto God) in obeisance,
15:99: And worship thou thy Lord until there cometh unto thee what is certain.
16:1: The Decree of God hath come, therefore ye hasten it not: Glory be to Him and Exalted is He above what they associate with Him.
16:2: He sendeth down the angels with the spirit (revelation) by His own decree on whomsoever He willeth of His servants saying: “Warn ye (the mankind) that there is no god but I therefore fear Me.
16:3: Created He the heavens and the earth with the truth; Exalted is He above what they associate (with Him).
16:4: He created man from life sperm or germ and behold! (that same drop now a man) he is an open disputer.
16:5: And the cattle (He) created them for you, therein is warmth and many gains, and of them ye eat.
16:6: And for you they beseem well when ye drive them (home) and when ye drive them forth (to pasture.)
16:7: And bear they your burdens to lands which ye could not else reach but with distress unto (your) self; Verily thy Lord is Pitiful, All-Merciful,
16:8: And (He made) horses and mules and asses that ye might ride upon them and as adornment; and createth He what ye know not.
16:9: And upon God rests the guidance unto the right way, and of them (the ways) are the deviating ones; and if He willeth He would certainly guide you all aright.
16:10: He it is Who sendeth down water from the heavens for you; from it ye drink, and by it (groweth) trees on which ye pasture your cattle.
16:11: He groweth for you thereby corn, and the olives, and the palm-trees, and the grapes, and of all the fruits; Verily in this is a sign for a people who reflect.
16:12: And (He hath) made sub servient for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon; and the stars have been made subservient by His decree; Verily in this are signs for a people who understand,
16:13: And what He hath produced in the earth of varied hues (and qualities) Verily there is in this a sign for a people who are mindful (with gratitude).
16:14: And He it is Who made subservient the sea that ye might eat from it fresh meat and take out from it ornaments which ye wear, and thou seest the ships cleaving through it, and that ye might seek of His grace, and that ye might give thanks.
16:15: And He hath cast great mountains (standing firm) in the earth lest it may shake with you, and rivers and the roads that ye be guided aright,
16:16: And landmarks (too), and by the star they are guided (to the right way)
16:17: What! Is He then who createth like unto him who createth not? Will ye not then consider?
16:18: If ye would count God’s bounties, ye can not compute them; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
16:19: And God knoweth what ye hide and what ye manifest
16:20: And those whom they call on besides God create not aught while they are themselves created.
16:21: Dead (they are), not living, and they perceive not when they will be raised.
16:22: Your God is One God; and those who believe not in the hereafter, their hearts are repulsive (against the truth ), and they are men of pride.
16:23: Certainly it is that God knoweth what they hide and what they express; Verily He loveth not the proud ones.
16:24: And when it is said unto them: “What is it that your Lord hath sent down?” Say they (Nothing but the) legends of the ancients,
16:25: That they may bear their burden entirely on the Day of Judgment and also of the burdens of those whom they led astray without knowledge; Behold! Evil is it what they bear!
16:26: Indeed did plot those before them, and then (the wrath of) God came (and destroyed) their structure (from) the foundations, and fell on them the roof from above them, and came on them the torment whence they perceived not.
16:27: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: “Where are My partners (which ye ascribed unto Me), about whom ye have been disputing; Those who have been given the knowledge will say: “Verily the disgrace this day and evil is upon the infidels,
16:28: Those whom the angels terminate their life while they are unjust unto themselves, then they would offer submission (saying): “We used not to do any evil,” (the angels will reply): “Aye! Verily knoweth God well what ye were doing.
16:29: Therefore enter ye the gates of Hell, to abide in it; Woeful indeed will be the abode of the haughty ones!
16:30: And it is said unto those who guard themselves against evil: “What is that hath sent down your Lord?” Say they: “Good; For those who do good in this world is good; and indeed the abode of the hereafter is better; and excellent indeed is the abode of the pious ones,
16:31: Gardens of eternity, they shall enter therein, beneath them flow rivers; they shall have in them whatever they desire for; Thus doth God reward the pious ones,
16:32: Those whom the angels take away in a good state, (the angels) while receiving them will say: “Peace be on you; Enter ye the Garden, for what ye were doing.
16:33: What! Await they aught save that come unto them the angels or cometh (to pass) the decree of thy Lord? Thus did those before them; And God was not unjust unto them, but they were unto their own selves unjust.
16:34: So afflicted them the evils what they did; and encompassed them that which they were scoffing at.
16:35: And say they who associated (other gods with God) “If God had willed, we had worshipped not aught besides Him, (neither) we nor our fathers; nor had we (forbidden) aught without a (decree from) Him;” Even so did (say) those before them; Is then (aught) incumbent upon (Our) apostles save a clear delivery (plain preaching of the message)?
16:36: And indeed raised We in every nation an apostle (of Ours) (preaching) that “Worship ye God (only), and shun ye (the worship of every kind of) idol,” so of them were some whom God guided, and of them were others on whom error was confirmed; Therefore travel ye in the earth, then see what hath been the end of the beliers.
16:37: If covetest thou for their guidance, yet verily God guideth not those whom He leaveth to stray, and neither for them shall be any of the helpers.
16:38: And swear they by God, with the strongest of their oaths that God will raise not one who dieth; Nay, but it is a promise binding on Him in truth, but most people know it not,
16:39: (They will be raised up) so that He might manifest unto them that which they differed about, and (that) those who disbelieved might know that they were liars.
16:40: Verily only Our word for a thing when We will it is that We say unto it, ‘Be’ and it exists.
16:41: And those who migrate in (the cause of) God after they are oppressed, certainly We will give them good (recompense) in this world; and certainly the reward in the hereafter is much greater, if they only know (this),
16:42: Those who endured patiently and on their Lord (only) do they rely.
16:43: And We sent not before thee but men (as Our apostles), We revealed unto them; So ask ye the people of ‘Dhikr’ (the Qur’an) if ye know not,
16:44: With clear proofs (miracles) and scriptures; and We sent down unto thee the ‘Dhikr’ (The Reminder i.e., Qur’an) that thou mayest make clear unto mankind what hath been sent down unto them, that they may reflect
16:45: What! then feel they secure, who plan evil devices, (against) God causing them swallowed up by the earth, or cometh unto them the wrath from whence they perceive not?
16:46: Or that He seizeth them during their movement, they shall not frustrate (God's decree),
16:47: Or He seizeth them by a gradual loss, for verily your Lord is Pitiful and All-Merciful.
16:48: Or see they not towards what God hath created that everything turneth its shadow to the right and to the left, prostrating in obeisance unto God, while they lie abased.
16:49: And prostrateth in obeisance unto God (only) whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, (and) of the (moving) creatures, and the angels (too), and they pride not.
16:50: They fear their Lord (Supreme) above them and do what they are commanded.
16:51: God hath said: “Take ye not two gods, Verily, Verily, He is only One God; So of Me (alone) should ye be afraid.
16:52: And His it is whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and unto Him (only) should obedience constantly be; Do ye then fear (any one else) other than God?
16:53: Whatever of the bounty is with you, it is from God, then when any distress toucheth you, unto Him do ye cry for help.
16:54: Yet when removeth He the distress from you, lo! some of you associate others with their Lord,
16:55: That they may deny what We have given them; (Say O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “then enjoy your selves (for a time); for soon will ye know.
16:56: And they assign for what they know not, a portion of what We have provided them with; By God! Certainly ye shall be questioned about what ye have been forging.
16:57: And they ascribe daughters to God Glory be to Him; And for themselves (they ascribe sons) what they desire!
16:58: And when is announced unto (any) one of them a daughter, black becometh his face and he is filled with wrath.
16:59: He hideth himself from the people, of the evil for the tidings given to him, (he pondereth whether) he shall keep her with disgrace or bury her (alive) in the dust? Behold, (how) evil it is what they decide.
16:60: For those who believe not in the hereafter is an evil similitude, and God’s is the highest similitude; for He is the Mighty, the All-Wise.
16:61: If God had to take to task the people for their inequity, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving being but He respiteth them until an appointed term; so when cometh their doom, they shall delay it not (even) an hour, nor shall they bring it on before (its appointed time).
16:62: And they assign unto God what they (themselves) hate and attribute their tongues falsely that for them are (all) good things; Inevitably there shall be for them the (Hell) fire and they shall be the foremost to it.
16:63: By God! indeed sent We (Our) Apostles unto people before thee, but Satan made unto them their deeds fair-seeming, so he is their guardian today, and for them shall be a grievous chastisement.
16:64: And We sent not down unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muham mad!) the Book (the Qur’an) but that thou mayest explain unto them that which they differ about, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for the people who believe.
16:65: And God hath sent down from the heavens water, then enliveneth He with it the earth after its death; Verily, in this is a sign for people who listen.
16:66: And verily for you there in the cattle is a lesson; We give you to drink what is in their bellies, from betwixt the faeces and the blood, milk pure, easy and palatable for those who drink (it).
16:67: And of the fruits of the date-palms, and the grapes - obtain ye from them (drinks of) intoxication and goodly sustenance; Verily in this is a sign for people who understand.
16:68: And revealed thy Lord unto the bee saying: “Make thou hives in the mountains and in the trees and in what they (men) build,
16:69: Then eat thou of all the fruits and walk thou in the ways of thy Lord submissively.” There cometh out from within it a drink of divers colours, in it is healing for men; Verily in this is a sign for the people who reflect.
16:70: And God hath created you, then He taketh you away, and of you is he who is reverted to the lowest state of the age, so that he knoweth not aught after (once) having knowledge: Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
16:71: And God hath favoured some of you above the others in the provision of sustenance, now those who have been more favoured give not their sustenance to those whom their right hands possess, (the slaves) so that they may be equal therein; What! Is it then the bounty of God they deny?
16:72: And God hath given you wives of your own selves, and hath given you from your wives sons and grandchildren, and sustained you of good things; What! Is it then in the falsehood they believe, and (a) in the bounty of God (that) they disbelieve?
16:73: And they worship other than God that which owneth not for them any sustenance (aught) from the heavens and the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power?
16:74: So coin ye not any similitudes to God; Verily God knoweth (everything) and ye know not.
16:75: Setteth forth God the similitude (of two men: one) a slave, a property of another, who hath no power over aught, and (the one) whom We sustained from unto Ourselves a goodly sustenance, and he spendeth from it secretly and openly; Are the two equal? All praise is God’s! But most of them know it not.
16:76: Setteth forth God the similitude of two men; one of them is dumb, unable to do anything, he is a burden to his master; wherever he (the master) sendeth him, he bringeth no good; can he be equal to him who enjoineth justice and he (himself) is on the straight path?
16:77: And God’s is the unseen (worlds) of the heavens and the earth; and the matter of the Hour (of Judgment) is but like a twinkling of the eye, or nigher still; Verily God over all things hath power.
16:78: And God hath brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers - ye knew not anything, and He gave you hearing and the sight and the hearts, that ye may give thanks.
16:79: What! See they not towards the birds held poised in the air in the sky? Nothing holdeth them but God; Verily in this are signs for a people who believe
16:80: And God hath made for you of your houses, a place of rest (and the quiet) and hath made for you of the skins of the cattle houses which ye find so light to carry on the day of your march and on the day of your camping, and of their wool and their fur and their hair (he hath provided for you) (useful) goods of convenience and a provision for a time.
16:81: And God hath made for you, of what He hath created shelters, and hath made for you (some) of the mountains (as) places of refuge, and He hath made for you garments to guard you against the heat (and cold), and the garments to protect you in your fighting; Thus completed! He, His bounties on you so that ye may submit (unto Him thankfully).
16:82: But if turn they away, then on thee is incumbent only the clear delivery (of Our message).
16:83: They recognise the bounties of God, and yet they deny them, and most of them are infidels
16:84: And on the day We will raise up from among every people a witness, then shall be no permission for those who disbelieve (to make any excuses) nor shall they be allowed to solicit any amends.
16:85: And when those who act unjustly shall see the torment, it shall not be lightened for them, nor shall they be respited.
16:86: And when those who associate (others with God) will see their associates, they shall say: “O’ Our Lord! These are our associates whom we called besides Thee!” But they will throw (back) unto them (their) word, (and say) “Verily ye are liars!
16:87: And they shall tender submission unto God on that day; And shall depart from them (leaving them in lurch) what they were forging.
16:88: (For) those who disbelieved and hinder people from the way of God: And We unto them will increase torment over torment for they were making mischief.
16:89: And on the day when We will raise up in every people from among themselves, a witness (upon them) and bring thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) as a witness upon (all) these; and We have sent down upon thee the Book (The Qur’an) explaining everything, and a guidance, and mercy, and glad tidings unto those who submit themselves (To God).
16:90: Verily, God enjoineth justice and benevolence (to others) and giving unto the kindred, and forbiddeth lewdness, and evil, and rebellion; He exhorteth you that ye may take heed.
16:91: And fulfil ye the covenant of God when ye have covenanted, and break ye not the oaths after ratification thereof while indeed ye have appointed God over you a surety (for it); Verily God knoweth (everything) what ye do.
16:92: And be not like unto her who unraveleth her yarn, dis joining it into thin filaments, after she hath made it spun strong, ye take your oaths as means of deceit between you for one nation is more flourishing than (other) nation. Verily God only trieth you by this; And most assuredly He will make it clear unto you on the Day of Judgment about what ye were differing.
16:93: And if God willeth He would surely make you all a single nation, but He leaveth to err whomsoever He willeth and guideth whomsoever He willeth; And certainly will ye be question ed of what ye were doing.
16:94: And take ye not your oaths a means of deceit between you, lest slippeth a foot after it hath been firmly fixed, and ye taste the evil for ye hindered (others) from God’s way; and for you be a great torment.
16:95: Sell ye not the covenant of God for a mean price; for verily with God is that which is better for you, if ye only knew.
16:96: What (ever) is with you passeth away and what is with God is everlasting; and certainly We will give those who exercise patience, their return, with the best of what they were doing.
16:97: Whosoever did good, whether male or female, and he be a believer, then We will certainly make him live a life good and pure, and certainly We will give them their return with the best of what they were doing.
16:98: And when recitest thou the Qur’an seek thou refuge with God from Satan the accursed.
16:99: Verily there is no authority for him over those who believe and rely on their Lord.
16:100: Verily, his authority is only over those who befriend him and those who associate others with Him.
16:101: And when change We one sign for another sign, and God knoweth best what He sendeth down, say they; “Thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) art only a forger.” Nay! most of them know not.
16:102: Say thou (unto the disbelievers O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “The Holy Spirit (Angel Gabriel) hath brought it down (unto thee) from thy Lord with the truth, that it may establish those who believe and as a guidance and glad tidings unto those who submit (themselves to God).
16:103: And indeed know We that they say: “It is only a man (that) teacheth him.” The tongue of him whom they (falsely) hint at is outlandish while this language is Arabic (pure and) plain.
16:104: Verily those who believe not in the signs of God, God guideth them not, and for them shall be a painful torment.
16:105: Verily forge the lie only they who believe not in the signs of God, and these, they are the liars.
16:106: He who disbelieveth in God after his belief in Him, save he who is compelled while his heart remaineth steadfast with the faith, but he who openeth (his) breast for infidelity, on these is the wrath of God; for them shall be a great torment.
16:107: This because they love the life of this world preferring it over the hereafter, and that God guideth not the infidel people.
16:108: These are those who, God hath set a seal on their hearts, and (on) their hearing (ears) and (on) their sights (eyes), and these, they are the heedless (ones)
16:109: Doubtless (it is) that they in the hereafter, they will be the losers.
16:110: Then verily thy Lord unto those who migrate after they are persecuted, then they struggle hard (fight) (for God’s cause) and exercised patience; verily, thy Lord, after that is Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
16:111: (Remember) the day when every soul shall come, pleading for itself, and every soul shall be recompensed fully for what (all) it hath done, and they will not be dealt with unjustly.
16:112: And setteth forth God a similitude: “(Like) a town safe and secure, cometh unto it its sustenance in abundance from every side, then it turned ungrateful to the bounties of God, therefore God made it taste of (getting enveloped into) the extreme of hunger and dread for what they were doing.
16:113: And indeed did come unto them (Our) Apostle from among themselves, but they belied him, so seized them a torment while they were unjust.
16:114: So eat ye of what God hath provided you lawful and good (things), and give ye thanks for God’s bounty if unto Him ye worship.
16:115: Verily He hath forbidden unto you what dieth of itself and blood and the flesh of swine and that over which hath been invoked any name other than God’s; but whosoever be forced to the necessity, nor desiring nor (wilfully) transgressing the limit, then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
16:116: And utter ye not whatever lie describe your tongues (saying): “This is lawful and this is for bidden,” to forge a lie against God; Verily, those who forge a lie against God succeed not.
16:117: It is a very little means of enjoyment and for them is a painful torment.
16:118: And unto those who were Jews We had forbidden what We have (already) related unto thee from before; And We did them not any injustice, but they were unto their own selves unjust.
16:119: Yet verily thy Lord, unto those who do an evil (deed) in ignorance, and turn (repent) after that and make amends, Verily thy Lord is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
16:120: Verily Abraham was an Imam (leader in religion) (for the) people, devoutly obedient to God, upright, and he was not of the polytheists,
16:121: Grateful for His bounties; He (God) chose him and He guided him on the right path.
16:122: And We gave him good in this world, and verily he in the hereafter will surely be of the righteous ones.
16:123: So We revealed unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) that thou followeth the religion of Abraham, the upright one; and he was not of the polytheists.
16:124: Verily the sabbath was ordain ed only for those who differed about it; and verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment in what they used to differ about.
16:125: And call thou unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and kindly exhortation and dispute with them in the manner which is the best; Verily thy Lord knoweth better of him who hath gone astray from His path; and He knoweth best of those guided aright.
16:126: And if ye punish then punish ye as ye were afflicted; But if ye be patient, certainly it will be best for the patient ones.
16:127: And be thou patient (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) and thy patience is not but by (the help of) God, and grieve not for them; and distress not thyself at what they devise.
16:128: Verily God is with those who guard (themselves against evil), and those who do good (to others).
17:1: Glory be to Him Who carried His servant (Apostle Muhammad) by night from the Holy Mosque (of the Ka’ba) to the Farthest Mosque, which We have blessed its environment that We may show unto him, of Our signs; Verily He, is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
17:2: And gave We unto Moses the Book (Torah) and made it a guidance for the children of Israel, (saying) that “Take ye not other than Me (any one as) a guardian.
17:3: (O’ ye!) The offspring of those whom We bore with Noah (in the Ark); Verily, he (Noah) was a grateful servant.
17:4: And We had (expressly) declared unto the children of Israel (a warning) in the Book (Torah saying): “Certainly ye will make mischief in the land twice, and certainly will ye be elated with great arrogance.
17:5: So when came the first of the two (promises), raised We upon you Our servants, with terrible prowess, so they invaded the innermost parts of your abodes; and it was a warning (completely) fulfilled.
17:6: Then returned We unto you the turn (to prevail) against them and aided you with wealth and offspring and made you a numerous host.
17:7: If ye do good, ye do it for your own selves; and if ye do evil it is (in like manner) for your ownselves; So when came the second promise (warning to be fulfilled) (We roused your enemies to) sadden your faces, and that they may enter the Mosque as they entered it the first time, and to destroy whatever they conquered (with) total destruction.
17:8: It may be that your Lord will have mercy on you, but if ye (again) return (to disobedience) We (too) will return (to chastisement), and We have made Hell for the infidels a prison.
17:9: Verily, this Qur’an guideth unto that which is the most upright and announceth glad tidings unto the believers who do good that they shall have a great reward,
17:10: And those who believe not in the hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful torment.
17:11: And prayeth man for evil as he prayeth for good; and man in ever hasty.
17:12: And We have made the night and the day two (of Our) signs, then cause We the sign of the night to pass away and have made We the sign of the day sight-giving that ye may seek grace from your Lord, and that ye may know the number and the count of the years; and every thing have We explained in detail.
17:13: And every man’s destiny We have caused to cling to his neck; and We will bring forth unto him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.
17:14: (It will be said unto him) “Read thou thy book; Sufficeth thine own self today, as a reckoner against thee.
17:15: Whosoever getteth guided aright, verily he getteth guided aright for his ownself; and he who goeth astray, verily he goeth astray against his ownself; nor shall the bearer of a burden bear the burden of another; And We chastise not (any people) until We raise an apostle (among them)
17:16: And when intend We to destroy a town, (first) send We Our commandment to its people who lead easy lives (to obey Us), and yet (when) they transgress in it, then proveth true against it, the word so We destroy it to a complete destruction.
17:17: And how many have We destroyed of the peoples after Noah! and thy Lord is (Himself) sufficient with regard to the sins of his servants, (for He is) the All-Aware, the All-Seeing.
17:18: Whosoever intendeth this (fast hastening) immediate (life) We hasten unto him in it what We please for whomsoever We intend, then assign We unto him the hell; he shall enter it despised, driven away.
17:19: And whosoever intendeth the hereafter and striveth for it a (sincere) striving and he is a believer, these, their striving shall be (recompensed fully) appreciated.
17:20: All We do aid, these and (also) those out of the bounty of thy Lord; and the bounty of thy Lord is not confined.
17:21: Behold (thou) how We caused some of them excel the others; and surely the hereafter is much greater in respect of degrees and greater still in respect of excellence.
17:22: Associate not with God any other gods, lest thou sittest despised, neglected.
17:23: And commanded thy Lord hath that thou shalt worship not (any one) but Him, and goodness to parents; if either or both of them reach old age with thee, utter not unto them (even so much as) “Fie” nor chide them, and speak unto them a generous word.
17:24: And lower unto them the wing of humility out of compassion, and say thou: “O’ My Lord! Have mercy on them as they cherished me when I was little.
17:25: Your Lord knoweth best what is in yourselves; if ye be righteous, then verily He is for the repentants Oft-Forgiving.
17:26: And give to the near of kin his due and to the needy and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy earnings) wastefully.
17:27: Verily the squanderers are the brethren of the satans; and Satan to his Lord is ever an ingrate.
17:28: If thou (helplessly) turn away from them seeking mercy from thy Lord which thou hopest for, then speak unto them (at- least) a kindly word.
17:29: And cause thou not to shackle thy hand unto thy neck, nor stretch it forth to the maximum (limits of) stretching forth, lest thou shouldst (thereafter) sit down blamed, destituted.
17:30: Verily thy Lord extendeth the sustenance for whomsoever He willeth and measureth it He (to a just measure); Verily He is, of His servants ever Fully- Aware, All-Seeing.
17:31: And kill ye not your children for fear of want; We sustain them and yourselves (too); Verily killing them is a great sin.
17:32: And approach ye not adultery, Verily, it is a shameful act, and an evil way (opening to many other evils)
17:33: And kill ye not any one whom God hath forbidden but for a just cause; and whoever is slain unjustly, then indeed have We given his heir the authority, but he shall not be extravagant in slaying; Verily he is aided (by God).
17:34: And approach ye not the property of an orphan save in a way which is good until he attaineth his maturity and fulfil ye the promise; Verily (every) promise shall be questioned about.
17:35: And give ye full measure when ye measure out (anything) and weigh ye with a correct balance; This is good and the fairest in the end.
17:36: And pursue thou not that which thou hast not the know ledge of; Verily, the hearing and the sight and the heart, all these shall be questioned about it.
17:37: And walk thou not on the earth exultingly; for thou (by thy insolence) canst not rend the earth nor reach (the heights of) the mountains in stretching (thyself).
17:38: All this, the evil of it, with thy Lord is hateful.
17:39: This of what thy Lord hath revealed unto thee of wisdom; and set not with God any other god lest thou be cast into the hell, blamed and cast away.
17:40: What! has then your Lord preferred giving you sons, and taken (for Himself) daughters, from (among) the angels? Verily, ye utter an awful saying.
17:41: And indeed have We displayed (the warnings) in this Qur’an that they might take heed; but it addeth not to them save aversion (against the truth).
17:42: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) If there were with Him (any) other gods (also) as they say, then certainly they would have been able to seek against the Lord of the ‘Arsh’ a way.
17:43: Glory be to Him and Exalted is He far above from what they say He is the High, and the Great.
17:44: Celebrate His glory the seven heavens and the earth, and (all) those in them; and there is not any thing but it glorifieth Him, but ye understand not their glorification; Verily, He is the Forbearing, the Oft-Forgiving.
17:45: When thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) recitest the Qur’an We set between thee and those who believe not in the hereafter a hidden veil,
17:46: And We have set on their hearts coverings lest they should understand it (the Qur’an) and in their ears a heaviness and when thou mentionest thy Lord alone, in (reciting) the Qur’an, turn they their backs in aversion.
17:47: We know best what they hearken, when they hearken unto thee, and when they are whispering secretly apart, when say the unjust (unto the believers): “Ye follow none but a man bewitched.
17:48: Behold thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) what similitudes they coin for thee! for they have gone (so far) astray (that) they can not find the way (to truth).
17:49: And say they: “What! when we become (mere) bones and a decayed dust, shall we (even) then in fact be raised up into a new creation?
17:50: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) (Even if) become ye stones or iron,
17:51: Or any other creature which seem yet harder to you (to receive life)”, But they will say “Who will cause us to return?” Say thou: “He Who created you first!” Then will they wag their heads unto thee and say: “When will that be?” Say thou “Maybe it is nigh.
17:52: On the day when He will call you forth, and ye will respond with His praise and ye will think that ye tarried (in your graves) but a little (while).
17:53: And say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto My servants that they should utter (only) that which is best; Verily Satan soweth dissensions among them; Verily Satan unto man is an open enemy.
17:54: Your Lord knoweth you best; If He willeth He will have mercy on you, and if He willeth He will chastise you; and We sent not thee to be a guardian over them (against the evils they do).
17:55: And thy Lord knoweth best (all) those who are in the heavens and the earth; and indeed We have exalted some apostles to some (other apostles): and gave We unto David, ‘Zabur’ (the Psalter).
17:56: Say thou: “Call ye those whom ye fancy (to be gods) other than Him: they shall neither have the power of removing the distress from you nor (even) to alter it.
17:57: Those whom they call, to seek the access unto their Lord (to know) which of them is the nearest (to Him) and hope they for His mercy, and fear they His chastisement; Verily, the chastisement of thy Lord is to be dreaded of.
17:58: And there is not a town but We shall destroy it before the Day of Judgment or chastise it with a severe chastisement; that is written in the Book (of Our Will).
17:59: And nothing hindereth Us that We should send signs save that belied them the ancients; and gave We unto Thamud the She-Camel, an open sign but unto her they did injustice; and We send not signs but to warn (the people).
17:60: And (recollect thou O’ Our Apostle Muhammad) when said We unto thee: “Verily, thy Lord encompasseth the people;” and We caused not the vision which We shewed thee save as a trial for the people, and (similarly) the Accursed Tree in the Qur’an; and We cause them to fear, but it addeth not to them but their grievous transgression.
17:61: And (remember O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) when said We unto the angels: “Prostrate ye (in obeisance) to Adam!” Prostrated all (of them) but ‘Iblis’ (who did it not) said he: “(What!) Am I to prostrate unto him whom Thou hast created of clay?
17:62: He (Iblis) said: “Seest Thou, (This) is (the creature) whom Thou hath honoured above me? If thou respiteth me until the Day of Judgment, I will sever his posterity (under my sway) from its origin save a few.
17:63: Said He: “Begone! But whosoever of them followeth thee, then verily Hell is your recompense, a recompense in full!
17:64: And tear thou away whomsoever of them thou canst with thy voice, and collect (against) them thy cavalry and infantry, and partake with them in (their) riches and (their) children, and make promises unto them;” and promiseth not unto them the Satan but a deceit.
17:65: Verily (as for) My (own) servants, thou shalt not have over them any authority, and sufficeth thy Lord (as their) Guardian.
17:66: Your Lord is He who saileth the ships for you in the sea that ye may seek of His grace; Verily He is ever unto you the Most Merciful.
17:67: When toucheth you any distress in the sea, away go those whom ye invoke, save He (alone) yet when He bringeth you safe unto the land ye turn away (from Him); and man hath ever been ungrateful.
17:68: What! feel ye then secure that He will (not) cause the slope of the earth for you (to be swallowed up) I or that He will (not) send against you a violent wind showering stones (on you), then ye shall find not for you any protector.
17:69: Or feel ye secure that He will (not) take you back into it (the sea) another time, and then send on you a fierce gale and drown you for what ye disbelieved, then ye shall find not against Us any pleader
17:70: And indeed We have honoured the children of Adam, and We carry them in the land and on the sea and We provided them with sustenance of good things, and We have exalted them over most of those whom We have created, by (high) decree of exaltation.
17:71: Remember the Day (of Judgment) when We will summon every people with their Imam (Leader); then whosoever is given his book in his right hand, these shall read their books (with pleasure), and they shall not be dealt with (even) a shred unjustly.
17:72: And whosoever is blind in this (life), he shall in the hereafter (also) be blind and gone further astray from the (right) way.
17:73: And verily they had well-nigh purposed to turn thee away from that which We have revealed unto thee, that thou shouldst forge against Us other than that, and then they would surely have taken thee as a friend.
17:74: And if it was not that We had firmly established thee, thou wouldst surely had been nigh to incline unto them a little,
17:75: In that case We would surely have caused thee taste a double (torment) in this life and a double (torment) after death, (and) then thou wouldst not have found for thee against Us any helper.
17:76: And verily well-nigh they purposed to tare these away from the land, that they might drive thee out from it, but then, they would not have tarried (therein) after thee, but a little.
17:77: This was Our way with those of Our apostles whom We did send before thee, and thou shalt find not in Our way any change.
17:78: Establish prayer (regularly) from the declension of the sun till the darkness of the night, and the recital at the morn; verily the recital at the morn is witnessed.
17:79: And (in a part) of the night, forsake sleep for prayer, in addition to (what is incumbent on) thee; Maybe that exalteth thee thy Lord unto a position praised.
17:80: And say thou (praying): “O’ My Lord! cause me to enter a goodly entrance and cause me to go out (of) a goodly exit, and grant me from unto Thee an authority to assist (me)
17:81: And say thou “The truth hath come and the falsehood hath vanished; Verily falsehood is (a thing by nature) vanishing.
17:82: And We sent down of the Qur’an which is a healing and a mercy unto the believers, but it addeth not to the unjust but perdition.
17:83: And when bestow We our bounties on man, he turneth aside and goeth away (on the reverse) and when toucheth him any evil, he is despondent.
17:84: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad! unto the people): “Every one acteth after his own mould; thus your Lord best knoweth (as to) who (among you) is the best guide of the right path.
17:85: And they ask thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) about the spirit, Say thou “The spirit is, from the command of my Lord, and ye are not given of the knowledge but a little.
17:86: And if We please, We would certainly take away that which We revealed unto thee, then thou wouldst find not for thee against Us any pleader,
17:87: Save the mercy from thy Lord: Verily, His grace on thee is (ever) great.
17:88: Say thou “(Even) if men and the jinn get united (with the object) that they bring the like of this Qur’an, they would bring not the like of it, even though some of them to the others be helpers.
17:89: And indeed have We displayed unto the people, in this Qur’an, every (kind of) example but incline not most of the people save denying.
17:90: And said they: “Never will we believe in thee until thou causeth a spring for us from the earth to gush forth,
17:91: Or (cause it to) be for thee a garden of date-palms and grapes, and (cause) rivers in their midst, gushing forth,
17:92: Or cause the heavens to fall as thou didst assert upon us, in pieces, or bring thou God and the angels (to vouch for thee) face to face (with us),
17:93: Or there be for thee a house of gold, or ascend thou into the heaven; and never will we believe in thy ascending until thou causeth to be sent down unto us a book that we may read it. “Say: thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!)” “Glory be to my Lord; am I aught save a man (sent by God as) Apostle.
17:94: And nothing prevented the people from believing, when came unto them the guidance (from their Lord), save that they said: “What! hath God sent a man (like unto us to be) (His) Apostle.
17:95: Say thou: “If there were in the earth angels walking, settled in security, surely We would have sent down unto them, from the heaven, an angel as an apostle.
17:96: Say thou: “Sufficeth God as a witness between me and you; Verily He of His servants is All- Aware and All-Seeing.
17:97: And whomsoever God guideth, then he is guided aright; and whomsoever He leaveth to stray, thou shalt never find for him any guardians other than Him; and We will gather them together on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, blind dumb and deaf; their abode shall be Hell; so oft as it abateth, We shall increase for them the blaze.
17:98: This is their recompense for they disbelieved in Our signs and said they: “What! when we become (mere) bones and decayed dust, (even) then shall we (in fact) be raised into a new creation?
17:99: What! See they not that God Who created the heavens and the earth, is (certainly) able to create the like of them, and He hath decreed for them a term in which there is no doubt; but incline not the unjust save (to) denying.
17:100: Say thou: If ye own the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, (even) then will ye certainly withhold them for fear of spending; and man is ever niggardly.
17:101: And indeed We gave Moses nine clear signs (miracles); so ask the children of Israel when he came unto them, Pharaoh said unto him; “Verily I deem thee O’ Moses one bewitched
17:102: Said he Indeed, thou knowest that none hath sent these down save the Lord of the heavens and the earth (as) eye opening proofs; and I think thou O’ Pharaoh is doomed to perdition.
17:103: And resolved he to tare them away out of the land, so We drowned him and those with him, all together,
17:104: And said We after that, unto the children of Israel: “Abide ye in peace in the land, but when cometh the later promise, We shall bring you all rolled up (collected together)
17:105: And with truth have We sent it down and with truth it hath come down; and We sent not thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) but as a Giver of glad tidings and as a Warner.
17:106: And it is Qur’an which We have apportioned it so that thou mayest recite it unto the people with deliberation (by degrees), and We have sent it down, gradually in portions.
17:107: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Believe ye in it or believe ye not; Verily those who are (already) given the knowledge from before it, when it is recited unto them they fall down on their faces prostrating in obeisance,
17:108: And say they: “Glorious is our Lord! verily the promise of our Lord was (a certainty) to be fulfilled.
17:109: And they fall down on their faces weeping and it (the listening to the Qur’an) increaseth their humility.
17:110: Say: “Call upon ‘Allah’ (God) or call upon ‘Rahman’ (the Beneficent); whichever ye call upon, for Him (alone) are all the best names; and say thou not thy prayer too aloud, nor say it in too low a voice, but seek between these (extremes) a middle course.
17:111: And say thou: “(All) Praise is God’s, Who hath not taken unto Him a son and Who hath not a partner in the kingdom, and there is not for Him any helper against any humility, and proclaim thou His Greatness magnifying (His Glory).
18:1: All praise is God’s, Who sent down upon His Servant the Book (the Qur’an) and hath not caused in it any crookedness,
18:2: (Made it) straight that he might warn of a severe punishment from Him, and give glad tidings unto the believers who do good, that there is for them a goodly recompense,
18:3: Wherein to abide therein for ever,
18:4: And he may warn those who say: “God hath taken unto Him a son.
18:5: They have no knowledge of it nor their fathers had; grievous is the word that cometh out of their mouths; They speak not but a lie.
18:6: So maybe that thou wilt worry thyself with grief after them, if they believe not in this revelation (the Qur’an).
18:7: Verily We have caused whatever is in the earth an embellishment for it, that We may test them (to prove) as to which of them is best in behaviour.
18:8: And verily We will make whatever is on it bare, barren ground.
18:9: Or thinkest thou that the fellows of the Cave and (of) the inscribe tablet (which) were of Our signs (miracles) (matters) wonderful?
18:10: When sought refuge the youths unto the Cave then said they: “O’ Our Lord! Grant us mercy from unto Thee and provide for us in our affairs a right course”.
18:11: Then We did set a seal on their ears for a number of years,
18:12: Then We raised them up that We might know (i.e., show) which of the two parties reckoneth best the duration of their stay.
18:13: We relate unto thee their story with the truth; verily, they were youths who believed in their Lord and We increased them in guidance.
18:14: And We strengthened their hearts with steadfastness, when they stood up then said they: “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Never will we call other than Him any god, for indeed then we should have uttered extravagantly.
18:15: These our people have taken gods other than Him; why do they bring not a clear authority in their support? who is there more unjust than he who forges against God, a lie.
18:16: And when ye have left them and what they worship but God, betake yourselves for a refuge unto the Cave, your Lord will extend unto you His mercy, and provide for you means of (safety and) ease.
18:17: And thou mightest see the sun, when it rose, decline from their cave unto the right and when it set, leaving them away unto the left, while they were in the cleft thereof; This is of the signs of God; Whomsoever God guideth, he is guided aright, and whomsoever He leaveth to stray, never shalt thou find for him any guide to guide (him) aright.
18:18: And thou wouldst have deemed them awake while they were asleep; and We turned them unto the right and unto the left; and their dog lay stretching his paws at the entrance, Hadst thou looked at them, surely thou wouldst have turned away from them in flight, and surely thou wouldst have been filled with awe of them.
18:19: And thus did We raise them that they might question among themselves. Said one among them: “How long have ye tarried (here);” Said they: “Tarried we a day or a part of a day.” Said (the others): “Your Lord (alone) knoweth best how long ye have tarried (here); Therefore send ye then one among you with this (silver) coin of yours to the city, let him see (find out) which of them hath the purest (most whole some) food, so let him bring unto you provision from it, and let him behave gently, and maketh not you known unto any one.
18:20: For verily if they come to know of you, will stone you, or force you to return into their creed, and then never will ye succeed.
18:21: And thus We did disclose the matter unto them (the people) that they might know that God’s promise is true, and that (about) the Hour (of Judgment) there is no doubt in it. When they disputed among themselves about the affair then said they: “Build a building (monument) over them (their cave); Their Lord knoweth them best” Those (the believers) who prevailed in their affair said: “Certainly we will have over them a Mosque.
18:22: (They will) say: “(they were) Three, the fourth of them was their dog;” and say (some others): “Five, the sixth of them was their dog,” guessing about the unknown; and (yet the others) say: “seven, and the eighth of them was their dog;” Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “My Lord knoweth best their number, knoweth them not but a few;” Therefore contend not about them but a plain contention, and ask thou not any one about them.
18:23: And say ye not (of aught); “Verily I will do it tomorrow,
18:24: Save (say) “If God willeth” and remember thy Lord when thou forgettest and say thou: “Maybe my Lord will guide me nearer than this to the right (way)
18:25: And stayed they in the Cave three hundred years and they add nine (more).
18:26: Say thou: “God (alone) knoweth best how long they stayed; His are the unseen (worlds) of the heavens and the earth; (Glory be to Him) How clear is His sight and how clear is His hearing! There is none for them other than God, any guardian, and He shareth not (with Him) in His sovereignty any one.
18:27: And recite thou what hath been revealed unto thee of the Book of thy Lord; None shall change His word; And thou shalt find not other than Him, any refuge.
18:28: And restrain thou thyself with those who call unto their Lord morning and evening seeking His pleasure, and let not thy eyes turn away from them, aspiring the pomp of the life of this world; and obey not him whose heart We have made unmindful of Our remembrance, and he who followeth his inclination, and his case hath transgressed the limits.
18:29: And say thou: “The truth is from your Lord; so let him who pleaseth believe; and let him who pleaseth disbelieve, verily We have prepared for the unjust (the Hell) fire, encompass them its enclosures; and if cry they for water, they shall be given water like the molten brass which will scald their faces; (how) wretched will be the drink; and (how) ill will be the resting place.
18:30: Verily those who believe and do good deeds, verily We waste not the recompense of him who doth good deeds.
18:31: These, for them are the gardens of eternity beneath which flow rivers, they shall be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they shall wear green robes of fine silk, and thick brocade woven with gold, reclining therein on raised couches; (What a) Blissful recompense (will it be); and (how) goodly (will be) the resting place.
18:32: And set forth unto them a parable: Two men We made for one of them two gardens of grape-vines, and We surrounded the two (gardens) with date palms, and made We corn fields in the midst of the two (gardens)
18:33: Both the gardens brought forth its fruits and failed not aught in it, and We caused a river to gush forth in their midst,
18:34: And he had fruits (in abundance), and said he unto his companion while talking to him: “I am greater than thee in wealth and am mightier in my clan.
18:35: And entered his garden he who was unjust to himself. Said he: “I think not that this will ever perish,
18:36: And I think not that the Hour (of Resurrection and Judgment) will ever come, and even if I am returned unto my Lord, I will (ever) of a certainty find better than this a resort.
18:37: Said unto him his companion while talking to him: “What! disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then He fashioned thee (into) a complete man?
18:38: But as for me He, God is my Lord, and I associate not with my Lord any one.
18:39: And why didst thou not say when thou didst enter thy garden: “(It is) as God willeth! there is no power but with God, if thou dost see me less than thee in wealth and children.
18:40: Yet maybe my Lord may give me better than thy garden, and send on it (on thy garden) thunderbolts (as a reckoning) from heaven, that it becometh barren slippery dust,
18:41: Or get sunk underground its waters and thereafter never thou art able to search for it.
18:42: And his fruits were enwrapped into destruction, so he began wringing his hands for what he had spent in it, and it (his garden) lay fallen on its roofs, and said he: “Alas me! Would that I had not associated with my Lord any one!
18:43: He had no force to help him other than God, nor could he himself help.
18:44: Here (in the event of such a helplessness) protection is only God’s the Truth; He is the Best to reward and the Best to requite.
18:45: And set thou unto them the similitude of the life of this world, like the water which send We down from heaven, and the herbage of the earth mingleth with it, then it becometh dry stubble which the winds scatter; for God over all things hath power.
18:46: Wealth and children are the adornment of the life of this world; and the everlasting good works are best in view of thy Lord in (earning the) reward, and best as hopes (of His mercy).
18:47: And the day when We will cause the mountains to pass away, and thou seest the earth a levelled plain and We will gather them (and) then leave not behind, of them any one.
18:48: And they shall set before thy Lord in ranks; (and it will be said unto them): “Now are ye come unto Us as We created you at first: and yet ye thought never We had made unto you a tryst.
18:49: And (when) the Book of (deeds) is placed then wilt thou see the guilty, dreadful of what is (recorded) in it: and they will say: “Ah woe unto us! What a book is this! it leaveth not aught (of our sins) small or great but enumereth (each one of) them!” And will find they what ever they did, present (in it): and dealeth not thy Lord unjustly with any one.
18:50: And when said We unto the angels: “Prostrate ye unto Adam!” then they (all) prostrated but ‘Iblis’; he was of the jinn, and he transgressed the behest of his Lord; What! would ye then take him and his progeny as friends rather than Me, and they are enemies unto you! Evil for the unjust would be the exchange.
18:51: I called them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor of the creation of their selves; nor am I he who taketh those who lead (people) astray, as helpers.
18:52: And the Day (of Judgment) when He will say: “Call ye on those whom ye thought to be my partners,” and they will call on them, but they will not listen to them, and We will cause between them a valley of perdition.
18:53: And shall see the guilty ones the fire, and apprehend that they are falling into it, and they will find not any escape thence.
18:54: And indeed have We (fully) displayed for mankind in this Qur’an every kind of similitude; but man, of most things, is contentious.
18:55: And nothing preventeth the people from believing when the guidance came unto them, and from asking for the forgiveness from their Lord except overtaketh them, the fate of the ancients or cometh face to face unto them the chastisement.
18:56: And We send not apostles but as bearers of glad tidings and warners; and dispute those who disbelieve with falsehood that they may refute with it the truth, and take they My signs and that they have been warned with, for a jest.
18:57: And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, then he turneth away from them and forgetteth what have sent forth his two hands? Verily We have caused veils over their hearts lest they understand it and in their ears a heaviness; And if thou calleth them unto guidance, never will they in that case get guided aright at all.
18:58: And thy Lord is Oft-Forgiving and the Lord of Mercy; were He to seize them for what they earn, surely He would have hastened for them the chastisement; but for them is a tryst never shall they find, besides it, a refuge.
18:59: And these towns, We did destroy them when they committed iniquities; but We had a tryst for their destruction.
18:60: And (remember) when said Moses unto his boy: “I will cease not until I reach the junction of the two rivers or I will go on (a non-stop march) for years.
18:61: So when they reached the junction of the two (rivers), they forgot their fish and it took its way into the sea making a hole (in the earth).
18:62: But when they had gone (some distance) said he unto his boy “Bring unto us our morning meal, indeed we have met from this our journey weariness.
18:63: He said: “Didst thou see (what happened) when we took refuge on the rock, then verily I forgot the fish, and nothing made me forget to mention of it but the devil; and it took its way into the sea, what a wonder it is!
18:64: He said: “That is (the place) what we were seeking for!” So they retraced their steps,
18:65: Then found they one, from among Our servants whom We had vouchsafed mercy from unto Us and We had taught him knowledge unto Ourselves.
18:66: Said unto him Moses: “Shall I follow thee on condition that thou shouldst teach me aright of what thou hast been taught.
18:67: Said he: “Verily, thou canst not have patience with me.
18:68: How canst thou be patient about what thou comprehendest not its knowledge.
18:69: He said: “Thou wilt find me patient if God willeth, and I shall not disobey thee in any matter.
18:70: Said he: “If thou followest me, ask me not of aught until I myself unto thee make mention of it.
18:71: Then they went (their way) until they embarked in the boat, he made a hole in it. (Moses) said: “Made thee a hole in it to drown its inmates? Indeed thou hast done a strange thing?
18:72: He said: “Said I not unto thee that thou canst not be with me in patience?
18:73: Said he (Moses): “Chide me not that I forgot, and constrain me not to a difficulty in my affair.
18:74: Then they went on until they met a boy, he slew him. Said (Moses): “Slew thou an innocent person, who had slain none? Indeed thou hast done a horrible thing!
18:75: He said: “Said I not unto thee that thou couldst not be with me in patience?
18:76: Said he: “If ever I ask thee about anything after this, then suffer me not to be in thy company; then indeed thou hast had an excuse (to do so) unto me.
18:77: Then went they on until they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they declined to receive them as (their) guests, then they found in it (the town) a wall about to fall, and he set it upright. Said he: “If thou hadst wished, thou mightest surely have taken a return (payment) for it ”.
18:78: He said: “This shall be the parting point between me and thee, now I will acquaint thee of the interpretation of what thou couldst not bear with patience.
18:79: As for the boat, it was of (some) poor men they plied in the sea and I intended that I should damage it, for there was after them a king who seized every boat by force
18:80: And as for the boy, because his parents are believers and feared we that he should grieve them by rebellion (against them) and disbelieve (in God).
18:81: So we did intend that their Lord giveth them instead one better than him in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection.
18:82: And as for the wall, it was of two orphan boys in the city, and was underneath it (depo-sited) a treasure (intended) for them two and their father was a righteous man; so willed thy Lord that they should attain their maturity and take out their treasure (which is) a mercy from thy Lord; and I did it not of my own will. This is the interpretation of what thou couldst not have patience.
18:83: And they ask thee about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say thou: “I shall recite unto you of him a mention.
18:84: (Sayeth the Lord) Verily We did make him mighty in the earth, and We gave him the means of access to every thing,
18:86: Until when he reached the place where settest the sun (the Western most land) and found it (the sun) setting in a black muddy pool, and found by it a people. Said We: “O’ Dhu al-Qarnayn! Either chastise them thou (for their infidelity) or treat them with kindness (if they correct themselves).
18:87: (And) said He: “As to him who is unjust We will chastise him, then he shall be returned unto his Lord, and He will chastise him with a grievous chastisement.
18:88: And as for him who believeth and doeth good, for him shall be a goodly recompense; and We will speak unto him (only) of easy (one of) Our command.
18:90: Until when he reached the place where riseth the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided not any shelter,
18:91: Even so; and indeed We had full knowledge of whatever was with him.
18:93: Until when he reached between two mountains he found on the hither side of the two (mountains) a people who could scarce understand a word.
18:94: Said they: ‘O’ Dhu al-Qarnayn! Verily Gog and Magog cause mischief in the land, shall we collect for thee the (necessary) resources (from among ourselves) so that thou shalt raise between us and them a barrier?
18:95: He said: “The power in which hath my Lord established me is better, so ye help me only with the strength (of labourers), I will make between you and them a barrier,
18:96: Bring ye unto me blocks of iron,” until when it filled the space between the mountain sides, said he: “Ply your bellows,” until he had made it red-hot with fire, he said: “Bring unto me molten brass which I may pour over it.
18:97: So they could not scale it nor could they make a hole in it.
18:98: Said he: “This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord (the Resurrection) cometh to pass, He will level it with the ground; and the promise of my Lord is (always) true.
18:99: And We will let some of them, that day, to dash (like the billows) one another and the Trumpet will be blown, then will We gather them all together,
18:100: And We will present the hell that day, for the disbelievers, fully exposed to their view,
18:101: Those whose eyes were under a veil from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.
18:102: What! think those who disbelieve, that they can take My servants as their guardians besides Me? Verily We have got Hell ready for the infidels to be entertained (therein).
18:103: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Shall We acquaint you of the greatest losers in (their) deeds?
18:104: (They are) those whose labour is lost in the life of this world and they deem that that they were acquiring good by their deeds.
18:105: These are they who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord and meeting Him so vain will be their deeds, nor will We on the Day of Judgment, assign unto them any weight.
18:106: Thus Hell is the recompense for what they disbelieved and held My signs and My Apostles with scorn.
18:107: Verily those who believe and do good there is for them the gardens of Paradise for their entertainment,
18:108: Abiding therein, desiring not to be removed therefrom.
18:109: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Should the sea become ink (to write) the words of My Lord, the sea will certainly be exhausted ere the words of my Lord are exhausted, and though we bring the like of that (the seas) to add thereto.
18:110: (And) say thou: “I am only a man like you, it is revealed unto me that your God is but One God, whosoever therefore desireth to meet his Lord, let him do good deeds, and associate not any one in the worship of His Lord.
19:1: Kaf. Ha. Ya. Ain. Sad. (K. H. Y. A. S.)
19:2: (This is) a mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
19:3: When called he unto his Lord (with) prayer in low voice.
19:4: Said he: “O’ my Lord! Verily my bones are weakened and my head doth glisten with grey hoariness: but never am I in my prayer unto Thee, O’ my Lord! been unblest!
19:5: And verily I fear my kindred (cousins) after me, and my wife is barren, So grant me from Thyself an heir!
19:6: Who shall inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob; and make him O’ my Lord! one with whom Thou art well pleased!
19:7: (The Lord responded to the prayer saying): “O’ Zachariah! Verily We give thee the glad tidings of a son, his name shall be Yahya (John), and We gave not to any one before (him) that name!
19:8: Said he: “O’ my Lord! How can there be for me a son while my wife is barren and indeed I have reached of the old age the extreme infirmity?
19:9: Said He (the Lord): “So shall it be.” Thy Lord sayeth: “Easy is it to Me, for indeed have I created thee aforetime, when thou wert nothing!
19:10: Said he: “O’ my Lord! Vouchsafe me a sign!” He said: “Thy sign is that thou speaketh not to the people for three nights, though sound (in health)!
19:11: Then he went out (of the sanctuary) unto his people and made signs unto them (with his hands) that they should glorify (God) morning and evening.
19:12: (The Lord said unto Zachariah’s son) “O’ Yahya! Hold thou the Book fast!” and We granted him wisdom (apostleship) while yet a child.
19:13: And compassion as from Us and purity, and pious one was he,
19:14: And duteous unto his parents, and neither insolent (nor) disobedient.
19:15: Peace be on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth, and the day he is raised (once again) to life.
19:16: And mention in the Book (Qur’an) about Mary (also) when she withdrew herself from her family (in the house) eastward
19:17: Then she took a veil (cover herself) from them; then sent We unto her Our Spirit, then he (the Spirit) appeared to her a man sound (in form)
19:18: Said she: “Verily I fly for refuge in The Beneficent (God) from thee, (be gone from me) if thou art God-fearing
19:19: Said he: “I am only a messenger (Angel) of thy Lord: so that I give to thee a son purified.
19:20: Said she: “How can there be unto me a son while hath not touched me (any) man and nor was I unchaste!
19:21: Said he “So shall it be; thy Lord sayeth, It is easy for Me, and that We will make him a Sign (miracle) (of Ours) unto the people and a Mercy from Us; It is a matter (already) decreed.
19:22: So she conceived him and retired with him (away from her people) to a remote place.
19:23: And the throes (of childbirth) forced her to betake herself unto the trunk of a palm-tree. She said: “Oh! Had I died ere this, and had been lost in oblivion totally forgotten!
19:24: Then (a voice) called out unto her from beneath her; “Grieve not thou, verily thy Lord hath caused from beneath thee, (to flow) a stream!
19:25: And shake towards thee the trunk of the palm-tree, it will drop on thee dates fresh (and) ripe.
19:26: Then eat and drink and refresh the eye. Then if thou seest any man say: “Verily I have vowed unto the Beneficent (God) a fast so never shall I speak today unto any man.
19:27: And she came with him unto her people carrying him (with her). Said they: “O’ Mary! Indeed thou hath come with an unusual thing!
19:28: O’ sister of Aaron! thy father was not a bad man, nor was thy mother an unchaste woman!
19:29: But she pointed unto him. They said: “How can we speak unto one who is (yet) a child in the cradle
19:30: He (Jesus miraculously) said: “Verily I am a servant of God; He hath given me a Book (Evangel) and made me a Prophet!
19:31: And He hath made me blessed wherever I be and He hath enjoined on me prayer and poor-rate so long as I live!
19:32: And (to be) duteous to my mother, and He hath not made me insolent unblest!
19:33: And peace be on me day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive ”!
19:34: This is Jesus, the son of Mary; (this is) a statement of the truth about which they dispute.
19:35: It beseemeth not God that He should take unto Himself a son, glory be to Him; when a matter is decreed, He only sayeth unto it ‘Be’ and it is
19:36: And verily God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship (only) Him; this is the right way.
19:37: Then did differ the sects among themselves and woe unto those who disbelieved, because of their presenting themselves on the great day.
19:38: How clearly shall they hear and how clearly shall they see on the day when they appear unto Us, but the unjust this day are in manifest straying.
19:39: And warn them of the intense regret, when the matter shall have been decreed while they are (now) in negligence and they believe not.
19:40: Verily We inherit the earth and those who are on it, and unto Us shall they be returned.
19:41: And (make) mention in the Book (Qur’an) Abraham; verily he was a man of Truth, an Apostle (of Ours).
19:42: When said he unto his father, “O’ My Father! Why worshippeth thou that which heareth not, nor doth it see, nor doth it avail thee in aught?
19:43: O’ my father! Indeed hath come unto me, of the knowledge which hath not come unto thee, so follow me: I will guide thee on the path (which is) straight.
19:44: O’ my father! Worship not Satan; Verily Satan unto the Beneficent (God), was disobedient”.
19:45: O’ my father! Verily I fear that toucheth thee chastisement from the Beneficent (God), so that thou be unto Satan a friend.
19:46: Said he: “Inclineth thou against my gods, O’ Abraham; If thou didst desist not certainly I will stone thee; Begone from me for a long while.
19:47: Said he: “Peace be on thee, I will pray unto my Lord to forgive thee; Verily He unto me is most gracious.
19:48: I withdraw from you (all) and what ye call upon other than God, and I call upon (only) my Lord; Happly in my prayer unto my Lord I shall not be unblest.
19:49: And when he withdrew from them and what they worshipped besides God, We granted unto him Isaac and Jacob; and each one of them made We an apostle.
19:50: And granted We unto them of Our mercy, and assigned unto them a lofty tongue of truth fulness.
19:51: And mention in the Book (Qur’an) about Moses; Verily he was one freed, and he was an Apostle and a Prophet.
19:52: And We called unto him from the right side of the Mount Sinai, and made him draw nigh (unto Us) for a communion.
19:53: And granted We unto him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, (also) a Prophet.
19:54: And (make) mention in the Book (Qur’an) Ishmael verily he was (ever) true to his promise, and he was an Apostle, a Prophet.
19:55: And he was enjoining on his family, prayer and charity and was he unto his Lord well-pleasing.
19:56: And mention in the Book (Qur’an) (about) Idris; verily he was a truthful one, a Prophet.
19:57: And We exalted him to a high station.
19:58: These are they on whom did God bestow (His) bounties, from among the prophets of the posterity of Adam; and of those whom We did bare with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We did guide and We did choose; When the signs of the Beneficent (God) were rehearsed unto them, they fell down prostrating (in obeisance) and weeping.
19:59: But followed after them a succession who neglected prayers and they followed lust, so they shall soon meet perdition,
19:60: Except he who repented and believed and did good, then these shall enter the garden {of Paradise), and they shall not be dealt with unjustly in aught,
19:61: The gardens of eternity which the Beneficent (God) hath promised unto His servants, while unseen; Verily His promise shall come to pass.
19:62: They will hear not therein any vain discourse, but only ‘Peace’, and they shall have their sustenance therein, morning and evening.
19:63: This is the garden (Paradise) which We shall cause to be inherited by those of Our servants who are pious.
19:64: (Say the angels, “O’ Apostle of God, Muhammad!) “We come not down (from heaven) but by the command of thy Lord; His is whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is between these! And thy Lord is not forgetful.
19:65: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what (ever) is between them; so worship Him (alone), and be steadfast in His worship! Knowest thou of any other (worthy of being) named (with) of the same name? (as He)?
19:66: And sayeth man: “What! When I am dead shall I be brought forth alive?
19:67: What! Beareth not man in mind that We created him before when he was naught.
19:68: So by thy Lord! Most certainly will we gather them together and the Satan, then shall We certainly bring them forth round the Hell on their knees.
19:69: Then shall We certainly pick out from every group of them those who against the Beneficent (God) were more intensely rebellious.
19:70: And certainly, We do know best those who deserve most to be burnt therein.
19:71: And (there is) not one of you but shall go down unto it; This is of thy Lord a decided (unavoidable) decree
19:72: And then will We deliver those who guarded (themselves) against evil, and We will leave the unjust on their knees.
19:73: And when Our clear signs are rehearsed unto them, say those who disbelieve unto those who believe, which of the two parties is best in position? And which is the most goodly company?
19:74: And how many of the generations We did destroy before them, they were (even) better in riches and in splendour.
19:75: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “As to those who are in error, the Beneficent (God) will certainly lengthen the span (of their) life; until behold they what they were promised, be it the chastisement (in this world) or the Hour (of Doom); Then shall they know who is worse placed and (who is the) weakest in forces!
19:76: And God increaseth in guidance those who are guided aright; and the everlasting good deeds are best with thy Lord, in recompense and best in (the ultimate) return.
19:77: Have thou then seen him who disbelieveth in Our signs and sayeth: “I shall surely be given wealth and children (sons)
19:78: Hath he got into the (secret) knowledge of the unseen? or hath taken from the Beneficent (God) a promise?
19:79: By no means! We will write down what he sayeth and We will lengthen for him the length of the chastisement.
19:80: And We will inherit what he spake of, and he shall come unto Us all alone.
19:81: They have taken gods besides God that they shall be unto them a source of strength,
19:82: By no means! Soon shall they disavow their worship, and they shall unto them be adversaries.
19:83: What! Seest thou not that We have sent satans against the dis believers to incite them with an incitement (to sin),
19:84: So be not thou in haste against them, We only count unto them a limited number (of days).
19:85: On the day (of resurrection) We will gather the pious ones unto the Beneficent (God) like the guests of honour,
19:86: But We will drive the guilty ones, unto Hell like (the thirsty) herd (to the watering place).
19:87: They shall own not any intercession, save he who hath taken a promise from the Beneficent (God to do so).
19:88: And say they: “The Beneficent (God) hath taken unto Him a son!
19:89: Indeed, have ye put forth a thing (most) monstrous!
19:90: Might the heavens be almost rent thereat, and the earth cleaveth asunder, and the mountains fall down in fragments,
19:91: That they should ascribe unto the Beneficent (God) a son!
19:92: And it behoveth not the Beneficent (God) that He should take (unto Him) (any one) a son.
19:93: None there is in the heavens and the earth but must come unto the Beneficent (God) as a servant.
19:94: And indeed He hath an account of (all), and numbered them (with) an exact numbering.
19:95: And each one of them shall come unto him on the Day of Judgment, singly (alone).
19:96: Verily those who believe and work good deeds the Beneficent (God) will appoint love for them.
19:97: So have We only made it (Qur’an) easy in thine own tongue that thou mayest give glad tidings thereby unto the pious ones, and warn by it a people (who are) contentious.
19:98: And how many of the generations We did destroy before them? Dost thou find out any one (anywhere)? or dost thou hear (even) a whisper (of them)?
20:2: O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) Sent We not down the Qur’an unto thee that thou distressest thyself!
20:3: Save it is a Reminder unto him who feareth (God)
20:4: It is a Missive (sent down) from Him who created the earth and the heavens on high.
20:5: The Beneficent (God) on the ‘Arsh’ is firm
20:6: His is what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and what is between them two and what is beneath the lowest of the low below the earth.
20:7: And if thou utter aloud (or in whisper) Verily (alike) knoweth He (all that is) secret and (whatsoever is) yet more hidden.
20:8: God, there is no god but He; His are (all) the Best names.
20:9: And hath come unto thee the story of Moses?
