20:10: When he saw fire, then said he unto his family, “Tarry ye here, for verily I perceive a fire: happly I may bring unto you a brand from it, or I find at the fire some guidance.
20:11: So when he came unto it (the fire) a voice called: “O’ Moses!
20:12: Verily I; I (alone) am thy Lord! So take off thy shoes! Verily thou art in the sacred valley of ‘Tuwa
20:13: And I have chosen thee (for apostleship) then hearken thou unto what is revealed (unto thee)?
20:14: Verily I, I (alone) am God: There is no god but I: worship thou (only) Me, and establish prayer for My remembrance!
20:15: Verily the Hour (of Doom) is sure to come but I am about to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be recompensed as he striveth:
20:16: Therefore let him who believeth not in it and followeth his own vain desires turn thee away from the truth, lest thou perish.
20:17: And what is this in thy hand O’ Moses!
20:18: Said he: “This is my staff; I recline on it, and I beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and for me therein are other uses (also).
20:19: He said: “Cast it down, O’ Moses!
20:20: Then he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent running.
20:21: He said: “Lay hold on it, and fear thou not; for We will restore it to its former state (of a staff)
20:22: And place thy hand under thy armpit, it shall come forth white, without any harm, (and this is) another sign (miracle),
20:23: That We may show thee of Our greatersigns (miracles)
20:24: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Verily he hath transgressed the bounds!
20:25: Said he “O’ My Lord! Expand for me my breast,
20:26: And make easy for me my task,
20:27: And loosen the knot of my tongue,
20:29: And appoint for me an aider from my family,
20:32: And associate him (with me) in my affair,
20:33: That we may glorify Thee much,
20:35: Verily Thou art ever seeing of us.
20:36: Said He: “Granted is thy prayer, O’ Moses!
20:37: And indeed We conferred Our favour on thee at another time,
20:38: When We revealed unto thy mother what was revealed (unto her),
20:39: That: “Cast him into a chest, then cast it into the sea, then the sea shall throw him ashore”; there taketh him (up) one (who is an) enemy unto Me and an enemy unto him; and I cast down upon thee love from Me (that everyone may love thee); so that thou mightest be brought up under My eyes (as I will):
20:40: When thy sister went (unto Pharaoh’s wife) and said: “Shall I show you one who will take care of him?” So We brought thee back unto thy mother, that her eyes be cooled and she might grieve not; And thou didst kill a man (and wert perturbed) and We delivered thee from the grief and We tried thee with a heavy trial and then thou didst tarry years among the people of Midian, then thou didst come hither as ordained (by Us), O’ Moses!
20:41: And I have chosen thee for Myself;
20:42: Go thou and thy Brother with My signs (miracles) and slacken not either of you in remembering Me.
20:43: Go ye both unto Pharaoh, Verily he hath transgressed (the bounds)
20:44: Then speak ye both unto him a gentle word, happly he may get admonished or fear (Our punishment),
20:45: Said both “O’ Our Lord! Verily fear we that he breaketh forth against us, or lest he getteth uncontrolled.
20:46: Said (God): “Fear not ye both! Verily I am with ye both; I do hear and see
20:47: So go ye both unto him, and say”: “Verily we are apostles from thy Lord, so send thou with us the children of Israel, and torment them not! indeed have we brought signs (miracles) from thy Lord; and peace will be unto him who followeth the guidance;
20:48: Verily, hath it been revealed unto us that indeed the chastisement shall certainly come upon him who belieth and turneth back.
20:49: Said (Pharaoh): “And who is the Lord of ye two, O’ Moses!
20:50: Said he (Moses): “Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its (suitable) form, and then (also) guided it (aright)
20:51: (Pharaoh) said: “What then is the state of the generations past?
20:52: He said: “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Book (secured by Him), erreth not my Lord, nor doth He forget.
20:53: He Who made the earth for you a bed and made for you therein paths, and sent down from the heavens water; then thereby have We brought forth pairs of plants, various (in kinds)
20:54: Eat ye and pasture your cattle; Verily in this there are signs for those endowed with understanding
20:55: From it (the earth) We created you, and into it will We return you, and out of it will We bring you forth for a second time.
20:56: And indeed We did show unto him Our signs, all of them, but he belied and refused (to believe)
20:57: Said he: “Hast thou come unto us that thou turneth us out of our land by thy sorcery, O’ Moses!
20:58: Then we too will certainly produce before thee a sorcery like unto it, so make between us and thee a tryst, we will not fail it, (neither) we nor thou, in a place alike for both
20:59: (Moses) said: “Your tryst be the day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered together in the bright of the noon.
20:60: So Pharaoh turned back and collected his crafts thereafter he came.
20:61: Said Moses unto them, “Woe unto you! forge ye not a lie against God: lest He destroyeth you by a sorcery. And faileth he who forgeth a lie.
20:62: Then they (the magicians) disputed about their affair among themselves and they spake apart in secret.
20:63: (At last) Said they: “These two are certainly two (expert) sorcerers who intend to drive you out from your land by the sorcery of them both and wipe out your most exemplary tradition!
20:64: So muster your plan: then come in (organized) order: And indeed shall succeed he this day who overcometh!
20:65: They said: “O’ Moses! Either cast thou (first) or shall we be the first who cast down?
20:66: (Moses) said: “Nay! cast ye down (first) Then lo! Their cords and their rods, seemed to him by their sorcery as if they were running.
20:67: Then Moses felt in himself a fear.
20:68: Said We: “Fear thou not! Verily thou shalt be the uppermost.
20:69: And cast down what is in thy right hand: It shall swallow up what they have wrought; Verily they have wrought by the plan of a sorcerer, and a sorcerer shall not be successful whatso ever manner (of skill) he may come from.
20:70: Then fell down the sorcerers prostrating (in obeisance) they said: “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses!
20:71: Said (Pharaoh): “Believe ye in him ere I give ye leave (to do it)? Verily he is your Chief (sorcerer) who hath taught you sorcery, so I shall certainly cut off your hands and your feet on the opposite sides, and I will certainly crucify you on the trunks of the palm trees, then will ye certainly know which of us is more severe in tormenting and abiding!
20:72: They said: “Never will we prefer thee (O’ Pharaoh!) to what hath come unto us of the clear signs, and to Him Who made us, so decree thou whatever decree thou decreeth; for thou canst decree only about the life of this world
20:73: Verily we! we do believe in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and the sorcery thou didst compel us (to do); and God is the Best and the Most Abiding!
20:74: And verily he who cometh unto his Lord as guilty, for him certainly is Hell; he shall die not in it nor shall he live.
20:75: And whosoever cometh unto Him as a believer and who hath indeed done good deeds, these, for them are the ranks high,
20:76: The Gardens of Eternity, beneath which flow rivers, to abide therein; and this is the recompense of him who purifieth himself (from evil).
20:77: And indeed We revealed unto Moses (saying); “Travel thou by night with My servants, and strike for them a dry path in the sea, not fearing to be overtaken (by Pharaoh), nor be thou afraid (of getting drowned)
20:78: And followed them Pharaoh with his hosts, so covered them (the billows) of the sea, as they were they covered (drowned).
20:79: And Pharaoh led astray his people and he did not guide them (aright)
20:80: (“O’ Children of Israel!) We rescued you from your foe; and We made a covenant with of Israel!) you on the right side of ‘Tur’ (the Mount Sinai), and We sent down unto you Manna and quails:
20:81: Eat ye of the good things We have provided you with and transgress not in it, lest descendeth on you My wrath, and on whomsoever My wrath doth descend, indeed he is perished.
20:82: And verily I am the Most Forgiving unto him who repenteth and believeth and doth good, then he doth continue to follow the right guidance.
20:83: (Said God): “But what made thee hasten (thyself on apart) from thy people, O’ Moses!
20:84: Said (Moses): “They are close on my track and I hastened unto Thee O’ my Lord! that thou mightest be well pleased (with me)!
20:85: Said (God): “Verily We have tried thy people in thine absence, and the Samiri had led them astray.
20:86: So returned Moses unto his people angered, sorrowfully said he! “O’ my people! Did not your Lord promise you a goodly promise? Did then the promise seem long to you? or did ye wish, or desired ye that the wrath from your Lord should light upon you? that ye violated the tryst with me?
20:87: Said they: “We violated not the tryst with thee of our own accord, but we were made to bear the burdens of the ornaments of the people, so we cast them away, and thus didst the Samiri suggest
20:88: Then he brought forth (from the fire) for them (the image of) a calf, a (mere) body; which (also) gave out the lowing sound; Then they said: “This is your god and the god of Moses, but he (Moses) hath forgotten,
20:89: What! See they not that it could not return unto them a word (for an answer) and that it could neither hurt nor benefit them?
20:90: And indeed Aaron had said unto them before: “O’ my people! Verily, ye are tried by it (the image) and verily your Lord is the Beneficent (God), so follow me and obey ye my order.
20:91: Said they: “Never will we cease worshipping it until returneth unto us Moses.
20:92: (Moses) said: “O’ Aaron! What hindered thee when thou didst see them going astray,
20:93: That thou didst not follow me? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?
20:94: Said (Aaron): “O’ son of my mother! Seize me not by my beard nor by my head; I was afraid lest sayest thou: “Thou hast caused a division among the children of Israel and didst not respect my word!
20:95: (Moses) said: “What was thy object O’ Samiri?
20:96: Said (Samiri): “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful of (the dust) from the track of the Messenger (Angel), and flung it (into the image of the calf) for so did my self prompt me (to do)
20:97: (Moses) said: “Begone then, verily for thee it shall be in this life to say: ‘Touch me not’; and (besides this) thou hast a tryst (of punishment) never will that fail; and (now) look at thy god whose worship thou kept (so long); Certainly will we burn it, then certainly will we scatter (the ashes of) it in the sea (with a wide) scattering!
20:98: Verily your God is only ‘Allah’ (God); There is no god but He; He comprehendeth all things in (His) knowledge!
20:99: Thus do We relate unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) of the (historic) accounts of what hath passed (of old); and indeed have We given unto thee from Ourselves a Reminder (Qur’an).
20:100: Whosoever turneth aside from it, verily he shall bear on the Day of Resurrection, a burden,
20:101: Abiding in it; while grievous will it be for them on the Day of Resurrection to bear,
20:102: (On) the day when the Trumpet shall be blown and We will gather the guilty ones, and the blue eyed ones.
20:103: They shall consult among themselves in a low voice (saying): “Ye did tarry but ten (days)
20:104: We know best what they will say, when the most ideal ones of them in conduct will say: “Ye tarried not but a day!
20:105: And they ask thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) about (what will happen to) the mountains (on the Day of Resurrection), say then, “My Lord will root them up and scatter them away as dust,
20:106: Then leave it a plain, smooth level,
20:107: Thou shall see not in it any crookedness or unevenness
20:108: On that day they shall follow the summoner no crookedness (shall be shown) unto him, and low shall be the voices before the Beneficent (God), that thou shalt hear not aught but the light footfall.
20:109: On that day shall avail not intercession (of any) save (that of) whom hath permitted God, and whose word He is pleased with.
20:110: Knoweth He what is before them and what is behind them, while they comprehend Him not in (their) knowledge.
20:111: And (all) faces shall be humbled before the Ever-Living, The Self- Subsistent God, and indeed disappointed will be he who beareth iniquity.
20:112: And whosoever doth good deeds and he be a believer, he shall fear not of (the least) injustice (unto him), nor of (any) curtailment (of his dues).
20:113: Thus have We sent down (unto thee O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) an Arabic Qur’an and explained therein some of the threats, that they may adopt piety or that it may serve unto them a reminder.
20:114: High above all is God, the King, the (Self-Existent) Truth; And hasten not (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) with the Qur’an ere its completed unto thee its revelation, and say thou: “O’ my Lord! increase me in knowledge!
20:115: And indeed had We covenanted unto Adam before, but he forgot; but We did not find in him any intention (to disobey Us).
20:116: When said We unto the angels “Prostrate ye in obeisance unto Adam!” they did prostrate on obeisance save ‘Iblis’; he refused.
20:117: Then said We: “O’ Adam! Verily this is an enemy unto thee and thy wife; therefore, let him not drive ye both out of the Garden for (then) thou shouldst be put to toil.
20:118: For thee it is ordained that thou shalt not be hungry in it, nor (shalt thou be) naked,
20:119: And that thou shalt not be thirsty in it, nor shalt thou feel the heat of the sun.
20:120: But Satan whispered unto him saying: “O’ Adam! shall I guide thee unto the tree of eternity and unto a kingdom which decayeth not?
20:121: Then they both ate of it, so their nakedness appeared unto them, and they both began to cover themselves with the leaves of the Garden; And Adam acted not (to the advices of) his Lord (deceived by Satan) and got astray.
20:122: Then his Lord chose him and turned unto him (accepting his repentance) and guided him.
20:123: (And God) said: “Get down hence ye two, all together, one of you (being) the enemy unto another. So will surely come unto you guidance from Me, then whoever followed! My guidance, he shall go not astray nor put to grief
20:124: And whoever turneth away from My monition, verily his shall be a life straitened, and We shall raise him up on the Day of Judgment, blind.
20:125: He shall say: “O’ my Lord! why hast thou raised me blind? Whereas indeed I was seeing (before)?
20:126: (God) will say: “Thus (is the recompense) for did come unto thee Our signs but thou didst ignore them; And even so art thou forsaken this day
20:127: And thus will We recompense him who doth transgress and believeth not in the signs of his Lord; and certainly the torment of the hereafter be more severe and more lasting.
20:128: What! Doth it guide them not aright (to know) how many of the generations We did destroy before them, amidst whose dwellings they (now) walk about? Verily, in this are signs for those (endowed) with understanding.
20:129: And had not a word (of respite) from thy Lord gone forth their arrest had immediately been ensued; And the term (of respite for them) is appointed
20:130: So be thou patient with what they say, and glorify thy Lord by praising Him ere the rising of the sun and ere the setting of it; And in some hours of the night also do glorify (Him), and during parts of the day, that thou mayest achieve the pleasure (of they Lord).
20:131: And strain not thine eyes unto that which We have provided (different) parties of them, (of) the splendour of the life of this world, so that We may try them in it; for the provision of thy Lord is better and more abiding.
20:132: And enjoin prayer on thy followers, and adhere thou steadily unto it, We ask thee not for subsistence; (but) We (Ourselves) give thee subsistence; and the (success of the) hereafter is for the guarding (against evil).
20:133: And say they: “Why doth he not bring unto us a sign from his Lord,” What! Hath not there come unto them the clear evidence which were in the former scriptures?
20:134: And had We destroyed them with a chastisement before him (The Apostle Muhammad) certainly would they have said: “O’ Our Lord! Why didst thou not send unto us an apostle, for then would we have followed Thy signs ere that we were (thus) humbled and disgraced.
20:135: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Every one (of us) is awaiting, so do ye (also) await: then soon ye will come to know who have been the followers of the even way and who hath been the guided aright.
21:1: Hath drawn nigh unto the people (the day of) their reckoning, and they in heedlessness are turning aside.
21:2: (There) Cometh not unto them a reminder from their Lord, anew, save they hear it and they get busy in sport.
21:3: Pre-occupied at their hearts with trifles; and discoursed in secret; those who did wrong (saying) “Is this (man) other than a human being like unto yourselves; What! will ye then yield unto sorcery while ye see (it)?
21:4: He said: “My Lord (well) knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heaven and the earth; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
21:5: Nay! say they: (these are) medleys of dreams! Nay! he hath forged it; Nay! he is a poet; let him then bring unto us a sign like unto the ones that were sent unto the former ones (of the apostles).
21:6: Believed not before them (the people of) any of the towns which We did destroy: what! will these (now) believe?
21:7: And We sent not before thee, but men unto whom We did reveal, so ask ye the people of the Reminder if ye know not.
21:8: We made them not (such) bodies not eating the food, and they were not to abide (in this world) for ever.
21:9: Then fulfilled We unto them Our promise (of punishment), then We delivered them, and those whom We willed, and We destroyed the extravagant ones.
21:10: Indeed have We sent down unto you a Book (the Qur’an) wherein is your remembrance; What! Do ye not then understand?
21:11: How many a town (the people of) which were iniquitous, We did destroy, and raised We up after it another people?
21:12: So when they felt (the coming of) Our torment, lo! they began (trying) to fly from it.
21:13: (Said We ): “Flee not ye but return unto that wherein ye revelled, and unto your dwellings, happly ye will be questioned.
21:14: Said they: “Oh! Woe unto us! Verily, we were unjust!
21:15: And ceased not this their cry till We made them like reaped corn, extinct.
21:16: And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them for sport.
21:17: Had We intended that We should take amusement, We could certainly have taken it from (the things) with Us, if We had been doing (it) We had willed to do it.
21:18: Nay! We hurl truth upon falsehood, that it crusheth its head, and lo! it vanisheth; and woe unto you for what ye describe (of God).
21:19: And His is whosoever is in the heavens and the earth; and those who are with Him are not proud to worship Him, nor do they get weary.
21:20: They glorify (Him) by night and day, they (even) intermit not.
21:21: Or have they taken gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
21:22: Had there been in (the heavens and the earth) (other) gods except God, they both had been in disorder; So glorified is God, the Lord of the ‘Arsh’ (High above) from what they attribute (unto Him).
21:23: He is not questioned about what He doeth, but they shall be questioned.
21:24: Have they taken beside Him other gods? Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Bring ye your proof: (that they are gods). This (Qur’an) is the Reminder unto those with me, and the Reminder unto those before me; Nay! most of them know not the truth, so they turn aside.
21:25: And sent We not before thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) any apostle but revealed We unto him that “Verily there is no god but I; so worship ye Me (alone)
21:26: And say they: “The Beneficent (God) hath taken unto Him a son; Glory be to Him! Nay! They are (His) honoured servants.
21:27: They speak not ere He speaketh, and they on His bidding (only) act.
21:28: Knoweth He what is before them and what is behind them, and they can not intercede but for him whom He approveth, and they, of His fear, tremble.
21:29: And whosoever of them sayeth; Verily I am god besides Him, such a one will We recompense with hell; Thus do We recompense the iniquitous.
21:30: Or see not those who disbelieve that the heavens and the earth were one piece, and that We clave them asunder; and made We of water everything alive; Will they not then believe?
21:31: And We have made in the earth, (lofty) mountains (standing firm) lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways that they may be guided aright.
21:32: And We have made the heavens a canopy, well guarded; and yet they, from its signs turn aside.
21:33: And He it is Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all in their (respective) orbits move (in a swim).
21:34: We granted not unto any man before thee life eternal, What! then if thou diest, will they live for ever?
21:35: Every soul shall taste of death; We try you with evil and (with) good (by way of) a test; and unto Us shall ye (all) be returned.
21:36: When behold thee those who disbelieve, they take thee not but for a ridicule; (saying) “Is this he who speaketh of your gods?” and (while) they, at the mention of the Beneficent (God), are themselves disbelievers.
21:37: Man is made of haste; I shall show you My signs, so ask Me not to hasten (on)
21:38: And say they: “When will this threat come to pass, if ye be truthful?
21:39: If only know those who disbelieve, (of the time) when they shall not be able to keep off from their faces and the backs the (Hell) fire nor shall they be helped.
21:40: Nay! but it shall come on them suddenly, and make them confounded, so they shall neither be able to repel it, nor will they (then) be respited.
21:41: And indeed were (also) ridiculed (some) of the apostles before thee, but surrounded those who ridiculed that (very torment) which they had been ridiculing.
21:42: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): Who can protect you by night and by day from the Beneficent (God)? Nay! they from the remembrance of their Lord turn aside.
21:43: Or have they gods who can protect them from Us; They have no power to help their own selves, and nor shall they from Us be protected.
21:44: Nay! Provided We (enjoyment) unto these and their fathers until lasted their life; What! See they not that We come unto the land, shortening its borders; Shall they then be the prevailing ones?
21:45: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Verily I do but warn you by the revelation (from God):” But the deaf will hear not whenever they are warned.
21:46: And yet if toucheth them a blast of thy Lord’s punishment, certainly will they say, “Woe unto us! Verily we had been unjust!
21:47: And We shall set up the balances of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least; and even if there be the weight of a grain of mustard seed, (even that) will We bring it (into account); And sufficient are We (as) reckoners.
21:48: And indeed We did grant unto Moses and Aaron the (Book of) Criterion (between the right and wrong), and Light and a Reminder for the pious ones.
21:49: Those who fear their Lord unseen, and of the Hour (of doom) they are frightened.
21:50: And this (Qur’an) is a Reminder full of blessings which We have sent it down (Unto Our Apostle Muhammad) Do ye then deny it?
21:51: And indeed gave We unto Abraham his rectitude before, and We did know him well.
21:52: (Recollect thou O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) when (Abraham) said unto his father and his people: “What are these images unto which ye (as devotees) cleave
21:53: Said they: “Found we our fathers, worshippers unto them
21:54: Said he: “Indeed ye and your fathers had been in error manifest.
21:55: Said they: “Hast thou brought unto us the truth, or art thou of the jesters?
21:56: Said he: “Nay! Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who hath created them; and I am unto this, one of the witnesses.
21:57: And by God, I will scheme against your idols after ye go away, turning back
21:58: So he broke them into pieces, except the chief of them, that happly they may unto him return.
21:59: Said they: “Who hath done this to our gods? Verily he is of the unjust ones
21:60: (Some others) said: “We heard a youth speak of them, he is called Abraham
21:61: They said: “Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness.
21:62: Said they: “Hast thou done this to our gods, O’ Abraham?
21:63: (Abraham) said: “Nay! Hath done it he, the chief of them is this (idol) so ye ask them, if they can speak
21:64: Then they turned unto them selves and said, “Verily, ye are yourselves the unjust ones,
21:65: Then they were confounded in their heads, (and they helplessly said): “Thou knowest fully well that these (idols) speak not!
21:66: Said: (Abraham) “What! worship ye then besides God what profiteth you not, nor do any harm unto you?
21:67: Fie on you and on what ye worship besides God. What! Do ye not understand?
21:68: Said they: “Burn him and help your gods, if ye can do (anything at all);
21:69: Said We; “O’ fire! Be thou cold, and a safety unto Abraham,
21:70: And they intended a device against him, but We made them the greatest losers,
21:71: And We delivered him and (also) Lot, (and took them safely) to the land which We have blessed for all worlds.
21:72: And We gave him Isaac, and Jacob, as a further gift, and made We all of them righteous ones.
21:73: And We made them leaders, guiding (the people) by Our command, and revealed We unto them the doing of good, and the establishing of prayer, and the giving of alms, and (only) unto Us did they worship,
21:74: And Lot, We gave him wisdom, the knowledge; and We delivered him from the town which were doing filthiness; for they were people evil, perverse,
21:75: And We admitted him into Our mercy; verily he was of the righteous ones.
21:76: And (remember) Noah, when he cried aforetime, then We responded unto him and delivered him and his companions from the great calamity.
21:77: And We helped him against his people who belied Our signs; verily they were an evil people, so We drowned them all.
21:78: And David and Solomon when they were judging about the corn-field when the sheep of the people pastured in it by night, and We unto their judgment were among the witnesses,
21:79: Then We made Solomon to understand it; and unto each one gave We wisdom and knowledge, and We made subservient with David the mountains and the birds; to sing hymns of (Our praise) And We were the doers.
21:80: And We taught him the art of making the coat of mail for you that ye might protect yourselves in your wars; Will ye then be grateful?
21:81: And unto Solomon (We subjected) the wind blowing violent, blowing at his command unto the land wherein We had blessed; And We are, of all things the Knowers.
21:82: And of the satans there were those who used to dive for him and to do other work besides that; and We were guardians over them,
21:83: And (Remember) Job (Ayyub), when he cried unto his Lord (saying); “Verily hath touched me distress, and Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones!
21:84: So We responded unto him and We removed what he was distressed with, and We gave him and his family and the like of them with them, a mercy from unto Us, and a reminder unto the worshippers (of Ours).
21:85: And (remember) Ishmael and Idris and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient ones.
21:86: And We admitted them into Our Mercy; Verily they were of the righteous.
21:87: And (remember) Yunus i.e. Zunnun when went he in anger, and imagined he that never would We straiten him; Then he cried out from the darkness: “There is no god but “Thou (O’ my Lord!), Glory be to Thee, verily I was of the unjust ones!
21:88: Then responded We unto him and delivered him from the grief, thus do We deliver the believers.
21:89: And (remember) Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: “O’ my Lord! Leave me not alone (without an issue) though Thou art the Best of heirs!
21:90: Then responded We unto him and gifted unto him John (Yahya), and adjusted his wife (of her barrenness) for him; verily, they did vie in goodness and did call unto Us, with love and reverence, and were unto Us humbled
21:91: And (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad! remember) her (Mary) who guarded her chastity We breathed into her Our Spirit, and We made her and her son a sign unto all peoples.
21:92: Verily, this (Islam) is your group, one group and I am your Lord! therefore worship ye Me (alone)!
21:93: But they have rent asunder (this) their concern among them selves (into sects), (and yet) unto Us shall all of them return.
21:94: So whosoever shall do of good deeds and he be a believer, there shall not be any rejection of his endeavour, and verily, We will write it down for him.
21:95: And is forbidden unto (the people of) the towns which We did destroy that they shall not return.
21:96: Until are let loose the Gog and the Magog and they shall from every elevation hasten forth.
21:97: And the true promise shall draw nigh, then lo! stare amazedly, the eyes of those who disbelieve; (and they shall say): “Woe unto us! Indeed were we in heedlessness as to this; Nay! we were unjust ones.
21:98: Verily, ye and what ye worship beside God, shall be the fuel for hell; unto ye shall arrive.
21:99: Were these been gods they would not have come unto it and all shall abide therein.
21:100: For them therein shall be groaning, and they therein shall not hear (any other sound)
21:101: Verily those for whom hath went forth from Us goodness, those from it (Hell) shall be kept away,
21:102: They will hear not (even) the slightest sound of it (Hell), and they in what their souls desire, shall abide.
21:103: Shall grieve them not the great terror and the angels shall meet them (saying): “This is your Day, which ye were promised
21:104: On that day will We roll up the heaven, as is rolled up the written scroll; As we caused the first creation, so will We get it return. (It is) a promise binding Us, Verily We were doing it.
21:105: And indeed We did write in the Psalms (Zabur) (given to David) after the Reminder (at-Tawrat given to Moses), that the earth, shall inherit it My servants righteous.
21:106: Verily in this is a conveyance for a people who worship (Us).
21:107: And We sent thee not (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) but a Mercy unto (all) the worlds.
21:108: Say: “It hath only been revealed unto me that your God is One God: Will ye then submit (unto Him i.e. be Muslims)
21:109: And if they turn back say: “I have warned you all alike; and I know not whether nigh or far, is that which ye are promised.
21:110: Verily, He knoweth what is spoken aloud, and He knoweth (too) what ye hide
21:111: And I know not (also) happly this (respite) may be a trial for you and a provision until a time.
21:112: Said (the Apostle Muhammad praying): “O’ my Lord! Judge Thou with truth; And Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is sought against what ye ascribe (unto Him)
22:1: O’ ye People! Fear ye your Lord! Verily, the quake of the Hour (of Doom) is a thing tremendous!
22:2: On the day ye shall behold it, every suckling mother shall forsake her suckling babe; and every pregnant female shall drop her load, and thou shalt behold the people (as) intoxicated; But the wrath of God will be (so) terrible.
22:3: And among the people there is he who disputeth about God without knowledge, and followeth every rebellious Satan,
22:4: Against him is decreed that whosoever taketh him as his friend, then verily shall he beguile him and lead him unto the torment of the burning fire.
22:5: O’ people! if ye be in doubt about (your) rising again (resurrection), then (reflect ye that) verily We created you from dust, then from sperm, then from a clot, then from a lump of flesh, formed and (sometimes) partly unformed, that we may manifest (our power) unto you, and We cause to stay in the womb what We will until an appointed term, then We bring ye forth as babes, then (foster you) that ye reach your maturity; and of you is he who is caused to die, and of you is he who is brought back to the feeblest (state of) old age that he knoweth not aught after knowing (much), and ye behold the earth dried, dead, but when send We down on it water, it is stirred (to life) and swelleth up and produceth every kind of attractive herbage (in pairs).
22:6: This is because Verily God, He is the Reality, and because verily He giveth life unto the dead, and because verily He, over all things hath power.
22:7: And that the Hour (of Resurrection) is coming there is no doubt therein and that God will raise up those in the graves.
22:8: And among the people there is he who disputeth about God without knowledge and without any guidance and without any enlightening book,
22:9: Turning away haughtily that he may beguile (others) from the way of God; For him in this world is disgrace and We shall make him taste on the Day of Judgment the punishment of the burning (Hell fire)
22:10: (And unto him will be said): “This is for what sent before thy two hands, and that (verily) God is not unjust to His servants.
22:11: And of the people is he who worshippeth God (standing) on the verge, so if befalleth unto him good he is satisfied, and if afflicteth him a trial, he turneth back his face; loses he both this world and (also) the here after; That is a loss (which is) manifest.
22:12: He calleth besides God, that which harmeth him not nor doth it profit him; that is straying far off.
22:13: He calleth upon him whose hurt is nearer than his profit: verily evil is the lord, and evil certainly is the associate.
22:14: Verily God will admit those who believe and do good deeds, into gardens ’neath which flow rivers; Verily God doeth what He intendeth.
22:15: Whoever thinketh that never will God help him (the Apostle Muhammad) in this life nor in the hereafter, let him stretch a cord unto the heaven (to raise himself) and hang himself, then let him cut it off, then see if his device taketh away what he is enraged at.
22:16: And thus have We sent it down, as signs manifest, and that verily God guideth whomsoever He intendeth.
22:17: Verily, those who believe and those who are Jews and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians (Zoroastrians) those who associate (other gods with God), verily, God will decide between them on the Day of Judgment; Verily God is witness over all things.
22:18: Seest thou not that God (is He), unto Him prostrateth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and animals, and many of the people; and many there are unto whom hath become due the chastisement; and whomsoever God abaseth, then there is none for him to honour; Verily God doeth whatever He willeth.
22:19: These are the two disputants who dispute about their Lord; but for those who disbelieved, shall be cut off for them garments of fire; (and) shall be poured over their heads boiling water.
22:20: With it shall be melted what is in their bellies and (their) skins (as well).
22:21: And for them are maces of iron.
22:22: Every time they will intend to go forth from it, from the very anguish, back shall they be turned into it: and (it will be said unto them) “Taste ye the torment of the burning (fire).
22:23: Verily, God will admit those who believe and do good deeds, into gardens ’neath which flow rivers, adorned shall they be therein with bracelets of gold and with pearls; and their raiment therein shall be of silk.
22:24: For they (in this life) are guided unto goodly words, and they are guided unto the path of the Praised One.
22:25: Verily, those who disbelieve and obstruct (people) from the way of God and from the Sacred Mosque (Masjid-al-Haram) which We have made alike; for the dweller therein as well as the stranger; and whoever doth intend to wrong therein unjustly, We will make him taste of a grievous chastisement.
22:26: And (remember O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) when We fixed for Abraham the place for the House, (saying): “Associate thou not with Me aught, and cleanse My House for those who make the circuits and stand in prayer, and bow and prostrate themselves (unto Me)
22:27: And proclaim thou unto the people the Pilgrimage (Hajj)! They will come unto thee on foot and on lean camel, coming from every remote (high) way.
22:28: That they may witness the advantages unto them, and mention the name of God during the appointed days over what He hath provided them of the cattle quadrupeds (as sustenance) then eat of them and feed the needy the poor.
22:29: Then let them get cleansed and smarten themselves and fulfil their vows, and let them circuit the Ancient House (the Ka’ba).
22:30: That (shall be so); and whoever respecteth the sacred ordinances of God, it is best for him with his Lord; And the cattle are made lawful unto you, save that which is (already) specified unto you, shun ye therefore, the pollution of the idols; and shun vain words.
22:31: Being upright for God, not associating (anything) with Him; whosoever associateth with God, is like that which hath fallen from heaven and (a vulture) bird snatched it away or the wind wafted it to a distant abyss.
22:32: That (shall be so); And whoever respecteth the signs of God verily it is (the reflection) of the piety of the hearts.
22:33: For you therein are benefits till a fixed time, and the place of their sacrifice is the Ancient House, (The Ka’ba).
22:34: Unto every people We have prescribed a rite (of devotion) that they may mention the name of God on what He hath provided them of the cattle quadrupeds, (as their sustenance) so your God is One God, so unto Him submit ye (all) yourselves; and thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) give glad tidings unto the humble ones,
22:35: Who, when God is mentioned, get thrilled their hearts (with awe for His Glory); and the steadfast on what befalleth them, and the establishers of prayer and of what We have provided them with they spend (benevolently).
22:36: And the camels (of sacrifice) We have made them for you among the signs of God, for you in them is good; so mention the name of God on them (when they are drawn) in rows (to be sacrificed); and when fall they down (sacrificed), on their sides, eat of them and feed the contented (poor ones) and the beggar; thus have We subjugated them unto you that happly ye may give thanks.
22:37: Never doth reach God their flesh nor their blood, but reacheth God the piety on your part; Thus hath He subjugated them unto you that ye might pronounce the greatness of God for what He hath guided you aright; and thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) give glad tidings unto the doers of good.
22:38: Verily, God doth ward off (the mischief of infidels) from those who believe; Verily, God loveth not any of the unfaithful, ungrateful (ones).
22:39: Permission (to fight) is given unto those upon whom war is made for they have been op pressed, and verily, to help them, God is Most Potent,
22:40: Those who have been expelled from their homes unjustly save that they say: “Our Lord is God!” And had repelled not God some people by others, verily had been pulled down the cloisters and the churches and the synagogues and the mosques in which is God’s name is much mentioned; and verily God will help him who helpeth Him (His cause); for verily God is Strong, Mighty.
22:41: Those, if We establish them in the earth, will establish prayer and pay the poor-rate and enjoin good and forbid evil; and unto God (alone) is the sequel of (all) affairs,
22:42: And if they belie thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad) then indeed have belied before thee the people of Noah and ’Ad and Thamud (the prophets sent unto them),
22:43: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
22:44: And the dwellers of Midian, and was (also) belied Moses, but gave I respite unto the disbelievers, then I did seize them, and how (severe) was My (wrathful) rejection.
22:45: So how many of towns We did destroy while they were un just, and (their walls) have fallen down over their roofs, and (how many a) well abandoned and (even) lofty castles (ruined)
22:46: What! Have not they travelled in the earth that they should have hearts to understand them with, or ears to hear them with? for verily blind are not the eyes but blind are the hearts which are in the breasts.
22:47: And they ask thee to hasten on the chastisement and never doth God fail His promise; And verily, there is a day with thy Lord as a thousand years, of what ye reckon (them).
22:48: And how many a town I did give a respite unto it while it was unjust, then I did seize it; and unto Me is the return.
22:49: Say: thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) O’ ye people, I am unto you only an Open Warner;
22:50: Then (as for) those who believe and do good, for them is pardon and an honourable provision.
22:51: And those who strive to invalidate Our signs they shall be the inmates of the flaming (Hell) fire.
22:52: And We sent not before thee (O’ Our Apostle Muham mad!) any apostle or prophet, but when he recited (the message) the Satan did cast his recitation (to create error); But annulleth God that which the Satan casteth, then God doth establish His signs; And verily God is All-Knowing, All-Wise,
22:53: So that he may make that which casteth the Satan a trial unto those in whose hearts is disease and those whose hearts are hard; and verily, the unjust are in a schism far (away from the truth),
22:54: And that may know those who have been given the knowledge that it (Qur’an) is the truth from thy Lord, so they may believe in it and may humble unto it their hearts; and verily, God guideth those who believe, unto the right path.
22:55: And will cease not those who disbelieve, in (their) doubt about it (Qur’an) until overtaketh them the Hour (of Resurrection) suddenly, or cometh unto them the doom of the day of desolation.
22:56: The Kingdom that day shall be God’s; He will judge between them; and those who believe and do good will be in the gardens of bliss.
22:57: And those who disbelieve and belie Our signs, these, for them shall be a chastisement disgraceful.
22:58: And those who migrate in the Way of God and are then slain or die, certainly will God provide them with an excellent sustenance; and Verily, God is the Best of providers.
22:59: Certainly, will He admit them into an entrance which they shall be well pleased with; Verily, God is the All-Knowing, the Most Forbearing.
22:60: That (shall be so); and he who did retaliate with the like of that which he hath been wronged, and again he hath been aggressed, most certainly God will aid him; Verily God is the Most Merciful, Oft-Forgiving.
22:61: That is because God causeth the night to enter into the day and causes the day to enter into the night, and because God is All-Seeing, All-Hearing.
22:62: That is because God, He is the Truth and that what they call upon besides Him - it is falsehood, and because God, He is the Highest, the Great.
22:63: Seest thou not that God sendeth down from the heaven water and (by it) the earth becometh green? Verily God is Benign, Subtle, All-Aware.
22:64: His is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; Verily God, certainly He is the Self-Sufficient, The Praised One.
22:65: Seest thou not that God hath subjugated for thee whatsoever is in the earth and the ships sailing in the sea by His command? And He withholdeth the heaven that it falleth not on the earth, save with His permission; Verily, God unto the people is Compassionate, All-Merciful.
22:66: And He it is who hath brought you to life (for the first time), then He will cause you to die, then bring you to life (again); Verily man is ungrateful.
22:67: Unto every people have We prescribed the rites of devotion which they observe, so they should dispute not with thee about the affair, and call thou unto thy Lord; Verily, thou art on the Right way.
22:68: And if they dispute with thee, say thou: “God knoweth best what ye do.
22:69: God will judge between you on the Day of Judgment wherein ye differ.
22:70: Knowest thou not that God knoweth what is in the heaven and the earth? Verily this is in the Book (of the Divine Will); Verily this is easy for God.
22:71: And worship they besides God that for which He hath sent not any authority, and that of which they have no knowledge; and there shall not be for the unjust any helper.
22:72: And when are recited Our clear signs unto them, thou wilt perceive repugnance on the faces of those who disbelieve; they well nigh spring upon those who recite unto them Our signs; Say thou: “Shall I inform you of what is worse than this? The “Fire”; God hath promised it unto those who disbelieve; How evil is the resort!
22:73: O’ ye people! A parable is set forth (unto you) so listen ye unto it! Verily, those whom ye call upon besides God can never create (even) a fly, even though they all gather (themselves) together for it; and should the fly carry away any thing from them, they can not take it back from it; (how) weak the invoker and the invoked!
22:74: They estimated not God His rightful estimation; Verily, God is All-Strong, and All-Mighty.
22:75: God chooseth from among the angels messengers and from among the men; Verily God is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
22:76: Knoweth He what is before them and what is behind them, and unto God are returned all affairs.
22:77: O’ ye who believe! Bow ye down and prostrate ye and worship ye your Lord, and do ye good, happly ye may succeed.
22:78: And fight (endeavour) ye in (the way of) God as it behoveth you to fight (endeavour) for Him; He hath chosen you and hath laid not upon you any hardship in religion; The faith of your Father Abraham; He (God Himself) named you Muslims before and in this, that the Apostle may be a witness over you and ye be witness over the people; So establish ye prayer and pay ye the poor-rate and hold ye fast by God; He is your Master - How Excellent the Master and How Excellent the Helper!
23:2: Those who in their prayers are humble,
23:3: And those who, from what is vain, keep (themselves) aloof,
23:4: And those who act for purification,
23:5: And those who guard their private parts,
23:6: Except from their wives or those whom their right hands possess for then verily they are not blameable,
23:7: But whosoever seeketh beyond that, then, these are they the transgressors of the bounds,
23:8: And those who keep well their trusts and (honour) their promises,
23:9: And those who take care of (the regularity in) their prayers,
23:11: (These are) those who inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein.
23:12: And indeed We, created man, from an extract of clay,
23:13: Then We made him sperm, in a firm resting place,
23:14: Then made We the sperm a clot, then made We the clot a lump of flesh, then made We in the lump of flesh bones, then clothed We the bones with flesh; then We did grow it into another creation; so Blessed be God, the Best of the creators.
23:15: Then verily after that ye shall die,
23:16: Then verily on the Day of Judgment ye shall be raised.
23:17: And indeed made We above you seven paths (heavens); and neither, of the creation, We are heedless
23:18: And send We down water from the heaven according to a measure, and We cause it to settle in the earth; and verily to take it away We are able.
23:19: Then with it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and grapes; for you therein are fruits in plenty and from them ye do eat,
23:20: And a tree that groweth out of Mount Sinai which produceth oil and a condiment for those who eat.
23:21: And verily for you there is, in the cattle a lesson; We Provide you to drink of what is in their bellies, and for you there are in them benefits in plenty, and of them ye do eat,
23:22: And on them and on ships are ye borne.
23:23: And indeed sent We Noah unto his people, and he said: “O’ My people! worship ye God (alone) ye have no god other than Him; Will ye not then guard (yourselves against evil)?
23:24: But said the chiefs of those who disbelieved, among from his people: “This is a man like unto yourselves who intendeth to exalt himself above you; but had God will (to send any apostle) He would certainly have sent angels. We have heard not of this among our fathers of old;
23:25: Verily he is not but a man maniac so bear ye with him for some time.
23:26: He (Noah) said: “O’ my Lord! help me against what they belie.
23:27: So revealed We unto him that: “Make thou (O’ Our Apostle Noah!) the Ark before Our eyes and (as per) Our revelation and when cometh (unto thee) Our command, and gusheth forth water from the oven, take into it two of every species a pair and thy people except those among them about whom had already been issued the word; and address Me not in respect of those who are unjust; for verily they shall be drowned.
23:28: And when thou art settled (in the Ark), thou and those with thee, then say thou: “All praise be unto God Who delivered us from the unjust people!
23:29: And say thou: “O’ my Lord! disembark me with a blessed landing, for Thou art the Best of all who cause to land!
23:30: Verily in this are signs and We do only try (the people).
23:31: Then We raised up after them another generation (Hud).
23:32: Then sent We among them an apostle (Saleh) from among themselves saying “Worship ye God (alone), there is not for you any god other than Him: What! Will ye not therefore guard (against evil)?
23:33: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and belied the meeting of the hereafter, and whom We had richly provided in the life of this world said: “This is not but a man like yourselves, eateth he of what ye eat from, and drinketh he of what ye drink,
23:34: And if ye follow a man like yourselves, verily then ye be the losers.
23:35: What! doth he promise you that when ye are dead and become dust and bones that ye shall be brought forth?
23:36: Far, Far (from sense) is what ye are promised!
23:37: There is nothing but our life in this world: We die and we live and we shall not be raised again.
23:38: He is nothing but a man who hath forged a lie about God, and we are not going to believe in him.
23:39: He (Saleh) said: “O’ my Lord! help me against what they belie!
23:40: Said (God): “Yet a while, they will soon turn repentant,
23:41: Then did the (awful) cry, in truth overtook them, and We made them like a rubbish; so away with the unjust people!
23:42: Then We raised after them other generations.
23:43: No people can hasten their (fixed) term, nor can they delay (it).
23:44: Then sent We Our apostles one after another; whenever came unto a people their apostle, they belied him, so caused We some to follow the others and made (of) some stories (of old), so away with the people who believe not.
23:45: Then sent We Moses and his brother, Aaron, with Our signs and a manifest authority,
23:46: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved proudly and they were a haughty people.
23:47: And said they: “What! Shall we believe in two men like ourselves whose people are unto us servile.
23:48: So they did belie them, so became they of those destroyed.
23:49: And indeed We gave Moses the Book happly they may be guided aright.
23:50: And made We the Son of Mary and his Mother a Sign, and We gave them a refuge for both on a high land, quiet, secure and watered with springs
23:51: (And the apostles were commanded by God) “O’ (My) apostles! eat ye of the good things and do good; Verily I know what ye do.
23:52: And verily this your group is one group, and I am your Lord therefore fear ye (Only Me).
23:53: But they have rent the unity among themselves into sects; each party rejoiceth in that which is with them.
23:54: So leave them in their over whelming ignorance till a certain time.
23:55: What! Think they that what We aid them with of wealth and children,
23:56: We are hastening unto them the good things? Nay! they (only) perceive not.
23:57: And Verily they who are thrilled for fear of their Lord,
23:58: And those who believe in the signs of their Lord,
23:59: And those who associate not (anything) with their Lord,
23:60: And those who give what they give (in charity) while their hearts thrilled for fear that unto their Lord they must return,
23:61: These (are they who) hasten unto good things and they are the foremost to (attain) them,
23:62: And task We not a soul but to the extent of its ability and with Us is a Book, it speaketh the truth, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.
23:63: Nay! their hearts are in overwhelming ignorance about this, and they have other than this, deeds which they do,
23:64: Until seized We the luxurious ones of them with chastisement, Behold! cry they in supplication!
23:65: (It will be said unto them) “Cry not this day for succour! Verily from Us ye shall not be helped!
23:66: Indeed My signs were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
23:67: Puffed up with pride about it (Qur’an) discoursing foolishly by night.
23:68: What! Ponder they not over the Word (Qur’an) or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
23:69: Or recognize they not their Apostle that they deny him?
23:70: Or say they that there is mania in him? Nay! he hath brought unto them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
23:71: And should the Truth follow their vain inclinations certainly will perish the heavens and the earth and all those who are therein: Nay! he hath brought unto them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they turn aside.
23:72: Or is it that thou asketh them for a tribute? But the recompense of thy Lord is the Best; and He is the Best of the sustainers.
23:73: And verily thou callest them unto the straight path;
23:74: And verily those who believe not in the hereafter are from the (right) path, the deviators
23:75: And should We have mercy on them and (should) We relieve (them) of their distress, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, blindly wandering on.
23:76: And indeed We seized them with a chastisement but they sub mitted not themselves unto their Lord, nor did they humble themselves (unto Him).
23:77: Until when We did open upon them a door of severe chastisement, lo! they got into despair at it.
23:78: He it is Who caused for you the hearing and the sight and hearts; (very) little it is what ye give thanks (unto Him).
23:79: He it is Who multiplied you in the earth, and unto Him (only) ye shall be gathered.
23:80: And He it is Who giveth life and (causeth) death, and (in) His (control) is the alternation of the night and the day; What! do ye not then understand?
23:81: Nay! say they the like of what said the ancients.
23:82: They say: “What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we (even) then be raised?
23:83: Certainly this have we been promised, we and (also) our fathers aforetime, but this is not but fables of the ancients.
23:84: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Whose is the earth; whoever is in it, if ye know?
23:85: They will say: “God’s,” Say “Will thou (then): “Will ye not reflect?
23:86: Say thou: “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Glorious Throne?
23:87: They will say: (that they are) “God’s”; (then) Say thou: “Will ye not then guard (yourselves against evil)?
23:88: Say thou: “Who is it in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things and Who protecteth and is never protected? if ye do but know?
23:89: They will say: “In God’s” (hand) (then) Say thou: “From whence (then) are ye beguiled?
23:90: Nay! We have brought unto them the Truth, and verily they are liars.
23:91: Never did God take unto Him a son and never was there with Him any god - else would each god have certainly taken away what he had created, and some of them would certainly have overpowered others; Far from the glory of God, be what they attribute (unto Him),
23:92: (He is) the Knower (alike) of the seen and the unseen, so exalted is He, far above what they join (with Him).
23:93: Say thou: “O’ my Lord! If thou wilt make me see what (chastisement) they are promised,
23:94: O’ my Lord! then place me not amidst the unjust people!
23:95: Verily, We are well able to make thee see (the chastisement) what We have promised them.
23:96: Repel evil by what is best; We know best what they attribute (against thee).
23:97: And say thou: “O’ my Lord! I seek refuge unto Thee from the (evil) promptings of the satans!
23:98: I seek refuge unto Thee O’ my Lord! from their access to me
23:99: Until, when cometh death unto one of them, sayeth he: “My Lord! send me back again (into the world)”,
23:100: That I may do (the) good which I have left undone.” By no means! it is but a word he sayeth; and after them shall be a barrier until the day they shall be raised (again).
23:101: And when the trumpet is blown, there shall be no ties of kindred between them on that day, nor shall they ask of one another.
23:102: Then (those) whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, they shall be the successful ones;
23:103: And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who shall lose their souls, abiding in Hell.
23:104: The fire shall scorch their faces and they therein shall be grinning (of the affliction).
23:105: (Then will God ask them) “Were not My signs rehearsed unto you? then ye used to belie them
23:106: They shall say: “O’ Our Lord! overcame us our ill-luck and we were people gone astray
23:107: O’ our Lord! Take us out of it; if we return (to evil) then verily we shall be unjust,
23:108: (God will) say: “Be ye driven down into it, and speak ye not unto Me!
23:109: Verily, there was a party of My servants who said: “O’ our Lord! we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, and Thou art the Best of the Merciful ones!
23:110: But ye took them with ridicule that (until they) made you to neglect My remembrance, while ye did laugh at them.
23:111: Verily, I have recompensed them this day for they were patient; (that), they are the achievers.
23:112: He will say: “How many years did ye tarry in the earth?
23:113: They will say: “Tarried we a day or part of a day, ask thou those who keep account
23:114: (God will) say: “You did tarry but a little if ye only knew (it)
23:115: What! think ye then that We created you in vain and that unto Us ye shall not be returned?
23:116: Then (behold) the most exalted is God, the True King; No god is there but He, the Lord of ‘Arsh’ (the Throne) of Grace.
23:117: And whoever invoketh with God another god - he hath no proof therefore - his reckoning is only with his Lord; Verily, the disbelievers shall not be successful.
23:118: And say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “O’ my Lord! For give and have mercy, and Thou art the Best of the merciful ones!
24:1: (This) ‘Surah’ which We have sent down, and which We have ordained; and We have sent down therein clear signs, that ye may take heed.
24:2: The fornicatress and fornicator scourge ye each of them (with) a hundred stripes, and let not pity for them keep you away from enforcing the sentence of God, if ye believe in God and the Last Day; and let their chastisement be witnessed by a party of the believers.
24:3: The fornicator marrieth not but a fornicatress or an idolatress, and the fornicatress marrieth not but a fornicator or an idolator; and it is forbidden unto the believers.
24:4: And those who accuse protected women (with adultery) (and) then bring not four witnesses (supporting the charge), scourge them (with) fourscore stripes, and (after that) accept ye not their testimony for ever; and these it is the wicked (ones),
24:5: Save those who repent after this and amend themselves, for verily God is Oft-Forgiving All- Merciful.
24:6: For those who accuse their wives while they have no witnesses save themselves, then the testimony of one of them (shall be taken) four times (swearing) by God that verily he is of the truthful (ones)
24:7: And the fifth (oath to be) that the curse of God on him if he be one of the liars.
24:8: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she testify four times (swearing) by God, that verily he is one of liars,
24:9: And the fifth (path) to be that the wrath of God be on her if he be of the truthful ones
24:10: And had it not been God’s grace upon you and His mercy - and that God is Oft-Returning, All-Wise (ye had been ruined indeed).
24:11: Verily those who have brought forth the slander are a gang among you, deem it not an evil unto you; Nay! It is good for you. Unto every man of them (shall come the punishment for) what he hath earned of the sin; and for him of them who took the greater part therein shall be a grievous chastisement.
24:12: Why did not the believer men and the believer women when ye heard of it, think well of themselves, and say: “This is a clear slander
24:13: Why did they not produce four witnesses about it? But since they did not produce any witnesses, with God they are the liars.
24:14: And had it not been God’s grace upon you and His mercy in this world and the hereafter, indeed had seized you for the slander ye entered into, a grievous chastisement.
24:15: When ye received it with your tongues and uttered it with your mouths what ye had no knowledge of, and ye deemed it a light matter; while with God it was grievous.
24:16: When ye heard it, why did ye not say: “It is not for us to talk of this (affair) glory be to Thee (O’ Lord)! this is a serious slander?
24:17: God admonisheth you that ye return not unto the like of it for ever, if ye be believers.
24:18: And God maketh clear unto you the signs; and God is All Knowing, All-Wise.
24:19: Verily those who love to spread scandal about those who believe, they shall have a grievous chastisement in this world and the hereafter; and God knoweth and ye know not.
24:20: Had it not been God’s grace on you and His mercy, and God is Compassionate, All-Merciful (ye would have been chastised).
24:21: O’ ye who believe! follow ye not the steps of Satan; for whoever followeth the steps of Satan, he (the Satan) enjoineth (unto him) filth and evil; and had it not been God’s grace on you and His mercy not one of you had ever been clean, but God cleaneth whom He willeth; and God is All-Hearing, All Knowing.
24:22: And let not those with bounties among you swear against giving to their kindred, to the poor, and the emigrants in the way of God, and they should pardon and turn away (overlook); What! Love ye not that God should forgive you? and God is Oft-Forgiving, All-Merciful.
24:23: Verily they who accuse protected believer women, unaware (of the crime), shall be accursed in this world and the hereafter, and for them shall be a grievous chastisement,
24:24: On that day will bear witness against them, their tongues and their hands and their feet, as to what they did.
24:25: On that day will God mete out unto them their just due, and they will know that God, He is the Truth (Self) Evident.
24:26: Dirty women are for the dirty men and the dirty men are for the dirty women, and the clean men are for the clean women and the good ones are for the good things; These are free from what they say; For them shall be forgiveness and sustenance honourable.
24:27: O’ ye who believe! enter ye not the houses other than your (own) houses until ye have sought familiarity and saluted their inmates; This is best for you, happly ye may remember.
24:28: But if ye find out in them any one, then enter them not until permission is given to you; and if it is said unto you ‘Get ye back’ then ye get back, for it is purer for you; and God knoweth what all ye do.
24:29: (There shall be) no blame on you that ye enter uninhabited houses wherein be your goods; and God knoweth what ye do openly and what ye hide.
24:30: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto the believer men that they cast down their gaze and guard their private parts; that is purer for them; Verily God is All-Aware of what (all) ye do.
24:31: And say unto the believing women that they cast down their gaze and guard their private parts and they display not their adornment save what is apparent of it; and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and they display not their adornment save to their husbands or their fathers, or the fathers of their husband’s, or their sons, or the sons of their husbands or their brothers, or their brother’s sons, or their sister’s sons, or their women, or those whom their right hands possess, or the male servants void of sexual stimulant, or the children who have not yet attained the carnal knowledge of women’s nakedness, and let them not strike their feet (in walking) that what they hide of their adornment gets apparent; and turn ye (repentant) unto God all of you, O’ ye believers! that ye may be successful.
24:32: And marry ye those among you who are single and those who are righteous ones your male slaves and your female slaves; If they be needy, God out of His grace will make them free from want; and God is All-Bounteous, All-Knowing.
24:33: And let them be in continence, those find not means to marry until God of His grace maketh them free from want; And those who seek a deed (of liberation) from among those whom your right hands possess, give them the writing if ye know of goodness in them; and give them of the wealth of God which He hath given you; and compel not your slave girls to prostitution when they desire to be chaste in order ye may seek the casual fruitions in the life of this world; and whoever compelleth them then verily after their compulsion God is Oft-Forgiving, All-Merciful.
24:34: And indeed sent We down unto you signs descriptive and an instance from those who have passed away before you, and an admonition unto the pious ones.
24:35: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth; the similitude of His Light is as a niche in which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass; The glass is as it were a star shining bright, lit from a blessed olive tree, neither eastern nor western, the oil whereof almost gloweth forth (of itself), and (even) though fire toucheth it not; Light upon Light: God guideth unto His Light whomsoever He willeth; and God setteth forth parables for people; and God is All- Aware of all things.
24:36: (That lamp is lit) In houses which God hath permitted to be exalted and His name be mentioned therein, therein declare glory unto Him in the mornings and the evenings,
24:37: Men whom neither merchandise nor any sale diverteth from the remembrance of God and constancy in prayer and paying the poor-rate; They fear the day when the hearts and eyes shall writhe of the anguish,
24:38: That God may give them the best recompense for what they have done and increase for them, out of His grace; And God provideth sustenance for whomsoever He willeth without measure.
24:39: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert, the thirsty supposeth it to be water; until he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth God with him, so he payeth unto Him his account; And God is quick in reckoning,
24:40: Or like unto utter darkness in the deep sea: there covereth it a wave above another wave, above it is cloud; (with layers of) darkness one over the other; when he holdeth out his hand, he almost seeth it not; unto whomsoever God giveth not light, there is not for him any thing of light.
24:41: Seest thou not that God, He it is unto Him do glorify whoever is in the heavens and the earth? - The (very) birds with their wings spread; Each one knoweth its own (mode of) prayer and praise; And God knoweth all that they do.
24:42: God’s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and unto God is the ultimate return.
24:43: Seest thou not that God driveth gently the clouds then joineth them together, then pileth them up (layers over layers) then seest thou the rain coming forth from their midst? He sendeth down from the heavens from the (clouds like) mountains therein of hail, afflicting with it whom He willeth and turning it away from whom He willeth; the flash of His lightning well nigh taketh away the sight.
24:44: God turneth over the day and the night; verily there is a lesson for those with sight.
24:45: And God hath created every animal, of water; and of them is he who walketh upon its belly; and of them is he who walketh upon two feet; and of them is that walketh upon four (feet); Createth God whatever He willeth; Verily God over all things hath power.
24:46: Indeed We have sent down signs explanatory; and God guideth whomsoever He willeth unto the right way.
24:47: And say they: “Believe we in God and in the Apostle and we obey; then did turn back a party of them thereafter; and these are not believers
24:48: And when they are summoned unto God and His Apostle that he may judge between them, lo! a faction of them turn aside.
24:49: And if right be on their side they come quickly unto Him submissive and obedient.
24:50: Is in their heart any disease or do they doubt, or fear they lest will unjustly deal with them God and His apostle; Nay! they themselves are the unjust ones.
24:51: The answer of the believers, when they are summoned unto God and His apostle that He may judge between them, that they say: “we hear and we obey; and these it is that are the successful (ones).
24:52: And whoever obeyeth God and His apostle, and feareth God, and keepeth duty (unto) Him, these! they are the achievers.
24:53: Swear they by God with the most solemn of their oaths that if thou doth command them they would certainly go forth; Say thou: “Swear ye not: (better than this) is obedience; verily God is well aware of whatever ye do.
24:54: Say thou: “Obey God and obey the Apostle, and if ye turn back, then on him is what is imposed (on him) and on you is what is imposed on you; and if ye obey him ye are guided aright; and nothing is on the Apostle save the clear conveyance (of the Message)
24:55: God hath promised unto those of you who believe and do good deeds that He will certainly appoint them successors in the earth as He appointed successors those before them, and that certainly He shall establish for them their religion (Islam) which He hath chosen for them, and that certainly He will, after their fear, in exchange give them security; They shall worship Me; and associating not with Me aught; and whosoever disbelieveth after this, these! they are the wicked ones.
24:56: And establish ye prayer and pay ye the poor-rate and obey the Apostle, that ye be dealt with mercy.
24:57: Think not that those who disbelieve can (ever) frustrate (God's plan) on earth; Their abode is the (Hell) fire; and certainly an evil is the resort.
24:58: O’ ye who believe! let those whom your right hands possess and those of you who have not reached puberty seek permission of you three times (a day) (ere they come into your presence); before the morning prayer, and when ye lay aside your garments for the heat (at midday), and after the night prayer; These are the three times of privacy for you; It is neither for you nor for them a sin (if) after those (three times); some of you go round attendant upon the others; Thus doth God maketh clear unto you the signs; and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
24:59: And when the children among you reach puberty let them seek permission even as those (of age) before them did seek permission; Thus doth God make clear to you His signs; and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
24:60: And of the women past child bearing, who hope not for marriage, it is no sin on them if they put off their (outer) garments, without displaying their ornaments; Yet if they restrain themselves (even from this) it is better for them; And God is All-Hearing, All Knowing.
24:61: No blame is there on the blind one, nor is there any blame on the lame, nor is there any blame on the sick, nor on yourselves that ye eat from your houses, or your fathers’ houses, or your mothers’ houses, or your brothers’ houses, or your sisters’ houses, or your paternal uncles’ houses, or your paternal aunts’ houses, or your maternal uncles’ houses, or your maternal aunts’ houses, or what ye possess the keys of, or of your friends’ (house); It is no sin on you that ye eat together or separately; and when ye enter houses greet ye your people with a salutation from God, blessed (and) goodly; Thus doth God maketh clear unto you His signs, that ye may understand.
24:62: Verily, only those are believers who believe in God and His Apostle, and when they are with him on an affair demanding collective action, they go not away until they seek his permission; Verily those who seek thy permission are they who believe in God and His Apostle; so when they seek thy permission for some affair of theirs, give permission to whomsoever thou leases of them, and seek pardon for them from God; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, All-Merciful.
24:63: Make ye not the addressing of the Apostle among you like your addressing one another; indeed knoweth God those from among you who steal away from you, screening themselves; so let those beware who go against his order lest a trial afflicteth them or there befalleth unto them a painful chastisement.
24:64: Beware! Verily God’s is what soever is in the heavens and the earth; Knoweth He indeed your state; and on the day on which they are returned unto Him, then He will inform them of what they did; and God of everything is well Aware.
25:1: Blessed is He who sent down ‘Furqan’ (the Distinction) upon His Servant (Muhammad) that he may be unto the worlds a Warner,
25:2: He, Who’s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and hath not taken He (unto Himself) any son, and there is not for Him any partner in the kingdom, and created He everything, and then planned He (for everything) a fixed measure.
25:3: Yet have they adopted gods besides Him, which create not anything and they are them selves created, and own not for themselves any hurt or profit, and they control not death, nor life, nor raising the dead.
25:4: And say those who disbelieve: “This (Qur’an) is nothing but a lie which he (Our Apostle) hath forged and have helped him at it other people;” So indeed have they produced iniquity and uttered a slander.
25:5: And say they: “(they are the) tales of the ancient he hath got them written, so these are recited on him morn and even.
25:6: Say thou: “Hath sent it down He who knoweth the secrets of the heavens and the earth; Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, All- Merciful.
25:7: And say they: “What sort of an apostle is this? He eateth food and he walketh about in the marts! Why hath not been sent unto him an angel that he be a warner with him?
25:8: Or be thrown down unto him a treasure, or there be for him a garden that he may eat of it?” and say the iniquitous: “Ye follow but a man bewitched
25:9: See thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) how they coin comparisons for thee! But they have gone astray, so they shall not be able to find the (right) way,
25:10: Blessed is He who, if He pleaseth, will give thee what is better than this {what all they say), gardens ’neath which flow rivers, and give thee mansions.
25:11: Nay! they belie the Hour (of Resurrection) and We have, ready for him who belieth the Hour, the burning fire.
25:12: When it beholdeth them from afar, they shall hear its raging and roaring.
25:13: And when they shall be flung into a narrow place therein, bound, they shall there call out for death;
25:14: (It shall be said unto them) “Call ye not for this day for one death but call ye for death multiple!
25:15: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad): “Is this better or the eternal garden which hath been promised to the pious ones? that shall be for them a recompense and (their) destination.
25:16: For them shall be therein whatever they desire abiding (in it)-, It is a promise from thy Lord worth to be prayed for.
25:17: And on the day when He shall gather them, and what they serve besides God, He shall say: “Was it ye who beguiled these My servants, or themselves strayed they from the right path?
25:18: They will say, “Glory be to Thee! It behoved not for us that we take any friends besides Thee, but Thou didst provide them and their fathers to enjoy until they forsook Thy remembrance, while they were people to suffer perdition.
25:19: (Then will be said unto the idolaters) “so (now) indeed shall they belie you of what ye say, so ye shall not be able to avert (the doom) or to succour (yourselves) and whosoever be unjust of you, We shall cause taste great torment.
25:20: And We sent not any apostles before thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) but they certainly ate food and walked in the markets; and We have made some of you a trial for the others; will ye bear patiently? Your Lord is Ever-Seeing.
25:21: And say those who hope not of Our meeting: “Why have not angels been sent down upon us, or see we not Our Lord?” Indeed think they too high of themselves and have exceeded a great excess.
25:22: On the day when see they the angels, no glad tidings shall there be that day for the guilty, and they (the angels) shall say: “Forbidden it (the enjoyment) is, totally forbidden!
25:23: And (then) will We proceed unto what they have wrought of deeds, and We shall render them like unto the dust scattered in air.
25:24: The dwellers of the Garden {Paradise} that day shall be in a better abode and a better resting place.
25:25: And on the day when the heavens shall burst asunder with cloud and the angels be sent down, descending (in ranks)
25:26: The kingdom that day in truth shall belong to the Beneficent Lord; and the day for the infidels shall be very hard.
25:27: And on the day when the unjust one shall bite his hands saying: “Oh! would that I had taken with the Apostle the (same right) path!
25:28: Oh! woe is me! would that I had not taken such a one as my friend!
25:29: He did lead me astray from the Reminder after it had come unto me; and the Satan unto man was ever a detester!
25:30: And shall say (out) the Apostle (that day) “O’ my Lord! Verily my people have held this Qur’an as a vain forsaken thing!
25:31: And thus We did appoint for every apostle an enemy from among the guilty ones; But sufficient is thy Lord as a Guide and a Helper (for thee).
25:32: And say those who disbelieve: “Why hast not the Qur’an been sent down upon him all at one (time)?” Thus (is it revealed) that We may strengthen by it thy heart, and We have recited it (unto thee) in well-arranged gradual stages.
25:33: And they (the infidels) shall bring not unto thee any argument, but We shall bring unto thee the truth and the best explanation (of it).
25:34: Those who shall be gathered upon their faces unto Hell, those shall have the worst place, and straying farther away from the (right) path.
25:35: And indeed We gave Moses the Book and We did appoint with him his brother Aaron (as his) assistant.
25:36: And said We: “Go ye both unto the people who belie Our signs!” so We did destroy them with utter destruction.
25:37: And the people of Noah, when they belied the apostles, We drowned them, and made them a sign for mankind; and We have prepared for the unjust, a painful chastisement.
25:38: And the (tribes of) ’Ad and Thamud and the inhabitants of Ar-Rass, and generations between them, in a great number.
25:39: And unto each of them We did give examples and every one (of them) We did destroy with utter extermination.
25:40: And indeed they have passed by the town on which was rained a fatal rain; did they not then see it? Nay! they hope not to be raised again (after their death).
25:41: And when they see thee, they take thee not for aught but in ridicule; (saying) “What! Is this he whom God hath raised to be an apostle?
