25:42: He hath well-nigh led us astray from our gods had we not been adhered to them steadfastly!” And they will know when they see the chastisement, who is straying farther away from the (right) path.
25:43: Hast thou seen him who taketh his vain inclinations for his god? Wouldst thou then be a guardian over him?
25:44: Thinkest thou that most of them do hear or understand? they are not but like the cattle; Nay! they are farther astray from the (right) path.
25:45: Seest thou not unto (the might of) thy Lord, how He extendeth the shadow? And had He willed He would certainly have made it stationary, then We have made the sun to be its guide,
25:46: Then We draw it in unto Us, by an easy (gradual) contraction.
25:47: And He it is who hath made for you the night as a covering, and the sleep a rest, and made the day to rise up again.
25:48: And He it is Who sendeth the winds as the herald of the glad tidings going before His mercy (rain), and We send down from heaven water pure,
25:49: That We may give life by it to a dead land, and We give it for drink, out of what We have created, to cattle and men in numbers multiple.
25:50: And indeed We distribute it (water) to them that they may be (thankfully) mindful, but content not the great number of the people but to be thankless.
25:51: And had We willed, certainly had We raised up a warner in every town.
25:52: So yield thou not to infidels, and strive against them with it a strenuous strife.
25:53: And He it is Who hath made the two seas join and flow together, one palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; and yet hath made He between the two a barrier, and a barrage impassable.
25:54: And He it is Who hath created man of water, and made him related in blood and in wedlock; and thy Lord is All- Powerful.
25:55: And yet worship they besides God, (things) which neither profit them nor harm them; And the infidel had (ever) been an aider (of evil) against thy Lord.
25:56: And We sent thee not (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) but a Bearer of glad tidings and a Warner.
25:57: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “I ask ye not aught of any recompense (for my ministry) save that he, who will, take the way unto his Lord!
25:58: And rely thou on the (Ever) Living One who dieth not, and celebrate thou with His praise; and sufficient is He as being All-Aware of the faults of His servants.
25:59: (He) Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Supreme Authority); the Beneficent (God); Ask thou about Him (only) from (the one who is) aware.
25:60: And when it is said unto them: “Prostrate ye in obeisance unto ‘Rahman’ (the Beneficent, i.e., God),” say they: “Who is ‘Rahman’ (the Beneficent, i.e., God)? Shall we prostrate in obeisance unto what thou biddest us?” and it (only) addeth to their flight (from the Truth)
25:61: Blessed is He who made in the heavens the constellations and made in it a lamp (the sun) and the moon illuminating.
25:62: And He it is who hath made the night and the day to succeed each other for him who desireth to reflect or desireth to be thankful.
25:63: And the servants of the Beneficent (God) are they who walk on the earth humbly; and when address them the ignorants, say they: Salam (Peace).
25:64: And those who pass the night in prostrating (in obeisance) unto their Lord and standing.
25:65: And those who say (pray): “O’ Our Lord! Turn Thou away from us the torment of the Hell, verily the torment of it is a lasting affliction.
25:66: Verily, it is an evil abode and (an evil) station.
25:67: And those who when they spend, are neither extravagant and nor niggardly but are stationed between the two (extremes).
25:68: And those who call not with God any other gods, and slay not a soul which God hath forbidden (to do it) save with a right (to do so), and who commit not adultery; and whosoever doeth this shall find a requital of the sin,
25:69: For him shall be doubled, the torment on the Day of Resurrection, and for ever shall they abide in it, in ignominy
25:70: Save he who turneth repentant and believeth and doeth good deeds; then these are they who, God changeth (their) evil deeds to good ones; And God is Oft-Forgiving, All-Merciful.
25:71: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good and verily turneth he unto God a (sincere) turning,
25:72: And those who bear not witness to what is false, and when pass they by what is vain, pass they in dignity.
25:73: And those who, when admonish ed by the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat deaf and blind.
25:74: And those who say “O’ Our Lord! Grant us from our wives and our offspring the joy of our eyes, and make us for the pious ones (their) Imams
25:75: These shall be rewarded with the high stations (in Paradise) for their patience, and they shall meet therein with honours and salutation,
25:76: Abiding therein; Excellent the abode, and the resting place.
25:77: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto the disbelievers: “My Lord would (also) care not for you had it not been your prayer (unto Him), but ye indeed have belied (the Truth), and soon ye shall be (in) the grip (of the inevitable)
26:2: These are the verses of the Book Manifest
26:3: Happly thou wilt kill thyself with grief that they become not believers
26:4: If We will, We can send down upon them from the heaven a sign that their necks get bent unto it.
26:5: And there cometh not unto them of a reminder from the Beneficent (God) afresh, save they, from it, turn aside.
26:6: And indeed they belied it: but soon shall come unto them the tidings of what they mock (at).
26:7: What! See they not unto the earth, how many of every noble kind We have caused to grow in it?
26:8: Verily in that there is a sign; but most of them believe not.
26:9: Verily thy Lord, certainly is He the Al-Mighty, the All- Merciful.
26:10: And when called out thy Lord unto Moses saying: “Go thou unto the unjust people (to guide them)?
26:11: The people of Pharaoh; Will they not ward off evil?
26:12: Said (Moses): “O’ my Lord! Verily fear I that they will belie me!
26:13: And straitened is my breast, and eloquent is not my tongue, so send Thou unto Aaron (to my aid)
26:14: And they have (a charge) against me (of) a crime, and fear I that they may slay me.
26:15: Said (God): “By no means! so go ye both with Our signs, Verily, with you are We, (and will be) hearing!
26:16: So go unto Pharaoh and say ye both (unto him): “Verily we two are the apostles of the Lord of the worlds!
26:17: Send thou with us the children of Israel!
26:18: Said (Pharaoh): “Did we not cherish thee amidst us as a child? And thou didst dwell amidst us for (many) years of thy life,
26:19: And thou (O’ Moses!) didst a deed which thou didst and thou art one of the ungrateful (ones).
26:20: Said (Moses): “I did it while I was one not yet directed” (as what to do)
26:21: So I fled from you when I feared you, then granted unto me my Lord, command, and made me (one) of (His) apostles.
26:22: And is it a favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the children of Israel?
26:23: Said Pharaoh: “What is the Lord of the worlds?
26:24: Said (Moses): “(He is) The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between the two, if only ye be sure.
26:25: Said (Pharaoh) unto those around him: “Do ye hear not?
26:26: Said (Moses): “(God is) your Lord and the Lord of our fathers of old!
26:27: Said (he): “Verily your apostle who is sent unto you is certainly mad.
26:28: Said (Moses): “(God is) the Lord of the east and the west and what is between the two, if ye (only) understand
26:29: Said (Pharaoh): “Should thou take a god other than me, I will certainly make thee one of the imprisoned ones.
26:30: Said (Moses): “What! even if I bring unto thee something manifest?
26:31: Said (Pharaoh): “Bring it then, if thou be of the truthful ones.
26:32: So he (Moses) threw down his staff, and lo! and it was a manifest serpent,
26:33: And he drew out his hand, and lo! it was radiant white unto the beholders.
26:34: Said (Pharaoh) unto the chiefs around him: “Verily this is a skilled sorcerer”,
26:35: Intendeth he to drive you out of your land with his sorcery, what then is it ye counsel?
26:36: Said they: “Give him respite and to his Brother (Aaron), and send heralds into the cities,
26:37: (That) they bring unto thee all the sorcerers well-versed
26:38: So were gathered together the sorcerers at the appointed time on a day (which was) announced,
26:39: And it was said unto the people: “Will ye all assemble?
26:40: Happly we may follow the sorcerers, if they be triumphant
26:41: When came the sorcerers, said they unto Pharaoh: “Is there for us a reward if we be triumphant?
26:42: Said (Pharaoh): “Yea! verily ye in that case be of those (exalted to be) nearest (to me)
26:43: Said unto them Moses: “Cast ye what ye have to cast!
26:44: Then they cast down their cords and their rods and said: “By Pharaoh’s dignity we shall certainly be triumphant
26:45: Then cast down Moses his staff, and lo! it swallowed that which they falsely displayed.
26:46: Then flung themselves the sorcerers prostrating.
26:47: Said (the sorcerers): “Believe we in the Lord of the worlds!
26:48: The Lord of Moses and Aaron!
26:49: Said (Pharaoh): “What! Believe ye unto him ere I give you leave; Verily, he is the chief of you who taught you the sorcery; so soon shall ye know; then certainly, will I cut off your hands and your feet on opposite side, and certainly will I crucify you all
26:50: Said they: “No harm; Verily we unto our Lord shall return.
26:51: Verily we hope that our Lord will pardon us our wrongs for we are the first of the believers.
26:52: And revealed We unto Moses (saying): “Go thou forth with My servants by night, for verily ye will be pursued.
26:53: Then sent Pharaoh in the cities, (his) heralds.
26:54: (And said he) “Verily these (Israelites) are only a small group”,
26:55: Verily they unto us have enraged very much”,
26:56: And verily We are a multitude forewarned (and well Provided)
26:57: So We turned them out of the gardens and the springs,
26:59: Thus (did We punish them) and We made the children of Israel the inheritors to them.
26:60: Then they (Pharaoh with his host) pursued them at sunrise.
26:61: When the two parties saw each other, said those with Moses: “Indeed we are caught!
26:62: (Moses) said: “By no means! verily my Lord is with me, soon will He guide me (to safety).
26:63: Then revealed We unto Moses saying: “Strike thou the sea with thy staff”; then it clave asunder and each part (of the water stood) like a huge mountain.
26:64: Then We drew near the others
26:65: And saved We Moses and those with him all of them.
26:67: Verily in this is a sure sign; but most of them believe not.
26:68: And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful.
26:69: And recite unto them the story of Abraham.
26:70: When said he unto his father and his people: “What do ye worship?
26:71: Said they: “Worship we the idols, and we shall ever be unto them the devotees.
26:72: Said (Abraham): “Do they hear you when ye call (them)?
26:73: Or do they profit you (in any way) or cause you (any) harm?
26:74: Said they: “Nay! found we our fathers likewise acting.
26:75: Have ye then seen what ye have been worshipping?
26:77: Verily they are enemies unto me, save the Lord of the worlds,
26:78: Who created me, and He it is who guideth me,
26:79: And who feedeth me provideth me to drink.
26:80: And when I get ill then He healeth me,
26:81: And who causeth me to die and then giveth me life (again),
26:82: And Who, hope I, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Judgment.
26:83: O’ My Lord! Grant thou unto me authority and unite me with the righteous!
26:84: And cause for me a Truthful tongue (goodly mention) among the posterity.
26:85: And make me of the heirs of the garden of Bliss,
26:86: And forgive my father, verily, he was of those who have gone astray,
26:87: And disgrace me not on the day when they are raised (again),
26:88: The day when will avail not wealth or sons,
26:89: Save him who cometh unto God with a heart submissive.
26:90: And shall be brought near, the garden for the pious ones.
26:91: And the Hell shall lay open for those who go astray,
26:92: And it shall be said unto them: “Where are those whom ye used to worship,
26:93: Besides God; can they help you or help themselves?
26:94: So they shall be thrown down into it, they and those gone astray,
26:95: And the hosts of the Iblis (Satan), all together.
26:96: They shall say, while they wrangle therein among them selves,
26:97: By God! we were in plain error,
26:98: When we equalled you with the Lord of the worlds,
26:99: And none beguiled us but the guilty ones,
26:102: And if there be for us a return, we would be of the believers.
26:103: Verily in this is a sign; And most of them believe not.
26:104: And verily thy Lord, He is certainly the All-Mighty, All- Merciful.
26:105: The people of Noah belied the apostles (of God),
26:106: When said unto them their brother Noah: “Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?
26:107: Verily I am unto you a trusted apostle,
26:108: Guard ye therefore against (the wrath of) God, and obey me;
26:109: And I ask not from you any recompense for it, for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds.
26:110: So guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me
26:111: Said they: “What! Shall we believe in thee, while follow thee the meanest (ones)?
26:112: Said (Noah); “No knowledge have I of what they were doing;
26:113: Their reckoning is only on my Lord, if ye only knew
26:114: I am not here to drive away the believers.
26:115: I am not but an open warner
26:116: Said (they): “Now, if thou desist not, O’ Noah! thou shalt surely be one of those stoned to death.
26:117: Said (Noah): “My Lord! verily my people have belied me
26:118: Therefore decide thou a decision between me and them, and deliver me and those of the believers with me,
26:119: So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark
26:120: Then drowned We the rest afterwards.
26:121: Verily in this is a sign; but most of them believe not.
26:122: Verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful.
26:124: When said unto them their brother Hud: “Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?
26:125: Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle,
26:126: Therefore guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me
26:127: I seek not from you any recompense for it, for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds
26:128: Build ye on every height a monument? (but) vain it is,
26:129: And raise ye strong mansions as if ye will abide (therein) for ever.
26:130: And when ye seize (any one) by force, ye seize as tyrants
26:131: So guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me,
26:132: And fear ye Him who hath bestowed plenty on you, what ye know
26:133: He hath provided you with plenty of cattle and children,
26:135: Verily I fear for you against the chastisement of a grievous day.
26:136: Said (they): “It is same to us if thou admonish us, or be not of the admonishers (unto us),
26:137: This (threatening) is naught but the custom of the ancients,
26:138: And We are not those who would be punished
26:139: So they belied him, then We destroyed them; Verily in this is a sign; but most of them believe not.
26:140: And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful.
26:141: Belied (the tribe of) Thamud, the apostles (of God),
26:142: When said unto them their brother Salih: “Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?
26:143: Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle,
26:144: Fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me,
26:145: And I seek not of you any recompense for it, for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds;
26:146: What! Will ye be left in what is here, secure (for ever)?
26:148: And cornfields and palm-trees with fine species!
26:149: And ye hew out of the mountains for dwellings (for you), exaltingly
26:150: Therefore, fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me,
26:151: And obey not the bidding of the extravagants,
26:152: Those who make mischief in the earth, and amend not.
26:153: Said they: “verily thou art only of the bewitched ones,
26:154: Thou art naught but a man like unto us, so bring thou a sign if thou art one of the truthful (ones)
26:155: Said (Salih) “Behold ye! This is a She-Camel for it shall be its drink and for you shall be your drink, (each) on an appointed day.
26:156: Touch her not with evil, lest will seize you the torment of the grievous day.
26:157: Then they hamstrung her, and turned (themselves) regretful,
26:158: So seized them the chastisement; verily in this there is a sign; but most of them believe not.
26:159: And verily thy Lord, He is certainly the All-Mighty, The All-Merciful.
26:160: Belied the people of Lut, the apostles (of God)
26:161: When said unto them their brother Lut: “Will ye not guard {yourselves) against evil?
26:162: Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle,
26:163: Therefore fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me,
26:164: I seek not from you for it any recompense, for my recompense is only on the Lord of the worlds.
26:165: What! come ye (only) to males, of all the creatures!
26:166: And leave ye what hath created for you your Lord, of your wives? Nay! ye are people transgressing (the limits)
26:167: Said they: “If thou desist not O’ Lut! thou shalt surely be of those who are expelled.
26:168: Said (Lut): “Verily, I am of those who abhor your doings
26:169: My Lord! “deliver me and my family from what they do!
26:170: So, We did deliver him and his people, all,
26:171: Save an old woman among those who tarried behind.
26:173: And we showered down, upon them, and evil was the rain on those (who were) warned (but heeded not).
26:174: Verily in this is a sign, but most of them believe not.
26:175: And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful.
26:176: Belied the dwellers of the forest, the apostles (of God)
26:177: When said unto them Shu’ayb: Not to cheat people of their things “Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil.
26:178: Verily I unto you am a trusted apostle,
26:179: So fear ye (the wrath of) God and obey me
26:180: I seek not from you, for it any compensation, for my compensation is only on the Lord of the worlds.
26:181: Give ye just measure and be not of those who lessen (to deceive)
26:182: And weigh with balances correct, upright
26:183: Defraud not people in their (due) goods, and work not evil in the earth making mischief
26:184: Fear Him who created you and the races of old
26:185: Said they: “Verily thou art only of those bewitched,
26:186: Thou art but a man like us, and we deem thee certainly of the liars;
26:187: Cause (thou) then a part of the heaven to fall down upon us, if thou art one of the truthful (ones)
26:188: Said (Shu’ayb): “My Lord knoweth best what (all) ye do
26:189: But they belied him, so seized them the chastisement of the day of cloud; Verily it was a chastisement of a Mighty day.
26:190: Verily in this is a sign, but most of them believe not,
26:191: And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, All-Merciful.
26:192: And verily it hath come down from the Lord of the worlds.
26:193: Came down with it the Spirit trusted,
26:194: Upon thy heart (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) that thou mayest be the Warner,
26:196: And verily it is foretold in the scriptures of yore,
26:197: Is it not a sign unto them that recognize it the learned ones of the children of Israel?
26:198: And if We had sent it down unto any of the outlanders,
26:199: (And) then had he recited it unto them, they would have believed not in it.
26:200: Thus We caused it passing into the hearts of the guilty (ones)
26:201: They will believe not in it till they see the grievous chastisement,
26:202: And it shall come upon them of a sudden, while they perceive not,
26:203: Then will they say: “Shall we be respited?
26:204: What! Seek they to hasten Our chastisement?
26:205: Hast thou then seen that We provided them to enjoy themselves for years,
26:206: Then came unto them that which they were promised,
26:207: Availed them not that which they were provided to enjoy.
26:208: We destroyed not any town but it had its warners,
26:209: To Remind (them); and never are We unjust.
26:210: And came not with it, the devils.
26:211: It behoveth them not, they can do it.
26:212: Verily they, (even) from hearing it, are far removed.
26:213: So call thou not with God another god, lest thou be of the chastised ones.
26:214: And warn thou thy relatives of nearest kin.
26:215: And be kind unto him who followeth thee, of the believers.
26:216: But if they disobey thee, then say: “verily I disassociate (myself) of what ye do!
26:217: And rely thou on Mighty, All-Merciful,
26:218: He who seeth thee when thou dost stand up,
26:219: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves (in obeisance unto God)
26:220: Verily He is the All-Hearing, The All-Knowing,
26:221: Shall I inform you (of him) upon whom descend the satans?
26:222: Descend they on every lying sinful one,
26:223: Lend they their ears (eagerly), and most of them are liars.
26:224: And the poets, follow them the erring ones,
26:225: See thou not that they, in every valley they wander bewildered?
26:226: And that they say what they (themselves) do not do.
26:227: Save those who believe and do good, and remember God much, and defend themselves after they are oppressed; And soon shall know those who deal unjustly, what an (evil) turning they shall be turned unto!
27:1: Ta Seen These are the verses of the Qur’an, and the Book maketh the truth manifesting,
27:2: A guidance and glad tidings unto the believers,
27:3: Who establish prayer and give the poor-rate, and of the hereafter, they are sure.
27:4: Verily, those who believe not in the hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming unto them, so they wander bewildered.
27:5: These are those for whom shall be a grievous chastisement, and (these are) they in the hereafter, who shall be the greatest losers,
27:6: Verily thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) receivest the Qur’an from unto the All-Wise, All-Knowing.
27:7: When said Moses unto his family, “Verily I perceive fire; soon will I bring unto you of it some tiding or bring I unto you a brand lighted, that ye may warm yourselves.
27:8: So when he came unto it, he was called unto saying, “Blessed is whosoever is in the fire and whosoever is about it; and hallowed is God, the Lord of the worlds!
27:9: O’ Moses! Verily it is, I am God the All-Mighty, the All-Wise,
27:10: And cast thou down thy staff! “So when he saw it moving as if (it was) a serpent, he turned back retreating and returned not: (then it was said unto him): “O’ Moses’ Fear not! for shall not fear (My) apostles in My presence.
27:11: Save he who hath been unjust, then in its place he doeth good after the evil, for verily I am the Oft-Forgiving, the All- Merciful.
27:12: Now put thy hand into thy bosom, it shall come forth white, shining, without evil: (this is) along with the nine signs (thou wilt take) unto Pharaoh and his people; Verily, they are a transgressing people
27:13: So when came unto them Our clear signs, said they: “this is plain sorcery.
27:14: They denied them in iniquity and arrogance while their hearts were convinced; See then how was the end of the mischief makers.
27:15: And indeed gave We knowledge to David and Solomon, and (both the apostles) said: “All praise is God’s, Who hath made us to excel many of the believing servants,
27:16: And Solomon inherited David, and he said “O’ people! We have been taught the language of the birds, and We have been granted (plenty) of every thing; Verily this is a manifest grace.
27:17: And gathered together unto Solomon his hosts of jinn and men and birds, then they were arrayed in ranks.
27:18: Until they came to the valley of the Ants, said an Ant (addressing the other ants of the valley): “O’ ye ants! enter ye into your dwellings, so that Solomon and his hosts may not crush ye (all) while they know it not.
27:19: Then smiled (Solomon) laughing at her word, and said: “O’ My Lord! arouse me to be thankful for thy bounty which thou hast bestowed on me and my parents, and that I do good such as Thou wouldst be pleased with, and admit me by Thy mercy, among Thy righteous servants.
27:20: And reviewed the birds, then said: “How is it, I see not Hud-hud (Hoopoe) or is that he is among the absentees?
27:21: Certainly will I chastise him with a severe chastisement, or will I certainly slaughter him, or he shall bring unto me a warrant clear,
27:22: And he tarried not long, then (he came up in the air and) said: “I comprehend what thou comprehendeth not, and I have brought unto thee from Sheba tidings sure.
27:23: Verily found I a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given plenty of every thing, and she hath a throne magnificent.
27:24: And I found her and her people prostrating (in obeisance) unto the sun, besides God, and unto them Satan hath made their deeds fair-seeming, and thus hath turned them from the (right) way, so they are not guided aright.
27:25: That (why) they make not obeisance unto God. Who bringeth forth to light what is hid den in the heavens and the earth and what ye hide and what ye manifest,
27:26: God! There is no God but He! He is the Lord of ‘Arsh’, the Mighty (Throne of Supreme Authority)
27:27: Said (Solomon): “We will see if thou hast uttered the truth or thou art of the liars
27:28: Go thou with this letter of mine and convey it unto them, and turn away from them and see what (answer) they return
27:29: Said (the Queen of Sheba) “O’ ye Chiefs! Verily, has been delivered unto me a letter honourable!
27:30: Verily, it is from Solomon; And it is: “In the name of God the Beneficent, the Most Merciful
27:31: That “exalt not yourselves against me, and come ye unto me submitting (yourselves to God)
27:32: Said she: “O’ ye chiefs! advise me in (this) my affair; (ye know) that I decide not any affair but in your view
27:33: They said: “We are endued with strength and possess mighty prowess, and to command is thine: so think (well before) what thou wilt command
27:34: Said (the Queen): “Verily kings, when they enter a town (victorious), ruin it and make the noblest of its people the meanest; and thus will they (also) do.
27:35: And verily I will send unto him a present, and (wait to) see with what (answer) return the messengers
27:36: And when came (the messenger of the Queen) unto Solomon, said (Solomon): “Aid ye me with riches? But what God hath given unto me is better than what He hath given unto you, Aye! it is ye, of your present, exultant.
27:37: Return thou unto them: for we will surely come unto them with (such) hosts which they shall not be able to meet, and certainly will we expel them out therefrom abased, while they shall be contemptible.
27:38: Said (Solomon): “O’ ye chiefs! which of you can bring unto me her throne, ere they come unto me submitting?
27:39: Said an audacious one among the jinn; “I will bring it unto thee ere thou risest up from thy place; for verily I am strong (enough to do it) and I am (also thy) trusted one
27:40: Said he with whom was some knowledge (of a part) of the Book: “I will bring it unto thee ere thy eye twinkleth,” and when saw (Solomon) the throne settled besides him, he said: “This is by the grace of my Lord that He may try me if I am grateful or am ungrateful; and he who is grateful, verily he is grateful for his own self, and whoever is ungrateful, then verily my Lord is Self-Sufficient, Bounteous.
27:41: Said (Solomon): “Transform her throne for her; we will see if she followeth the way aright, or (she is) of those who go not aright?
27:42: So when came (the queen), it was said (unto her): “Is thy throne (also) like this?” Said she: “as it were the same, and we were (already) given the knowledge (of thy apostleship) before it, and we were submitting.
27:43: But prevented her what she worshipped besides God, verily she was of the disbelieving people.
27:44: It was said unto her: “Enter thou the palace”, but when she saw it she deemed it to be a pool of water and bared her legs; (Solomon) said: “Verily this is but a place smoothed with (slabs of) glass;” said (the Queen): “My Lord! verily I have been unjust to myself, and I submit (along) with Solomon unto God, the Lord of the worlds.
27:45: And indeed sent We unto (the tribe of) Thamud their brother Salih, saying: “Worship ye God (alone)!” but lo! they became two parties, wrangling (with each other).
27:46: Said (Salih): O’ my people! Why seek ye to hasten on the evil ere the good? Why seek ye not pardon of God? that ye may be shewn mercy.
27:47: Said they: “We augur ill from thee and those with thee.” Said (Salih): “Your ill augury is with God; Nay! ye are a people who are being tried.
27:48: And there were in the town nine men who made mischief in the land and they would not amend (themselves)
27:49: They said: “Swear ye to one another by God that surely we will suddenly attack by night, him and his family, and then surely we would say unto his heir we witnessed not the murder of his family, and verily we are truthful.
27:50: And plotted they and We (too) plotted a plot, and they perceived not.
27:51: See then what was the end of their plot, that We, destroyed them and their people as a whole.
27:52: So those are their houses in empty ruins for they were unjust; Verily there is in this a sign for people who understand.
27:53: And delivered We those who believed and guarded (themselves) against evil.
27:54: And (sent We) Lut, when said he unto his people “What! Commit ye filthiness while ye see.
27:55: What! come ye unto men with lust rather than (unto) women? Verily ye are ignorant people?
27:56: But the answer of his people was naught save that said they: “Turn ye the people of Lut out of your town; Verily they are people (who seek to be) Pure.
27:57: So We delivered him and his followers, except his wife; We had decreed her to be of those who remained behind.
27:58: And showered We on them a shower, and evil was the shower of those who had been warned.
27:59: Say: “All praise be (only) to God, and peace be on His servants whom He hath chosen: What! Is God better, or what they join (within?)
27:60: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down for you water from heaven; then caused We to grow by it gardens beautiful; it was not in your power that ye grow the trees thereof; What! Is there any god with God? Nay! they are a people who (yet) find equals (unto Him)?
27:61: Is not He Who made the earth a resting place, and made in it rivers, and made on it mountains, and caused between two seas a barrier; Is there any god with God? Nay! most of them know not.
27:62: Is not He Who answereth the distressed one when he calleth Him, and removeth the distress and maketh you the successors in the earth; Is there any god with God? (Nay!) Little it is what ye reflect.
27:63: Is not He Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sendeth the winds as the bearers of the good news of His Mercy? Is there any god with God? Exalted High is God above what they associate (with Him).
27:64: Is not He Who originateth the creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you sustenance from the heaven and the earth? Is there any god with God? Say: “Bring ye your proof, if ye be truthful.
27:65: Say: “None (either) in the heavens or in the earth knoweth the unseen save God; And they perceive not when they shall be raised
27:66: Nay! hath reached them the knowledge about the hereafter; Nay! they are in doubt about it; Nay! they are blind unto it.
27:67: And say those who disbelieve: “What! when we have become dust, and our fathers (too), shall we certainly be brought forth (again)?
27:68: Indeed we had been promised this, we and our fathers before (too); (But) these are naught but stories of yore
27:69: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Travel ye in the earth and see how was the end of the guilty (ones)
27:70: And grieve thou not for them and be not distressed of what they devise.
27:71: And say they: “When shall this promise (of chastisement) come to pass, if ye be truthful?
27:72: Say thou: “Maybe that it is after you, a part of what ye seek to hasten.
27:73: And verily thy Lord is the Lord of grace unto the people but most of them thank not.
27:74: And verily thy Lord well-knoweth what do enshroud their breasts and what they declare.
27:75: Nothing is there hidden in the heavens and the earth but it is in the manifest Book.
27:76: Verily this Qur’an relateth unto the children of Israel most of what they therein disagree.
27:77: And verily it is a (sure) guidance and mercy unto the believers.
27:78: Verily, thy Lord will judge between them by His (Own) decree, and He is the All- Mighty, All-Knowing.
27:79: Then rely thou on God; verily thou art on the manifest truth.
27:80: Verily thou canst not make the dead to listen nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they turn away backward.
27:81: And nor canst thou be a guide unto the Blind against their straying; thou canst make none hear save those who believe in Our signs, so they have submitted themselves.
27:82: And when the word shall come to pass on them, We shall bring forth unto them, a walking one from the earth who shall speak unto them, that the people believed not (with certainty') in Our signs.
27:83: And on the day when We will collect from every people a party from those who belied our signs, then will they be formed into groups.
27:84: Till they come before God (who will) say “Belied ye My signs while ye comprehended them not in your knowledge? or what is it ye were doing?
27:85: And the word shall come to pass on them for they were unjust, and they shall speak not.
27:86: What! See they not that We have made the night that they may rest therein, and the day with light (to see); Verily, in this are signs for the people who believe?
27:87: And the day when there shall be blown the Trumpet, and those in the heavens and those in the earth shall be terrorized, save him whom God willeth, and all shall come unto Him abased.
27:88: And thou wilt see the mountains which thinkest thou firm, solid, pass away the pas sing of the clouds. It is the work of God Who hath made everything firm; Verily He is All-Aware of what (all) ye do.
27:89: Whosoever bringeth good, for him shall be better than it and they, of the terror of the day, be secure.
27:90: And whosoever bringeth evil, these shall be cast down on their faces, in the (Hell) fire; Ye shall be recompensed for aught save what ye were doing.
27:91: (Say thou unto them O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “I commanded only that I should serve the Lord of this city, Who am hath made it sacred, and His are all things, and commanded I am that I should be of the Muslims (those who have submitted themselves to God),
27:92: And that I should recite the Qur’an: so whosoever is guided aright, he is guided aright for his (own self), and whosoever goeth astray, then say thou: “I am only of the warners.
27:93: And say thou, “All praise is God’s. Soon will He show you His signs that ye shall recognise them;” and thy Lord is not heed less of what all ye do.
28:2: These are the verses of the Book which is manifest.
28:3: We recite unto thee from the accounts of Moses and Pharaoh, with truth, for a people who believe.
28:4: Verily, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and divided its people into parties, weakening a group among them, he slaughtered their sons and spared alive their women; Verily he was of the mischief-makers.
28:5: And intend We to bestow (Our) favour upon those who were considered weak in the land, and to make them the Imams (guides in faith), and to make them the heirs,
28:6: And to establish them with power in the earth; and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts to see from them what they did dread.
28:7: And revealed We unto the mother of Moses, saying: “Give him suck; and if thou fearest for him, launch him on the River; and fear thou not, nor grieve thou; for We will return him unto thee, and make him one of the apostles.
28:8: And took him up Pharaoh’s people, that he might be unto them an enemy and a (cause of their) grief; (for) verily Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were sinners.
28:9: And said Pharaoh’s wife: “(Here is) a joy of the eye unto me and unto thee: slay him not: maybe he will be useful to us, or we will adopt him as a son;” But they knew not (what would Moses he to them).
28:10: And the heart of the mother of Moses became tranquilled; she was about to disclose it had We not strengthened her heart so that she might be of the believers (in Our promise)
28:11: And said she unto his sister, “Follow him!” And she watched him from afar: while they perceived it not,
28:12: And already forbade We on him all fostermothers ere (his sister cometh there) and said: “Shall I guide you unto the people of a house who will take care of him for you, and they will (also) wish well of him.
28:13: So We did restore him unto his mother that her eye might be refreshed and that she might not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of God is (always) true, but most of them know not.
28:14: And when he reached the (age of) strength and was full-grown, We granted him wisdom and knowledge; Thus do We recompense those who do good.
28:15: And he entered the city at a time when unvigilant were its people, and found he therein two men fighting: the one, of his own party; and the other of his enemies; And the one of his own party sought his help against the one who was of his enemies, and Moses smote him with his fist and passed (death) on him; Said (Moses): “This is of the Satan’s doing; verily, he is an enemy, an open misleader.
28:16: Said (Moses): “O’ my Lord! Verily I have hurt mine own self, so grant Thou refuge to me!” So granted He refuge to him, (against his enemies); Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.
28:17: Said (Moses): “O’ My Lord! because of the grace Thou hast bestowed on me, never shall I be a supporter of the guilty.
28:18: And in the morn he, in the city, passed full of fear apprehending when lo! he who sought his help the day before, (again) crying out unto him for help. Said unto him Moses: “Verily thou art an open hot-head.
28:19: And when he intended to seize him who was the enemy of them both, said he: “O’ Moses! Dost thou intend to kill me as didst thou kill one the day before? Intendeth thou nothing but thou shouldst be a tyrant in the land, and intendeth not thou to be of those who compromise.
28:20: And there came a man from the remotest part of the city, running, (and) said he: “O’ Moses! verily the chiefs are consulting to slay thee, Begone (from here at once)! Verily unto thee I am of the sincere advisers.
28:21: So, forth he went in fear, apprehending, (and) said he “O’ my Lord! Deliver me from the unjust people!
28:22: And when he turned his face towards (the land of) Midian said (Moses): “Maybe my Lord will guide me in the right path.
28:23: And when arrived he at the water of Midian, he found on it a group of men (watering their flocks) and found he besides them two women keeping back (their flocks); Said (Moses): “What aileth you?” Said the two (women): “We cannot water until the shepherds take away (their sheep from the water), and our father is very old.
28:24: So he watered (their flocks) for them, then retired he unto the shade, (and) then said he: “O’ my Lord! Verily of what Thou hast sent down unto me of the good, I stand in need
28:25: Then came unto him one of the two women walking bash fully; Said she: “Verily my father calleth thee so that he may recompense thee for what thou hath watered for us: So when came he unto him and narrated unto him his story, Said (the old man): “Fear thou not, thou art (now) secure from the unjust people
28:26: Said one of the two (women): “O’ my father! Employ him, verily the best of those who thou canst employ is the strong (man) the trusted (one).
28:27: Said he: “Verily, I intend to wed to thee one of these two daughters of mine on condition that thou servest me for eight years, and if thou didst complete ten (years) that will be a goodness of thine own accord; and I intend not to place any hardship on thee; Thou wilt find me, if God willeth, (one) of the righteous ones.
28:28: Said (Moses) “Be it so between me and thee: whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there shall be no injustice unto me: And God, on what we say, is a witness.
28:29: And when Moses had fulfilled the term and was travelling with his family, perceived he on the side of the mount ‘Tur’ a fire; Said he unto his family: “Wait ye! Verily perceive I a fire, maybe I bring unto you from it some tidings or a brand (lighted) of the fire, so that ye may warm your selves.
28:30: When came he unto it, (he) was called (by a voice) from the right side of the valley, in the blessed spot, from the Tree, saying: “O’ Moses! Verily I, am God, The Lord of the worlds
28:31: And saying: “Cast thou down thy staff;” And when he saw it moving as if (it were) a serpent, he turned back retreating and returned not: (then it was said unto him): “O’ Moses! Come thou forward and fear thou not! for verily thou art of those who are secure!
28:32: (And now) pass thou thy hand in thy bosom, it shall come forth white (radiant) without evil: and close nearer thy sides against fear, and these be two proofs from thy Lord unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, verily they are a transgressing people.
28:33: Said (Moses): “O’ my Lord! Verily have I killed one of them, so fear I that they would slay me;
28:34: And my brother Aaron, he is more eloquent than me in speech, so Thou send him with me as an assistant, to testify me; for fear I that they would belie me
28:35: (God) said: “We will strengthen thy arm with thy brother, and We will give ye two an authority so that they reach not unto ye two, (go ye) with Our signs, ye two and those who follow ye two shall be the triumphants.
28:36: So when came unto them Moses with Our clear signs, said they: “This is nothing but a sorcery forged, and we heard not of it amongst our fathers of old.
28:37: And said Moses: “My Lord knoweth best who cometh with guidance from unto Him, and for whom shall be the good end of the abode; Verily, succeed not the unjust ones.
28:38: And said Pharaoh: “O’ Chiefs! I know not any god for you other than me, so burn for me O’ Haman, bricks of clay, and build for me a tower that I may mount up to the God of Moses, and verily I deem him to be one of the liars
28:39: And prided he and his hosts in the land, without any right * and deemed they that they will not be returned unto Us.
28:40: And We seized him and his hosts and We cast them into the sea; Behold then how (bad) was the end of the unjust ones.
28:41: And We made them Imams (leaders) who invite unto the (Hell) fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they shall not be helped.
28:42: And We caused them to be followed in this world, by a curse; and on the Day of Resurrection they shall be of the loathed (ones).
28:43: And indeed We gave Moses the Book after We had destroyed the generations of yore, (containing) clear arguments for man kind and a guidance and mercy, that happly they might reflect.
28:44: And thou wert not on the western side (of Mount Sinai) when passed We unto Moses the commandment, nor wert thou one of the (eye) witnesses,
28:45: But We raised up generations (after Moses), and a long time passed upon them, and nor wast thou a dweller among the people of Midian, rehearsing unto them Our signs, but We were that sent thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad); (with the knowledge) (of the past).
28:46: And thou wert not on the side of the Mount ‘Tur’ when called We (unto Moses), but it is the mercy of thy Lord that thou warneth a people, unto whom no warner hath come before thee, that they may reflect.
28:47: And were it not so and should there befall unto them a calamity for what their (own) hands have sent before (them), then they would say: “O’ Our Lord! why didst Thou not send unto us an apostle then we would have followed Thy signs and had been of the believers
28:48: But (now) when hath come unto them the truth from Us, say they: “Why is he not given the like of what was given unto Moses?” What! did not they disbelieve in what was given unto Moses before? They said: “(these are) Two sorcerers backing up each other;” and they said: “Verily we, in everything do disbelieve.
28:49: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Bring ye then some (other) book from God which is a better guide than both of them, Torah and Qur’an), that I may follow it, if ye be truthful.
28:50: Then if they answer thee not, then know thou that they follow their own caprices; And who is more astray than he who followeth his own caprices without any guidance from God? Verily God guideth not the unjust people.
28:51: And indeed We caused the Word (of guidance) to come unto them continuously, that they may be admonished.
28:52: And those whom We gave the Book before it, they are believers in it.
28:53: And when it is recited unto them say they: “We believe in it, verily it is the truth from Our Lord, verily we were Muslims - (Submitters) (even from) before it (came)
28:54: These shall be granted their reward twice for what they were steadfast, and they repel evil with good, and of the sustenance We have provided them with, they spend (in Our Way)
28:55: And when hear they any vain talk, they withdraw from it, and say they: “For us shall be our deeds, and for you shall be your deeds, peace be on you, we desire not the (society of the) ignorants.
28:56: Verily, thou canst not guide whomsoever thou likest; but God guideth whomsoever He pleaseth, and He knoweth best those who follow aright.
28:57: And they say: “If we follow the guidance with thee, we shall be driven out from our land” What! have We not established them in a sacred (and) safe precinct, unto which are drawn fruits of every thing? - a sustenance provided from unto Us; but most of them know not.
28:58: And how many a town We did destroy, which exulted in its means of subsistence; So these their dwellings have not been inhabited after them save a little, and We are their heirs!
28:59: And thy Lord destroyeth not the towns until He raiseth in their Mother-(Town) (metropolis) an apostle, rehearsing unto them Our signs, and We destroyed not the towns except while their people were unjust.
28:60: And of whatever things ye have been given are only a provision of the life of this world and its adornment; and whatever is with God, is better and more lasting; What! do ye not then understand?
28:61: What! Is he then unto whom We have promised a goodly promise which he shall meet it, similar to him whom We have provided with the provision of the life of this world, then on the Day of Resurrection he shall be of those arraigned?
28:62: On that day will call (God) unto them and say: “Where are My partners whom ye were asserting?
28:63: Those against whom the sentence hath been confirmed will say: “O’ Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray: we led them astray even as we had been led astray ourselves: we declare unto Thee to be free (of them): They were not unto us worshipping.
28:64: And it will be said (unto them): “Call ye your associate (gods)” so they called upon them, but they answered them not, and they shall see the chastisement, and would wish that they had been guided aright.
28:65: And on that day shall (God) call unto them and say: “What was it that ye answered the apostles (from Me)?
28:66: But the tidings shall that day be so confusing that they shall (even) ask not each other.
28:67: Yet as to him who turned repentant unto God and believed and did good, maybe he will be among the successful (ones)
28:68: And thy Lord createth whatever He willeth and (also) chooseth too; it is not theirs to choose; Hallowed is God and Exalted High is He (far) above what they join (with Him).
28:69: And thy Lord knoweth what concealeth their breasts and what they declare.
28:70: And He is God, there is no god but He! His is all praise, in first and (in) the last, and His is the authority, and unto Him (only) ye shall be returned.
28:71: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “See ye? Had God made the night to continue on you until the Day of Resurrection, who is the god other than God that could bring light unto you; What! Do ye not then hear?
28:72: Say thou: “See ye?” Had God made the day to continue on you until the Day of Resurrection, who is the god other than God that could bring, night unto you, that ye rest therein? What! Do ye not then see?
28:73: And of His mercy He hath made for you the night and the day, that ye may rest therein, and that ye may seek of His grace, and that ye may give thanks.
28:74: And on that day when He shall call unto them and say: “Where are My partners whom ye used to assert?
28:75: And We will draw forth from every people a witness, and We will say: “Bring ye your proof; then shall they know that the truth is God’s, and shall depart from them what they used to forge.
28:76: Verily, Korah (Qarun) was of the people of Moses, but he rebelled against them, and We had given him of the treasures so much that its keys would have been a burden to a company of men of strength. When his people said unto him, “Exalt thou not, for God loveth not those who exult.
28:77: And seek, by means of what God hath given thee, the abode in hereafter, and forget not thy share in this world, and be good to others even as God hath been good unto thee, and seek thou not to mischief in the earth, Verily, God loveth not the mischief-makers.
28:78: Said (Korah): “It hath been given unto me only for the knowledge I possess;” What! knew he not that God hath indeed destroyed before him of the generations that were mightier in strength than he and greater in hoarding (of wealth)? And the guilty (at the time of punishment) shall not be questioned against their faults.
28:79: So went forth he unto his people in his pomp; (And) Said those who aspired for the life of this world: “Oh! would that we had the like of what hath been given unto Korah, verily he owneth a great fortune
28:80: And those who were given the knowledge said: “Woe unto you! The reward of God is better for him who believeth and doeth good, but none shall attain it save the steadfast ones
28:81: Then We caused the earth to swallow him up and his abode; then for him there was no group to help him against God; nor was he of those who can defend themselves.
28:82: And those who coveted his position only the day before began saying: “Ah! that God amplifieth the sustenance for whomsoever He pleaseth, of his servants and straiteneth it; had not God been gracious unto us, He would certainly have abased us; Ah! the ungrateful (ones) succeed not.
28:83: That abode in the hereafter, We assign it for those who intend not to exult themselves in the earth, nor (to make) mischief (therein) and the end is (best) for the pious ones.
28:84: Whosoever bringeth good, for him shall be better than it, and whosoever bringeth evil, then shall not be recompensed those who wrought evil, (with) aught save what they had been working.
28:85: Verily He Who hath ordained the Qur’an unto thee certainly bringeth thee back {to thy) home; Say thou: “My Lord knoweth best him who hath brought the guidance and him who is in manifest error.
28:86: And thou didst not expect that the Book would be inspired unto thee, but it is a mercy from thy Lord, therefore be not a supporter of the disbelievers.
28:87: And let them not turn thee aside from the signs of God after they have been sent down unto thee, and call (mankind) unto thy Lord, and be not of the polytheists.
28:88: And call not with God any other god; There is no god but He: All things are perishable but He: His is the Authority, and unto Him shall ye be returned.
29:2: What! Do people imagine that they will be left off on (their) saying: “We believe!” and they will not be tried?
29:3: And indeed We did try those before them, so God certainly knoweth those who are true, and certainly knoweth He the liars.
29:4: Or imagine they who work evil that they will escape Us? Ill it is what they judge.
29:5: Whoever hopeth to meet God and then verily the doom decreed by God shall certainly come (to pass); and He is the All Hearing, the All-Knowing.
29:6: And whoever striveth hard, he striveth only for his own self; verily God is Self- Sufficient (Independent of the needs) of (all) the worlds.
29:7: And (as to) those who believe and do good, certainly will We blot out from them their evil deeds and certainly will We recompense them the best of what they were doing.
29:8: And We have enjoined on man goodness unto his parents; and if they (either of them) strive (to force) thee to associate (others) with Me (in worship) of which thou hast no knowledge, then thou obey them not; Unto Me is the return of ye (all) and then will I inform you of what ye were doing.
29:9: And those who believe and do good, certainly We will admit them among the righteous,
29:10: And among the people are those who say: “We believe in God;” and when they are persecuted in the (way of) God they think the persecution from the people as the chastisement from God; and yet if cometh the help from thy Lord they would certainly say: “Verily, we were with you:” What! is not God the Best-Knower of what is in the breast of all those in (His own created) worlds?
29:11: And certainly well-knoweth God those who believe and certainly well-knoweth He the hypocrites.
29:12: And those who disbelieve say unto those who believe; “Follow ye our path and we will certainly bear (the burden of) your sins.” And they shall not be bearers of any thing of their sins; Verily, they are liars.
29:13: And certainly they shall bear their own burdens, and (other) burdens with their own burdens, and certainly, shall they be questioned on the Day of Judgment as to what they were forging.
29:14: And indeed sent We Noah unto his people, and he did stay amidst them a thousand years but fifty years; and seized them the Deluge while they were unjust.
29:15: And We delivered him and the inmates of the Ark, and We made it a sign unto the people of the worlds.
29:16: And (recollect) Abraham when he said unto his people; “Worship ye God and fear Him; This is best for you, if ye but know.
29:17: Ye only worship idols besides God, and create a lie; verily those whom ye worship besides God, own not for you any sustenance, so seek ye from God (your) sustenance and worship ye (only) Him, and give ye thanks (only) unto Him; unto Him (only) shall ye (all) be returned.
29:18: And if ye belie (the truth)! then indeed did belie (the truth) the people before you; and nothing is incumbent on the Apostle but a clear delivery (of the message).
29:19: What! see they not? How God originateth the creation then causeth it to return again? Verily this is easy for God.
29:20: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Travel ye in the earth and see how He hath originated the creation so will God bringeth forth the later development (on the Day of Resurrection); Verily God hath power over all things.
29:21: Chastiseth He whomsoever He willeth and bestoweth mercy on whomsoever He willeth, and unto Him ye shall be turned back.
29:22: And ye shall frustrate not His power in the earth nor in the heaven, and there is not for you other than Him, any protector, nor a helper.
29:23: And those who disbelieved in the signs of God and His meeting, these are despaired of My mercy, and these it is who shall have a painful chastisement.
29:24: So naught was the answer of his people except that they said: “Slay him or burn him;” Then God delivered him from the fire; verily in this there are signs for a people who believe.
29:25: And said (Abraham): “Ye have only taken for yourselves idols besides God in friendship between you in the life of this world, then on the Day of Judgment some of you shall deny the others, and shall curse some of you the others and your abode shall be the (Hell) fire, and for you shall not be any helpers,
29:26: Then believed in him Lut and said he: “I betake me unto my Lord, for verily He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise
29:27: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made the prophethood and the Book to be in his seed, and We gave him his recompense in this world; and verily he in the hereafter will certainly be among the righteous ones.
29:28: And (recollect) Lut when said he unto his people: “Verily ye commit a lewdness, which not one of the people of the worlds gone before you did ever commit.
29:29: What! Proceed ye unto men? and cut ye the highway (to plunder the wayfarers)? and commit ye evil deeds in your assemblies; But nothing was the answer from his people except that they said: “Bring thou unto us the chastisement from God, if thou art of the truthful (ones).
29:30: Said (Lut): “O’ My Lord! Help me against the mischievous people!
29:31: And when came Our messengers unto Abraham with glad tidings (of a son unto him) said they: “Verily we are going to destroy the people of this town, for verily its people are unjust.
29:32: Said (Abraham unto the messenger angels): “Verily in it is Lut.” They said: “We know it well who is in it; We shall certainly deliver him and his people; save his wife: she shall be of those who stay behind.
29:33: And when came Our Messengers unto Lut, he was grieved for them, and was straitened (at heart) for the (weakness of his) arm (to protect them): and they said “Fear thou not, nor grieve thou; verily we will deliver thee and thy people except thy wife; she shall be of those who stay behind.
29:34: Verily We are bringing down upon the people of this town a punishment from heaven for what they were transgressing.
29:35: And indeed We have left a clear sign of it for a people who understand.
29:36: And to Midian (We did send) their brother Shu’ayb and he said: “O’ my people! worship ye God (alone) and fear the Last day (of Judgment) and enact not evil in the earth making mischief (therein).
29:37: But they belied him, so seized them an earthquake, and they lay (dead) in their abodes motionless.
29:38: And We (destroyed) ’Ad and Thamud, and indeed it had been made manifest unto you from (the ruins of) their dwellings; and Satan made their deeds fair-seeming unto them, so he kept them back from the (right) path, though they were endued with sight,
29:39: And (We destroyed) Korah and Pharaoh and Haman: and indeed came unto them Moses with clear proofs but they behaved haughtily in the land, but they could not outstrip (Us).
29:40: So each (one of them) We did seize for his sin; and of them was he on whom We sent a stone-charged violent wind; and of them was he whom seized the blast; and of them was he whom We caused to be swallowed up by the earth; and of them was he whom We drowned; and it was not God to do injustice to them, but they unto their own selves did injustice,
29:41: The likeness of those who take to themselves guardians besides God, is the likeness of the spider that maketh for itself a house; but verily the frailest of all houses is the house of the spider; if they but know (this).
29:42: Verily, God knoweth whatever thing they call upon besides Him: and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise.
29:43: And these similitudes We do set forth unto people, but understand them none but the learned (ones)
29:44: God created the heavens and the earth with truth; Verily in this there is a sign for the believers.
29:45: Recite thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) that which hath been revealed unto thee of the Book and establish prayer; verily prayer restraineth (one) from filth and evil; and certainly the remembrance of God is the greatest (duty of the believers), and God knoweth what ye do.
29:46: And dispute not with the people of the Book save what is best, except those of them who act unjustly, and say ye (unto the people): “Believe we in that which hath been sent down unto us and sent down unto you, and our God and your God is One, and we unto Him do submit
29:47: And thus have We sent down unto thee the Book (The Qur’an); and those whom We have given the Book believe in it; and of these there are those who believe in it; and dispute not against Our signs but the disbelievers.
29:48: And thou didst not recite any book before it (the Qur’an) and thou didst not transcribe one with that right hand of thine, for then would have doubted those who utter falsehood.
29:49: Nay! it (Qur’an) is the clear signs in the breast of those who have been granted the knowledge; and dispute not against Our signs except the unjust (ones)
29:50: And say they: “Why have not been sent down upon him the signs from the Lord?” Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “The signs are with God (alone); And I am only a plain warner
29:51: What! Is it not enough for them that We have sent down unto thee the Book which is recited unto them? Verily in this there is mercy and a reminder for a people who believe.
29:52: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Sufficient is God as a witness between me and you; He knoweth what is in the heavens and the earth; and those who believe in the falsehood and disbelieve in God; these it is who are the losers.
29:53: And they challenge thee to hasten on the chastisement; and had not the term been decreed, the chastisement would certainly have come unto them; and certainly, it will come unto them suddenly while they perceive not.
29:54: And they challenge thee to hasten on the chastisement, and verily the Hell will encompass the disbelievers,
29:55: On the day when shall cover them the chastisement, from above them, and from beneath their feet; and shall say He; “Taste ye what ye were doing.
29:56: O’ My servants who believe! verily My earth is vast, therefore Me alone should ye worship!
29:57: Every soul shall taste of death; Then unto Us (only) ye shall (all) be returned.
29:58: And those who believe and do good, certainly will We lodge them in the exalted places in the gardens beneath which flow rivers, they shall abide therein; How excellent is the recompense of those who act (aright),
29:59: Those who are steadfast and, on their Lord, do they rely,
29:60: And how many a moving creature that doth not carry its sustenance; God sustaineth it and yourselves; And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
29:61: And if thou ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth and made subservient the sun and the moon?” Certainly will they say: “God!” Whence are they then turned away?
29:62: God (it is Who) maketh abundant the sustenance for whomsoever He willeth of His servants, and (similarly) He causeth it to be straitened for him (whomsoever He willeth); Verily God is Well-Cognizant of all things.
29:63: And if thou ask them, “Who sendeth down from heaven the water, and giveth life with it unto the earth after its death?” Certainly, will they say: “God!” Say, “all praise is His;” Nay! most of them understand not.
29:64: And nothing is this life of the world but a vain sport and play; and verily the abode of the hereafter, is certainly the life: if they but know.
29:65: And when embark they on ships, call they upon God sincerely vowing worship (only) unto Him, and when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they associate (others with Him),
29:66: (Then) let them thank not for what We have given them, and let them enjoy; but soon shall they know.
29:67: What! See they not that We have established a Sacred Precinct Secure, while people are ravaged all around them? Will they yet believe in the falsehood and in the bounty of God disbelieve?
29:68: And who is more unjust than he who forgeth a lie against God, or belieth the truth when it hath come unto him? Is not in the Hell the abode for the disbelievers?
29:69: And those who strive hard in Us, certainly will We guide them in Our ways; And verily God is (always) with those who do good.
30:3: In a nearer land, but they after being defeated will soon be victorious,
30:4: Within a few years; God’s is the authority before and after; and on that day the believers shall rejoice,
30:5: With the aid of God; Aideth He whomsoever He willeth; And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful,
30:6: (This is) the promise of God! Faileth not God His promise, but most people know not (this).
30:7: They know (only) the appearance of the life of this world, while of the hereafter they are heedless.
30:8: What! Reflect they not with in themselves; (that) created not God the heavens and the earth and what is between them two but with truth, and for an appointed term? And verily most of the people in the meeting of their Lord, disbelieve.
30:9: Have they travelled not in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than them in strength; and they dug up the earth and built on it more than what did these build; and there came unto them their apostles with clear proofs (miracles); (for) it is not God Who should do them (any) injustice, but they did injustice unto their own selves.
30:10: Then evil was the end of those who wrought evil, for belied they the signs of God, and at them they used to mock.
30:11: God (it is Who) originateth the creation, then causeth it to return again, then unto Him shall ye all be returned.
30:12: And on the day when shall come the Hour (of judgment), in despair shall be the guilty (ones)
30:13: And there shall not be for them any intercessors from among their partner gods, and they shall be the deniers of their partners.
30:14: And the day when arriveth the Hour (of Judgment), on that day shall (they) be separated from one another.
30:15: And as to those who believed and did good deeds, they shall be in the garden, made happy.
30:16: And as to those who disbelieved and belied Our signs and the meeting of the hereafter, these shall be brought over to the chastisement.
30:17: So glory be to God when ye enter the evening and when ye enter the morning.
30:18: And His (alone) is all praise in the heavens and the earth, at the sun’s decline and when ye enter the noon.
30:19: He bringeth forth the living from the dead and bringeth forth dead from the living, and giveth life to the earth after its death, and thus shall ye (too) be brought forth (after ye are dead).
30:20: And of His signs is that He created you from dust, then lo I ye are human beings scattering (in the world).
30:21: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves, mates that ye may dwell (inclined) unto them, and caused between you love and compassion: Verily in this are signs for a people who reflect.
30:22: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the variety of your languages and your complexions; verily in this are signs for the learned (ones).
30:23: And of His signs is your sleeping by night and day and your seeking of His grace; verily in this are signs for a people who would hear.
30:24: And of His signs is that He sheweth you the lightning causing awe and hope, and sendeth down from the heavens water and giveth life with it to the earth after its death; verily in this are signs for a people who understand.
30:25: And of His signs is that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His command; then (after your death) when He summoneth you with a (single) summons from out of the earth, lo! ye come forth
30:26: And His is whosoever is in the heavens and the earth: all are subservient unto Him.
30:27: And He it is Who originateth the creation, then causeth it to return again, and to Him it is most easy; His are the most exalted similitudes in the heavens and the earth; and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
30:28: He setteth forth unto you a parable of yourselves. Have ye of those whom your right hands possess partners in what We have provided you for sustenance, so that in regard to it, ye are alike, Fear ye them as ye fear each other? Thus We make clear Our signs for a people who understand.
30:29: Nay! those who are unjust follow their vain desires without any knowledge: Who can guide him whom God hath allowed to err? There shall not be for them any of the helpers.
30:30: Then set thou thy face uprightly for (the right) religion, in natural devotion to the truth (following) the nature caused by God in which He hath made the people; No change can there be (by any one else) in the creation of God; This (uprightness) is the established religion; but most people know not,
30:31: Turning unto Him and fear His wrath and establish prayer and be not of the polytheists,
30:32: Of those who split up their religion, and have become sects, every party rejoiceth in what is with them.
30:33: And when afflicteth the people any harm call they upon their Lord turning unto Him, then when He causeth them taste of mercy from unto Him, lo! some of them associate partners with their Lord,
30:34: Let them be ungrateful for what We have given them; But enjoy ye (only for a while) for soon shall ye know.
30:35: Or, have We sent down upon them any authority that it speaketh of what they associate with Him?
30:36: And when We make people taste of mercy they rejoice in it, and if befalleth them an evil for what have already wrought their (own) hands, lo! they are in despair.
30:37: What! See they not that God amplifieth the provision for whomsoever He willeth and straiteneth? Verily in this are signs for a people who believe.
30:38: Then give thou to the near of kin his due, and to the needy, and the wayfarer; this is best for those who desire the pleasure of God, and these it is who are the successful ones.
30:39: And what ye give out at interest, so that it may increase in the wealth of the people, but it increaseth not with God, and whatever ye give in charity desiring the pleasure of God, it is these that shall get manifold.
30:40: God is He who created you then provided you with sustenance, then He causeth you to die, then bringeth you to life; Is there any of your associate gods who doeth aught of these things? Glory be to Him, and Exalted High is He far above what they associate (with Him).
30:41: Mischief hath appeared in the land and the sea on account of what the hands of men have wrought, that He may make them taste a part of what they have done, so that they may turn (away from evil).
30:42: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Travel ye in the earth, then see ye how was the end of those who were before (you); most of them were polytheists.
30:43: Then set thy face upright unto the established religion ere cometh from God the day, there is no averting for it, on that day they shall be separated.
30:44: Whoever disbelieveth. on Him shall be (the charge of) the disbelief, and whoever doeth good deeds, for their own self they are preparing,
30:45: So that He may recompense those who believe and do good out of His Grace; Verily He loveth not the disbelievers.
30:46: And of His signs is that He sendeth forth the winds bearing good tidings, and that He may make you taste of His mercy, and that ships may sail by His Command, and that ye should seek of His grace, and that ye be grateful.
30:47: And indeed sent We before thee apostles unto their people, and came they unto them with clear proofs, then took We vengeance upon those who were guilty; and was incumbent on Us the succour of the believers.
30:48: God it is Who sendeth forth the winds, so raise they the clouds, then He spreadeth it forth in the skies as He willeth, and causeth it to break up so that ye see the rays coming forth from inside it; and when He causeth it to fall upon whomsoever He pleaseth of His servants, lo! they rejoice.
30:49: Even they who, before it was sent down upon them, were in mute despair.
30:50: Look then at the traces of God’s mercy, how He giveth life to the earth after its death; verily He is the giver of life to the dead; and He hath power over all things.
30:51: And if We send a wind (from which) they see (their tilth turned) yellow, they become, thereafter, disbelievers (ungrateful).
30:52: For verily thou canst not make the dead to hear and thou canst not make the deaf to hear the call, when they withdraw turning their backs.
30:53: Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their straying; Thou canst not make hear any but those who believe in Our signs for they are resigned (to Our will i.e. Muslims).
30:54: God (it is) Who created you out of weakness and then caused strength after weakness, then caused weakness after strength and grey hairs; Createth He what soever He willeth, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.
30:55: And the day whereon the Hour (of Judgment) arriveth, the guilty will swear that they tarried not but an hour; Even so they used to utter lies (on earth)
30:56: And those who have been given knowledge and faith will say: “Indeed tarried ye according to the decree of God till the Day of Resurrection, so this is the Day of Resurrection but ye were wont not to know.
30:57: But on that day their plea shall not profit those who were unjust, nor will they be allowed to please (God).
30:58: And indeed have We set forth for the people, in this Qur’an every kind of similitude; And if thou bringest unto them a sign, certainly will say those who disbelieve: “Ye are naught but a false claimant.
30:59: Thus doth God set a seal on the hearts of those who know not.
30:60: Therefore be thou patient (for) Verily the promise of God is True, and let not those who have no certainty hold thee in light estimation.
31:2: These are the verses of the Book of wisdom,
31:3: A guidance and a mercy unto the righteous ones,
31:4: Those who establish prayer and pay the poor-rate, and they, of the hereafter are certain;
31:5: These are on the guidance from their Lord, and these are they who are successful.
31:6: And of the people there is he who buyeth for a vain story, that he may lead (others) astray from the path of God without knowledge; and taketh it (the revelation from God) for a mockery; for these shall be a disgracing chastisement.
31:7: And when are recited unto him Our signs, he turneth back proudly as if he had heard them not, as though in his ears were a heaviness; so give thou unto him the tidings of a painful chastisement.
31:8: Verily those who believe and do good, for them are the gardens bountiful,
31:9: To dwell therein; It is the promise of God, (a) true (promise); and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
31:10: Created He the heavens without pillars as ye can see them, and He did cast mountains upon the earth lest it shaketh with you, and He hath spread in it of every kind of animals; and We sent down water from the heaven, then caused We to grow up therein (vegetables) of every noble kind.
31:11: This is the creation of God, Show me what those besides Him have created. Nay! The unjust are in a manifest straying.
31:12: And indeed gave We to Luqman wisdom saying: “Be thou grateful to God; for whoever is grateful, verily he is only grateful for his own self; and whoever is ungrateful, (it is to the discredit of his own self) then verily God is Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised.
31:13: And when said Luqman unto his son, while he was exhorting unto him: “O’ my son! associate not aught with God for verily associating (aught) with God is the greatest iniquity.
31:14: And We did enjoin upon man concerning his parents; beareth him his mother in weakness upon weakness and his weaning taketh two years (and) saying: “Be thou grateful unto Me and unto thy parents; (and remember thou that) unto Me is the ultimate return (of all),
31:15: And if they contend with thee that thou should associate with Me what thou hast no knowledge of, (then thou) obey them not, and consort kindly, with them in the world, and follow thou the path of him who turneth (repentant) unto Me; then unto Me is the return of ye (all), and then will I inform you of what ye were doing.
31:16: O’ my son! Verily if it is even the very weight of the grain of a mustard seed (closed) in (even) a rock, or (be it high above) in the heavens or (buried deep) in the earth, God will bring it (forth) to light; (for) verily God is All-Subtle, All- Aware.
31:17: O’ my son! establish prayer and enjoin the good and forbid the evil, and be patient against what befalleth thee; verily this is the task of steadfastness
31:18: And turn not thy face at people (in scorn) and walk not in the earth exulting; verily God loveth not any self-conceited boaster
31:19: And be moderate (in thy movement) and lower thy voice: Note the degree of humility Islam enjoins upon its adherents verily the most unpleasant of voices is the braying of the asses.
31:20: What! See ye not that God hath made subservient unto you what is in the heavens and what is in the earth, and completed on you His bounties (both) apparently and hidden? yet among the people is he who disputeth concerning God without knowledge and without any guidance and without any book illuminating.
31:21: And when it is said unto them, “Follow ye what God hath sent down,” say they, “Nay! follow we that on which found we our fathers”; What! (would they do it) even if it be Satan beckoning them unto the chastisement of the blazing fire!
31:22: And whosoever setteth his face (submitting himself) unto God, and he be a doer of good, then indeed hath (he) laid hold on a firmest hand-hold (a rope); and unto God is the end of all affairs.
31:23: And whoever disbelieveth, let not his disbelief grieve thee; unto Us is their return, then will We inform them of what they did; verily God well-knoweth what is in their breasts.
31:24: We provide them to enjoy a little, then will We drive them to a severe chastisement.
31:25: And if thou askest them “Who created the heavens and the earth?” certainly will they say: “God.” Say thou: “(all) praise is God’s;” “Nay! most of them know not.
31:26: God’s is whatever is in the heavens and the earth; verily God is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised.
31:27: And if it were that all the trees in the earth be pens, and the sea added to seven (more) seas (be ink), (yet) will exhaust not the words of God; Verily God is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
31:28: Neither your creation nor your raising (after your death) is anything but as a single soul: Verily God is All-Hearing, All- Seeing.
31:29: Seest thou not that God causeth the night to pass into the day, and causeth the day to pass into the night, and hath made subservient the sun and the moon, each passing an appointed term, and that God, of what ye do, is All-Aware.
31:30: This, because God is truth, and that which they call upon besides Him is falsehood, and that God, He is the Highest, the Greatest.
31:31: Seest thou not that the ships sail on the sea by the favour of God, that He may show you of His signs? Verily in this are signs for every steadfast grateful (one).
31:32: And when covereth them a wave like mountains they call upon God in sincere devotion unto Him; but when He bringeth them safe to land, of them are those who halt between (the right and wrong); and disputeth not about Our signs but every perfidious, ungrateful one.
31:33: O’ ye people! guard ye (your selves against the wrath of) your Lord and dread ye the day when a father shall avail not of his son, neither the child shall avail of its father; verily the promise of God is true, so let not the life of the world beguile you; nor let the deceiver deceive you concerning God.
31:34: Verily, God is He with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour and He sendeth down the rain, and knoweth He what is in the wombs; and knoweth not any soul what he shall earn the morrow; and knoweth not any soul in what lands he shall die; Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
32:2: The revelation of the Book (the Qur’an) there is no doubt in it, (it is) from the Lord of the worlds.
32:3: Or say they “He hath forged it?” Nay! it is the truth from thy Lord, that thou mayest warn a people unto whom came not any warner before thee, that happly they may be guided aright.
