32:4: God (it is) Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days (stages) and got firm on His Throne (of authority), for you there is none besides Him of a guardian, nor any intercessor; What! will ye not then reflect?
32:5: Regulateth He (all) the affairs from the heaven to the earth, then shall it ascend unto Him in a day the measure of which is a thousand years of what ye reckon.
32:6: This is the Knower of the hidden and the manifest, the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful,
32:7: He Who made best every thing which He hath created and began the creation of man from clay.
32:8: Then He made his progeny of an extract of despised water (liquid)
32:9: Then shaped him and breathed into him of His spirit and made for you the ears, and the eyes and the hearts; (yet how) Little is it that ye give thanks.
32:10: And said they: “What! when we become lost in the earth, shall we even then be (returned) into a new creation?” Nay! in the meeting of their Lord they are disbelievers.
32:11: Say thou: “Shall cause you to die the angel of death who is put in charge of you, then unto your Lord ye shall be brought back.
32:12: And couldst thou but see when the guilty ones shall droop their heads before their Lord (saying): “O’ our Lord! we have seen and we have heard, now then send us back, we will do good; verily (now) we are certain
32:13: Had We pleased certainly We would have given every soul its guidance, but true is the word which hath gone forth from Me, certainly will I fill hell with jinn and men together.
32:14: So (they will be told) “Taste ye (the recompense) for what ye had forsaken the meeting of this your day Verily We too forsake you: and taste ye the abiding chastisement for what ye were doing.
32:15: Verily believed in Our signs only those who when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrating in obeisance and celebrate the praise of their Lord, and they exalt not (with pride).
32:16: Their sides forsake their beds (getting way from their beds overnight), praying unto their Lord in fear and (in) hope, and (of what We provide them with) spend they (benevolently in the Way of their Lord)
32:17: And knoweth not any soul what is hidden for them (the righteous ones) of the joy of the eyes, in recompense for what (good) they were doing.
32:18: Is he then who is a believer like the one who is a transgressor? They shall not be held alike.
32:19: As for those who believe and do good, for them, the gardens (of bliss) shall be the (heavenly) abode; as an entertainment for what (good) they were doing.
32:20: But as for those who transgress, their abode shall be the (hell) fire; so oft as they shall desire to get out of it they shall be brought back into it, and it shall be said unto them: “Taste ye the chastisement of the fire which ye used to belie.
32:21: And (here) certainly will We make them taste of a minimum chastisement instead of the maximum chastisement, that happly they may turn (unto Us, repentant).
32:22: And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, then he turneth away from them? Verily We, from the guilty ones, shall exact (the due) retribution.
32:23: And indeed gave We unto Moses the Book, so be thou not in doubt of receiving this from Him (God), and it (Torah) made We a guidance unto the children of Israel,
32:24: And of them made We Leaders (Imams) to guide (the people) by Our command as they were steadfast (in the calamities); and they of Our signs were quite certain.
32:25: Verily thy Lord Himself will decide between them on the Day of Judgment concerning what they therein were disputing.
32:26: What! Doth it not guide them aright (to see) how many of the generations We did destroy before them, they walk (today) in (the ruins of) their abodes; verily in this are signs; Will they not then hear?
32:27: What! See they not that We drive the water unto the parched earth and We bring forth with it crops of which eat the cattle and they themselves? Will they not then see?
32:28: And say they: “When will this judgment take place? (tell us) if ye be truthful,
32:29: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “On the Day of Judgment, will not profit those who disbelieve, their faith, nor will they be respited.
32:30: So turn thou away from them and wait, verily they too do wait.
33:1: O’ Our Prophet (Muhammad!): “Fear thou God (alone), and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites; Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Wise,
33:2: And follow thou what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord; Verily God is, of what ye do, well-aware,
33:3: And rely thou on God (alone), and God is sufficient a Protector.
33:4: God hath made not for any man two hearts in his breast; nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers, are in fact also) your mothers; nor hath he made whom ye call (as your sons in real also) your sons; These are (mere) words of your mouths; and God speaketh the truth and He guideth unto the (right) way.
33:5: Call them after their fathers; this is more just with God; but if ye know not their fathers, then they are your brethren in faith and your friends; and it shall not be on you any crime concerning that in which ye mistake, but what ye do with intent of heart; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
33:6: The Prophet (Muhammad) hath a greater claim on the believers than they have on their own selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers; and blood relations have the better claim in respect of one to the other, according to the book of God, than the (other) believers and the emigrants, save that ye do some good unto your friends; This in the Book (of God) is prescribed.
33:7: And (Recollect) when took We a covenant from the prophets and from thee and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, son of Mary, and took We from them a firm covenant,
33:8: That He may question the truthful of their truth, and hath prepared He for the disbelievers a painful chastisement.
33:9: O’ ye who believe! Remember ye the bounty of God unto you when came upon you the hosts, then sent We upon them a strong wind and hosts that ye saw them not; and seeth God what (all) ye do.
33:10: When came they upon you from above you and from below you, and were turned dull the eyes, and reached to the throats the hearts, and ye did imagine about God diverse thoughts.
33:11: There were tried the believers and they were shaken a tremendous shaking.
33:12: And when began to say the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease that: “Promised us not God and His Apostle but (it was only) a deception.
33:13: And when said a party of them: “O’ ye the people of Yathrib! There is no place for you to stand, so return ye,” and a party of them asked permission of the Prophet saying: “Verily our houses are exposed (to destruction),” and they were not exposed (to destruction): they only intended to flee away.
33:14: And had the entry been made upon them from all sides (of the City), and had they been incited to treachery, they would certainly have brought it to pass, with only a short time had they stayed.
33:15: And indeed they had made a covenant with God before (that) they would turn not their backs; And the covenant with God shall be inquired of.
33:16: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad) “Never shall benefit you the flight, if ye flee away from death or slaughter, and (even) then ye will not be allowed to enjoy yourselves but (only) a little
33:17: Say thou: “Who is he that can screen you from God if intendeth He unto you any evil or intendeth He unto you mercy?” And they will find not for themselves other than God any guardian or helper.
33:18: Indeed knoweth God those who hinder others among you and those who say unto their brethren “Come hither unto us,” and they come not to fight but a little,
33:19: Being niggardly unto you, but when cometh fear, thou wilt see them looking unto you, their eyes rolling like the one on whom death hath cast its shadow and when passeth away the fear, they smite you with sharp tongues, being niggardly of the good things; These have believed not, and so God hath made their deed in vain; and this for God is easy.
33:20: Think they the allies have not gone, and should the clans come (again) they would fain be dwelling with the wandering arabs in the desert, seeking news about you; and had they been amidst you, they would fight not but a little.
33:21: Indeed (there) is for you in the Apostle of God (Muhammad) an excellent pattern (of conduct) for him who hopeth in God and the latter day and remembereth God much.
33:22: And when saw the believers the allies, said they: “This is what God promised unto us and His Apostle and God and His Apostle had spoken the truth;” and it increased not in them but faith and submission.
33:23: Of the believers are the men who are true to what they covenanted with God; of them is he who hath fulfilled his vow and of them is he who awaiteth (its fulfilment); and they have changed not in the least,
33:24: That God may recompense the truthful ones for their truth, and chastise the hypocrites if He willeth or turn unto them (merciful); Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
33:25: And God turned back those who disbelieve in their rage, they achieved not any advantage; and God did suffice for the believers in fighting; for God is All-Strong, the Almighty.
33:26: And He drove down those of the people of the Book who backed them from their fortresses, and He cast awe into their hearts, some ye killed and took ye captives of the other part (of them)
33:27: And He made you to inherit their land and their dwellings and their properties, and a land which ye have not yet set your foot; And God is Powerful over all things.
33:28: O’ Our Prophet (Muhammad!) Say thou unto thy wives: “If ye desire (the enjoyment of) the life of this world and its adornment, come then I will provide for you and allow you to depart a goodly departing.
33:29: And if ye desire God and His Apostle and the abode in the hereafter, then verily God hath prepared for the good among you a great recompense.
33:30: O’ wives of the Prophet! whosoever of you committeth an open indecency double will be the chastisement for her; and this for God is easy.
33:31: And whoever of you is obedient to God and His Apostle and doeth good, We will give her recompense twice, and We have prepared for her an honour able sustenance.
33:32: O’ ye wives of the Prophet! ye are not like any other women if ye guard (yourselves) against evil, and be not soft in (your) speech lest lusteth after you he in whose heart is a disease, and speak ye a plain speech.
33:33: And stay ye in your abodes and display not your finery like the display of the ignorance of yore, and establish ye prayer and give away the poor-rate, and obey God and His Apostle; Verily, verily God intendeth but to keep off from you (every kind of) uncleanness O’ ye the People of the House, and purify you (with) a thorough purification.
33:34: And remember ye what is recited in your abodes of the signs of God and wisdom; verily God is Benignant, All-Aware.
33:35: Verily the Muslim men and the Muslim women and the believing men and the believing women and obedient men and the obedient women, and the truthful men and the truthful women, and the patient men, and the patient women, and the humble men and the humble women, and the alms-giving men and the alms-giving women, and the fasting men and the fasting women, and the men who guard their private parts and the women who guard (their private parts), and the men who remember God much and the women who remember God (much), for them hath been prepared forgiveness and a great recompense.
33:36: And it is not for a believer man or woman to have any choice in their affair when God and His Apostle have decided a matter; and whoever disobeyeth God and His Apostle, indeed he hath strayed off a manifest straying.
33:37: And when thou didst say on him whom God hath bestowed (His) bounty and unto whom thou hast shown (thy) favour “Keep unto thyself thy wife and fear God,” But thou didst hide in thy self what God wouldst bring to light, and thou didst fear the people; and God hath greater right that thou shouldst fear Him. But when Zayd hath concluded his concern with her (i.e., divorced her) We joined her (in wedlock) as thy wife, so that there should not be a difficulty for the believers concerning the wives of their adopted sons, when they have concluded their concerns with them (i.e., have divorced them); and the command of God shall be carried out.
33:38: On the Prophet is no blame in doing what hath been ordained by God unto him, and such hath been the way of God with those who have passed before, and the behest of God is a decree irrevocable,
33:39: Those who convey the messages of God and fear Him, and fear not any one but God; and sufficient is God to take account.
33:40: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but an apostle of God and the seal of the prophets; And God is of all things - ever the Knower.
33:41: O’ ye who believe! Remember ye God by remembering (Him) frequently,
33:42: And glorify Him morning and evening.
33:43: He it is Who confereth upon you His blessings, and (likewise do) the angels, that He may bring you forth from the darkness (of infidelity) into the light (of faith); and He is unto the believers, All-Merciful.
33:44: Their greeting on the day when they shall meet Him shall be ‘Peace!’ and He hath prepared for them an honourable recompense.
33:45: O’ (Our) Prophet (Muhammad!) Verily We have sent thee as a Witness, and as a Bearer of Glad Tidings and as a Warner,
33:46: And as the Inviter unto God by His command, and an illuminating torch.
33:47: And give thou the glad tidings unto the believers that there shall be for them from God, a great grace.
33:48: And comply not with (the desires of) the infidels and the hypocrites, and leave off (heedless) their annoying talk, and rely on God; and God is sufficient a Protector.
33:49: O’ ye who believe! when ye wed the believing women, then ye divorce them before ye touch them, there is not for you any ‘Iddat’ (term) on them which ye should reckon; so make some provisions for them and send them away (with) a goodly send- off.
33:50: O’ (Our) Prophet (Muhammad!) Verily We have made lawful unto thee thy wives whom thou hast given their dowries, and those whom thy right hand possesseth out of those whom God returneth unto thee (without war), and the daughters of thy paternal uncle, and the daughters of thy paternal aunts, and daughters of thy maternal uncle and the daughters of thy maternal aunts who fled with you, and a believing woman if she giveth herself unto the Prophet, if the Prophet desireth to wed her; specially for thee, other than the (rest of the) believers; indeed know We what We have ordained for them about their wives and those whom their right hands possess in order that no blame may attach to thee; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
33:51: Thou mayest put off whom thou pleaseth of them, and thou mayest take unto you whom thou pleaseth; and whom thou desireth of those whom thou hast separated, no blame shall be on thee; this is nearer to give them the joy of their eyes and they may grieve not, and that they be pleased with what thou giveth them, all of them; and God knoweth what is in your hearts; and God is All-Knowing, the Forbearing.
33:52: It is not allowed unto thee to take women afterwards, nor shouldst thou change them for other wives, though their beauty may charm thee, save what their right hand possesseth; and God is, over all things watchful.
33:53: O’ ye who believe! Enter ye not in the houses of the Prophet unless it is permitted to you for a meal, without waiting for the cooking to be finished - but when ye are invited, enter ye, and when ye have taken the food - then disperse ye without seeking any familiar talk; verily this annoyeth the Prophet, but he forbeareth for you, and God forbeareth not from the truth, and if ye ask from them any goods, ask ye of them from behind the curtain; Purer it is for your hearts and (for) their hearts: and it is not for you that ye should annoy the Apostle of God (Muhammad)! nor that ye should ever wed his wives after him: Verily this with God is very grievous.
33:54: If ye manifest any thing or hide it, then verily God of all things is Well-Aware.
33:55: There is no blame on them about their fathers, nor their sons, nor their brothers, nor their brothers’ sons, nor their sisters’ sons, nor their own women, nor of what their right hands possess; fear ye God! Verily God, on all things is a witness.
33:56: Verily God and His angels bless the Prophet! O’ ye who believe! send ye blessings on him and ye greet him with a salutation worthy of the respect (due to him).
33:57: Verily those who annoy God and His Apostle (Muhammad), God, hath cursed them in this world and the hereafter, and He hath prepared for them a chastisement disgraceful.
33:58: And those who annoy believing men and believing women without their having earned it, then indeed they bear the guilt of slander and a manifest sin.
33:59: O’ (Our) Prophet (Muhammad)! say thou unto thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers that they let down upon them their cover garments; that they may be known, so that they will not be troubled, God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
33:60: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease and the agitators in the city desist not, We shall certainly rouse thee up against them, they shall not be allowed to be thy neighbour in it, but a little while,
33:61: (They are) cursed (driven off) wherever they are found they shall be seized and slain (and it shall be a horrible) slaughter!
33:62: (Such has been) the way of God concerning those who have passed away before; and never shalt thou find in the way of God any change.
33:63: Ask thee the people about the Hour (of Judgment). Say thou: “The knowledge of it is only with God, and what will make thee know? happly the Hour (of Judgment) may be nigh.
33:64: Verily God hath cursed the disbelievers and hath prepared for them a flaming fire,
33:65: For ever shall they abide therein they shall find not a protector nor a helper.
33:66: On that day when their faces shall be turned into the fire, they shall say: “Oh! would that we had obeyed God and obeyed the Apostle!
33:67: And they shall say: “O’ Our Lord! verily we obeyed our chiefs and our elders, and they led us astray from the path:
33:68: O’ our Lord! give them a double chastisement, and curse them a great curse.
33:69: O’ ye who believe! be not like those who afflicted Moses (with a slander), but God cleared him of what they said, and he was with God in high esteem.
33:70: O’ ye who believe! Guard yourselves (against the wrath of God) and speak ye the right word,
33:71: He will set right for you your deeds, and forgive you your faults; and whoever obeyeth God and His Apostle, then indeed he hath achieved a great success.
33:72: Verily We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid thereof; and man undertook it, verily he was (proved) unjust, ignorant,
33:73: So will God chastise the hypocrite-men and the hypocrite-women and the polytheist men and the polytheist-women and God will turn (merciful) unto the believer-men and the believer women; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
34:1: All praise is God’s, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and His is all praise in the hereafter; and He is the All Wise, the All-Aware.
34:2: Knoweth He whatever that passeth into the earth and whatever that cometh out of it, and whatever that cometh down from the heaven and whatever that goeth up unto it; and He is the Most Merciful, the Oft-Forgiving.
34:3: And say those who disbelieve: “The Hour (of Judgment) shall not come upon us.” Say thou: “Yea: By my Lord, the Knower of the unseen, it shall certainly come upon you, from Him is not hidden, the weight of (even) an atom in the heavens and nor in the earth, nor is there aught less than this and nor aught greater, but it is in the manifesting Book,
34:4: That He may recompense those who believe and do good; these it is for whom is forgiveness and an honourable sustenance.
34:5: And for those who strive hard in invalidating Our signs, these it is for whom is a chastisement of a painful torment.
34:6: And will see those whom knowledge hath been given, that which hath been sent down unto thee from thy Lord, that it is the truth, and it guideth unto the path of the All-Mighty, the Most Praised (One)
34:7: And say those who disbelieve, (in ridicule): “Shall we point out to you a man who informeth you that when ye are wholly scattered totally disintegrated, (even then) ye are certainly (returned) into a new creation?
34:8: Hath he forged a lie against God or there is madness in him?” Nay! those who believe not in the hereafter are in a torment and are straying far (away from the truth)
34:9: See they not then what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and the earth? If We please We will make them sink into the earth or We bring down upon them a portion from the heaven; Verily in this is a sign for every servant turning (unto the Lord).
34:10: And indeed gave We unto David from Us, a boon saying: “O’ Mountains! sing ye the praise of God along with him, and (ye) the birds (Too);” and made We soft for him, the iron,
34:11: Saying (unto David): “Make thou coats of mail, and measure its links and do good; verily I, of what all ye do, do see.
34:12: And for Solomon (We made subservient) the wind which travelled in the morning a month’s journey and a month’s journey in the evening; And We caused for him to flow a fountain of molten brass and of the jinn there were those who worked before him by the command of his Lord; and whoever among them turned away from Our Command, We will make him taste, of the chastisement of the flaming fire.
34:13: They made for him whatever he willeth of fortresses and statues, and basins (large as) reservoirs, and (huge) cooking cauldrons immovable from their places; “Act ye gratefully, O’ family of David! and very few of My servants are grateful!
34:14: And when We decreed death for him (Solomon), nothing did show them his death, but a worm of the earth which gnawed away his staff; and when it fell down, then came to know the jinn that had they known the unseen, they would have tarried not in the humiliating torment (of their toil)
34:15: Indeed for (the children of) Saba in their abode, there was a sign; two gardens on the right and the left; (and it was said unto them) “Eat ye of the sustenance of your Lord and give ye thanks unto Him”; A good land (it was, in this world) and (God is the) Lord Oft- Forgiving!
34:16: But they turned away, so sent We upon them a torrent irresistible and in place of their two gardens gave We unto them two gardens yielding bitter fruits and tamarisks and a few lote trees.
34:17: This We recompensed them for what they disbelieved; but do We (thus) recompense any save the ungrateful?
34:18: And We caused between them and the towns which We had blest, (other) towns to be seen, and We have made easy the journey therein; travel ye through them nights and days, secure.
34:19: Then said they: “O’ our Lord! make the spaces to be longer between our journey” and unjust were they unto themselves, We made them stories and scattered them with a total scattering; Verily in this are signs for every patient, grateful one.
34:20: And indeed ‘Iblis’ found true his conjecture concerning them, so they followed him, except a section of the believers.
34:21: And there is not for him any authority over them, save that We would know (distinguish) him who believeth in the here after, from him who is in doubt concerning it; and thy Lord is upon all things a Guard.
34:22: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Call ye upon those whom ye deemed (as gods) besides God; they own not the weight of (even) an atom in the heavens nor in the earth, nor for them is any partnership (share) in either (of them) nor for Him is (there) from among them any one to back up.
34:23: And will avail not aught any intercession with Him save of him whom He hath permitted, Until when terror shall be removed from their hearts, they shall say: “What is it that your Lord said?” They (the angels) shall say: “(that which is) True and He is the Most High, the Greatest!
34:24: Say thou: “Who provideth you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth?” Say thou: “(It is) God, and verily (either) we or ye are guided aright, or in manifest error?
34:25: Say thou: “Ye will not be questioned as to what we are guilty of, nor shall we be questioned as to what ye do.
34:26: Say thou: “Our Lord will gather us together, then will He judge between us with justice; and He is the Greatest Judge, the All Knowing.
34:27: Say thou: “Show me those whom ye associate with Him: Never (can ye ever do it); Nay! He is God the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
34:28: And (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) We sent thee not but unto the whole of mankind, a Bearer of glad tidings and a Warner, but most of the people know (it) not.
34:29: And say they: “When will this promise be (fulfilled)? If ye be truthful.
34:30: Say thou: “For you is the appointment of a day from which ye cannot hold it back (even) a while, nor can ye hasten it on.
34:31: And say those who disbelieve: “Never will we believe in this Qur’an, nor in that which is before it;” but couldst thou see when the unjust shall be made to stand before their Lord; returning reproaches from one unto another! Those who were despised as weak will say unto those who had prided: “Had it not been for you, we would certainly have been believers.
34:32: Those who had prided shall say unto those who were despised as weak: “What! did we turn you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay! ye were yourselves the guilty ones.
34:33: And those who were despised as weak shall say unto those who had prided: “Nay! (it was) (your) planning by night and by day, when ye bade us that we should disbelieve in God and set up equals unto Him.” And they shall feel regretful when they shall see the chastisement; And We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved; They are recompensed aught save what they did.
34:34: And We sent not a warner unto a town but the opulent ones of it said: “Verily we are disbelievers in what ye are sent with
34:35: And said they: “We are more (than you) in wealth and in children, and we shall not be the chastised
34:36: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad?): “Verily my Lord amplifieth the sustenance for whomsoever He willeth and straiteneth (it) (for whomsoever He pleaseth), but most of the people know not.
34:37: And neither your wealth and nor your children are that which bring you nigh unto Us, but whosoever believeth and doeth good, these are, (the ones) for whom is a double recompense for what they do, and they in the exalted places shall be secure.
34:38: And those who strive hard in invalidating Our signs, they shall be brought to the chastisement.
34:39: Say thou: “Verily my Lord amplifieth the sustenance for whomsoever He willeth of His servants and straiteneth (it) for him (whomsoever He pleaseth), and whatever thing ye spend, He returneth it (with His reward along with it), and He is the Best of Sustainers.
34:40: And on the day when He will gather them all together, then will He say unto the angels: “Did these worship you?
34:41: They shall say: “Glory be to Thee! Thou art our Guardian, not they; Nay! they worshipped the jinn; most of them were the believers in them.
34:42: So on that day shall not own one of you for the other any profit or harm; and We will say unto those who did injustice: “Taste ye the chastisement of the fire which ye did disbelieve.
34:43: And when are recited unto them Our clear signs say they: “This is none but a man, desireth he to turn ye away from what your fathers did worship,” and say they: “This (Qur’an) is naught but a falsehood forged” and those who disbelieve say of the truth when it cometh unto them: “This is nothing but a clear sorcery.
34:44: And We have not given them any books which they read, nor did We send unto them before thee any warner.
34:45: And belied those before them and these have not attained (even) the tithe of what We gave them, and yet they belied My apostles; so how (intense) was My abhorrence (of them).
34:46: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “I exhort you only to one thing, that rise up ye for God’s sake in twos and singly, then ponder ye: your companion (Our Apostle Muhammad) is not possessed, he is none but a warner (sent) unto you, before a severe chastisement.
34:47: Say thou: “Whatever recompense I have asked of you, it is only for yourselves; my recompense is (to be expected) from God (alone), and He is witness over all things.
34:48: Say thou: “Verily my Lord doth hurleth (out) the (light of) Truth, The Greatest Knower of the unseen.
34:49: Say thou: “The truth hath come, and falsehood neither bringeth forth anything nor doth it reproduce.
34:50: Say thou: “If I stray, I stray only against my own self, and if I am guided aright, it is of what hath revealed unto me my Lord; Verily He is All-Hearing, the (Most) Nigh.
34:51: And couldst thou see when they shall get terrified, then there shall be no escape and they shall be seized from a near place,
34:52: And they shall say: “We (now) believe in it.” And whence shall the approach (to faith) be for them from (such) a distant place?
34:53: And indeed they did disbelieve in it before, and aim their conjectures about the unseen from a distant place.
34:54: And a gulf shall be set between them and that which they desire, as was done unto the likes of them of yore, verily they have been in a disquieting doubt.
35:1: (All) praise is God’s, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, the Maker of the angels, messengers flying on wings, two, and three, and four: He addeth to His creation whatever He willeth; Verily God, over all things hath power.
35:2: Whatever God layeth open of His mercy unto the people, there is none to hold it back, and whatever He holdeth back there is none to send it forth after that, and He is the All- Mighty, the All-Wise.
35:3: O’ ye people! Remember ye God’s bounty on you; Is there any creator other than God who provideth you with your sustenance from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He; Whence then are ye turned away (from the truth)?
35:4: And if they belie thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) indeed have been belied apostles before thee; and unto God (alone) are returned all affairs!
35:5: O’ ye people! verily the promise of God is true, so let not the life of this world beguile you; and let not the Arch-Beguiler (Satan) beguile you about God!
35:6: Verily Satan is your enemy, so ye (too) take him (as your) enemy; He only inviteth his party that they may be the fellows of the flaming fire.
35:7: Those who disbelieve, for them shall be a severe chastisement; And as for those who believe and do good, for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense.
35:8: What! Is he then whose evil deed is made alluring that he beholdeth it good (equal to the one guided aright)! (Nay! by no means!), for verily God leaveth to stray whomsoever He willeth and guideth He whomsoever He willeth, so let not thy self go (in vain) in grief for them; Verily God knoweth all that they do.
35:9: And God is He Who sendeth the winds and they raise the clouds, then We drive them on to a country (which is) dead, and give We life therewith to the earth after its death; Even so is the (rising of the dead in) Resurrection.
35:10: Whosoever desireth honour (let him seek it from God, for) God’s (alone) is all honour; Unto Him (only) ascend all good words; and as for those who plot evil deeds, for them shall be a severe chastisement; and their plot, it shall be vain.
35:11: And God created you of dust, then of the life-germ, then He made you pairs (of male and female); and a female beareth not, nor doth she deliver, save with His knowledge; and ageth not the aged, nor finisheth from any one’s life, but it is all in a Book (decree ordained); Verily this, for God, is easy.
35:12: And nor are the two seas alike, this one (is) sweet, quencheth thirst its sweetness, (and) pleasant to drink, and the other salt, and bitter; and yet from them both, eat ye flesh fresh and take forth ornaments which wear ye; and seest thou the ships cleave through it, that ye may seek of His grace, and that ye may be grateful.
35:13: Causeth He the night to enter into the day, and the day to enter into the night, and hath made He subservient (unto you) the sun and the moon; each travelleth to an appointed time: This is God your Lord! His is the kingdom; and those whom ye call upon other than Him, own not (even) a straw.
35:14: If ye call on them they shall hear not your call; and even if they hear they shall answer you not; and on the Day of Judgment they will deny your associating them (with God), and none can (ever) inform thee as (the One Who is) the All-Aware.
35:15: O’ ye people! ye are the needy unto God; and God (alone) is He Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised One.
35:16: If He willeth, He will take you off and bring a new creation.
35:17: And nor this is hard for God.
35:18: And no bearer shall bear the burden of another; and if the heavy laden one should cry for (another bearer to carry) its burden, (even) aught of it shall not be carried, and even if he be near of kin; Thou canst but warn those who fear their Lord unseen and keep up regular prayer; And whosoever purifieth (himself), he only purifieth for his own self; And unto God (alone) is the destination (of all).
35:19: And alike are not (both) the blind and the seeing,
35:20: Nor the darkness and the light
35:21: Nor the shade and the heat,
35:22: And neither are alike (both) the living and the dead; Verily God heareth whom He willeth, and thou canst not make those hear who are in the graves.
35:23: None else art thou but a Warner.
35:24: Verily We sent thee with truth, as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner: and there is not a people but a warner hath gone among them.
35:25: And if they belie thee, so indeed did belie those before them; their apostles had come unto them with clear proofs, and with scriptures, and with the enlightening Book.
35:26: Then did I seize those who disbelieved, so how (Severe) was the abhorrence (of Mine)?
35:27: Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from the heaven; then We bring forth with it fruits of various colours; and in the mountains are streaks white and red, of various colours, and (others) intensely black?
35:28: And of the people and beasts and cattle are of various colours likewise; verily fear God only those of His servants endued with knowledge: Verily, God is All-Mighty, Oft-Forgiving.
35:29: Verily, those who recite the Book of God and establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with, secretly and openly, hope for a merchandise which will never perish,
35:30: That He may give them back their recompense (in full) and increase of His grace unto them; verily, He is Oft-Forgiving, the Greatest Appreciator (of Good)
35:31: And that which We have revealed unto thee of the Book, it is the truth testifying that which hath come before it; verily God, about His servants is All-Aware, All- Seeing.
35:32: Then made We the inheritors of the Book (Qur’an) those whom chose We from among Our servants: and of them is he who causeth himself to suffer a loss, and of them is he who followeth the middle course, and of them is he who is the foremost in goodness by God’s permission: This is that which is the greatest excellence.
35:33: Gardens of eternity they shall enter into, they shall be given to wear therein bracelets of gold and pearls, and their raiment therein be silk.
35:34: And they shall say: “All praise is God’s (alone) Who hath taken away from us (all) grief; Verily our Lord is Oft-Forgiving, the Greatest Appreciator (of goodness)
35:35: He Who hath alighted us of His grace in an abode to abide (for ever); therein toucheth us not any toil, nor affecteth us therein any fatigue.
35:36: And those who disbelieve, for them shall be the fire of Hell, it shall not be decreed that they should die, nor shall be lightened unto them aught of its torment; Thus do We retribute every ungrateful one.
35:37: And they shall cry aloud therein for help: “O’ our Lord! Take us out (hence), we will do good deeds other than what we used to do (before).” (It shall be said unto them by the Lord): “Did not We keep you alive long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? and came unto you the Warner (too); So (now) taste ye (the fruits of your deeds), then for the unjust there (shall be) no helper.
35:38: Verily, God (alone) is the Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth; Verily He knoweth all that is in the breasts (hearts).
35:39: He is the One Who made you the successors (of those who preceded you) in the earth; so whosoever disbelieveth against him shall be his disbelief; And the disbelief of the infidels shall increase not with their Lord but (His) wrath, and increaseth not the disbelief of the infidels but loss.
35:40: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “See ye not your partners whom ye call upon other than God? Show me what part of the earth they have created, or have they any share in the heavens; or gave We unto them any scripture so that from it they (may give) proof (of their claim) Nay! Promise not the unjust unto one another of them but only to delude.
35:41: Verily, God holdeth the heavens and the earth lest they come to naught; and if they come to naught none besides Hirn can hold them back; Verily, He is the Most Forbearing, the Oft-Forgiving.
35:42: And swore they by God with the strongest oaths that if came unto them a warner, they would certainly be guided aright better than any other people; but when came unto them a warner it increased not in them but their aversion,
35:43: (In) priding in the earth, and planning evil; and the evil plans {of theirs) shall beset not but the devisers themselves; Then wait they for aught save the course of the people gone before? For never shall thou find any change in the course of God; and never shalt thou find in the course of God any alteration.
35:44: Have they travelled not in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them though they were stronger than them in strength? And God is not such to frustrate Him aught in the heavens or in the earth; Verity He is the All-Knowing, All-Powerful
35:45: And were God to seize the people (to punish them) for what they wrought, He would leave not on the back of it (the earth) any moving being, but He respiteth them till an appointed term; and when cometh their doom, then verily God, about His servants is All-Seeing.
36:2: By Qur’an (The Word of) the All-Wise,
36:3: Verily thou (O’ Muhammad!) art of the apostles (sent by Us),
36:5: Sent down of the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful,
36:6: So that thou mayest warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and who therefore are heedless (of the truth)
36:7: Indeed the word hath been proved true of most of them, and wherefore they believe not.
36:8: Verily, We have put chains in their necks, and these reach up to their chins, and their heads are forced up stiffed.
36:9: And We have to set before them a barrier and behind them a barrier, and We covered them over, so that they see not.
36:10: And alike is it unto them if thou warneth them not, for they will not believe.
36:11: Verily thou canst warn only him who abideth by the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent (God) unseen; so bear thou unto him the glad tidings of forgiveness and an honourable recompense.
36:12: Verily We, (and) We (alone) give life unto the dead, and We write down what they have sent before them and (even) their footprints (which they leave behind them): And everything have We confined (recorded) into a Manifesting Imam (Guide).
36:13: And set forth unto them the instance of the people of a town when came unto it (Our) Apostles,
36:14: When sent We unto them two (of Our apostles) they belied them both, then We strengthened (the two) with a third (one from Us) and said they (unto the people): “Verily we are unto you the apostles (from God)
36:15: They said: “Ye are not but men like unto us, nor hath sent down the Beneficent (God) any thing, ye only utter a lie.
36:16: They said: “Our Lord knoweth that we are verily unto you the apostles.
36:17: And on us is nothing but a clear deliverance (of the message)
36:18: Said they: “Verily we augur ill from you, if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you, and there shall afflict you from us a painful torment.
36:19: They said: “your augury of ill is with yourselves; What! when ye are admonished (deem ye ill of it) 1 Nay! ye are people transgressing (exceedingly)
36:20: And came from the farthest part of the city a man running and said: “O’ my people! Follow ye (these) the apostles (of God),
36:21: Follow ye those who ask you not any recompense, and they are guided aright.
36:22: And why should not I worship only Him Who brought me into being? and unto Whom ye shall all be returned:
36:23: What! Shall I take besides Him any gods, if (God) The Beneficent willeth to afflict me with harm, their intercession shall not avail me aught, neither can they deliver me?
36:24: Verily, I in which case shall be in manifest error:
36:25: Verily, I believe in your Lord, so hear me!
36:26: It Was said (unto him): “Enter thou, the garden!” Said he: “Oh! would that my people had known,
36:27: Of that for which my Lord hath forgiven me and hath made me of the honoured ones
36:28: We sent not down upon his people any hosts from heaven, nor were We (in need) to send (any such hosts).
36:29: It was nothing but one terrible cry, and lo! they were (like ashes) extinct.
36:30: Alas! the servants (are misled and yet) there cometh not unto them an apostle but they mock at him.
36:31: What! See they not how many of the generation We did destroy before them? they will return not unto them.
36:32: And assuredly all, gathered together, shall be brought before Us.
36:33: And a sign unto them is the dead earth; We give life to it and bring We forth from it grain of which they eat.
36:34: And make We therein gardens of date-palms and grapevines, and cause We to flow therein springs,
36:35: That they may eat of its fruits, and made it not their hands; What! will they not then be grateful?
36:36: Hallowed is He Who created pairs (of) all things, of what groweth the earth, of their selves and of what they know not.
36:37: And a sign unto them, is the night, We draw forth from it the day, and Io! they are in the dark,
36:38: And the sun travelleth unto a resting-place fixed for it; That is the decree of the All- Mighty, the All-Knowing.
36:39: And (as for) the moon. We have fixed for it stages till it returneth to be bent like an old palm branch.
36:40: It is not (expedient) for the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; and each (of these luminaries) rotate on in (its peculiar) sphere.
36:41: And a sign unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden Ark,
36:42: And that We have created for them (the other conveyances) like it, on which ride they.
36:43: And if We only will, We can drown them, then there shall not be any one to help them, nor shall they be rescued,
36:44: Save (by) mercy from Us and as an enjoyment for yet awhile.
36:45: And when it is said unto them: “Guard ye (yourselves) against what is before you and what is behind you, that ye be treated with mercy.
36:46: And there cometh not unto them any sign from the signs of their Lord but from it turn they away.
36:47: And when it is said unto them: “Spend ye of what God hath provided you with the sustenance,” say those who disbelieve unto those who believe: “What! shall we feed him whom, if God willeth, He could feed? Ye are not but in a manifest error.
36:48: And say they: “When will this promise come to pass, if ye be truthful?
36:49: They wait not but for a single (terrible) cry which will seize them while they wrangle with one another.
36:50: Then shall they not be able to make a bequest, nor shall they be able to return unto their families.
36:51: And is blown the Trumpet, when lo! From the grave unto their Lord they (all) hasten.
36:52: They shall say: “Oh! woe unto us! who hath raised us up from our place of repose?” (it will be replied): “This is what the Beneficent (God) did promise and the apostles spake the truth.
36:53: There will be but a single cry, when lo! they shall all be brought unto Us.
36:54: So this day no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least, nor shall ye be recompensed but that which ye were doing.
36:55: Verily, the inmates of the Garden shall on that day be busy enjoying.
36:56: They and their mates, shall be in (Pleasant) shades, on raised couches reclining;
36:57: For them therein shall be fruits, and for them shall be whatever they call for.
36:58: (They shall receive the greeting): “Peace” a word (of salutation) from the Lord the Most Merciful.
36:59: (And a voice would say): “And get ye aside this day O’ ye the guilty ones!
36:60: Enjoined I not on you O’ children of Adam! that ye should worship not Satan? for he is your open enemy,
36:61: And ye should worship (only) Me, (and) this is the (only) Right way?
36:62: And yet hath he led astray a great multitude of you; Did ye not then understand?
36:63: This is the hell which ye were promised,
36:64: Enter ye into it, for what ye were disbelieving.
36:65: On that day will We set a seal upon their mouths, and shall speak unto Us their hands and shall bear witness their feet, of what they were earning.
36:66: And if We will, We would certainly put out their eyes, then they would struggle (groping) to get first to the way, but how could they see?
36:67: And if We will, We would certainly transform them in their (own) places, then they would not be able to go on, nor will they return.
36:68: And whomsoever We lengthen in age, We reverse him to an abject state in life, What! Do they understand not?
36:69: We have taught him not poetry, nor would it beseem him; It is naught but a Remin der and manifesting Qur’an,
36:70: To warn him who is alive, and (that) the word be proved against the disbelievers.
36:71: What! See they not that We created the cattle for them, of what Our hands have wrought, and of them they are the masters?
36:72: And them (the cattle) We did subject unto them and some of them they ride upon, and some of them they eat.
36:73: And for them in them are benefits and drinks: What! will they not then be grateful?
36:74: And (yet) they have taken gods besides (the only True) God so that they may be helped.
36:75: They shall not be able to help them: and yet they (the disbelievers) are their host (who on the Day of Resurrection) shall be brought forth to account.
36:76: So let not their speech grieve thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!), (for) verily know We what they do hiding, and what they do openly.
36:77: What! Seest not man that We created him from (a drop of) sperm? (and) yet lo! he is an open disputant!
36:78: He setteth unto Us an argument, and hath forgotten his (own) creation (origin), Sayeth he: “Who will enliven the bones when they are rotten?
36:79: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “He will enliven them Who created them for the first time, and He is, fully cognizant of (all) the creation,
36:80: He who made for you the fire from the green tree, and lo! from it ye kindle (fire).
36:81: What! Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create (again) the like of them? Yea! and He is the Creator (Omnipotent), the All-Knowing.
36:82: His command, when intendeth He anything, is only that He sayeth unto it ‘Be’ then (and there) it is.
36:83: Therefore, Hallowed is He in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things, and unto Him ye shall all be returned.
37:1: By those who range themselves in ranks,
37:2: And (by) those, who drive away the evil with reproof,
37:3: And by the reciters of Qur’an,
37:5: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and the Lord of the places of the rising of (the sun and the moon).
37:6: Verily We have adorned the heaven nearest to this world (earth) with an adornment, the stars,
37:7: And (which is also) a guard against every rebellious Satan;
37:8: (So that) They may hear not (what passeth in) the assembly on high, and they are darted from every side.
37:9: (To be) Driven off, and for them being a perpetual chastisement,
37:10: Except, he who stealeth (a word) by stealth then pursueth him a glistening flame.
37:11: Ask them then (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Are they stronger in creation or (the others) whom We have made?” Verily We created them of a sticky clay.
37:12: Nay! Wonderest thou (at their disbelief) while they mock (at thee)
37:13: And when they are warned, they mind not,
37:14: And when they see a sign they incite mocking (at it)
37:15: And say they: “this is but an open sorcery
37:16: What! when we are dead and are dust and bones, shall we (even then) indeed be raised?
37:18: Say thou: “Yea! ye shall be disgraced
37:19: Then it will only be a single roar, when lo! they shall gaze (around),
37:20: And they shall say: “Oh! Woe unto us! This is the Day of Reckoning;
37:21: This is the Day of Judgment which ye used to belie
37:22: (And the angels will be commanded): “Gather ye together those who were unjust and their mates, and what they used to worship,
37:23: Besides God, and lead them all unto Hell.
37:24: And stop them, for verily they have to be questioned:
37:25: ( Saying) “How now, that ye help not one another?
37:26: Nay! on that day they shall be submitting themselves.
37:27: And some of them shall advance unto the others questioning each other.
37:28: They shall say: “Verily ye did come unto us beguiling from the right side.
37:29: They shall say: “Nay! ye (yourselves) were not the believers:
37:30: And there was not for us over you any authority. Nay! ye were a people rebellious!
37:31: So now hath been proved true against us the sentence of Our Lord that verily we shall (have to) taste (the doom)
37:32: And we led you astray, for verily we ourselves were astray.
37:33: Verily they on that day shall be the sharers in the punishment.
37:34: Verily, thus do We deal with the guilty ones.
37:35: Verily they, when it was said unto them that there is no god but God, used to behave proudly,
37:36: And (used) to say “What! Are we to indeed give up our gods for a poet (who is) crazed?
37:37: Nay! he hath come with the truth and did testify the (preceding) apostles.
37:38: Verily, ye will taste the painful chastisement.
37:39: And ye shall be recompensed not but what ye were doing,
37:40: Save the servants of God, the freed ones (from evil inclinations).
37:41: They, for them is a sustenance known,
37:42: Fruits, and they shall be highly honoured,
37:45: Round will go unto them a cup from a clear spring,
37:46: Limpid white, delicious unto those who, drink.
37:47: Nothing therein to oppress the sense, nor shall they be exhausted therewith
37:48: And with them shall be chaste women with modest gaze, with big (beautiful) eyes,
37:49: As if they were eggs (secured) hidden
37:50: And shall advance some of them unto the others questioning each other.
37:51: Shall say a speaker (among them) who shall speak: “Verily, there was of mine an intimate one,
37:52: He used to say: “What! art thou (too, indeed) of the testifying ones (of the Resurrection)?
37:53: What! when we are dead and are dust and bones, shall we (even) then in fact be brought to account?
37:54: He shall say (unto those around him): “Will ye look?
37:55: Then he looked down and saw him in the midst of Hell.
37:56: He shall say: “By God! thou hast almost caused me to perish!
37:57: And had it not been the bounty of my Lord, certainly would I (too) have been (with thee) brought into (the Hell)
37:58: Is it then we die not (hereafter)?
37:59: Save our first death; And we shall not be chastised?
37:60: Verily this is a great achievement.
37:61: For the like of this should act every active one!
37:62: Is this the better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum?
37:63: Verily, We have made it a trial for the unjust.
37:64: Verily, it is a tree that groweth in the bottom of the hell,
37:65: Its produce is (ugly) as the heads of the satans.
37:66: And verily they shall eat from it and fill (their) bellies with it.
37:67: Then verily for them shall be to drink over it, a mixture in boiling water.
37:68: Then verily their return shall be unto the hell
37:69: Verily they found their fathers going astray,
37:70: So they in their footsteps did hasten on.
37:71: And indeed went astray most of the ancients before them,
37:72: And indeed We did send among them warners.
37:73: See then how had been the end of those (already) warned,
37:74: Save the servants of God, the freed ones (from sinning).
37:75: And indeed did call on Us Noah, and (We are) the Most Excellent answerers (of prayer)
37:76: And We, delivered him and his followers from the great distress.
37:77: And We made his progeny the survivors.
37:78: And We did perpetuate for him (his praise) in the later generations.
37:79: Peace be on Noah in all the worlds!
37:80: Verily thus do We recompense the doers of good.
37:81: Verily he was (one) of Our faithful servants.
37:83: And verily of his persuasion was Abraham.
37:84: When came he unto his Lord with a submissive heart,
37:85: When said he unto his father and his people: “What is it that ye worship?
37:86: Is it a falsehood - gods other than (the One True) God, desire ye?
37:87: What then think ye about the Lord of the worlds?
37:88: Then glanced he, casting glance at the stars,
37:89: Then said he: “Verily, sick I am (of your worshipping these)
37:90: So they turned away turning their backs.
37:91: Then he turned unto their gods secretly and said: “What! eat ye not?
37:92: What aileth you that ye speak not?
37:93: Then he attacked them in secret, striking with his right hand
37:94: Then came they (the worshippers) hastening unto him.
37:95: Said he: “What! worship ye what ye (yourselves) hew out?
37:96: And God hath created you and (also) what ye make (the idols)
37:97: Said they: “Erect for him a building (furnace) and fling him in the flaming fire!
37:98: So they desired a plot against him, but We brought them low.
37:99: And said he: “Verily, I am going unto my Lord, He will guide me;
37:100: O’ my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!
37:101: So We gave him the glad tidings of a son extremely forbearing
37:102: And when (the son) reached (the age of) working with him, said he: “O’ my son! verily I saw in a dream that I sacrifice thee: now what is thy view?” Said (the son)! “O’ father! Do thou what thou art bidden; If God willeth, thou wilt find me of the steadfast ones
37:103: And when they both had surrendered (themselves) to the will of God and he (Abraham) threw him (the son) upon his forehead,
37:104: And We called out unto him: “O’ Abraham!
37:105: Indeed hast thou proved true the dream; Verily thus do We recompense the doers of good!
37:106: Verily, this is an open trial.
37:107: And We ransomed him with a Great Sacrifice.
37:108: And We shifted (this blessing) on him (who is from) among the generations (to come) in later times;
37:110: Thus do We recompense the doers of good.
37:111: Verily he was (one) of Our faithful servants.
37:112: And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous ones.
37:113: And bestowed We Our blessings on him and on Isaac: and on their progeny are the doers of good, and those (too) who are openly unjust to their own selves.
37:114: And indeed conferred We Our favour on Moses and Aaron.
37:115: And We delivered them both and their people from the great distress
37:116: And We succoured them, so they were the triumphants.
37:117: And We gave them both the Book making things clear.
37:118: And We guided them both on the right way.
37:119: And We perpetuated their praise in the later generations,
37:120: Peace be on Moses and Aaron.
37:121: Verily, thus do We recompense the doers of good.
37:122: Verily, they were both Our faithful servants,
37:123: And verily, Elias was (one) of the apostles.
37:124: When said he unto his people; “What! Guard ye not yourselves (against evil)?
37:125: What! Call ye upon Ba’l and forsake the Best of the creators?
37:126: God, is your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of yore?
37:127: But they belied him, so they shall certainly be brought (to account),
37:128: Save the servants of God, the freed ones (from sinning)
37:129: And We perpetuated his praise in the later generations,
37:131: Verily, thus do We recompense the doers of good.
37:132: Verily, he was (one) of Our faithful servants.
37:133: And verily Lot, was (one) of the apostles.
37:134: When We delivered him and his followers all.
37:135: Save an aged woman among those who tarried.
37:137: And verily, ye pass by (their ruined dwellings) at morn,
37:138: And at night; What! (even) then understand ye not?
37:139: And verily Jonah was (one) of the apostles.
37:140: When he fled unto a ship fully laden,
37:141: And they drew lots, and he was of those who were cast off.
37:142: And the fish swallowed him while he was blamed.
37:143: So if it were not that he was of those who glorify Us,
37:144: He would certainly have been detained in its belly to the Day (of Resurrection) when they shall be raised;
37:145: And We cast him forth on the naked shore and he was sick.
37:146: And caused We to grow (to give shade) over him, a plant of gourd.
37:147: And We sent him unto a hundred thousand (people) or (even) more were they.
37:148: And believed they, so We gave them provision till a time.
37:149: Then ask them (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) Is it that thy Lord hath daughters, and they have sons?
37:150: Or have We created the angels, females? and did they witness it?
37:151: Beware! Verily it is of their own falsehood that they say:
37:152: (that) God hath begotten: And verily they utter a lie.
37:153: Hath he preferred daughters to sons?
37:154: What hath happened to you? How judge ye?
37:155: What! will ye not then reflect?
37:156: Or have ye any clear authority?
37:157: Then bring ye your book if ye be truthful.
37:158: And assign they between Him and the jinn a kinship, and indeed the jinn to know that they shall surely be brought up (to account on the Day of Judgment)
37:159: Hallowed is God far above from what they ascribe (unto Him),
37:160: But (not so are) the servants, freed (from sinning)
37:161: So verily ye and what ye worship,
37:162: Ye can excite not (any one) against Him,
37:163: Except him who goes to Hell.
37:164: And there is not (any one) of us, but for him is an assigned place,
37:165: And verily we are they who range ourselves in order.
37:166: And verily we are they who celebrate His praise.
37:167: And certainly they used to say,
37:168: Had we a reminder from those of yore,
37:169: Certainly had we been the servants of God, sincerely devoted
37:170: Then disbelieved they with it, so, soon will they know.
37:171: And indeed Our word hath already gone forth about Our servants, the apostles:
37:172: Verily they shall be the succoured ones.
37:173: And verily Our hosts, (only) they shall be the victorious.
37:174: So turn thou away from them for a time,
37:175: And (then) behold thou: for they too shall soon behold (their doom).
37:176: What! would they then hasten on Our chastisement?
37:177: But when it shall descend in their court, evil shall then be the morning of the warned ones.
37:178: And turn thou away from them for a time,
37:179: And (then) behold thou, for they too shall soon see (their doom).
37:180: Hallowed is thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, far above from that which they ascribe (unto Him)
37:181: And peace be upon the apostles.
37:182: And all praise is God’s, the Lord of the worlds.
38:1: Sad, (S) By the Qur’an (which) is full of admonition
38:2: Nay! those who disbelieve are (steeped) in self-exaltation and opposition.
38:3: How many We did destroy of the generations before them, and they cried while (there was no longer) the time to escape.
38:4: And they did wonder that came unto them a warner from among themselves, and said the disbelievers: “This is a sorcerer, a great liar.
38:5: What! maketh he the gods to be but one God? Verily this is a thing indeed strange!
38:6: And the chiefs from them get away (impatiently, exhorting the others saying): “Walk ye away hence and be steadfast unto your gods: verily this is (but) with something designed against us!
38:7: We heard not of this in the former creed. This is nothing but an imposture:
38:8: (What!) Hath the reminder been sent down (only) unto him among us?” Nay! they are in doubt about My reminder, Nay! they have yet tasted not My chastisement!
38:9: Or is it that with them are the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the All-Mighty, the Greater Bestower?
38:10: Or is it that unto them belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend with means
38:11: And what a mighty host of the clans shall here be routed.
38:12: And did belie before them the people of Noah, and ’Ad, and Pharaoh the lord, of stakes (of established authority),
38:13: And Thamood and the people of Lot and the dwellers of the wood; these were the clans.
38:14: Not one (of them) but did belie the apostles (from Me) so just was (My) retribution.
38:15: And wait not these (infidels) but a single (Trumpet) blast, there shall be no delaying it.
38:16: And (yet) they (dare to) say: “O’ Our Lord! hasten on unto us our lot before the Day of Reckoning
38:17: Bear (thou) with patience what they say, and remember Our servant David, (who was blessed by Us) with the strength of hand, (and yet) verily he (was the one who) Oft-turned (unto Us in patience).
38:18: Verily, We did subject the mountains to join with him in the hymns (of their Lord) at the night-fall and at sunrise,
38:19: And the birds assembled together (to sing the hymns unto their Lord) and were unto him obedient.
38:20: And made We strong his kingdom and bestowed We on him wisdom, and the clear (power of) judgment.
38:21: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? when they climbed the wall into the prayer room?
38:22: When entered they upon David and he was frightened of them, said they: “Fear (thou) not, (we are) two litigants, one of us hath exceeded against the other, so decide thou between us with justice, and act not unjustly, and guide us unto the right way.
38:23: Verily, this my brother; he hath ninety and nine ewes and for me is but a single ewe;” but said he, “Make me the owner of that (also), and hath prevailed over me in arguing
38:24: Said (David): “Indeed hath he been unjust unto thee in demanding thine ewe to add her to his own ewes: Verily many of the associates act wrongfully unto one another, save those who believe and do good deeds, and few are they!” And David perceived that We had tried him: so asked he the forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down bowing and oft-turning himself (unto Us).
38:25: So We forgave him that (lapse), and verily for him with Us is a near approach, and an excellent resort.
38:26: O’ David! Verily We have appointed thee a vicegerent in the earth, so judge thou between the people with justice and follow not vain desires, lest it should take thee astray from the Way of God; for them shall be a severe chastisement for forgot they the Day of Reckoning.
38:27: And We created not the heavens and the earth in vain: that is the imagination of those who disbelieve; then woe unto those who disbelieve - because of the fire.
38:28: (Or) shall We treat those who believe and do good deeds like the mischief-makers in the earth? Or shall We treat the pious ones like the wicked ones?
38:29: (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad! this Qur’an is) the Book which We have sent down unto thee, abounding in blessings, that they may ponder over its verses, and bear in mind those (who are) endowed with understanding.
38:30: And to David We gave (a son) Solomon; an excellent servant (of Ours was he); Verily he was oft-turning (unto Us).
38:31: Remember when were shown unto him at eventide lightfooted coursers.
38:32: Then said he: “Verily I have loved the good things besides the remembrance of my Lord, until got hidden in the veil (of the darkness of the Night):
38:33: (Then said he): “Bring it back unto me!” And he began to rub the legs and necks.
38:34: And indeed We did try Solomon, and cast on his throne a (mere) body, then turned he (unto God).
38:35: Said he: “O’ my Lord! Forgive me and grant me a dominion such as shall not befit any one after me, verily Thou alone art the Bounteous Bestower!
38:36: Then We made subservient unto him the wind: it flew gently at his command whithersoever he desired.
38:37: And the satans, every builder, and diver,
38:38: And the others bound in chains;
38:39: This is Our gift, now give thou freely or withhold it, (for thou hast) not to render (any) account.
38:40: And verily, for him unto Us is a near approach and an excellent resort.
38:41: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried unto his Lord; “Verily, Satan hath caused me an affliction and pain.
38:42: (Said We unto him); “Stamp thou with thy foot” thou this (spring) is (for thee) to wash with, (it is) cool, and a (refreshing) drink
38:43: And gave him his family and the like of them with them, a mercy from Us and a reminder for those with understanding.
38:44: And (it was said unto him) “Take in thine hand a bunch of (thin) stick (like fibre) and strike thou (thy wife) with it, and break not thine oath. Verily We found him steadfast; an excellent servant (was he): Verily he was oft-turning (unto Us).
38:45: And remember thou Our servants, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight.
38:46: Verily We freed them (from sinning) with a distinction of remembrance of the (eternal) abode.
38:47: Verily, they are with Us, of the chosen ones, the good ones.
38:48: And remember Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu’l-Kifl; they all were of the good ones.
38:49: This is a reminder; and verily, for the pious ones there is an excellent resort,
38:50: Gardens of eternal bliss, opened for them are the doors (thereof).
38:51: Reclining therein, calling therein for many a fruit and drink.
38:52: And with them shall be of modest gaze, equals in age.
38:53: This is what ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
38:54: Verily, this is Our sustenance; for it there is no end,
38:55: This (for the righteous); and verily for the wicked ones there a wretched resort,
38:56: Hell, they shall enter it, and so evil is the place,
38:57: Even so, Let them then taste it - boiling water and gore,
38:58: And other (torment) similar to it, of various sort!
38:59: (To their leaders it shall be said) “This army (of your followers) shall be thrown headlong with you! No welcome for them! Verily they shall enter the fire!
38:60: They shall say: “Nay! ye too! there shall be no welcome for you; Indeed ye did prepare this for us; and wretched is the abode!
38:61: They shall say: “O’ our Lord! Whoever hath brought this for us, increase Thou a twofold torment in the fire.
38:62: And they shall say: “What hath happened unto us that we see not the men whom we counted among the wicked ones?
38:63: What! was it that we (wrongly) took them to scorn, or have our eyes turned from them?
38:64: Verily, this is truth - the wrangling of one with another of the inmates of the fire.
38:65: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “I am only a warner and there is no god but God the One, The Almighty!
38:66: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and what is between them two, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.
38:67: Say thou: “It is a message of (great) importance,
38:68: (And) ye are turning away from it.
38:69: I had no knowledge of the exalted chiefs when they disputed!
38:70: It is revealed unto me save that I am an open Warner.
38:71: Remember when thy Lord said unto the angels: “Verily I am about to create man from clay,
38:72: And when I have completed and have breathed into him of My spirit, then fall ye prostrating in obeisance unto him.
38:73: And did fall prostrating in obeisance the angels all together,
38:74: Save Iblis; he was proud and was of the disbelievers.
38:75: Said (God): “O’ Iblis! what prevented thee that thou shouldst not prostrate in obeisance unto him whom I created with My two hands? Art thou proud or art thou of the exalted ones?
38:76: Said he: “I am better than he: Thou hast created me of fire and Thou didst create him from clay.
38:77: Said (God): “Begone thou out of it, for verily thou art the outcast one!
38:78: And verily on thee shall be My curse to the Day of Judgment.
38:79: He said: “O’ my Lord! then Respite me to the Day when they (Adam and his posterity) will be raised,
38:80: Said (God): “Verily then thou art of the respited ones,
38:81: Till the day of the time made known!
38:82: Said he: “Then by Thy Might, I will certainly beguile them all,
38:83: Save Thy servants from among them the freed ones,
38:84: He said: “Then it is the truth - and the truth do I speak,
38:85: Certainly, will I fill hell with thee and with those who follow thee, all (together)
38:86: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “I ask ye not for any recompense for it; nor am I of the imposters
38:87: It is naught but a Reminder unto the worlds
38:88: And certainly ye will come to know about it after a time.
39:1: The descent of the Book (Qur’an) is from God, the Al-Mighty, The All-Wise.
39:2: Verily, We have sent down unto thee the Book (Qur'an) with the truth; so worship thou God (alone), being sincere unto Him in religion
39:3: Beware! Unto God alone is due all obedience; and those who take guardians besides Him, (say) “we worship them not save (in order) that they may make us near unto God,” verily God will judge between them about what they differ; Verily, God guideth him not who is a liar, an ingrate
39:4: Had God intended to take a son unto Himself, certainly would He select those He willeth of what He hath created, Hallowed is He! He (alone) is God, the Almighty.
39:5: He hath created the heavens and the earth with the truth; causeth He the night to enter the day and the day to enter the night, and subjected the sun and the moon; each one speedeth on to an assigned term; Beware! He is the All-Mighty, the Oft- Forgiving.
39:6: He created you from a single being, then made He from it its mate, and sent down for you eight in pairs, of the cattle, He createth you in the wombs of your mothers a creation after a creation, in triple darkness; that is God your Lord, His is the kingdom; there is no god but He; How then are ye turned away?
39:7: If ungrateful ye be, then verily God is (Self-Sufficient) independent of you; and He liketh not ingratitude in His servants; and if ye be grateful; He liketh it in you; and no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another; then unto your Lord is your return, then will He inform you of what ye were doing; verily, He knoweth all what is in the breasts (hearts).
39:8: And when toucheth man a distress he crieth unto his Lord, oft-turning unto Him; and when He bestowed upon him a favour from Him, forgetteth he that for which he did cry unto Him before, and (he) setteth up rivals unto God, that he may beguile (men) to stray away from His path; say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad! unto such a man) “Enjoy thyself in thy ingratitude a little; verily, thou art of the inmates of the (Hell) fire
39:9: What! (this or) he who is prayerful during the hours of the night, prostrating in obeisance and standing, and he taketh heed of the hereafter and hopeth he for the mercy of his Lord! Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “What! Can those who know be equal to those who know not? Verily only the men of understanding take the warning
39:10: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “O’ my servants who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) your Lord, for those who do good in this world (there) is good, and God’s earth is extensive; Verily, only the patient ones will be paid their recompense without any account.
39:11: Say thou: “I have been bidden that I should worship God (alone) being sincere unto Him in religion,
39:12: And Commanded I am, that I shall be the first Muslim
39:13: Say: “Verily, fear I, if I disobey my Lord, the chastisement of a great day.
39:14: Say: “God (It is Whom) worship I, being sincere unto Him in my religion,
39:15: Worship ye then whatsoever ye like other than Him.” Say thou: “Verily, the losers are those who have lost their own selves and their families on the Day of Judgment; Beware! that is the clear loss
39:16: For them shall be from above them coverings of fire and from beneath them coverings; with that maketh God His servants to fear; (so) fear Me ye O’ My servants.
39:17: And those who shun the worship of the idols and turn they unto God, for them is the glad tidings, so bear thou the glad tidings unto My servants.
39:18: Those who hearken unto the word and follow the best of it; those are they whom God hath guided; and those it is who are the men of understanding.
39:19: What! Is he on whom the sentence of chastisement hath been justly passed (equal to one who deserveth a reward)? Canst thou rescue him who is in the fire?
39:20: But (for) those who fear the (wrath of) their Lord are lofty pavilions, above them (ever) lofty pavilions, built (for them), ’neath which flow rivers: (this is) the promise of God: Faileth not God (His) promise.
39:21: Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from heaven, then causeth it go into the earth in the springs, then bringeth forth with it herbage of various colours then it withereth that thou seest it yellow, then He maketh it chaff? Verily in this is a reminder for men of understanding.
39:22: What! is he whose breast (heart) God hath opened for Islam then he followeth the Light from God (like unto the hardhearted one)? Nay! Woe unto those whose hearts are hard against the remembrance of God; those are in a clear error.
39:23: God hath sent down the best recital, a Book Consistent (in its parts) with iteration, at which do shudder the skins of those who fear their Lord, then get softened their skins and their hearts unto the remembrance of God; This is God’s guidance, guideth He with it whomsoever He willeth; and whomsoever alloweth God to stray, for him there is no guide.
39:24: What! is he then who hath to guard himself with his own face against the torment of the chastisement on the Day of Judgment (like unto him who is secure from it)? And it will be said unto the unjust: “Taste ye what ye were earning!
39:25: Those before them did belie (the apostles) so came there unto them the chastisement from whence they perceived not.
39:26: Then did God make them taste the disgrace in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is greater: did they but know.
39:27: And indeed have We set forth for the people in this Qur’an examples of every sort that happly they may reflect.
39:28: An Arabic Qur’an without any crookedness, that happly they may guard themselves (against evil).
39:29: Setteth forth God the examples of the man in (the service of) associates quarrelling with each other, and of a man (devoted) wholly to a (single) man (Master). Can the two (such) ones be alike in condition? (No!) All Praise is God’s; Nay! most of them know not.
39:30: Verily thou shall (one day) die, and they (too) shall (one day) die.
39:31: Then verily ye on the Day of Judgment before your Lord will wrangle one with another.
39:32: Who is then more unjust than he who lieth about God and belieth the truth when it cometh unto him; Is there not in the Hell an abode for the disbelievers?
39:33: And he who bringeth the truth and he who testifieth it - These are they that are the pious ones.
39:34: For them is whatever they please with their Lord; that is the recompense of the doers of good;
39:35: That God may take away from them the worst of what they did, and recompense them with their reward for the best of what they used to do.
39:36: Is not God sufficient for His servant? And they frighten thee with those besides Him, and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him there shall not be any guide.
39:37: And whomsoever God guideth, then him none shall beguile; Is not God the Almighty Lord of Retribution?
39:38: And if thou ask them who created the heavens and the earth? They would certainly say: ‘God’; Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Bethink ye then of what ye call upon besides than God, if willeth God unto me a harm, could they be the removers of His harm, or if willeth (God) unto me His mercy, could they be the withholders of His mercy?” Say thou: “Sufficeth me God! On Him (alone) do rely the reliants.
39:39: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “O’ my people! Act ye (as ye like) in your place, verily I (too) do act, soon will ye come to know,
39:40: Who it is unto whom cometh a chastisement which will disgrace him, and whom there falleth the everlasting doom.
39:41: Verily We sent down on thee the Book (Qur'an) for the sake of the people, with the truth; and whosoever is guided aright, it is for his own self, and whosoever goeth astray, strayeth he only to its own hurt, and thou art not over them a custodian.
39:42: God taketh the souls at death, and those that die not (He taketh) during their sleep; and He withholdeth those on whom He hath passed the decree of death (from returning unto their bodies); but sendeth He the others (to their bodies) till a time which is fixed; Verily, in this are signs for a people who reflect.
39:43: Or, have they taken intercessors other than God? Say thou: “What! even though they have no power over anything, nor do they understand.
39:44: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “God’s (alone) is intercession altogether; His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; then unto Him (only) ye shall all be returned.
39:45: When God alone is mentioned, shrink the hearts of those who believe not in the hereafter; and when those besides Him are mentioned, lo! they rejoice.
39:46: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “O’ God! the Originator of the heavens and the earth, the Knower of the unseen and the manifest! Thou (alone) shalt judge between Thy servants in the matter wherein they were differing.
39:47: And had it been for those who did injustice, whatever is in the earth and the like added to it, they verily will seek to ransom themselves with it from the pain of the chastisement on the Day of Judgment; and there shall appear unto them, from God, that which they had not been reckoning.
39:48: And shall appear unto them the evils of what they wrought, and shall surround them that which they used to mock at.
39:49: And when toucheth man a harm he crieth unto Us; then when We grant him a favour from Us, sayeth he; “I have been granted it only on account of (my) knowledge.” Nay! it is only a trial, but most of them know not.
39:50: Indeed, the same did say those before them, but availed them not what they had been earning.
39:51: So befell unto them the evils what they did earn; and (for) those of these who did injustice, soon shall befall unto them the evils what they did earn, and they shall frustrate Us not (in Our Plans).
39:52: What! know they not that (it is) God (alone Who) amplifieth the sustenance unto whomsoever He willeth, and straiteneth (it) (whosoever He willeth); Verily in this are signs for a people who believe.
39:53: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “O’ My servants! who have been extravagant unto their own selves, despair ye not of the mercy of God; verily God forgiveth sins all together; verily He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
