39:54: And return ye unto your Lord, and resign ye yourselves unto Him, ere cometh unto you the chastisement, for then ye shall not be helped.
39:55: And follow ye the most excellent thing what hath been sent down unto you from your Lord, ere cometh unto you the chastisement suddenly while ye even perceive it not,
39:56: Lest a soul should say: “Oh! Alas, Woe unto me! for what I failed (in my duty) unto God, and certainly was I of those who mocked,
39:57: Or, it should say: “Had God guided me, I would certainly have been of the pious ones,
39:58: Or, it should say when it seeth the chastisement: “Had there been only a return for me, I would be of the righteous (ones)
39:59: Nay! indeed did come unto thee My signs, then thou didst belie them, thou didst act proudly and thou wert of the disbelievers.
39:60: And on the Day of Resurrection thou shalt see those who have uttered lies against God their faces shall be blackened; is there not in Hell an abode for the proud?
39:61: And shall deliver God those who guard (themselves) against evil, with their success: evil shall touch them not, nor shall they grieve.
39:62: God (alone) is the Creator of everything, and He (alone) is over all things the Guardian.
39:63: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth; and those who disbelieve in the signs of God, these are they who are the losers.
39:64: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!)'. “What! Bid ye me to worship others than God? O’ ye ignorant ones!
39:65: And indeed hath it been revealed unto thee and unto those before thee: “Verily if thou associatest (others with God), certainly would come to naught thy work, and certainly wouldst thou be of the losers.
39:66: Nay! But God alone, worship thou and be of the thankful ones.
39:67: They have esteemed not God, as it is His rightful due; While the whole earth shall be in His grip on the Day of Judgment and heavens rolled up (shall be) in His right hand; Hallowed is He, high above what they associate (with Him).
39:68: And (when) shall be blown the Trumpet, then shall swoon (die) whoever is in the heavens and whoever is in the earth save those whom God hath willed (to keep alive); then (the Trumpet) shall be blown again, then lo! they shall stand up awaiting.
39:69: And the earth shall get radiant with the light of its Lord, and the Book (of deeds) shall be set, and the prophets shall be brought up and the witnesses, and (it shall) be judged between them, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.
39:70: And shall be paid in full unto every soul what it hath wrought, and He knoweth best what they do.
39:71: And shall be driven those who disbelieved, unto the Hell, in flocks; Until, when come they to it, its doors shall be opened and shall say unto them the keepers of it; “Came not unto you apostles from among you reciting unto you the signs of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your day?” they shall say; “Yea! but just is the sentence of punishment on the disbelievers
39:72: It shall be said (unto them): “Enter ye (Now) the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and wretched the abode of the arrogant.
39:73: And shall be conveyed those who feared (the wrath of) their Lord, in companies unto the garden; until when they come to it, and its doors shall be opened, and the keepers of it shall say unto them: “Peace be on you! ye shall be happy; Enter it then to abide.
39:74: And they shall say: “All praise is God’s, Who hath made good to us His promise, and He hath made us to inherit the earth, we may dwell in the gardens wherever we please, and goodly is the recompense of the workers (of good deeds).
39:75: And thou shalt see the angels circling around the ‘Arsh’ (The Throne of Absolute Authority), celebrating the Praise of their Lord; and it shall be judged between them with justice, and it shall be said, All praise is God’s the Lord of the worlds!
40:2: The descent (Revelation) of the Book is from God, the Almighty, All-Knowing,
40:3: The Forgiver of (every) sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Severe to chastise, the Lord of bounty; There is no god but He; unto Him is the ultimate end of the (life) journey (of everything).
40:4: Dispute not about the signs of God save those who disbelieve, so (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) let not their going to and from in the cities deceive thee!
40:5: Did belie the people of Noah before them and the parties after them, and did scheme every people against their apostle that they may seize him and they disputed by the falsehood that they might by it render into naught the truth, so I did seize them; and how (terrible) was then My retribution?
40:6: And thus did prove true the sentence of thy Lord against those who did disbelieve that they are the inmates of the fire.
40:7: Those who bear the ‘Arsh’ and those around it celebrate the praise of their Lord and believe in Him and seek forgiveness for those who believe in Him (saying): “O’ Our Lord! Thou comprehendeth all things in (Thy) mercy and knowledge, therefore forgive Thou those who turn (unto Thee) and follow Thy way, and save them from the torment of the Hell:
40:8: O’ Our Lord! Admit them into the ever-blissful gardens which Thou hast promised unto them and those who do good from their fathers, and, their wives, and their children; for Thou art the Almighty, the All-Wise!
40:9: And keep them from evil: and whomsoever keepest thou from evil, this day indeed Thou hast bestowed mercy on him, and that, it is a Mighty Achievement.
40:10: Verily, those who disbelieve, unto them shall a voice cry: “Certainly, God’s hatred (of you) is greater than your hatred of yourselves when ye were called upon unto the faith and ye did disbelieve!
40:11: They shall say: “O’ our Lord! Twice didst thou cause us to die, and twice didst Thou give us life, and (now) we do confess our sins: Is there then a way to get out (of this)?
40:12: This (hath befallen you) for when God alone was called upon, ye did disbelieve, and when associates were assigned unto Him, ye believed; And (all) authority is God’s, the Highest, the Greatest.
40:13: He it is Who showeth you His signs and sendeth down for you from the heaven - sustenance; but payeth not heed save he who turneth (unto Him).
40:14: So call ye upon God, devoting religion exclusively unto Him, though averse be the dis believers.
40:15: The Exalter of the ranks, the Lord of ‘Arsh’ (the Supreme Authority); Causeth forth He the spirit at His own behest on whomsoever He willeth of His servants, that he may warn (men) of the day of meeting,
40:16: (Of) the Day when they shall come forth (from their graves), when naught about them shall be hidden from God. (A voice shall ask): “Whose is the kingdom this day? (It is) God’s, the One, the Subduer (absolute)!
40:17: This day shall every soul be recompensed for what it hath earned; No injustice (shall be done on the Day); Verily God is quick in reckoning.
40:18: And (thou) warn them, then, of the approaching Day, when (men’s) hearts shall rise up to their throats choking; For the unjust there shall not be any sincere friend nor an intercessor who shall prevail.
40:19: He knoweth the deceit of the eye, and what the breasts conceal.
40:20: And God judgeth with truth; and those whom they call upon besides Him can judge not any thing; Verily God is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
40:21: What! Have not they travelled in the earth and seen how (destructive) hath been the end of those who were before them? (though) They were mightier in strength than these and in their relics in the earth, but God seized them (with destruction) for their sins; and there was not for them any shelter against (the wrath of) God.
40:22: This, because there hath come unto them their apostles with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so did seize them God; Verily He is All-Strong, Vehement in retribution.
40:23: And indeed sent We Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
40:24: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Qarun, but they said: “(This is a) great lying sorcerer!
40:25: And he brought unto them the truth from unto Us, said they: “Slay ye the sons of those who believe with him and leave their women alive;” but the plot of the disbelievers is nothing but a failure.
40:26: And said Pharaoh: “Let me alone I will slay Moses, and let him call upon his Lord; Verily I fear that he may change your religion, or he may cause mischief to appear in the land.
40:27: And Moses said: “Verily, I take refuge with my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who believeth not in the Day of Reckoning!
40:28: And said a man who was a Believer, from among the people of Pharaoh: who used to conceal his faith: “What! slay ye a man for sayeth he ‘My Lord is God,’ and indeed he hath brought unto you clear proofs (of his mission) from your Lord? While if he be a liar, on him will be his lie, and if he be truthful, then will afflict you some of what he warneth you (with); Verily, God guideth not him who is extravagant (and) a liar
40:29: O’ my people! Yours is the kingdom this day, being prevailing in the land, but who will help us against the wrath of God if it cometh upon us?” Pharaoh said: “I show you not aught but what I (myself) see, and I guide you not but in a right way.
40:30: And said he who believed: “O’ my people! verily, I fear, (that it may fall) on you the like of that (what befell) the parties,
40:31: The like of that (what befell) the people of Noah and ’Ad and Thamud and those (who came) after them; and God intendeth not injustice unto (His) servants
40:32: And O’ my people! I fear for you the Day of Calling out (each other)
40:33: The Day on which ye shall be turned back (from the Judgment unto the Hell), (when) for you there shall not be any saviour from (the wrath of) God; and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him shall not be any guide,
40:34: And indeed came unto you Yusuf before, with clear proofs (of his mission), but ye ever doubted about what he brought; until when he died ye said: ‘Never will God raise any apostle after him;’ Thus doth God allow him to stray, who is an extravagant, a doubter.
40:35: Those who dispute about the Signs of God without any authority having come unto them; are greatly hated by God and by those who believe; Thus God setteth a seal over every heart which is arrogant and haughty.
40:36: And said Pharaoh: “O’ Haman! Build thou for me a tower that I may reach the means of access,
40:37: The means of access unto heavens, so that I (may) mount up to reach unto God of Moses, and verily I think him to be a liar;” and thus was made fair-seeming unto Pharaoh the evil of his deed and he was turned away from the (right) way; and the plot of Pharaoh was not but (to end) into (his own) ruin.
40:38: And said he who hath believed: “O’ my people! follow me, I will show you the way to the right guidance
40:39: O’ my people! the life of this world is only (a passing ) enjoyment, and verily, the hereafter is the abode to last.
40:40: Whosoever shall have wrought an evil shall not be recompensed but the like of it, and whosoever shall have wrought good, whether a male or a female, and he be a believer, these shall enter the Garden, wherein they shall be provided with sustenance with out measure.
40:41: O’ my people! how is it that I invite you unto salvation and ye call me unto fire?
40:42: Ye call on me that I should disbelieve in God and associate with Him that I have no knowledge of, and I invite you unto the Almighty, and the Oft-Forgiving (Lord)
40:43: No doubt is there that what ye call me unto, hath no right to be invoked in this world nor in the hereafter, and our return is unto God, and that the extravagants shall be the inmates of the (Hell) fire.
40:44: And ye shall remember what I say unto you, and I entrust my affair unto God: verily, God seeth well (His) servants
40:45: And God preserved him from the evils of what they planned; and the woe of the chastisement encompassed the people of Pharaoh.
40:46: The fire: they shall be exposed unto it (every) morning and evening and on the Day when shall be established the ‘Hour (of Reckoning)’ (the sentence shall be) “Admit ye the people of Pharaoh to the severest of the chastisement.
40:47: And when they shall wrangle together in the fire, then shall say the weak unto those who were arrogant: “Verily we were unto you the followers; will ye then relieve us from something of the fire?
40:48: Shall say those who were arrogant: “Verily, we are all in it; Verily, God hath indeed judged between (His) servants,
40:49: And shall say those in the fire unto the guards of hell: “Call ye upon your Lord that He may lighten unto us (at least for) a day, of the chastisement.
40:50: They shall say: “Came not unto you your apostles with clear proofs (of their mission)? They shall say: “Yea!” They shall say: “(why not yourselves) Cry ye then (for help)?” but the cry of the disbelievers shall not be but in vain.
40:51: Verily, We do help Our apostles, and those who believe, in the life of this world and on the day when shall stand forth the witnesses,
40:52: The day when shall benefit not the unjust their excuses, and for them shall be the curse, and for them shall be the evil abode (in Hell).
40:53: And indeed We gave Moses the guidance, and We made the children of Israel inherit the Book,
40:54: A guidance and a reminder unto the men endued with understanding.
40:55: So be thou patient; verily, the promise of God is true; and seek protection for thy (followers’) shortcomings, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord in the evening and the morning.
40:56: Verily, those who dispute about the signs of God without any authority having come unto them, naught is there in their breast but (a vain desire ) to become great, which they shall attain not; therefore seek (thou) refuge in God, verily He is the All Hearing, the All-Seeing.
40:57: Surely, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of the people, but most people know not.
40:58: Not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor those who believe and do good and the doers of evil (are equal); little is it that ye reflect.
40:59: Verily, the Hour (of Reckoning) is to come, there is no doubt therein, but most people believe not.
40:60: And sayeth your Lord: “Call ye unto Me, I will answer you;” Verily those who are arrogant to serve Me, shall soon enter Hell, disgraced.
40:61: God is He who hath made for you the night that ye may rest in it and the day to give you light; Verily God is gracious unto the people, but most people thank not.
40:62: That is God, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no god but He; why then are ye turned away?
40:63: Thus were turned away those who denied the signs of God.
40:64: God is He Who made for you the earth to stay and the heaven a canopy, and shapened you, and made goodly your forms, and provided you with sustenance with goodly things; that is God your Lord; Hallowed is then God the Lord of the worlds.
40:65: He is the (Ever) Living, there is no god but He so call ye upon Him, devoting unto Him the religion; All praise is God’s, the Lord of the worlds.
40:66: Say: “Verily I am forbidden to worship those whom ye call upon besides God when clear proofs have come unto me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit myself unto the Lord of the worlds.
40:67: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a life-germ, then from a clot, then He bringeth you forth as a babe, then that ye may reach your full strength, then that ye may be old, and of you are those who are caused to die early and that ye may reach the appointed term, and (all this is related) that happly ye may understand.
40:68: He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and when He decreeth an affair, He only sayeth unto it ‘BE’ and it IS.
40:69: Seest thou not those who dispute about the signs of God; how they are turned away?
40:70: Those who belie the Book and what We sent Our Apostles with; then soon shall they know,
40:71: When the fetters shall be in their necks and the chains; they will be dragged,
40:72: Into the boiling water, then in the fire shall they be burned;
40:73: Then it shall be said unto them; “Where are those whom ye used to associate (as gods),
40:74: Besides God?” They shall say: “They have gone away from us, nay, we used not to call upon anything before;” Thus doth God leave the disbelievers to stray.
40:75: (It will be said unto them) “This because ye exulted in the land without any right, and because ye were insolent.
40:76: Enter ye the gates of Hell to abide therein.” Wretched then shall be the abode of the arrogant ones.
40:77: So be patient thou, verily the promise of God is true; And whether We let thee see of what We threaten them with, or We cause thee to die (before that), unto Us shall they be returned.
40:78: And verily sent We apostles before thee, of them there are those whom We have mentioned unto thee; and of them are those whom We have mentioned not unto thee; and it was not given to any apostle to bring a sign (miracle) save with the leave of God, but when came the behest of God, (it) was executed with truth, and those who stood on falsehood were then the losers.
40:79: God is He Who made for you the cattle that ye may ride on some of them, and of them ye may eat.
40:80: And for you in them are other benefits, and that ye may realize thereon the need ye cherish in your breasts; and upon them and upon the ships ye are borne.
40:81: And He showeth you His Signs; which, then, of the Signs of God will ye deny?
40:82: What! have they not travelled in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? They were more (in number) than those and mightier in strength, and greater are their relics (of their power) in the earth, but availed them not what they were earning.
40:83: And when came unto them their apostles with clear proofs (of their truthfulness), exulted they in what they had with them of knowledge, but encompassed them that which they were wont to scoff.
40:84: But when they beheld Our punishment said they: “We believe in God alone and we deny what we used to associate with Him.
40:85: But shall not benefit them their faith when they had beheld Our punishment; (such is) the procedure of God which hath indeed been in use concerning His servants; and then the disbelievers have lost.
41:2: A descent (Revelation) from the Beneficent, the Most Merciful (God);
41:3: A Book, fully expounded are its verses, a Qur’an in Arabic, for people who know,
41:4: A Bearer of glad tidings and a Warner, but turn away most of them and hearken not.
41:5: And say they: “Our hearts are under coverings from that unto which thou inviteth us, and in our ears is a heaviness, and between us and thee hangeth a veil, so act thou (as thou thinkest right): Verily we too act (as we do)
41:6: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “I am only a man like you; it is revealed unto me that your God is One God, be ye then in attention straight unto Him, and seek ye His forgiveness; and woe unto those who associate others with God,
41:7: Those who give not the poor-rate, and they in the hereafter too are disbelievers.
41:8: Verily, those who believe and do good, for them shall be a recompense ceaseless.
41:9: Say thou: “What! do ye indeed disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days (periods), and set ye up unto Him equals? that is the Lord of (all) the worlds
41:10: And hath made therein mountains high from above its surface; and He blessed therein, and planned therein its foods, in four days (periods): alike for the seekers.
41:11: Then He applied Himself unto the heaven, which was yet only a smoke, so said He unto it and unto the earth: “Come ye Two, willing or reluctant;” Said the two: “We do come willingly
41:12: And He made them seven heavens in two days (periods), and revealed in every heaven His Will; and adorned We the lower heavens with lights (of the brilliant stars), and made it guarded (with angels); That is the decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
41:13: And if they turn away, then say: “I warn you of thunderbolt (of a destructive punishment) (which afflicted the people) of ’Ad and Thamud.
41:14: And when came unto them apostles from before them and from behind them, saying: “Worship ye not aught but God;” said they: “Had our Lord willed, He would certainly have sent down angels; so verily in what ye have been sent with, we disbelieve.
41:15: And as to the people of ’Ad, they prided in the land without right, and said they: “Who is mightier than we in power?” What! Beheld they not that God Who created them is mightier than they in power? And Our signs they used to deny.
41:16: So sent We on them a violent wind in inauspicious days, that We may make them taste the chastisement of disgrace in the life of this world, and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is more disgracing, and they shall not be helped.
41:17: And as to (the people of) Thamud We did guide them aright, but they loved error against the right guidance, so there seized them the thunder bolt of a disgracing chastisement for what they used to earn.
41:18: And We rescued those who believed and guarded (themselves against evil).
41:19: And on the day when shall be collected together the enemies of God, unto the fire, then they shall be ranked in groups.
41:20: Until they come unto it (the Hell), shall bear witness against them, their ears and their eyes and their skins as to what they used to do.
41:21: And they shall say unto their skins: “Why witness ye against us?” They shall say: “Caused us to speak God who maketh everything speak, and He it is Who created you for the first time, and unto Him ye shall (all) be returned.
41:22: And ye covered not yourselves (merely) lest that your ears and your eyes and your skins should bear witness against you, but (it was) that ye thought that God knoweth not most of what ye did.
41:23: And that your (evil) conjectures which ye did conject about your Lord hath tumbled you into ruin, so ye are become of the losers.
41:24: And if they be patient, yet the fire shall be their abode: or if they seek favour, yet then they shall not be of the favoured (ones).
41:25: And We have appointed for them intimate companions so for them have they made fair seeming what is before them and what is behind them, and the sentence proved just against them, as it did among the peoples of the jinn and the human beings that have passed away before them; verily they were the losers.
41:26: And those who disbelieve say: “Hearken ye not unto this Qur’an, make noise in it, happly ye may overcome.
41:27: So, We will certainly make those who disbelieve taste a severe chastisement, and certainly will We recompense them for the worst of what they used to do.
41:28: That shall be the recompense of the enemies of God, the fire! For them therein shall be the abode to abide; in recompense for what they, with Our signs used to deny.
41:29: And those who disbelieve will say: “O’ our Lord! show us those who led us astray of the jinn and the human beings; both of them will we trample under our feet so that they may be of the lowest ones.
41:30: Verily, those who say: Our Lord is God! and persevere aright, descend upon them the angels, (saying): that “Fear ye not, nor be grieved, and receive the glad tidings of the Garden which ye were promised.
41:31: We are your guardians in the life of this world and in the hereafter, and for you shall be therein whatever desireth your selves and yours shall be therein whatever ye shall ask for.
41:32: A hospitable welcome from the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (God).
41:33: And who is better in speech than he who calleth unto God and doeth good and sayeth “Verily I am of the Muslims
41:34: And equals can not be the good and the evil. Repel thou (evil) with what is the best, when lo! he between whom and thee was enmity, shall be as though he were a warm friend.
41:35: And receive it not but those who are steadfast, and receive it not but those with the greatest good fortune.
41:36: And if an enticement from satan enticeth thee, then seek thou refuge in God; Verily, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
41:37: And among His signs are the night, and the day, the sun and the moon; Do not prostrate ye in obeisance unto the sun nor unto the moon; and prostrate ye in obeisance unto God (alone) Who created them, if Him it is ye worship.
41:38: But if they be arrogant (to do this), yet those with thy Lord glorify Him during the night and the day, and they tire not.
41:39: And among His signs is this, that seest thou the earth barren, but when send We down on it water, it is stirred and swelleth; verily He Who giveth it life, will certainly give life unto the dead; Verily, He hath power over all things.
41:40: Verily, those who distort (a) Our signs are not hidden from Us. What! is he then who is cast in the fire better or he who cometh safe on the Day of Judgment? Do ye what ye like; Verily seeth He what all ye do.
41:41: Verily, those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them, and verily it (Qur’an) is a Book Unassailable.
41:42: Shall come not nigh it falsehood from before it nor from behind it: a revelation from the All- Wise, the Most Praised One.
41:43: Nothing is said unto thee save what indeed was said unto the apostles before thee; Verily, thy Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous retribution.
41:44: And had We made it a Qur’an in a slang language, certainly had they said: “Why are not its verses been made plain? What! in a slang (tongue)? while the Prophet is Arabian” Say: “It is unto those who believe a guidance and a cure; but as to those who believe not, there is in their ears a heaviness and it is unto (such of) them a blindness; These are like unto those who are called to from a place far off.
41:45: And indeed, gave We Moses the Book, but disputes arose therein: and had not a word already gone forth from thy Lord, there would certainly have been judgment between them; and certainly they are about it in a disquieting doubt.
41:46: Whosoever doeth good, it is for his own self, and whosoever doeth evil, it is against it; and 1 is not unjust unto the thy Lord servants.
41:47: Unto Him is referred the knowledge of the Hour (of Reckoning); And cometh not forth any of the fruits from its covering, and beareth not any of the females, and nor doth she delivereth, but with His knowledge; and on the day when He shall call unto them (saying). “Where are (those whom ye made) My partners?” They shall say: “We declare unto Thee, there is not from us any witness,
41:48: And shall pass away from them what they called upon before, and they shall know that for them there is no escape.
41:49: Tireth not man in praying for good, and if toucheth him any evil, then is he despaired, hopeless.
41:50: And if We make him taste mercy from Us, after a distress hath toucheth him, certainly sayeth he: “This is my due; and I deem not the Hour (of Reckoning) would ever be established: and if I be returned unto my Lord, verily for me (is stored) with Him is (much of the) best;” but certainly will We inform those who disbelieved of what they did, and certainly will we make them taste of a hard chastisement.
41:51: And when bestow We (Our) bounties on man, he turneth away, and withdraweth himself; and when toucheth him any distress, then aboundeth he in long prayers.
41:52: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “See ye then? If it (i.e. this Book Qur'an) is from God, and yet disbelieve ye in it, who is farther astray than he who is in (such a great) opposition far away (from truth)?
41:53: Soon will We show them Our signs in the horizons (of the world), and in their own selves until it becometh manifest unto them that He is the Truth. Is it not sufficient for thy Lord that He is a witness over all things.
41:54: (Be it known that) verily they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord! (Be it known that) verily He encompasseth every thing.
42:3: Thus doth reveal unto thee as (did He) unto those before thee, God, the Almighty, The All Wise.
42:4: His is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Highest, the Greatest.
42:5: Nigh it is (that) the heavens cleave asunder from above (for the very awe of His glory), while the angels are (there) celebrating the praise of their Lord and seeking forgiveness for those in the earth; Be it known that verily, God, He (alone) is the Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
42:6: And those who take aught besides God as their guardians, God watcheth over them, and thou art not over them a guardian.
42:7: And thus have We revealed unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) an Arabic Qur’an, that thou mayest warn the Mother City (Mecca) and those around it, and (that) thou warn of the Day of Gathering together (the Resurrection), wherein (there) is no doubt; (when) a party shall be in the garden (of Paradise) and a party (shall be) in the burning (Hell) fire.
42:8: And had God (so) pleased certainly would He have made them a single people, but admitteth He whosoever He willeth into His mercy; and the unjust, for them shall not be any guardian or a helper.
42:9: Or have they taken besides Him, guardians? But God, He is the Guardian, and He giveth life unto the dead, and He is, over all things powerful.
42:10: And in whatever thing ye differ, its decision is unto God; (for) that is your God my Lord, on Him rely I, and unto Him (alone) do I (always) turn.
42:11: The Originator of the heavens and the earth; He made for you from among your (own) selves pairs, and of the cattle (too) pairs, thereby He multiplieth you; Nothing whatsoever (is there) like the like of Him; and He (alone) is the All-Hearing and the All-Seeing.
42:12: His are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; amplifieth He the sustenance unto whomsoever He willeth and straiteneth; Verily He knoweth all things.
42:13: He hath prescribed for you the religion what He ordained unto Noah and that which revealed We unto thee and what ordained We unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, that: “Establish ye the religion and be ye not divided therein;” Hard is it to the disbelievers what thou callest them unto; God chooseth unto Himself whomsoever He willeth, and guideth He unto Himself whosoever turneth - (to Him).
42:14: Nor were they divided until after had come unto them the knowledge, out of rivalry between themselves; and had not the word gone forth from thy Lord (respiting them) to a fixed time, certainly, the affair had been decided between them; and verily, those who were made the heirs to the Book after them are certainly in disquieting doubt about it.
42:15: For this then invite on thou (unto the truth) and be thou steadfast (on the right way) as thou art commanded; and follow thou not their vain desires, and say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Believe I in what God hath sent down of the Book; and I have been commanded to do justice between you; God is our Lord and your Lord; For us (is the responsibility) of our deeds, and for you (that of) your deeds; No contention (need there be) between us and you; God will gather us together; and unto Him is the ultimate return.
42:16: And those who dispute about God after response made unto Him, their argument is vain unto their Lord, and upon them is the wrath, and for them is a severe chastisement.
42:17: God is He Who sent down the Book with truth and the Balance, and what dost thou know? happly the Hour (of Reckoning) be nigh
42:18: Hasten it on (in challenge) they who believe not in it, and those who believe are afraid of it, and know they that it is the truth; Beware! Verily those who dispute about the Hour (of Reckoning) are far astray.
42:19: God is Benign unto His servants; Provideth He sustenance to whomsoever He willeth; and He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.
42:20: Whosoever intendeth the tilth of the hereafter, We increase for him in his tilth; whosoever intended the tilth of this world, We give him of it, and for him in the hereafter shall not be any share.
42:21: Or for them are any partners (of God) who have prescribed for them any religion which God doth not sanction? And had it not been for the word of decision (to wait until the Day of Reckoning), the decision would certainly have been made between them; and verily the unjust, for them shall be a painful chastisement.
42:22: (On that Day) thou wilt see the unjust alarmed for what they have earned, and (the chastisement for) it shall befall them; And those who believe and do good deeds shall be in the meadows of the Garden (of Paradise); For them shall be whatever they please with their Lord; that is the greatest grace.
42:23: That is of which giveth God the glad tidings unto His servants who believe and do good deeds; Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “I demand not of you any recompense for it (the toils of the apostleship) save the love of (my) relatives; and whosoever earneth good, We increase for him good therein, verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Grateful (One).
42:24: Or do they say: “He hath forged a lie against God?” But if God hath willed, He would have sealed thy heart (and quiet thee) and (yet) He would blot out the falsehood and prove the truth with His words; Verily He knoweth best whatever is in the breasts (hearts)
42:25: He it is Who accepteth repentance from His servants, and forgiveth the sins, and knoweth He whatever ye do,
42:26: And He respondeth to those who believe and do good deeds, and increaseth unto them of His grace; And the disbelievers, for them shall be a severe chastisement.
42:27: And should God amplify the sustenance unto His servants, they would certainly rebel in the earth, but He sendeth it down by measure as He willeth; Verily of His servants, He is All-Aware, All-Seeing.
42:28: He it is Who sendeth down the rain after what they have despaired, and spreadeth His Mercy; And He is the (Greatest) Guardian, the (Most) Praised One.
42:29: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and (the creation of) what He hath spread out in both of them of the animate beings and for their gathering together when He willeth, He is All-Powerful.
42:30: And whatever befalleth you of a misfortune, it is what your (own) hands have wrought, and (yet) He pardoneth the most of your sins.
42:31: Ye can not frustrate (God's) will in the earth, and for you (there) is none other than God, Guardian or a Helper.
42:32: And among His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains.
42:33: If He willeth, He lulleth the wind that they (the ships) lie motionless on the back of it (the sea); Verily in this are signs for every steadfast grateful one,
42:34: Or He may cause them to perish for what they have wrought, and (yet) He pardoneth the most,
42:35: And (that) may know those who dispute about Our signs; For them (there) is no refuge.
42:36: And whatever ye are given (here) is but a provision for the life of this world, and what is with God is better and more lasting for those who believe and on their Lord they rely;
42:37: And those who shun the great sins and filthiness, and when they are angry, they forgive;
42:38: And those who respond to their Lord, and establish prayer, and (conduct) their affairs with counsel among themselves, what We have provided them with their sustenance they spend,
42:39: And (those) who when afflicteth them any great wrong, they get helped by themselves.
42:40: And the recompense for an evil shall be an ill-return like unto it, but (if) one pardoneth and amendeth, his reward is incumbent on God; Verily He loveth not the unjust.
42:41: And whosoever defendeth himself (in avenging) after being oppressed, then against these there is no way (to blame)
42:42: The way (to blame) is against those who do injustice unto the people and transgress in the earth unjustly; these, for them shall be a painful chastisement.
42:43: And indeed whosoever remaineth patient and forgiveth, verily this is an act of great resolution.
42:44: And whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him (there) shall not be any guardian after it; and thou shalt behold the unjust when they see the chastisement, saying: “Is there any way (to help us) to return
42:45: And thou shalt see them brought unto it humbled of disgrace, looking with a stealthy glance; And shall say those who believe: “Verily the losers are those who lost their selves and their people on the Day of Reckoning.” Beware! verily the unjust shall be in a lasting chastisement.
42:46: And there shall not be for them any of the guardians to help them besides God; and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him shall not be any (other) way (of being guided aright)
42:47: Respond ye unto your Lord ere cometh the Day from God for which there is no averting; for you shall not be any refuge on the Day, and nor for you will it be to make any denial.
42:48: And if they turn away, then We have not sent thee over them as a watcher; On thee is naught but only to convey (Our Word unto mankind); And verily when We make man taste mercy from Us, rejoiceth he thereby, and if afflicteth them any ill for what have done their (own) hands, then verily man (forgetteth all Our grace and) turneth ingrate.
42:49: God’s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Createth He whatever He willeth; Granteth He unto whomsoever He willeth females and granteth He whomsoever He willeth males,
42:50: Or mingleth them of both males (i.e., sons) and females (i.e., daughters), and maketh whomsoever He willeth barren; Verily He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.
42:51: And it is not for any man that God should speak unto him save by revelation or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger and to reveal by His permission what He willeth; Verily He is the Most High, the All-Wise.
42:52: Thus did We reveal unto thee Our guidance by Our command; Thou didst know not what the Book (Qur'an) was, nor the faith, but We made it a light, guide We thereby whomsoever We will of Our servants; and verily guideth thou unto the Right Path;
42:53: The path of God, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; Be it known! Unto God (alone) shall be referred all affairs.
43:3: Verily, We have made it an Arabic Qur’an that ye may understand.
43:4: And verily it is in the Mother-Book (which is) with Us, Most Exalted (it is), full of Wisdom.
43:5: What! Shall We then turn away from you the Reminder wholly for ye are a people extravagant?
43:6: And how many did We send of Our prophets among those gone before.
43:7: And there came not unto them a prophet but at him they used to mock.
43:8: Then We did destroy those mightier than these in strength, and hath gone (such) examples among those gone before.
43:9: And if thou shouldst ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth?” certainly would they say: “Created them the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing,
43:10: He Who made for you the earth (as) a cradle and hath made therein ways for you that ye might be guided aright.
43:11: And He Who sendeth down water from the heavens in a measure; then raise We with it a country which is dead (dried), even so shall ye be brought forth (from your graves on the Day of Resurrection)
43:12: And He who created pairs in all things and made for you of the ships and the cattle that ye may ride on,
43:13: That ye may mount on their backs, then remember ye the bounty of your Lord, and when ye mount on it and say ye: Hallowed is He Who subjected this unto us, and we (by ourselves) were not able to attain this,
43:14: And verily We, unto our Lord, shall return,
43:15: And (yet) they assign unto (some) of His servants a partnership with Him; Verily man is an open ingrate!
43:16: What! Hath He taken daughters (unto Himself) of what He hath (Himself) created, and chosen you to have the sons?
43:17: And when the news is given unto anyone of them of what he setteth up a similitude unto the Beneficent (God) his face becometh darkened and he is choked with rage.
43:18: What! the one which was brought up amidst ornaments and in disputes can make not itself plain (to be associated with God)?
43:19: And make they the angels who are the servants of the Beneficent (God) - females (deities); What! did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be written down and they shall be they questioned.
43:20: And say they: “If had willed the Beneficent (God) we should not have worshipped them.” They have no knowledge of this; they do but guess.
43:21: Or have We given them a Book ere it that they hold fast unto it?
43:22: Nay! say they: “Verily we found our fathers on a creed and verily by their footprints are we guided
43:23: And thus, We sent not ere thee in any town a warner, but the luxurious of it said: “Verily, we found our fathers on a creed, and verily, of their footprints we are the followers
43:24: Said (that warner): “What! even if I bring you a guidance better than that on which found ye your fathers (will ye not believe)?” Said they: “Verily we are disbelievers in whatever ye are sent with”.
43:25: So We did retribute them, and behold thou how was the end of those who belied (Our apostles).
43:26: And (remember thou) when said Abraham unto his father and his people: “Verily I am free of what ye worship,
43:27: (I worship) but (only) Him Who created me, for verily He will guide me.
43:28: And he made it a word (doctrine) to continue in his progeny that they may return (unto God).
43:29: Nay! I did provide these and their fathers to enjoy until there came unto them the truth (the Qur’an) and the Apostle (Muhammad) manifesting (the truth).
43:30: And when came unto them the truth (the Qur’an) said they: “This is a sorcery, we are disbelievers in it
43:31: And say they: “Why was not this Qur’an sent down unto a man in the two cities, (who is) great?
43:32: What! do they distribute the mercy of thy Lord? (It is) We Who did distribute among them (even) their livelihood in the life of this world, and We did raise some of them above the others in rank, so that some of them may take the others in subjection; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than whatever they hoard.
43:33: And were it not that all people had been of one (evil) way of life, We would certainly have provided those who disbelieve in the Beneficent God, (to make) for their houses, roofs of silver and the stairs on which they ascend,
43:34: And the doors of their houses, and the couches on which they recline,
43:35: And ornaments of gold; But all these are only the provision of the life of this world; And the hereafter unto thy Lord is for the pious ones.
43:36: And whosoever is blinded against the remembrance of the Beneficent (God), for him We appoint a satan and he shall be his close companion.
43:37: And verily (the satans) turn them away from the (right) path, and deem they that they are guided aright.
43:38: Until when cometh he unto Us, he would say: “(O’ Satan!) would that between me and thee there were the distance of two Easts!” (what) an evil companion is (Satan)!
43:39: And never shall it profit you on this day, since ye did injustice, that ye be partners in the chastisement.
43:40: What! Canst thou then make the deaf hear or guide the blind and him who is manifestly astray?
43:41: Even if We take thee away, then verily shall We extract retribution from them
43:42: Or We shall show thee that which We have promised them for verily We are over them (fully) Powerful.
43:43: Therefore, hold thou fast what hath been revealed unto thee, Verily, thou art on the Right Path.
43:44: And verily, it is a reminder for thee and for thy people, and ye shall soon be questioned (about it).
43:45: And ask thou those of Our apostles We sent before thee: Did We appoint besides the Beneficent God any gods to be worshipped?
43:46: And indeed sent We Moses with Our signs, unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and said he: “Verily I am the apostle of the Lord of the worlds
43:47: And when came he unto them with Our signs, lo! they laughed at them,
43:48: And We showed them not a sign but it was greater than the other, and seized them with chastisement, that they may return.
43:49: And said they: “O’ sorcerer! Call on for us thy Lord, (to do) as he hath covenanted with thee; verily we will be guided aright.
43:50: But when We relieved them from the chastisement, lo! they broke the pledge.
43:51: And proclaimed Pharaoh unto his people: “O’ my people! is not the kingdom of Egypt mine? And these rivers flow below me; What! behold ye not?
43:52: Nay! I am better than this (fellow) who is contemptible, and who scarce can speak distinctly?
43:53: And why have not then bracelets of gold been put upon him? Or (why have not) come with him angels as (his) companions?
43:54: Thus, did he persuade his people to levity and they obeyed him; verily they were a transgressing people
43:55: And when they had angered Us, We did retribute them, so did We drown them all together,
43:56: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later generations.
43:57: And when was set forth (Jesus) son of Mary as an instance (of Our power), lo! thy people laughed out (in ridicule).
43:58: And say they: “Are our gods better or is He?” They do not set it forth unto thee but by way of disputation; nay! they are a contentious people.
43:59: None was he but a servant (of Ours), bestowed We on him (Our) favour (giving him the miracles); and We made him an example (of Our power) unto the children of Israel.
43:60: And had We pleased, certainly We could have made from among you angels to be in the earth (your) successors.
43:61: And verily he shall be the sign of (approach of) the Hour (of Reckoning), doubt not then about it and follow Me: This is the Right Path.
43:62: And let not satan prevent you, verily he is your open enemy.
43:63: And when came Jesus with clear proofs (miracles), said he: “Indeed have I come unto you with wisdom, and that I may make clear for you some of those things of which ye differ in; so guard ye (yourselves against evil) and obey me.
43:64: Verily God (alone) is my Lord and your Lord, so serve ye (only) Him; This is the right path.
43:65: But differed parties from among them, so woe unto those who were unjust, from the chastisement of a painful day.
43:66: Wait they for aught but the Hour (of Reckoning) to come on them suddenly while they perceive not?
43:67: The friends that day shall be enemies to one another, save the pious ones.
43:68: O’ My servants! No fear shall be on you this day, nor shall ye grieve.
43:69: Those who believed in Our signs and were Muslims (those submitting themselves unto God).
43:70: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your mates; ye shall be made to be delighted.
43:71: Shall be passed round unto them dishes of gold and cups (of drinks); and therein shall be whatever desire their souls, and (wherein) could delight the eyes; and ye shall abide therein.
43:72: This is the Garden (Paradise) ye are made to receive as a heritage (in recompense) for what ye have been doing.
43:73: For you therein are fruits in abundance of which ye shall eat.
43:74: Verily the guilty ones, in the torment of Hell, they shall abide.
43:75: It shall not be abated from them, and they therein shall be despairing.
43:76: And We were not unjust unto them, but (it was) they (who) were unto themselves unjust.
43:77: And they shall cry out: “O’ Malik! would that thy Lord maketh an end of us!” He shall say: “Verily ye shall remain (here).
43:78: Indeed have We brought unto you with the truth but most of you unto the truth, were hateful.
43:79: Or have they settled any device (among themselves)? then verily We too shall be the settlers (of Ours).
43:80: Or think they that We hear not their secret and their concealed discourses? Aye! (We do hear everything) and Our messengers unto them do write down (everything).
43:81: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “If there be for the Beneficent God any son, I am (to be that for I am) the first of the worshippers (to Him)
43:82: Hallowed is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of ‘Arsh’, far from what they attribute.
43:83: So leave them to plunge on, and sport (into vanities of falsehood) until meet they their day which they have been promised (warned with).
43:84: And He it is Who is God in the heavens and God in the earth; and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
43:85: Holiest is He Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them two, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour (of Reckoning), and unto Him shall ye all be returned.
43:86: And those whom they call besides Him, own not any power of intercession, save he who beareth witness of the truth and they know (the truth).
43:87: And if thou ask them who created them, they would certainly say: “God”. Whence are they then deluded away (from the truth)?
43:88: And (God hath the knowledge of) his cry (i.e. of the Prophet): “O’ my Lord! verily these are people who will believe not!
43:89: So turn thou away from them and say: “Peace (be unto you)”; for they shall soon know (the result).
44:3: Verily We sent it down on a Blessed Night - verily We have ever been warning –
44:4: Therein are made distinct all wise affairs,
44:5: (Becoming) a command from unto Us; Verily, We are the senders (of mercy and peace).
44:6: A mercy from thy Lord; Verily, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,
44:7: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them two, if ye be sure in faith.
44:8: There is no god but He; He giveth life and causeth death; your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of yore.
44:9: Yet they are sporting in doubt.
44:10: So await thou the day when the heaven shall give out a smoke clearly visible,
44:11: Enveloping the people; This will be painful chastisement.
44:12: (They will say): “O’ our Lord! Remove from us the torment; Verily we are believers!
44:13: How shall they be admonished when there came unto them an apostle making (the truth) mani fest,
44:14: (And yet) turned they their backs unto him and said: “(He is) tutored (by others), a mad man.
44:15: Verily, We will remove the torment a little (but) verily, ye will return (unto evil).
44:16: That day We shall seize (them) with a great seizure; Verily, We shall retribute (them).
44:17: And indeed We tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came unto them a noble Apostle,
44:18: Saying: “Deliver unto me the servants of God; Verily, I am unto you a trusted apostle,
44:19: And that exalt ye not yourselves against God; Verily, I come unto you with an authority manifest.
44:20: And verily, I take refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me (to death);
44:21: And if ye believe not in me, then leave me alone.
44:22: (But they began tormenting him); Then cried he unto his Lord that “these are a people guilty ones
44:23: (He was commanded saying): “Then march forth with My servants by night; verily ye will be pursued,
44:24: And leave thou the sea calm; Verily, they are a host that shall be drowned.
44:25: How many have they left, of the gardens and fountains!
44:27: And pleasant things in which they took delight!
44:28: So was it: and We gave them as a heritage unto another people;
44:29: So wept not on them the heavens and the earth nor were they respited.
44:30: And indeed delivered We the children of Israel from the degrading affliction,
44:31: From Pharaoh: verily he was haughty, (and was one) of the extravagants.
44:32: And indeed We chose them, with prescience, above all creatures (of their times);
44:33: And gave We unto them of the signs wherein was a clear trial.
44:35: There is naught save our first death and we shall not be raised again.
44:36: Then bring ye (back) our fathers, if ye be truthful.
44:37: Are they better or the people of Tubba, and those before them? We destroyed them, for verily they were the guilty ones.
44:38: And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them both, in sport.
44:39: We created them not but with the truth, but most of them know not.
44:40: Verily the day of sorting out is the appointed term for all of them,
44:41: The day when a friend shall avail not (his) friend aught, nor shall they be helped,
44:42: Save those on whom God shall have mercy; Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful.
44:44: Shall be the food of the sinful,
44:45: Like the molten brass; shall it boil in (their) bellies,
44:46: Like the boiling of hot water.
44:47: (There will be a cry saying) “Seize ye him, then drag ye him down into the midst of Hell,
44:48: Then pour on his head of the torment of the boiling water.
44:49: (It will be said again) “Taste thou; Verily thou was forsooth the mighty, the honourable,
44:50: Verily, this is what ye dispute about.
44:51: Verily, the pious ones will be in a secure place,
44:53: Attired in fine silk and in rich brocade, (sitting) face to face;
44:54: So shall it be, and We will unite them with fair ones; with wide, lovely eyes.
44:55: They shall call therein for every (kind of) fruit, (being) in security,
44:56: They shall taste not death therein save the first death, and He will save them from the chastisement of the hell,
44:57: A grace from thy Lord; this is the great achievement.
44:58: So have We made it (Qur'an) easy in thy tongue that they may be admonished.
44:59: Therefore wait thou: Verily, they (too) are waiting.
45:2: The descent (or revealed) of the Book (Qur’an) from God, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
45:3: Verily in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.
45:4: And in your (own) creation, and what He scattereth in the earth, of the animals, are signs for a people sure in faith,
45:5: And in the alternation of the night and the day, and what God sendeth down from heaven, of the sustenance, and (in His) giving life thereby to the earth after its death, and (in) the changing of the winds, are signs for a people who understand.
45:6: These are the signs of God recite We unto thee with truth; then in what (other) argument after (rejecting) God and His signs, would they believe?
45:7: Woe unto every liar, (and every) sinner,
45:8: He heareth the signs of God recited unto him, yet persisteth he arrogantly, as if he hath heard them not; so announce thou unto them a painful chastisement.
45:9: And when he cometh to know any of Our signs he taketh it in jest; These shall have a disgracing chastisement.
45:10: Behind them is hell, and shall avail them not aught of what they did earn, nor those whom they took as guardians besides God, and for them shall be a grievous chastisement.
45:11: This (Qur’an) is guidance, and those who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord, for them shall be the most painful chastisement.
45:12: God is He Who made subservient unto you the sea that may traverse the ships therein by His command, and that ye may seek of His grace and that ye may be thankful.
45:13: And made subservient unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, all, on His behalf: Verily in this are signs for people who reflect.
45:14: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto those (that) they may forgive those who hope not the days of God, that He may recompense the people for what they earn
45:15: Whoever doeth good, it is for his own self, and whoever doeth evil, it is against his own self; then unto your Lord ye shall be returned.
45:16: And indeed, gave We the children of Israel, the Book, and Wisdom and the Prophethood, and provided them with sustenance from the goodly things, and We favoured them above all peoples.
45:17: And We gave them clear arguments of the affair but they differed not until knowledge hath come unto them, through rivalry among themselves; Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Reckoning, about that wherein they differ.
45:18: Then have We set thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) on a (definite) course of Law, so follow it, and follow not the vain desires of those who know not.
45:19: Verily, they shall avail not thee aught against God; And verily, the unjust are the friends of one another; and God is the guardian of the pious ones.
45:20: These are proofs for the people and a guidance and a mercy unto a people who are sure in faith.
45:21: What! deem those who have wrought evils that We will make them like unto those who believe and do good, that equal shall be their life and their death? (Nay!) ill it is what they judge.
45:22: And created God, the heavens and the earth with the truth, and that be recompensed every soul for what it hath earned, and they shall not be done (the least) injustice.
45:23: Hast thou then seen him who taketh as his god his vain desires, and God hath allowed him to be astray (with his), knowing (it), and set a seal upon his ear and his heart and caused upon his eyes a veil; who can guide him after (his being allowed to stray by) God? What! Will ye not then reflect?
45:24: And say they: “Naught it is save our life in this world; we die and live and destroyeth us not but time.” For them there is no knowledge of that; they do but (merely) guess.
45:25: And when are recited unto them Our clear signs, nothing is their argument but they only say: “Bring ye our fathers (back) if ye be truthful.
45:26: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “God giveth you life then he causeth you to die, then will He gather you unto the Day of Reckoning, about which there is no doubt, but most people know not.
45:27: And God’s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour (of Reckoning) shall be established, on that Day shall lose the believers in the falsehood.
45:28: And thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) shalt see every people kneeling down; every people shall be called unto its Book; Today ye shall be recompensed for what all ye used to do.
45:29: This is Our Book that speaketh against you with justice; verily, We used to record whatever ye used to do.
45:30: And those who believed and did good deeds, so will admit them their Lord into His mercy, that is the manifest achievement.
45:31: And those who disbelieved: (unto them will be said): “What! were not My signs recited unto you? But ye acted arrogantly and ye were a guilty people.
45:32: And it was said (unto them): “Verily, the promise of God is true and the Hour (of Reckoning), no doubt is there about it, ye said ‘We know not what the Hour is,’ we deem it naught but a mere guess, and we are not sure.
45:33: And shall manifest unto them the evils of what they wrought, and shall surround them that which they used to mock at.
45:34: And it shall be said (unto them): “Today We neglect you even as ye neglected the meeting of this day of yours and your abode shall be the fire, and for you shall not be any of the helpers
45:35: That is for ye took the signs of God for a jest and deceived you, the life of this world “so on that day they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be granted any grace.
45:36: Therefore, God’s (alone) is the praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of the worlds.
45:37: And His (only) is greatness in the heavens and the earth; and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
46:2: The descent (of the revelation) of this Book (Qur'an) (is) from God, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise
46:3: We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them two, save with truth and (for) a determined term; But those who disbelieve turn away from what they are warned of
46:4: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Have ye seen what ye called upon besides God? Show me what of the earth did they create; or for them is there any share in the heavens? Bring me a book ere this or traces of knowledge, if ye be truthful.
46:5: And who is more astray than he who calleth upon besides God, unto such who will respond not unto him till the Day of Judgment, and they, of their invocations are not conscious
46:6: And when people shall be gathered together (on the Day of Reckoning) they shall be hostile unto them, and shall be the deniers of their worship (unto them)
46:7: And when Our clear signs are recited unto them, say those who disbelieve about the truth when it cometh unto them, this is an open sorcery
46:8: Or they do say: “He hath forged it?” Say thou (then O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): “If I have forged it, then ye have not aught for me against (the wrath of) God. He knoweth best what (all) ye utter (in mocking) about it; Sufficeth He a witness between me and you; and He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful
46:9: Say (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “I am not the first of the apostles (from God), I know not what will be done unto me, nor (what will be done) unto you; I follow not anything save what hath been revealed unto me, and I am not but an open warner.
46:10: Say thou: “See ye? If (this Qur'an) be from God and ye disbelieve in it, (although) hath borne witness a witness from among the children of Israel, on its similarity (with the previous scriptures), and hath (also him-self) believed (in it), and yet ye in pride exalt yourselves; Verily God guideth not the unjust people.
46:11: And say those who disbelieve about those who believe; “Had it been good, they would have gone not ahead of us unto it: “Since they seek not to be guided aright by it; say they: “This is a lie of old:
46:12: And before it the Book of Moses (the Pentateuch ) was a guide and a mercy: and this (Qur'an) is a Book confirmeth (the previous scriptures), in the Arabic language that it may warn those who are unjust; and (contains) glad-tidings for the doers of good
46:13: Verily, those who say: “Our Lord is God,” and are firm aright, then no fear shall be on them nor shall they grieve;
46:14: These shall be inmates of the garden, abiding in it; a recompense for what they did
46:15: And We have enjoined on man goodness unto his parents; Did bear him his mother with pain and she delivered him with pain; And bearing him and weaning him is thirty months; Until when he attaineth his maturity and reacheth forty years, sayeth he: “My Lord! arouse me that I may give thanks for Thy bounties which Thou hath bestowed on me and my parents and that I may do good which pleaseth Thee and do good unto me in respect of my offspring; Verily I turn unto Thee (repentant)., and verily I am one of the Muslims
46:16: These are they from whom We accept the best of what they have done and pass by their evils, (they shall be) among the inmates of the Garden; (this is that) promise of truth which they were used to be promised.
46:17: And he who sayeth unto his parents: “Fie on ye both! Promise ye me that I shall be brought forth (from the grave alive) when have passed away generations before me?” and they both implore for God’s aid, (saying): “Woe unto thee! Believe thou; for verily the promise of God is true;” Then will he say: “This is naught but stories of the ancients.
46:18: These are they against whom the sentence hath been proved among the peoples of the jinn and the men that have passed away before them; verily they were the losers.
46:19: And for all (are ranks) (assigned) according to what they did, and that He may (fully) recompense their deeds, and they shall not be done any injustice.
46:20: And on the day when shall be exposed those who dis-believed to the fire: (it will be said unto them): “Ye did away with your good things in your life of the world and ye took your fill of pleasure in them; This day therefore ye shall be recompensed with shameful chastisement for what ye used to act in arrogance in the earth without any right, and for what ye used to transgress.
46:21: And remember (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) of the brother of ’Ad when he warned his people of ‘Al-Ahqaf’ and (while) indeed warners have been before him and after him (saying) “Worship ye not but God! Verily, I fear for you the chastisement of a grievous day.
46:22: Said they: “What! Come thou unto us to turn us away from our gods? Then bring thou on us what thou threateneth us with, if thou art of the truthful ones.
46:23: Said he: “The knowledge (of it) is only with God, I only convey unto you the message which I am sent with, but I see you a people who are ignorant.
46:24: So when they saw (the punishment in the form of) a cloud advancing unto their valleys, they said: “This is a cloud which will give us rain;” Nay! it is (the calamity) what ye sought to hasten on; a blast of a violent wind in which is a painful chastisement,
46:25: Destroying every thing by the command of its Lord; So became they not to be seen save their dwellings; Thus do We recompense the guilty people.
46:26: And certainly had We firmly established them, what We established not ye in it, and We had given them ears, and eyes and hearts; but availed not them aught their ears nor their eyes nor their hearts, since they gainsaid the signs of God, and they were encircled by what they used to mock at.
46:27: And indeed We destroyed of the towns which are around you, and We did display Our signs that they might turn (unto Us).
46:28: Why then did not help them those whom they took for gods besides God, in approaching nigh unto God? Nay! but they failed them, and this was their lie and what they used to forge.
46:29: And when turned We unto thee a party of jinn who (quietly) listened to the Qur’an when came they unto it, said they: “Be ye silent! (and listen)?” then when was finished (the recital), returned they unto their people warning (them against the wrath of God)
46:30: Said (the Jinns): “O’ ye our people! Verily, have we listened unto a Book sent down (from God) after Moses, verifying what is before it, guiding unto the truth and unto a path straight aright.
46:31: O’ ye our people! Respond ye (all) unto the Summoner unto God and believe ye in Him, He will forgive you of your sins, and guard you against a painful chastisement.
46:32: And whosoever respondeth not unto the Summoner unto God, yet he can frustrate not God’s will in the earth, and there shall not be for him, other than Him, any guardians; these are in manifest error
46:33: What! Have they not seen that God Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, hath power to give life unto the dead? Aye! Verily, He is over all things powerful.
46:34: And on the day when shall be exposed those who disbelieved, to the fire (it will be asked of them): “Is this not the truth?” They shall say: “Aye! By our Lord!” then He will say: “Taste ye (now) the chastisement for what ye used to disbelieve
46:35: Therefore (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) bear thou up with patience, as did the apostles endowed with constancy and seek thou not to hasten for them (their doom); On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (it shall be unto them) as if they tarried not but (for only) an hour of the day; (a clear) Deliverance! (this is)! then shall be destroyed any but the transgressing people.
47:1: Those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the Path of God, He shall render in vain their deeds
47:2: And those who believe and do good, and believe in what hath been sent down unto (Our Apostle) Muhammad, and (that) it is the truth from their Lord, He will remove from them their evils, and (shall) improve their state.
47:3: That is because, those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord; Thus doth God set forth unto the people their examples.
47:4: So when ye encounter those who disbelieve (in a battle) then smite the necks until when ye have routed wounding them (rendering them helpless) and take them captives, under fetters, or set them free as an obligation or they be ransomed, until they lay down the weapons; Thus (are ye commanded); and if God be pleased, certainly would He exact retribution from them, but rather He would try some of you through the others; And those who are slain in the way of God, never will He allow their deeds to go in vain.
47:5: Soon will He guide them aright and improve their state;
47:6: And admit them to the garden which He hath made known to them.
47:7: O’ ye who believe if ye help (in the way of) God, He will (also) help you, and will set firm your feet.
47:8: And those who disbelieve, stumbling (with destruction) shall be for them, and He shall render (all) their (good) deeds in vain.
47:9: That is for they hated what God sent down, so shall He render null their deeds.
47:10: What! have they not travelled in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? God brought destruction on them, and for the disbelievers shall be the like unto it.
47:11: That is for God is the guardian of those who believe, and that the infidels, there shall not be any guardian for them.
47:12: Verily, God will admit those who believe and do good, to the gardens ’neath which flow rivers; and those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as the beasts eat, and the fire shall be their abode.
47:13: And how many a town which was mightier in power than thy town which hath driven thee out; We destroyed them, and no helper was there for them.
47:14: What! is he who is on (the path of the) clear proofs from his Lord like unto him whom the evil of his work is made fairseeming; and follow they their (own) vain desires?
47:15: A similitude of the garden which has been promised to the pious ones. Therein are rivers of water incorruptible, and rivers of milk, changeth not its taste, and rivers of wine – delicious unto those who drink, and rivers of honey pure and clear; And for them therein are (all kinds) of fruits and (a total) forgiveness from their Lord; (can these be) Like unto those who shall dwell in the fire? and who shall be made to drink boiling water so that it will rend asunder their bowels.
47:16: And of them are those who seek to listen to thee until when they go forth from thee say they unto those who have been given the knowledge: “What was it that he said just now?” These are they on whose hearts hath God set a seal, and follow they their vain desires.
47:17: And those who avail of the guidance, He addeth to His guidance unto them, and granteth them their guard (against evils)
47:18: What! wait they then for aught save the Hour (of Reckoning) that it cometh on them all of a sudden? Indeed have (already) come the signs of it; and of what avail can be the reminder to them when it hath already come on them?
47:19: So know thou that there is no god but God, and seek thou protection for thy sins and for (the sins of) the believer men and believer women; and God knoweth well the place of your movements (in this world) and the place of your final rest (the hereafter).
47:20: And say those who believe: “Why hath not been sent a chapter (for us), “But when is sent down a decisive chapter, and mentioned therein is war, seest thou those in whose hearts is a disease look unto thee with a look of one on whom has fallen the shadow of death; woe unto them! far better will certainly be for them,
47:21: Obedience and a fair word; but when the affair is determined, then if they be true to God, it would certainly be better for them,
47:22: Then be like ye are, if ye hold authority, that ye make mischief in the earth and sever the ties of kinship!
47:23: Those are they whom hath cursed God, and so hath he made them deaf and blinded their eyes.
47:24: What! Reflect they not on the Qur’an? Nay! on (their) hearts are (set) their locks.
47:25: Verily, those who return on the backs after hath become manifest unto them the guidance, the satan hath beguiled them, and hath given them a respite.
47:26: That is for they say unto those who hate what God hath sent down (saying): “We will obey you in a part of (this) matter” But God knoweth well their secret reservations.
47:27: But how? When the angels causing them to die, will smite their faces and their backs.
47:28: That is for they follow what displeaseth God, and hate what is His pleasure, so hath He made null their deeds.
47:29: Or deem those in whose hearts is a disease that never will God bring forth their spite?
47:30: And if We willed We could certainly have shown them unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) and thou wouldst certainly have known them by their features; and (now) certainly thou (can) recognise them by the tone of (their) speech; and God knoweth well (all) your deeds.
47:31: And certainly will We try you until We have known those who strive (fight) among you and the patient ones, and make your affairs known.
47:32: Verily, those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the path of God, and oppose the Apostle after that the guidance hath been made manifest unto them, can never harm God in any way; and He will make null their deeds.
47:33: O’ ye who believe! Obey ye God, and obey ye the Apostle, and do not render null your deeds.
47:34: Verily, those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the way of God, then they die while they are disbelievers, then never will God forgive them.
47:35: So be not fainthearted and call (the infidels) to peace, while ye have the upper hand, and God is with you, and never will He depreciate your deeds.
47:36: The life of this world is only an idle sport and a play, and if ye believe and guard (yourselves against evil ), He will give your recompense, and will ask not of you of your possessions.
47:37: Should He ask them of you, and if He urgeth you, ye will be niggardly, and He will bring forth your spite.
47:38: Lo! ye are they, who are called upon to spend in the way of God, but of you are those who are niggardly, and whosoever is niggardly, is niggardly only against his own self; and God is Self-Sufficient and ye are in need (of Him), and if ye turn back, He will bring in your place a people other than you, then they will not be like unto you.
48:1: Verily We have caused victory for thee a manifest victory,
48:2: ( So) That (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) God, may grant protection for thy sake (against) that which hath gone before of thy (followers’) shortcomings and that which hath to come later, and thus He perfecteth His bounty unto thee, and guideth thee (firm-footed) on the way straight (unto the Lord),
48:3: And that God might help thee, with a prevailing triumph.
48:4: He it is who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the faithful that they might add further faith to their faith; and God’s are the hosts of heavens and the earth; and God is All Knowing, The All-Wise,
48:5: That He may admit the faithful men and the faithful women to the gardens ’neath which flow rivers to abide in it and remove from them their evils; and that is with God a great achievement,
48:6: And that He may chastise the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and the polytheist women, the thinkers of evil thoughts about God; on them rotateth evil, and God is wroth with them, (He) hath prepared hell for them; and an evil journey’s end.
48:7: And God’s are the hosts of the heavens and the earth; and God is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
48:8: Verily ye have sent thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) as a witness and as a Bearer of glad-tidings, and as a Warner,
48:9: That ye may believe in God and His apostle and may aid him and revere him; And that ye may celebrate His Glory, morning and evening.
48:10: Verily those who swear their fealty unto thee do but swear fealty unto God; the hand of God is above their hands; so whosoever violateth his oath, doth violate it only to the hurt of his (own) self; and whosoever fulfilleth what he hath covenanted with God, soon will God grant him a great recompense.
48:11: Those of the desert Arabs who stayed behind will say unto thee “Engaged us our wealth and our families, so ask thou pardon for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts; Say (unto them O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “Who then can control anything for you from God if He intendeth unto you a harm or if He intendeth unto you a profit? Nay! God is, of whatever ye do, well-aware.
48:12: Nay! ye thought that never would return the Apostle and the believers unto their families, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were a people undone
48:13: And whosoever believeth not in God and His Apostle Verily We have prepared for the disbelievers the flaming fire.
48:14: And God’s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He forgiveth whom He willeth and chastiseth whom He willeth; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
48:15: Soon will say those who stayed behind when ye go forth unto the gains to take them: “Let us (too) follow you;” desire they to change the word of God. Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Never shall ye follow us (for) thus hath (already) said God before.” But they will say: “Nay! ye are jealous of us.” Nay! they understand not but only a little.
48:16: Say thou unto those of the desert Arabs who stayed behind; “Ye shall be called against a people of mighty prowess; ye shall fight against them until they submit, then if they obey, God will grant you with a goodly recompense, and if ye turned back as ye did turn back before, He will chastise you with a painful chastisement.
48:17: It shall not be on the blind a blame, and nor on the lame be a blame, and nor on the sick be a blame (if they go not to fight); And whosoever obeyeth God and His Apostle, He will admit him to the gardens ’neath which flow rivers; and whosoever turneth back, He will chastise him with a painful chastisement.
48:18: Indeed God was well pleased with the believers when they pledged their fealty unto thee under the tree, as He did know what was in their hearts, so did He send down tranquillity on them and rewarded them with a near victory,
48:19: And gains great many which they will take, and God is Ever- Prevalent, the All-Wise.
48:20: And God did promise gains great many which ye will take and speed this unto you and withheld the hands of the people from you, and that it may be a sign unto the believers and that He may guide you on the straight path,
48:21: And the other (gains) which ye have not yet gained hold on them, but indeed God hath encompassed them; And God, over all things hath power.
48:22: And if fight with you those who disbelieve, certainly would they turn their backs then they would find not any protector nor a helper.
48:23: (Such hath been) the course of God that hath passed into effect before, and never shalt thou find in the course of God a change.
48:24: And He it is Who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Mecca, after He hath given you victory over them; and God is seeing whatever ye do.
48:25: They are the ones who dis believed and obstructed you from reaching the Sacred Mosque and the offering (which was) prevented to reach its destined place (of sacrifice); and were it not for the believing men and the believing women, not having known them, ye might have trodden down, would have afflicted you a crime on their behalf without knowledge; that He may admit to His mercy whomsoever He pleaseth; had they been separated, certainly We would have chastised those of them who have disbelieved (with) a painful chastisement.
48:26: When fostered those who disbelieved in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of (pagans) ignorance, then sent down God tranquillity on His Apostle and the believers and made them bound unto the word of piety and well were they entitled to it and worthy of it; And God well knoweth all things.
48:27: Indeed God hath fulfilled for His Apostle the vision with truth (that): “Certainly shall ye enter the Sacred Mosque, if God pleaseth, in security, with shaved head, (some) with their hair shortened, without fear; for He knew ye not, and He hath ordained besides this a near victory.
48:28: He it is Who sent His Apostle with the Guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religions, and enough is God for a witness.
