48:29: Muhammad is the Apostle of God, and those who are with him are vehement against the infidels, compassionate among themselves, Thou seest them bowing down, prostrating them selves in obeisance (unto) God seeking grace from God and (His) pleasure; Their marks are in their faces (foreheads), be cause of the effect of their (frequent) prostrations; That is their description in the Torah; and their description in the Evangel; Like a seed which putteth forth its stalk then strengtheneth it, then it becometh stout and raiseth firm upon its stem, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage at them the disbelievers; God hath promised those who believe and do good deeds, forgiveness and a great recompense.
49:1: O’ ye who believe! Be ye not forward (in any affair) in the presence of God and His Apostle and fear ye (the wrath of) God; verily God is All Hearing, All-Knowing.
49:2: O’ ye who believe! raise ye not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and speak ye not loud unto him as speak aloud some of you to the others, lest (all) your (good) deeds become null while ye perceive not.
49:3: Verily those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of God, they are those whose hearts God hath proved for their guarding (themselves against evil); for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense.
49:4: Verily, those who call out to thee from out of the private chambers, most of them understand not.
49:5: And if they wait patiently until thou come out unto them, it would certainly be better for them; and verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
49:6: O’ ye who believe! if cometh unto you a wicked man with a news, ascertain carefully, lest ye harm a people in ignorance, and then repent ye for what ye have done.
49:7: And know ye that amidst you is the Apostle of God, should he obey you in most of the matters, ye would certainly be in distress, but God hath endeared the faith unto you, and made it attractive in your hearts and made abhorrent unto you disbelief and transgression; They are they who are on the Right guidance,
49:8: By grace from God and as a bounty; And God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
49:9: And if two parties of the believers fall into a quarrel (among themselves), restore ye peace between them two; but if one of the two transgresseth against the other, (then) fight ye (all against) that which transgresseth until it complieth with the command of God; and if it complieth then restore ye peace between the two with justice, and act ye justly; Verily, God loveth the just ones.
49:10: The believers are but brethren, so make ye peace among the brethren and fear ye (the wrath of) God that ye be blessed with mercy.
49:11: O’ ye who believe! let not a people laugh at (another) people (to scorn) who happily may be better than them; nor let women laugh at other women who happily may be better than these and find not fault with your own selves nor call ye one another by nick names; evil is a bad name (for any one) after his accepting the faith; and whoso turneth not (repenting against such of his conduct), these are they who are the unjust (ones).
49:12: O’ ye who believe! avoid such suspicion, for verily suspicions (in) some (cases) is a sin, and spy ye not, and let not some of you backbite the others; What! likest one of you to eat the flesh of his dead brother? But ye abhor it; and fear ye (the wrath of) God; Verily, God is Oft- returning (to mercy unto the repentants), the Most Merciful.
49:13: O’ ye people! Verily We have created you of a male and a female, and made you in nations and tribes, that ye may recognise each other; Verily the most honoured of you with God is the one of you who guardeth (himself) the most (against evil), verily God is All-Knowing, the All-Aware.
49:14: Say the desert Arabs “We believe.” Say thou (unto them): “Ye believed not, but say ye, “We submit, for faith hath not yet entered your hearts; and if ye obey God and His Apostle, He will lessen not aught of your deeds; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
49:15: The believers are only those who believe in God and His Apostle, they doubt not thereafter, and strive (fight) they with their wealth and their lives in the way of God; they are the truthful ones.
49:16: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “What! Teach ye God about your religion, and God knoweth whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth; And God knoweth all things.
49:17: Lay they an obligation upon thee that they have submitted (embraced Islam) Say thou: “Lay ye not upon me any obligation by your submission (Islam) rather God layeth an obligation upon you that He guided you unto the faith if ye be truthful ones.
49:18: Verily God knoweth (all) the unseen things of the heavens and the earth; and God seeth (all) whatever ye do.
50:2: Nay! wonder they that hath come unto them a warner from among themselves, so say the disbelievers: “This is a wonderful thing!
50:3: What! when we are dead and have become dust (shall we return)? That is a return far (from the truth)
50:4: Indeed, know We what reduceth the earth of them, with Us is a written record that secureth.
50:5: Nay! they belied the truth when it came unto them, so they are in a confused state.
50:6: What! See they not up unto the heaven above them how We have made it and adorned it, no gaps are therein.
50:7: And the earth, We have spread it out, and have cast We therein mountains and have caused We therein the growth of all beauteous kinds,
50:8: To serve insight and as a reminder unto every servant (of God) who turneth (unto His Lord).
50:9: And sent We down from the heaven water with blessings, and caused We to grow thereby gardens and the grain which is harvested,
50:10: And the tall palm-trees with fruit-stalks, closely set one above another,
50:11: A sustenance for the servants, and give We life thereby unto a dead town; Thus will be the Resurrection.
50:12: Belied (also) those before them the people of Noah and the dwellers of Ar-Rass and Thamood,
50:13: And ’Ad and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
50:14: And the dwellers of the Wood and the people of Tubba; all belied the apostles, so was proved true My promise (of the doom).
50:15: What! were We then wearied out with the first creation? Yet are they in doubt about the creation anew.
50:16: And indeed We created man, and know We whatever thoughts whispereth his self unto him, and We are nearer to him than his (very) life-vein.
50:17: When receive (and record all doings) the two (guardian angels) appointed to receive, sitting, (one) on the right and (the other) on the left.
50:18: He pronounceth not a word but is unto him a watcher ready (to record)
50:19: And shall come the stupor of death in truth; that is (the state) which thou wast wont to shun.
50:20: And shall be blown the Trumpet, it is the Day Promised (warned against).
50:21: And shall come every soul, along with it a driver and a witness.
50:22: (It will be said): “Thou wert heedless of this, now have We removed from thee thy veil, so thy sight today is sharp.
50:23: And shall say his companion: “This is what is ready with me
50:24: (It will be commanded): “Cast ye two into hell, every ingrate rebel,
50:25: The forbidder of good, the transgressor, the doubter,
50:26: Who did set up with God other gods, then cast him ye two into the severe chastisement.
50:27: Will say his companion: “O’ Our Lord! I led him not to rebel but he had himself gone far astray
50:28: He shall say: “Wrangle ye not in my presence, Indeed I had sent beforehand unto you the warning:
50:29: Changeth not the word with Me, nor am I (in the least) unjust unto (any of) the servants.
50:30: That day We will say unto hell: “Art thou filled up?” And it will say: “Are there (any) more?
50:31: And the Garden (Paradise) shall be brought near unto the pious ones, not far (from thence).
50:32: This is what ye have been promised; (this is) for every one who turneth (frequently) unto God, (and) guardeth (His limits);
50:33: Who feareth the Beneficent God in secret, and cometh (unto Him) with a heart, turned (to Him in devotion)
50:34: Enter it ye in peace, this is the Day of eternal life!
50:35: For them therein shall be whatever they desire and with Us is yet more.
50:36: And how many a generation We did destroy before them who were mightier than they in power! then they did wander through the lands; (searching) if there was any place of refuge (for them)?
50:37: Verily in this is a reminder for him who hath a heart or he giveth ear with the presence of his mind.
50:38: And indeed created We the heavens and the earth and what is between them two, in six periods and touched Us not any fatigue.
50:39: So be thou patient on what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere its setting,
50:40: And in the night glorify Him and after the prostrations (prayers).
50:41: And listen for the day whereon the crier shall cry from near place,
50:42: The Day when they hear the cry in truth; that is the Day of coming forth (from the graves)
50:43: Verily, We give life and cause death, and unto Us shall all return.
50:44: The Day on which the earth shall cleave asunder under them, they will make haste; that is a gathering together easy for Us,
50:45: We know best what they say, and thou art not one to compel them; therefore remind him though the Quran who feareth My threat.
51:2: Then those which bear their load,
51:3: Then by those which speed lightly along,
51:4: Then by those distribute the affair,
51:5: Verily what ye are threatened with, is certainly true,
51:6: And verily the Judgment shall surely come to pass.
51:7: And by the heaven with its starry highways,
51:8: Verily ye are in discordance in what ye say,
51:9: He will be turned away from it who is to be turned away.
51:11: Who in the abyss (of ignorance) are wandering (bewildered),
51:12: Ask they: “When is the Day of Judgment?
51:13: On that day shall they be tried at the fire.
51:14: (It will be said) “Taste ye (now) your trial (on the fire); This is what ye did seek to hasten on!
51:15: Verily the pious ones shall be in gardens and (among the) springs,
51:16: Receiving (the enjoyment) what giveth them their Lord; Verily, they were ere that the doers of good.
51:17: Little of the night was it that they used to sleep.
51:18: And in the (hours) ere the dawn they prayed for forgiveness.
51:19: And in their property was a share due to the beggar and the destitute.
51:20: And in the earth are signs for those who are sure in faith,
51:21: And (also) in your own selves; will ye not then see?
51:22: And in the heaven is your sustenance and what ye are promised with.
51:23: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth! verily It (the Qur'an) is certainly the truth, just as ye speak,
51:24: Has there come unto thee [O Muhammad] the story of Abraham’s honoured guests?
51:25: When entered they upon him said they: ‘Peace!’. ‘Peace! Said he [and deemed] A strange people [these are]
51:26: Then turned he aside unto his family, and brought a fat (roasted) calf
51:27: And set it near them. He said: ‘What! Eat ye not?
51:28: And he conceived of them a fear; Said they: “Fear thou not!” and gave they the glad tidings unto him of a son blessed with knowledge
51:29: Then came forward his wife in grief, she smote her face and said she (what! I) an old barren woman?
51:30: Said they: “Thus sayeth thy Lord: ‘Verily He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing
51:31: He said “What then is your errand, O’ ye Messengers?
51:32: Said they: ‘We are sent unto a criminal people
51:33: That We may send down upon them stones of clay
51:34: Marked out from unto thy Lord for the guilty ones of excesses
51:35: And We brought forth (those) who were there in (the town) of the believers
51:36: But We found not there in (the town) save one house of the Muslims
51:37: And left We therein a sign for those who dread the painful chastisement
51:38: And in Moses, when We sent him unto Pharaoh with manifest authority
51:39: But (Pharaoh) turned away with his forces and said (pointing to Moses): ‘(This is) a sorcerer or a madman
51:40: So, We seized him and his hosts and We cast them into the sea, for he was reprobate
51:41: And in ‘Ad: when sent We upon them the desolating (blast of violent’) wind
51:42: It left not aught upon which it came, but turned it like (rotten) dust
51:43: And in Thamood: when it was said unto them; “Avail ye your- selves for a while
51:44: But rebelled they against the command of their Lord, so seized them the rumbling, while they were yet looking on
51:45: Then they could not even rise (on their feet), nor could they help themselves
51:46: And the people of Noah before (that)’, Verily they were wicked people
51:47: And the heaven, We did raise it up with (Our) Might, and verily We are the expanders (of it) expanse?
51:48: And the earth, We did spread it out (like a carpet), how Excellent (are We) the Spreaders (thereof)?
51:49: And of everything have We created in pairs, that ye may reflect?
51:50: So fly ye unto God! Verily I am unto you a plain Warner
51:51: Set ye not with God any other god; Verily I am unto you a plain Warner
51:52: Even so there came not unto those before them an apostle but said they (of him): ‘A sorcerer or a mad man
51:53: Have they charged this unto one another? Nay! they are rebellious people
51:54: Then turn thou thy back upon them for thou art not to be blamed
51:55: And remind thou, for verily reminding profiteth the believers
51:56: And created not I, the Jinn and the humans, but that they may worship (Me)
51:57: I desire not from them any sustenance, nor do I desire that they should feed Me
51:58: Verily, God He (alone) is the Bestower of sustenance, the Lord of the unbreakable strength
51:59: So, verily those who are unjust shall have a share (of the burden) like unto the share (of the burden) which had their fellows (of old), Therefore, let them ask Me not to hasten it on
51:60: Therefore, Woe unto those who disbelieve because of their day which they are promised!
52:7: Verily the chastisement of thy Lord shall indeed come to pass
52:8: There is none to repel it
52:9: On the Day when the heaven shall reel a (Terrible) reeling
52:10: And the mountains shall fly an (awful) flight
52:11: Woe then that day unto those who belie the Truth
52:12: Those who, in vain sport do play
52:13: The Day on which they shall be driven unto the hell-fire with a violent drive
52:14: [And it shall be said unto them]: ‘This is the Fire which ye used to belie
52:15: What! Is it sorcery then? Or ye see it not?
52:16: Enter ye into it then be ye patient, or be ye not patient, alike shall it be unto you; certainly, shall ye be recompensed what ye used to do
52:17: Verily the pious ones shall be in the gardens amidst the bounties (therein)
52:18: Rejoicing in what gave them their Lord, and saved them their Lord from the chastisement of the Hell
52:19: (It will be said unto them)’. “Eat ye and drink ye in health and delight for what ye used to do
52:20: Reclining on thrones ranged; And We will unite them with Huries (maidens pure) with large (lovely) eyes
52:21: And those who believe and follow them their offspring in faith, We will unite with them their offspring and We will lessen not unto them aught of their (good) deeds; Every man shall for what he hath wrought, be responsible
52:22: And We will provide with fruits and flesh of what they desire
52:23: They shall pass therein to one another a cup wherein shall not be any vanity nor a sin
52:24: And there shall go around them (serving them) youths (handsome) as if they are imbedded pearls
52:25: And some shall accost the others making mutual enquiries
52:26: They will say: ‘Verily we feared ere (this) in regard to our families
52:27: But God hath bestowed His grace on us, and He hath saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind
52:28: Verily, we used ere this to call upon Him; Verily, He is the Benign, the Most Merciful
52:29: So thou remind on (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) for thou, by the grace of thy Lord (on thee), art neither a soothsayer, nor a mad man
52:30: Or say they (about thee O’ Our Apostle!) ‘A poet (is he)! Let us wait for him some fatal adversity (drawn) by time!
52:31: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!). “Wait ye, and verily I too with you am of those who wait
52:32: Or is it that bid them their deliberations, to do this, or are they an inordinate people?
52:33: Or say they (that): ‘He hath forged it (the Qur’an)? Nay! they believe not
52:34: Let them then bring a dis-course like unto it, if they be truthful
52:35: Or were they created by nothing? Or are they themselves the creators?
52:36: Or created they the heavens and the earth? Nay! they have no certainty
52:37: Or with them are the treasures of thy Lord, Or hold they the absolute authority?
52:38: Or for them is a ladder by which they can (climb up into the heaven and) listen (to the angels)? Then let the listener of theirs bring a proof manifest
52:39: Or for Him are daughters and for ye sons?
52:40: Or thou asketh of them any recompense, that they are burdened with the weight of debt?
52:41: Or with them is the unseen that they write it down?
52:42: Or intend they to lay snares for thee? But those who disbelieve are themselves the snared ones
52:43: Or for them is a god other than God? Hallowed is God from what they associate (with Him)
52:44: And if they see a portion of the heaven coming down, they would say: ‘(they are) clouds piled up
52:45: Leave them then until they encounter the Day of theirs where-in they shall be smitten (with terror) to swoon
52:46: A day wherein their devices shall avail them not aught, nor shall they be helped
52:47: And verily for those who did injustice there shall be a chastisement besides that, but most of them know it not
52:48: And wait thou patiently for the command of thy Lord, for verily thou art before Our eyes, and celebrate thou the praise of thy Lord when thou risest
52:49: And in the night too, celebrate thou His Glory and at the setting of the stars
53:1: By the star when it goeth down
53:2: Erreth not your Companion (Our Apostle Muhammad) nor is he led astray
53:3: And nor he speaketh of (his own) inclination
53:4: It (the wording) is naught but a revelation revealed (unto him)
53:5: Taught him the one Intense in power
53:6: The one endued with wisdom; (and) hence he took an overviewing position
53:7: While he was in the highest horizon
53:8: Then he drew nigh, and became pending
53:9: Thus was (he) the measure between two bows (facing each other) or nigher still
53:10: Then revealed He unto His Servant what He did reveal
53:11: Belied not (his) heart what he saw
53:12: What! Dispute ye then with him as to what he saw?
53:13: And indeed he did see him at another descent
53:15: Nigh unto it is the Garden-Abode
53:16: When covereth (over) the ‘Sidra’ (Tree) that which covereth it
53:17: Neither his eye did dazzle nor did it rebel
53:18: Indeed he did see of the greatest signs of his Lord
53:19: See ye then (the idols) Lat and the Uzza?
53:21: What! for you the males and for Him (God) the females?
53:22: This indeed is a division unjust
53:23: They are nothing but (mere) names, which have named ye and your fathers, sent not God for them any authority; They follow nothing but a conjecture what their selves are inclined to; and indeed, hath come unto them from their Lord the right guidance
53:24: What! Shall man have whatever he wisheth?
53:25: Nay! God’s is the (life) hereafter and the former (life)
53:26: And how many an angel in heavens are whose intercession is of no avail at all save after that permitteth God whomsoever willeth He and chooseth
53:27: Verily, those who believe not in the hereafter name the angels with female names
53:28: But they have not of it anything of knowledge; they follow nothing but a conjecture; verily a conjecture availeth naught the truth at all
53:29: Therefore, turn thou aside from him who turneth his back against Our reminder, and desireth not anything but the life of this world
53:30: That is the (last) reach of their knowledge; Verily, thy Lord knoweth best of him who is astray from His path and He knoweth best of him who is guided aright
53:31: And God’s is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may recompense those who do evil for what they did, and that He may recompense those who do good, with what is best
53:32: Those who do avoid the great ones of the sin and shameful deeds save accidentally verily, thy Lord is (the Lord of) vast forgiveness: He knoweth best about you when He raised you from the earth and when ye are embryos in the wombs of your mothers; so assert ye not the purity of your selves; He knoweth best of him who guardeth (himself against evil)
53:33: Hast thou then seen him who hath turned his back
53:34: And giveth he a little and withholdeth (his hand)
53:35: What! Is with him the know-ledge of the unseen that he seeth
53:36: Or hath he not been told of what is in the scriptures of Moses?
53:37: And of Abraham who fully discharged (his mission)?
53:38: That no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another
53:39: And that there is not for man (aught) save what he striveth for
53:40: And that his striving shall soon be seen
53:41: Then shall he be recompensed to the fullest measure
53:42: And that unto thy Lord is the end (of all)
53:43: And verily He it is Who causeth (one) to laugh and causeth (him) to weep
53:44: And that He it is Who causeth death and causeth life
53:45: And He it is Who createth pairs, the male and the female
53:46: From the sperm when it is discharged
53:47: And that on Him (alone) is the raising for a second time
53:48: And that He it is Who enricheth and bestoweth contention
53:49: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius
53:50: And that He did destroy (the powerful) ‘Ad of the ancient (times)
53:51: And Thamood, and He spared not (one to survive)
53:52: And the people of Noah before; Verily they, they were the most unjust and the most transgressing
53:53: And the cities overthrown (it is) He (Who) did overthrow
53:54: So covered them what did cover
53:55: Which then of the bounties of thy Lord wilt thou dispute about?
53:56: This (Our Apostle Muhammad) is a Warner of the warners of old
53:57: Draweth nigh the (Hour of Reckoning which is) ever drawing nigh
53:58: None there is for it other than God to lay it bare
53:59: What! Wonder ye then at this statement?
53:60: And laugh ye and not weep?
53:62: Therefore, prostrate ye in obeisance unto God and worship Him (alone)
54:1: Nigh hath come the Hour (of Reckoning) and hath been rent asunder the Moon
54:2: And if they see a sign, turn they away and say (that it is) sorcery continued
54:3: And they belie (it), and follow they their vain inclinations and every affair is unalterably fixed
54:4: And indeed, hath come unto them some of the tidings wherein is restraint (from evil)
54:5: Consummate wisdom, but (they) availed not (of) the warnings
54:6: So withdraw from them thyself (O Our Apostle Muhammad!) On the day when the Caller shall call them unto the hard task (of Reckoning)
54:7: With their eyes cast down, they shall go forth from their graves as if they were locusts scattered
54:8: Hastening unto the Caller; Shall say the disbelievers: ‘This is a hard day!
54:9: Belied before them the people of Noah (their apostles), so they belied Our servant and said they (he was) “Mad “ and he was driven out
54:10: So he called upon his Lord (saying): ‘Verily, I am overcome (by these people), so give help
54:11: So opened We the gates of heaven with water pouring down
54:12: And We caused the earth to break forth like springs and water from the heavens and the earth met together for the purpose verily destined
54:13: And We bore him on a thing made of planks and nails
54:14: It floated on, before Our eyes, a recompense for those who had been rejected (by the infidels)
54:15: And indeed, We have left it (the Ark) as a sign, but is there one to remember (it)?
54:16: How (great) was then My chastisement and My warning!
54:17: And indeed, have We made Qur’an easy (for remembrance ), but is there one to remember (it)?
54:18: Belied (the truth) (the people of) ‘Ad, then how (great) was My chastisement and My warning!
54:19: (Lo!) Verily sent We on them a violent wind, on a Day of constant ill-luck
54:20: Flinging the people away, as if they were palm-trunks uprooted
54:21: How (great) was then My chastisement and My warning!
54:22: And indeed, have We made Qur’an easy (to remember), but is there one to remember (it)?
54:23: (The people of) Thamood belied the warners
54:24: And said they: ‘What! A single man, from among us! and we to follow him? Verily then we shall be astray and in distress
54:25: Is it that (the duty of) reminding hath been bestowed on him (alone), of all the (people) among us? Nay! He is a great liar, an insolent one!
54:26: Soon they shall know on the morrow, (as to) who is the liar, the Insolent One!
54:27: (O’ Our Apostle Saleh!) verily We are going to send the she- camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be patient
54:28: And (thou O’ Saleh!) make them aware (beforehand) that the water is (to be) divided between them; and every drinking share shall be witnessed (on it)
54:29: But they called their companion, then he pursued (her) and hamstrung (her)
54:30: How (great) was My chastisement and My warning?
54:31: Verily sent We upon them a single (violent) blast, and they were (all) like the dry stubble used by a fencer in a fence
54:32: And indeed, have We made Qur’an easy (to remember) but is there any rememberer?
54:33: The people of Lot belied the warners
54:34: Verily sent We upon them a stone-storm, (which destroyed them all) save the followers of Lot; We saved them by early dawn
54:35: (As) a bounty from unto Us; Thus do We recompense him who giveth thanks
54:36: And indeed, he did warn them of Our severe seizure, but they did dispute about the warner
54:37: And indeed, they did demand him of his guests (for their evil desert), so did We blind their eyes (saying)’. ‘Taste ye then My chastisement and My warning!
54:38: And indeed, dawned on them in the morn a lasting chastisement
54:39: Now taste ye My chastisement and My warning!
54:40: And indeed, have We made Qur’an easy (to he remembered) but is there any one to remember (it)?
54:41: And indeed, came unto the people of Pharaoh the warners
54:42: They belied all Our signs so did We seize them after the manner of the one the Ever Prevalent, the All-Mighty One
54:43: What! Are your disbelievers (O’ ye Meccans!) better people than these? Or is there an exemption for you in the sacred Scriptures?
54:44: Or say they: “We are a host joined together to help each other?
54:45: Soon shall the host be routed, and they shall turn their backs
54:46: Nay! The Hour (of Reckoning) is their promised time, and the Hour shall be most grievous and bitter
54:47: Verily the guilty ones are straying and mad (in distress)
54:48: On that Day they shall be dragged upon their faces into the fire (and it will be said unto them)’. ‘Taste ye (now) the touch of Hell!
54:49: Verily every thing have We created to a determined measure
54:50: And Our command is but one (word ‘Be’! And it becometh) like the twinkling of an eye
54:51: And indeed, have We destroyed the like unto you, but is there any one to receive the warning?
54:52: And everything they have done is in the books (of deeds)
54:53: Every matter small and big, is (correctly) recorded in writing
54:54: Verily, the pious ones shall be in gardens and rivers
54:55: In the seat of Truth, with the Sovereign Omnipotent One
55:5: The sun and the moon follow the (prescribed) timings
55:6: And the herbs and the trees do obeisance (unto Him)
55:7: And the heaven, He did raise it high, and placed the scale (within reach)
55:8: So that ye may not transgress in scales
55:9: And maintain ye the measure with justice and do not cut short in the scale
55:10: And the earth, He hath made it for (His) (living) creatures
55:11: Therein is fruit and palms having, sheathed clusters
55:12: And corn with (its) leaves and stalks and with sweet-smelling herbs
55:13: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two (men and jinns ) belie?
55:14: He created man from dry clay like that of the earthen vessels
55:15: And created He the jinn of a flame of fire
55:16: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:17: (He alone is the) Lord of the two easts and the Lord of the two wests
55:18: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:19: He hath let loose the two seas that they flow together meeting each other
55:20: (Yet) between them (He hath caused) a barrier, (that) they encroach not (one upon another)
55:21: Which then of the bounties your Lord will ye two belie?
55:22: Come forth out of the two, pearls and corals
55:23: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:24: And His are the ships towering up at the sea like mountains
55:25: Which then of the bounties of vour Lord will ve two belie?
55:26: Every one on it shall perish
55:27: But will remain for ever the Face of thy Lord, the Glorious and Gracious
55:28: Which then of the bounties of thy Lord will ye two belie?
55:29: Beseech Him all those in the heavens and the earth; Every day He is in a (new) splendorous manifestation
55:30: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:31: Soon will We attend to you, O’ ye two groups (of men and jinns)
55:32: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:33: O ye peoples of jinn and humans, if ye can penetrate the bounds of the heavens and the earth, then do penetrate ye through; (But) ye cannot penetrate but with (Our) authority!
55:34: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:35: On ye two shall be sent the flames of fire and molten brass, then ye shall not be able to protect yourselves
55:36: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:37: And when is rent asunder the heaven, then it becometh red like the tanned hide
55:38: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:39: And on that Day shall not be asked man nor jinn of his sin
55:40: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:41: The guilty ones shall be re-cognised by their marks, and they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet
55:42: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:43: This is the hell which belied the guilty ones
55:44: Around in it shall they run in hot, boiling water
55:45: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:46: And for him who feareth the time of standing before his Lord are two gardens
55:47: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:48: With over-branching trees (in each of the two gardens)
55:49: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:50: In both of them are two fountains flowing
55:51: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:52: In each of them, of every fruit, are two kinds
55:53: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:54: Reclining on beds, the inner coverings of which are of silk brocade; the fruit of (both) the gardens shall be nigh (within easy reach)
55:55: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:56: Therein shall be damsels with retiring glances, whom hath touched not ever before, any human being nor a jinn
55:57: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:58: As though they were rubies and pearls
55:59: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:60: Is the recompense for good aught but good?
55:61: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:62: And besides these (two) are two other gardens
55:63: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:65: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:66: In them both are two springs gushing forth
55:67: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:68: In them both are fruits and palms and pomegranates
55:69: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:70: In them are virtuous women, beautiful ones
55:71: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:73: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:74: Hath touched them not ever before any human being nor any jinn
55:75: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:76: Reclining on cushions green and carpets beautiful
55:77: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye two belie?
55:78: Hallowed is the name of thy Lord, the Lord of Glory and Grace!
56:2: There is not for its happening, any belying
56:3: (It shall be) Abasing (some and) Exalting (the others)
56:4: When the earth shall be shaken with a (tremendous) shaking
56:5: And the mountains shall be crumbled a terrible crumbling
56:6: And they shall become scattered dust
56:7: And ye shall be (sorted into) three kinds
56:8: Then (will be) the people of the Right hand; Oh! What (a happy state shall) the people of the Right hand (be in)!
56:9: And the people of the Left hand; Ah! What (a wretched state shall) the people of the Left hand be (in it)
56:10: And the Foremost ones (in faith and virtue) shall be the Foremost ones (in receiving their reward)
56:11: These are they who shall be brought nigh (unto God)
56:13: (A group of the) numerous from among the first ones
56:14: A (group) few from among the later ones
56:16: Reclining on them face to face
56:17: Around shall go about (serving) them youths of unchanging bloom
56:18: With goblets and ewers and a cup of pure drink
56:19: Their brows ache not from it, nor faileth the sense
56:20: And fruits, any that they choose
56:21: And the flesh of fowls, any that they like
56:22: And the Huries (maidens pure), with large (lovely) eyes
56:23: Like unto pearls hidden (in their shells)
56:24: A recompense for what they used to do
56:25: They shall hear not therein any frivolity, nor any taint of sin
56:27: And the people of Right hand! Oh! What (a happy state shall) the people of the Right hand (be in)!
56:29: And banana-trees (with fruits) piled one above another
56:33: Neither failing (by season) nor (their free use) forbidden (by any)
56:35: Verily have We created them (The fair beautiful mates) as a (special) creation
56:36: And We have made them virgins pure
56:38: For the people of the Right hand
56:39: Numerous from among the first ones
56:40: And numerous from among the later ones
56:41: And the people of the Left hand, Ah! What (a wretched state shall) the people of the Left hand (be in)!
56:42: In scorching wind and scalding water
56:43: And in the shadow of a black smoke
56:45: Verily they were ere that, of the extravagants (in ease and luxury)
56:46: And they used to persist in heinous sin
56:47: And they used to say: ‘What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we even then indeed be again raised up?
56:49: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): ‘Verily the ancients and the later ones
56:50: Certainly, shall be gathered together unto the tryst of the known Day
56:51: Then verily ye, O’ ye who are astray and belie it
56:52: Certainly, shall ye eat of a tree of ‘Zaqqoom
56:54: And drink over it of boiling water
56:55: Then shall drink ye as drinketh the thirsty camel
56:56: This shall be their repast on the Day of Reckoning
56:57: It is We Who created you, why then do ye not admit the Truth?
56:58: Have ye seen what ye emit (the life germ)?
56:59: Is it ye that create it or are We the Creators?
56:60: It is We Who have decreed death among you, and We are not to be frustrated
56:61: To Our changing your forms and raising you in that ye know not
56:62: And indeed, know ye the first growth, why then ye reflect not?
56:63: Have ye seen what ye sow
56:64: What! Is it ye that grow it or are We the growers?
56:65: Had We willed, We could crumble it to dry bits, and ye would be left only to lament
56:66: (Saying): ‘Verily we have been burdened with loss!
56:67: Nay! We are deprived (of the benefits!)
56:68: Have ye seen the water which ye drink?
56:69: What! Is it ye that send it down from the heaven or are We the Senders?
56:70: Had We willed, We would have made it saltish, why then ye thank not?
56:71: Have ye seen the fire which ye kindle (by friction)?
56:72: What! Is it ye who produce its tree? Or are We the producers (of) it?
56:73: It is We Who have made it a reminder and a provision (of comfort) for the needy ones
56:74: So hallow thou the name of thy Lord, the Great
56:75: But nay! I swear by the setting of the stars
56:76: And verily it is a great oath if ye only knew it
56:79: Toucheth it not save the purified ones
56:80: Sent down by the Lord of the worlds
56:81: What! Hold ye then in scorn this statement?
56:82: And make ye your sustenance that ye should belie it
56:83: Why then do ye not (help) when (the soul of the dying man) cometh up to the throat?
56:84: And ye then (remain) only gazing (at him)
56:85: And We are nearer to him than ye, but ye see (Us) not
56:86: Why not then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us)
56:87: Ye send it (the soul) back, if ye be truthful
56:88: Then if he be of those drawn nigh (unto God)
56:89: (For him is) rest and happiness and a garden delightful
56:90: And if he be of the people of the Right Hand
56:91: Then Peace unto you from the people of the Right Hand
56:92: And if he be of those who have belied, gone astray
56:93: He shall have an entertainment of a boiling water
56:94: And the boiling of the hell-fire
56:95: Verily, this is truth in certainty
56:96: Hallow therefore the Name of thy Lord, the Great
57:1: Celebrateth the praise of God, whatever is in the heavens and the earth; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise
57:2: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He causeth life and causeth death; and He, over all hath power
57:3: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden: and He is the Knower of all things
57:4: He it is who created the heavens and the earth in six periods, then firmly established (Himself) over the ‘Arsh’ (the Seat of supreme authority)’, knoweth He whatever entereth the earth, and whatever goeth forth from it, and whatever descendeth from the heaven, and whatever goeth up into it; and He is with you wherever ye be; and God, is the Seer of whatever ye do
57:5: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and unto God (alone) arc returned (all) affairs
57:6: He causeth the night to enter in upon the day, and causeth (He) the day to enter in upon the night, and He (alone) is the Knower of whatever is in the breasts
57:7: Believe ye in God and His Apostle (Muhammad)! and spend ye (in charity) of whatever He hath made you the successors thereof; for whosoever among you believe and spend (in charity), for them is a recompense very great
57:8: And what reasons have ye that ye believe not in God? And the Apostle inviteth you to believe in your Lord, and hath indeed taken a covenant from you if ye are believers
57:9: He it is Who sendeth down unto His Servant signs manifest, so that He may bring you out of the darkness (of infidelity) into the light (of faith)’, and verily God unto you is the Most Kind and the Most Merciful!
57:10: And what reasons have ye that ye spend not in the way of God, and God’s is the heritage of the heavens and the earth; alike are not among you those who spent before the victory and fought and (those who did not), they are more exalted in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards; and unto all hath promised God goodness; And verily God, of whatever ye do, is All-Aware
57:11: Who is he who would loan unto God a goodly loan? so that He may double it for him, and for him shall be a noble recompense
57:12: The Day thou shalt see the faithful men and faithful women, with their light running before them, and on their right hand (shall be given) glad tidings for you of that Day! Gardens ‘neath which flow rivers, to abide therein; That is the great achievement
57:13: On the Day will say the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women unto those who believe: “Tarry ye for us, that we may borrow light from your light;” It shall be said: “Turn ye back and seek ye (some other) light!” So there will be set between them a wall (a harrier) with a door therein; the inside thereof shall be mercy in it, and outside it, before it shall be chastisement
57:14: They will cry out unto them: ‘Were we not with you?’ They shall say: ‘Yea! but ye cast yourself into temptation, and ye waited (for us to be beguiled) and ye doubted (in God’s warning), and deceived you your vain desires till came the decree of God (to pass) and deceived you about God the (Arch) Deceiver
57:15: So this day shall not be accepted from you any ransom nor from those who disbelieved; your abode shall be the fire; it is your guardian, and what a wretched resort it shall be!
57:16: Hath not the time yet come, for those who believe that their hearts become humble for the remembrance of God and what hath come down of the Truth? And (that) they should not be like unto those who were given the Book before, but (when) lengthened the ages passed over them, so it hardened their hearts; and many of them are transgressors
57:17: Know ye! that God enliveneth the earth after its death. Indeed, have We made the signs clear unto you, that ye may understand
57:18: Verily charitable men and charitable women and those who offer a goodly loan unto God, doubled shall it be unto them, and for them shall be a noble recompense
57:19: And those who believe in God and His Apostle, these it is who are the truthful ones, and the witnesses with their Lord. For them shall be their recompense and their light; And those who disbelieve and belie Our signs, these are the inmates of hell
57:20: Know ye! That the life of this world is only a sport and play, a gaiety and a boasting and the lustful-vying in the multi-plication of wealth and children, is like unto the rain therewith springeth up the vegetation, it pleaseth the husbandmen; then it is withered away, and thou seest it becometh yellow, then becometh it stubble crumbleth down; And in the hereafter is a severe chastisement and (also) forgiveness from God, and (His) pleasures; and naught is the life of this world but means of illusion
57:21: Vie ye in hastening unto forgiveness from your Lord and unto a garden whose extent is like the extent of the heaven and the earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His Apostles; that is the grace of God, He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth; and God is the Lord of Mighty Grace
57:22: Befalleth not any disaster in the earth or in your own selves save it is in a Book, ere We cause it to be, verily that is easy for God
57:23: Lest distress ye yourselves for what escapeth you, and be over- joyous for what He hath granted you; and God lovcth not an arrogant boaster
57:24: Those who are niggardly and enjoin upon people niggardliness; and whosoever turneth away (from charity) then verily God is He who is Self-Sufficient, the Most Praise-Worthy
57:25: Indeed, sent We Our apostles with clear proofs, and sent We down with them the Book and the scale that people may establish themselves in justice; and sent We down iron wherein is latent (in its use) mighty power and also benefits for mankind and that God may prove who helpeth Him and His apostles in secret; Verily God is All-Strong the Ever-Prevalent
57:26: And indeed sent We Noah and Abraham, and endowed We in their seed the Prophethood and the Book, so among them are some who are guided aright; and most of them are transgressors
57:27: We made Our apostles to follow in their footsteps, and sent We after them Jesus, son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel; and We put into the hearts of those who followed him kindness and compassion; but (as to) the monastic life, they invented it themselves. We prescribed not on them save seeking the pleasure of God, and this they observed not as they ought to have observed it; and gave We unto those of them who believed their (due) recompense; but many of them are transgressors
57:28: O’ ye who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) God and believe in His Apostle; He will give you a twofold of His Mercy, He will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk (straight on the Right Path) and He will forgive you; and God is Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful
57:29: So that may know the people of the Book that they control not aught of the grace of God, and that grace is in God’s hand, He bestoweth it upon whosoever He willeth; and God is the Lord of Mighty Grace
58:1: Indeed, hath God heard the statement of her who pleadeth with thee about her husband and petitioneth unto God; and verily God heareth the contention of you two; Verily God is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
58:2: Those of you who abandon any of their wives through ‘Zihar’ (by saying “Be thou unto me as my mother’s back”); they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who gave them birth! and certainly they utter a word hateful and false; and verily God is Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.
58:3: And those who abandon any of their wives through ‘Zihar’ and then would recall what they have uttered, they may free a captive ere they touch each other; that ye are admonished (to conform); and Verily God, of whatever ye do, is Well-Aware.
58:4: But whosoever findeth not the means (to free a captive), he may fast for two months consecutively ere they touch each other; and whosoever is not able to do (so) shall feed sixty needy ones; that is in order that ye may believe in God and His Apostle; And these are the bounds set of God; And for the disbeliever there shall be a painful chastisement.
58:5: Verily, those who oppose God and His Apostle, shall be humiliated as were humiliated those before them; and indeed We have sent down signs clear; and for the disbelievers there shall be a humiliating chastisement.
58:6: On the day when God will raise them all to life and inform them of what they did; God hath encompassed (everything) in (His) record; while they (might) have forgotten it; and God is over all things a Witness.
58:7: Seest thou not that God knoweth whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? nowhere taketh place any secret counsel between three (persons) but He is fourth of them, nor between five, but He is the sixth, nor (between) less than that, nor (between) more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; then will He inform them of whatever they did, on the Day of Judgment - Verily God Well Knoweth all things.
58:8: Seest thou not those who have been forbidden secret counsels, yet return they unto what hath been forbidden and hold they secret counsels to sin and revolt and towards disobedience to the Apostle, and when come they unto thee, they greet thee, not as greeteth thee God; and say they in their selves “Why doth God chastise not for what we say?” Enough for them is hell, they shall enter it, and what a wretched destination it is!
58:9: O’ ye who believe! When ye counsel among yourselves in secret, then counsel ye not to sin and revolt and disobedience to the Apostle, but counsel ye among yourselves for goodness and restrain (of yourselves against evil)’, and fear ye (the wrath of) God unto Whom ye shall all be gathered!
58:10: Secret counsels are (Simulated) only by satan, that he may cause grief unto those who believe, but he shall harm them not in any way but with the permission of God; and upon God alone depend those who believe.
58:11: O’ ye who believe! when it is said unto you, ‘Make ye room in (your) assemblies! then make ye room, God will make room for you; and when it is said unto you, ‘Rise ye up! then rise ye up, God will exalt (you in) ranks (unto Him), those who believe among you, and those who have been granted knowledge; and God is All-Aware of whatsoever ye do.
58:12: O’ ye who believe! When ye (wish to) consult in private with the Apostle, then offer some alms before your consultation, that is better for you and purer; but ye find not any means (to do so), then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
58:13: What Restrained ye that ye give alms before your consultation? Then since ye did it not and God turned (merciful) unto you, then keep ye up (the regular) prayer, and pay ye (the prescribed) poor-rate and obey ye God and His Apostle; and God is All-Aware of what (all) ye do.
58:14: Hast thou not seen those who befriend a people on whom hath been the wrath of God? Thy are neither of your party nor are they of theirs, and swear they for falsehood while they know (what they do).
58:15: For them hath prepared God a severe chastisement; Verily, evil is what they do.
58:16: Make they their oaths a shield, and obstruct they (others) from the way of God, so for them shall be a shameful chastisement.
58:17: Never shall avail them aught against God, their wealth nor their children; they are fellows of the fire; they shall abide therein.
58:18: On the day when God will raise them all, then will swear they unto Him as they swear unto you, and deem they that it will avail them. Nay! verily they, they are the liars!
58:19: Satan hath gained hold on them, so he maketh them forget the remembrance of God; They are Satan’s Party; Beware! verily, the party of Satan are the losers.
58:20: Verily those who are opposed to God, and His Apostle, they shall be of the most humiliated.
58:21: God hath decreed: “I shall prevail, I and My apostles!” Verily God is the All-Strong, the Ever-Prevalent.
58:22: Thou shalt find not a people who believe in God and the hereafter befriending those who oppose God and His Apostle, be they even their own fathers, or their sons, or their own brothers, or their kinsmen, they are those God hath inscribed faith in their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Himself; and He will admit them into gardens ‘neath which flow rivers, they shall abide therein; with God well pleased with them, and they will be well-pleased with God; They are the party of God; Be it known, verily the party of God alone shall be the successful ones.
59:1: Praiseth, whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth the Glory of God; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, The All-Wise.
59:2: He it is Who caused those who disbelieved among the people of the Book to go out from their homes unto the first banishment; ye deemed not that they would go out; while they thought that their fortresses would protect them against God but came upon them God from whence they looked not for Him, and caused (such) terror into their hearts that they demolished their home with their own hands and the hands of the believers; therefore get warned O’ ye who have eyes!
59:3: And were it not that God had decreed against them the exile, certainly would He have chastised them in this world; and for them in the hereafter shall be the chastisement of the fire.
59:4: That is for that they opposed God and His Apostle and whosoever opposeth God, then verily God is severe in retribution.
59:5: Whatever ye cut down of the palm-tree or spare it standing upon its roots, is by God’s permission, and that He may put to shame the transgressors.
59:6: And whatever hath God bestowed on His Apostle from them, ye pressed not against it any horse or a camel, but God granteth authority unto His apostles against whomsoever He willeth; And God over all things is All-Powerful.
59:7: Whatever hath God bestowed on His Apostle from the people of the towns, belongeth unto God, and for the Apostle, and for his (Prophet’s) kindred, and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, so that it may not circulate among the rich ones of you, and whatever giveth you the Apostle, ye accept it, and from whatever preventeth he, ye be away ( from it); and fear ye (the wrath of) God; Verily God is severe in retribution.
59:8: (And also) for the poor ‘Muhajirs’ (who fled), those who were expelled away from their homes and their possessions, seeking the grace of God and (His) pleasure, and aiding God and His Apostle; These it is that are the truthful ones.
59:9: And those (who believed) before them and had made (their) homes (in the city of Madina) and are (firm) in faith (and) love they those who have fled unto them and find not in their breasts (hearts) any need of what has been given to them, (the Muhajirs) and prefer (the Muhajirs) over their own selves, though their own lot be poverty; and whosoever is saved from the niggardliness of his self, these it is that are the successful ones.
59:10: And they who come after them say: “O’ Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in faith, and create not in our hearts any ill will unto those who believe; O’ Our Lord! Verily Thou art the Ever-Kind) the All-Merciful.
59:11: Hast thou not seen those who are hypocrites? say they unto those of their brethren who disbelieve from among the people of the Book: “If ye be driven out we shall certainly go out with you and we will obey not at all any one in what ye are concerned, and if ye are fought (against’), certainly will we help you and God beareth witness (that) Verily they are liars.
59:12: No! If they were driven out, they will not go out with them, and if they are fought against, they would help them not, and even if they help them, certainly will they turn their backs; then they shall not be helped.
59:13: Assuredly ye are more vehement in being feared in their breasts than God, that is for they are people who discern not.
59:14: They will fight not against you in a body except in towns fortified or from behind walls; Their fighting among themselves is severe; thou mayest deem them united, but their hearts are divided; That is because they are a people who understand not.
59:15: They are like unto those who preceded lately, (who also) tasted the evil result of their (own) doings; and for them is a painful chastisement.
59:16: Like unto satan who sayeth unto man; “Disbelieve thou!” and when he disbelieveth sayeth he: “Verily I disassociate from thee, verily I fear God, the Lord of the worlds!
59:17: So the end of both of those two (Satan as well as the disbeliever man) is that the two shall be in fire to abide therein; and that shall be the recompense of the unjust.
59:18: O’ ye who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) God! Let every soul (carefully) look well to what it hath sent on for the morrow (the Day of Reckoning); and fear ye (the wrath of) God; Verily God is All-Aware of whatsoever ye do.
59:19: And be not like unto those who forsook God! so He made them forsake their own selves; these are the transgressors.
59:20: Equal are not the fellows of the fire and dwellers of the garden: the dwellers of the garden are they that are the achievers
59:21: Had We sent down this Qur’an, on mountain, thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) wouldst certainly have seen it (the mountain ) humbled itself, and rent asunder for the fear of God; And We set forth these similitudes unto mankind that they may reflect.
59:22: He is God, There is no god, save He: The Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is the Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
59:23: He is God, There is no god save He; the King, the Holy, the Peaceloving (the Bestower of) conviction, the Guardian (over all), the Ever-Prevalent, the Supreme, the Great Absolute! Hallowed is God from what they associate (with Him).
59:24: He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner, His are all the Excellent names; Halloweth Him whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
60:1: O’ ye who believe! Take ye not My foe and your foe for friends: offering unto them (your) love while denied they what hath come unto you of the Truth; driving out the Apostle and yourselves for ye believe in God, your Lord; If ye go forth striving in My path and seeking My pleasure (take ye not them as friends by) manifesting unto them (your) love in secret, and I know best what ye conceal and what ye declare; and whosoever of you doeth this, indeed hath he gone astray from the straight path.
60:2: If they find any opportunity against you, they will be foes unto you, and will stretch forth unto you their hands and their tongues with evil (intent), and anxiously desire they that ye (too) should disbelieve.
60:3: Never shall profit you your relations, nor your children, on the Day of Reckoning; He (alone) will decide between you, and God Seeth All whatsoever ye do.
60:4: Indeed, there is for you a good pattern (of life) in Abraham and those with him; when said they unto their people: “Verily We disassociate (ourselves) from you and from what ye worship other than God; we renounce you: and hath sprung up between us and you enmity and hatred for ever, until believe ye in God alone” but not what said Abraham unto his father “I shall certainly seek forgiveness for thee, and I own not for thee aught from God; “O’ Our Lord! On thee (alone) do we rely; and unto Thee (only) do we turn! and unto Thee (alone) is (our) final return.
60:5: O’ Our Lord! make us not a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us O’ Our Lord! Verily Thou art the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
60:6: Indeed there is for you in them a good pattern (of life), for him who hopeth in God and the Last Day; and whosoever turneth away, then verily God is He Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised.
60:7: Maybe that God will cause friendship between you and those whom ye take to be your enemies among them, and God is All- Powerful; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
60:8: Forbiddeth not God unto you regarding those who have not made war upon you in the matter of (your) religion, and drove you not out of your homes, that ye show them kindness and be just unto them; Verily God loveth the just ones.
60:9: Only doth God forbid you regarding those who made war upon you in the matter of (your) religion, and drove you out of your homes and aided in your expulsion, that ye make friends of them; and whosoever maketh friends of them, these are the unjust ones.
60:10: O’ ye who believe! When come unto you believing women refugees, then ye examine them; God knoweth best their faith; and if ye find them to be believing women, return ye not them unto the disbelievers; neither these women are lawful for them, nor are those (men) lawful for them; and give them what they have spent, and no blame be on you in marrying them when ye pay them their dowries; and hold ye not the ties of marriage to the disbelieving women, demand ye for what ye have spent, and let them demand for what they have spent; This is the decree of God; He enforceth (it) among you; and God is All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
60:11: And if any of your wives passeth away from you unto the disbelievers and thereafter ye have your turn (of triumph over the disbelievers) then give unto those whose wives have gone away the like of what they have spent; and fear ye (the wrath of) God in Whom ye believe.
60:12: O’ (Our) Prophet (Muhammad!) when come unto thee believer women pledging that they will associate not aught with God, and they will steal not, and they will commit not adultery and kill not their children, and they will utter not slander, nor utter any falsehood which they had forged themselves between their hands and their feet and will not disobey thee in what is fair, then accept thou their pledge, and ask forgiveness for them from God; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
60:13: O’ ye those who believe! Make ye not friends with a people with whom God is wrath; indeed despair they of their hereafter, as the disbelievers despair of those in the graves.
61:1: Halloweth God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
61:2: O’ ye who believe! Why say ye what ye (yourselves) do (it) not?
61:3: Most hateful is it unto God that ye say what ye (yourselves) do (it) not.
61:4: Verily God loveth those who fight in His way in ranks as if they were an unbreakable metalled wall.
61:5: And when said Moses unto his people: “O’ ye my people! Why do ye pain me? while indeed ye know that verily I am an apostle of God unto you;” but when (yet) went they astray, God (too) allowed their hearts (to astray)’, and God guideth not the people who transgress.
61:6: And when said Jesus, son of Mary: “O’ ye the children of Israel! Verily I am an apostle of God unto you, confirming what is before you of the Torah and bearing (unto you) the glad tidings of an Apostle who shall come after me, his name being Ahmed (i.e. Muhammad) and when came he (Ahmed) unto them said they: “This is a manifest Sorcery!
61:7: And who is more unjust than he who forgeth a lie against God while he is invited unto Islam? and God guideth not the unjust people.
61:8: Intend they to put out the Light of God with their mouths! but God will perfect His Light, though averse may be the dis-believers.
61:9: He it is who hath sent His Apostle (Muhammad) with the Guidance (Qur’an) and the Religion of Truth (Islam), that He may make it triumph over all the (other) religions, though averse may be the polytheists.
61:10: O’ ye who believe! shall I show you a merchandise which will deliver you from a painful chastisement?
61:11: (That) ye should believe in God and His Apostle, and strive in the way of God with your possessions and your selves; that is better for you, if ye but knew!
61:12: He will forgive you your sins and admit you into gardens, neath which flow rivers and excellent abodes in the gardens of eternity; that is the supreme achievement.
61:13: And another (blessing will He bestow) which ye love, (that is) the help from God, and a victory at hand; So give thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) the glad tidings unto the believers.
61:14: O’ ye who believe! Be ye the helpers (in the cause) of God as said Jesus, son of Mary unto (his) disciples: “Who (among you) wall be my helpers unto (the work of) God?” Said the disciples (of Jesus) “We are the helpers (in the cause) of God! “Then believed a party of the children of Israel and disbelieved a party (among them), Then We aided those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious
62:1: Halloweth the Glory of God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, The King, the Most Holy, The Ever-Prevalent, The All Wise.
62:2: He it is Who raised among the ‘Ummies’ an Apostle from among themselves, reciting unto them His signs, and purifying them, and teaching them the Book (Qur’an) and wisdom although they were of before in manifest straying
62:3: And (unto) the others from among them who have yet joined not with them; And He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
62:4: That is the grace of God, He granteth it unto whomsoever He pleaseth; and God is the Lord of great grace.
62:5: The similitude of those who were placed under the Torah, and they held (followed) it not, is as the similitude of a donkey hearing books (on its back); Wretched is the similitude of the people who belie the signs of God; and God guideth not the unjust people.
62:6: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “O’ ye who profess Judaism! if claim ye that ye (alone) are the favourites of God excluding (every) other people, then desire ye for death, if ye be truthful!
62:7: But never will they desire for it for what have sent before their (own) hands, and God well knoweth (all) about the unjust ones.
62:8: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “Verily the death from which ye flee, verily it meeteth you, then ye shall be returned unto the Knower of the unseen and the seen, then will He inform you of whatever ye used to do.
62:9: O’ ye who believe! When the call is made for prayer on Friday, then hasten ye (all) unto the remembrance of God and leave off (all) trading, that is better for you, if ye do know!
62:10: And when the Prayer is ended then disperse ye in the earth and seek ye of the grace of God, and remember ye God much, so that ye may be successful.
62:11: And when see they merchandise or sport, they- break away unto it, and leave thee standing. Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “What is with God is better than sport and (better) than merchandise, and God is the Best of sustainers.
63:1: When came unto thee the hypocrites, said they: “We bear witness that verily thou art the Apostle of God;” and verily God knoweth that thou (O’ Muhammad!) art certainly His Apostle; and verily God beareth witness that the hypocrites are certainly the liars.
63:2: They make their oaths a shield, thus they obstruct (others) from the way of God; verily evil is what they are wont to do.
63:3: That is because they believe, then (again) disbelieve they, so a seal hath been set upon their hearts, so they understand not.
63:4: When thou seest them, marvel thee their bodies; and if they speak, thou listeneth unto their speech; (they are) as if they were blocks of wood propped up in garments, deem they that every cry is against them, They are the enemy (of yours), so beware thou of them! may God annihilate them, whence do they deviate!
63:5: And when it is said unto them: “Come ye! the Apostle of God will seek forgiveness for you,” they turn back their heads, and thou seest them turning away while they are the arrogant ones.
63:6: Alike it is for them whether thou seekest forgiveness for them or seekest not forgiveness for them; Never will God forgive them; Verily God guideth not transgressing people.
63:7: They are the ones who say (unto those who help the believer refugees’)’. “Spend ye not aught upon those who are with the Apostle of God until they break up; And God’s are the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites understand (it) not.
63:8: Say they: “If we return to Madina, the honourable ones will certainly drive out the meaner ones; “but for God is all honour and for His Apostle and for the believers, but the hypocrites know (it) not.
63:9: O’ ye who believe! let not your wealth, nor your children divert you from the remembrance of God; and who-soever doeth that, these are then the losers
63:10: And spend ye of what We have provided you with, (in the way of God) ere that cometh unto one of you death, then (lest) sayeth he: “O’ my Lord! why not thou respite me unto a near term, so that I may give alms, and be of the doers of good.
63:11: And never doth God respite a soul, when hath come unto it its fixed time; and God is All-Aware of whatever ye do.
64:1: Halloweth the Glory of God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; His (exclusively) is the Kingdom and unto Him (only) is due (all) praise, and He (alone) is over all things All-Powerful.
64:2: He it is Who created you, then some of you are disbelievers and (some) of you are believers; and God seest all whatsoever ye do.
64:3: Created He the heavens and the earth with Truth and fashioned you and made good your forms and unto Him (only) is the ultimate resort.
64:4: Knoweth He whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth and knoweth He whatsoever ye conceal and whatsoever ye declare; and God knoweth all of whatsoever is in the breasts (hearts).
64:5: Hath not come unto you the story of those who disbelieved before, then tasted they the evil consequences of their (own) doings; and for them shall be a painful chastisement.
64:6: That because there had come their apostles with clear proofs, but said they: “What! shall men (mortals like unto us) guide us?” So disbelieved they and they turned away, and God needeth not (anything), and God is Self Sufficient, The Most Praised.
64:7: Think those who disbelieve that never shall they be raised. Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!’)’. “Aye! By my Lord! certainly shall ye be raised, then certainly shall ye be informed of what ye did; and that, for God, is easy.
64:8: So believe ye in God and His Apostle and the Light We have sent down; and God is Well-Aware of whatsoever ye do.
64:9: The day that He will gather you for the day of gathering, that is the day of mutual loss; and whosoever believeth in God and doeth good, He will wipe out from him his sins and admit him into gardens ‘neath which flow rivers, to abide therein for ever; that is a great achievement.
64:10: And those who disbelieved and belied Our signs, they are the fellows of the fire, to abide therein; and wretched is the destination.
64:11: Afflicteth not any affliction save by the leave of God; and whosoever believeth in God, He guideth aright his heart; and verily God well-knoweth all things.
64:12: And obey ye God, and obey ye the Apostle! And if ye turn away, then upon Our Apostle is only the clear delivery (of Our Message).
64:13: God, there is no god but He; and upon God (alone) should rely the believers.
64:14: O’ ye who believe! Verily of your wives and your children (some are) enemy unto you; wherefore beware of them, and if ye forgive, overlook and cover up (their ills) then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful.
64:15: Verily your possessions and your children are only a trial and verily God it is (He) with Whom is a great recompense.
64:16: So fear ye (the wrath of) God as much as ye can, and listen ye (unto His word), obey ye (only Him), and spend ye (in His way), it is better for yourselves; and whosoever is saved from the greed of his (own) self, these it is who are the successful ones.
64:17: If ye lend God a goodly loan, He will double it unto you and will forgive you; And God is Most Appreciating, the Most Forbearing.
64:18: The Knower of (all things) the unseen and the seen, the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise.
65:1: O’ (Our) Prophet! (say thou unto the believers that) “When divorce ye (your) women, divorce ye at their prescribed period, and reckon ye the ‘Iddah’ (prescribed periods ) (exactly); and fear ye (the wrath of) God your Lord; and turn them not out of their houses, nor shall they (themselves) go out, unless they commit any indecency; And these are the limits (prescribed under the laws) of God; and whosoever transgresseth the limits of God, then indeed he doeth injustice to his own self; Knoweth thou not perhaps God may bring about some new situation thereafter.
65:2: And when they reached their ‘Iddah’ (the term prescribed), then either retain them with fairness or part with them with kindness, and call to witness two men (endued) with justice, and establish the witness (as) before God; That is with which is admonished he who believeth in God and the Last Day; and whosoever feareth (the wrath of) God, He will make for him a way (out of the troubles).
65:3: And provide him with sustenance from whence he reckon- eth not; and whosoever relieth on God, then sufficient is He for him; Verily God accomplished! His purpose; Indeed hath prescribed God for everything the due measure.
65:4: And (such of) those of your women as despair of menstruation, if doubt ye, then their prescribed term shall be three months, and (the same is the case) of those who have not yet had the course (if there be any doubt)’, and (as for) those pregnant women their prescribed ‘Iddah’ (term) shall be until they deliver their burden; and whosoever feareth (the wrath of) God, He will make for him his affair an ease.
65:5: This is the command of God which He hath sent down unto you, and whosoever feareth (the wrath of) God, He will wipe out from him his sins and will increase for him the recompense.
65:6: Lodge them wherever ye lodge according to your means, and ye harm them not to straiten (life for) them, and if they be pregnant, spend ye on them until they lay down their burden; and if they suckle (to your issues) for you, ye give them their recompense; and deal ye unto one another in fairness; And if ye find between you difficulties, then shall suckle some other woman for him.
65:7: Let him with abundance spend of his abundance and he on whom is straitened his subsistence, let him spend of what God hath given him; (for) God layeth not on any soul a burden save to the extent to which He hath given it; God will soon bring about ease after difficulty.
65:8: And how many a town rebelled against the command of their Lord, and His apostles, so We did call it to account unto a severe accounting and We chastised it with a stern chastisement.
65:9: So it did taste the evil consequences of its doings, and the end of its conduct was perdition.
65:10: God hath prepared for them severe chastisement, so fear ye (the wrath of) God! O’ ye with understanding who believe! Indeed hath God sent down unto you a Reminder.
65:11: An Apostle who reciteth unto you the clear signs of God that he may bring out those who believe and do good deeds from the darkness unto light; and whosoever believeth in God and doeth good deeds, He will admit him into gardens beneath which flow rivers, to abide therein for ever; God hath bestowed on him a goodly sustenance.
65:12: God is He Who created the seven heavens and of the earth, the like unto them, and are sent down amidst them, that ye may know that God, over all things is All-Powerful, and that God encompasseth all things in (His) knowledge.
66:1: O’ (Our) Prophet! Why dost thou forbid (unto thyself) what God hath made lawful unto thee? Thou seekest to please thy wives; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
66:2: Indeed hath God made lawful for you the dissolution of your oaths (in such cases), and God (alone) is your Lord, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
66:3: When the Prophet confided unto one of his wives a matter, but when she divulged it (unto others) and God apprised him thereof, he made known a part of it and avoided a part; so when he informed her of it, said she: “Who informed thee of this?” He said: “Informed, me, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.
66:4: If ye two turn (in repentance) unto Him, then indeed your hearts are inclined (to this) but if ye two back up each other against him, then verily God it is Who is his Protector, and Gabriel, and the (most) Virtuous one among the believers, and the angels thereafter will back (him)- up.
66:5: Happly his Lord if he divorceth you, will give him in your place wives better than you, submissive, faithful, obedient, repentant, prayerful, observers of fast, widows and virgins.
66:6: O’ ye who believe! Save yourselves and your families from the fire whose fuel shall be men and stones; over which shall be angels stern and strong, they disobey not God in what He commandeth them, and act (only) as they are bidden.
66:7: (Will say the Angels) “O’ ye who disbelieve! Make ye not excuses this day; ye shall be recompensed as ye used to do!
66:8: O’ ye who believe! Turn ye (in repentance) unto God with a turning of sincere penitence; happily your Lord will wipe out from you your sins and admit you into gardens ‘neath which flow rivers, on the day, God will abase not the Prophet and those who believe with him; their light will run before them and on their right hand; they shall (prayerfully) say: “O’ Our Lord! Perfect for us our light, and grant us forgiveness! Verily Thou (O’ Our Lord!) over all things, art the All-Powerful (One).
66:9: O’ (Our) Prophet! strive thou against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be thou hard against them; And their abode is hell; And evil is (their) destination.
66:10: Setteth forth God the similitude unto those who disbelieve the wife of Noah, and the wife of Lot; they both were under two of Our righteous servants, but they two were unfaithful (unto their husbands) and they (their husbands) availed them naught against God, and it was said (unto them)’, “Enter ye both the fire (along) with those who enter (it)?
66:11: Setteth forth God the similitude unto those who believe the wife of Pharaoh, when said she: “O’ My Lord! Build thou for me a house in the Garden and deliver me from Pharaoh and his doing, and deliver me from the unjust people!
66:12: And Mary the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity; and breathed We into it (her body) of Our Spirit, and she testified the truth of the words of her Lord, and His Scriptures, and she was of the obedient ones.
67:1: Hallowed is He in Whose hand is the kingdom (of the heaven and the earth), and He, over all things is All-Powerful
67:2: Who created death and life that he may try you (to prove) which of you is best in deeds; He is the Ever-Prevalent, the Oft-Forgiving
67:3: Who created the seven heavens layer above layer: thou seest not in the creation of the Beneficent (God) any defect or incongruity. Then look thou again; Seest thou any gap?
67:4: Then repeat thou (thy) gaze again and again, thy gaze shall return unto thee dulled, being Wearied
67:5: Indeed, have We adorned the lower heaven nearest to the world with lamps (i.e., the stars), and We have made them (as) missiles to repulse away the Satans, and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the flaming fire
67:6: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the chastisement of the hell, and evil is the destination
67:7: When they shall be flung into it, they shall hear its roaring as it boileth up
67:8: As it would burst with rage; Whenever a group is flung into it, its keepers shall ask them; “Came not there unto you a warner?
67:9: They shall say: “Yea! Indeed, a warner did come unto us, but we belied (him) and said we: “God hath sent not down aught, ye are in naught but a vast delusion!
67:10: And they shall say: “Had we but hearkened (unto them) or pondered (over what they said), we would not have been amidst the fellows in the flaming fire
67:11: So shall they confess their sins, but far will be (from mercy) the fellows in blazing fire
67:12: Verily, those who fear their Lord in secret, for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense
67:13: And conceal ye your word or declare it; Verily, He is the Knower of whatsoever is in the breasts (hearts)
67:14: What! Knoweth not He that created? and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware
67:15: He it is Who made for you the earth subservient, traVerse ye then its broad sides, and eat ye of His provision; and unto Him (alone) is the return
67:16: What! deem ye yourself secure of He Who (ruleth) in the heaven (as well), that He will cause not the earth to swallow you up? Then lo! it shall quake
67:17: Or deem ye yourself secure of He Who (ruleth) in the heaven (as well), will send not down upon you a stone-charged violent storm; Then shall ye know how (terrible) My warning is
67:18: And indeed belied those before them (My signs): how (terrible) then was My wrath
67:19: Behold they not the birds above them, outstretching (their wings), and contracting (them)? upholdeth them not save the Beneficent (God); for verily He well seeth everything
67:20: Or who is that who can be a host for you to succour you besides the Beneficent (God)? the disbelievers are but in mere delusion
67:21: Or who is that who can provide you with sustenance should He withhold His sustenance? Yet persist they in disdain and aversion (against the Truth)
67:22: What! is he who goeth along grovelling on his face, better guided or he who walketh upright upon the straight path?
67:23: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!): “He it is Who brought you (into being) and made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts; yet how little is it that ye thank!
67:24: Say thou: “He it is Who hath spread you in the earth and unto Him (alone) shall ye all be gathered
67:25: And say they: “When shall this appointment come to pass, if ye be truthful?
67:26: Say thou: “Verily the knowledge (of it) is only with God, and verily I am only an open Warner
67:27: But when they shall see it nigh, grieved shall be the faces of those who disbelieve, and it shall be said (unto them): “This is what ye have been calling for
67:28: Say thou: “See ye? If God were to destroy me and those with me or He bestoweth mercy on us, yet who can protect the disbelievers from the painful chastisement?
67:29: Say thou: “He is the Beneficent (God)! believe we in Him and on Him (alone) do we rely; so ye shall come to know who it is that is in manifest straying
