67:30: Say thou: “See ye? if your water should go down (into the earth), who then can bring you flowing water?
68:1: Nun’ and (N) by the Pen and by what they write
68:2: Thou (O’ Our Prophet!) by the grace of thy Lord, art not mad
68:3: And verily there is for thee a recompense unending (unobliging)
68:4: And most certainly thou standest on sublime morality
68:5: So thou wilt see and they (too) wilt see
68:7: Verily thy Lord! He knoweth best of him who is astray from His way, and He knoweth best of those guided aright
68:8: So yield thou not to the beliers!
68:9: Wish they that thou shouldst be pliant so they (too) would be pliant
68:10: And yield thou not unto any despicable swearer
68:12: Vehement hinderer of good, uncontrolled transgressor, sunk deep in sin
68:13: Cruelly violent, besides all that, baseborn
68:14: Just because possesses he wealth and sons
68:15: When unto him are recited Our signs, sayeth he: (they are the) “Stories of yore” (legends of the ancients)
68:16: We will brand him on the snout!
68:17: Verily We will try them as We did try the owners of the garden, when they vowed that they would certainly pluck the fruits at morn
68:18: And made no (room for) exception (for the will of God) (saying ‘If God willeth it’)
68:19: So encircled it a visitation from thy Lord, (rendering the garden desolate) while they were asleep
68:20: And it became like black barren soil
68:21: And they cried out one unto each other at morn
68:22: Be ye early at your tilth if ye would pluck (the fruits)
68:23: And went they whispering unto each other
68:24: Saying: “No poor man shall enter it today upon you
68:25: And at morn went they, strong in their resolve (to prevent the poor)
68:26: But when they beheld it, said they: “Verily we have strayed!
68:27: Nay! we are (the) deprived ones (of the fruits of our labour).
68:28: Said the most balanced one of them: “Said I not unto you, ‘Why should ye not glorify (God)’?
68:29: Said they: “Hallowed be Our Lord! Verily we have been unjust!
68:30: Then some of them proceeded against the others, reproaching each other
68:31: Said they: “O’ woe unto us! Verily we have been arrogant!
68:32: Happly, our Lord will give us in exchange a better one than it; Verily unto our Lord do we turn (in repentance)
68:33: Such hath been Our chastisement, and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is greater still; Did they but know (it)!
68:34: Verily, for the pious ones with their Lord are the Gardens of bliss
68:35: What! shall We then make the ‘Muslims’ like unto the guilty ones?
68:36: What is the matter with you? How judge ye
68:37: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye read?
68:38: Verily, therein is for you what ye choose?
68:39: Or have ye a sworn covenant from Us tending to the Day of Judgment that ye shall surely have whatever ye judge?
68:40: Ask them (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) which of them will guarantee that!
68:41: Or have they any ‘Partners’ (to Us)? Then let them bring their partners (associate gods) if they be truthful!
68:42: On the Day that the shin shall be laid bare, (i.e. befalleth an affliction), and they shall be called upon to prostrate in obeisance, but they shall not be able (to do it)
68:43: Casting down their looks, shall cover them abasement, and indeed they had been called upon to prostrate in obeisance, while yet they were whole (healthy)
68:44: So leave Me and him who belieth this announcement, We will lead them on (to ruin) by steps from whence they know not
68:45: And yet respite them; for verily My device is firm
68:46: Or askest thou from them a recompense that they are burdened with a load of debt?
68:47: Or with them is the knowledge of the unseen, that they write (it) down?
68:48: So wait thou patiently for the judgment of thy Lord! Be not thou like unto the Companion of the fish! when cried he when he was confined
68:49: Had not a bounty from his Lord reached him, he would certainly have been cast forth on the naked shore while in disgrace
68:50: Then chose him his Lord and made him of the righteous ones
68:51: And those who disbelieve would almost smite thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and say they: “Verily he is mad
68:52: And it is naught but a Reminder unto the worlds (the whole Mankind)
69:3: And what did thou comprehend what the Reality is?
69:4: Belied Thamood and ‘Ad’ the striking calamity
69:5: So as to Thamood, they were destroyed by an exceedingly terrible thunder
69:6: And as to ‘Ad, they were destroyed by a roaring violent blast
69:7: He made it rage against them for seven nights and eight days uprooting, that thou mightest see the people therein prostrate as if they were the trunks of the hollow palms
69:8: Seest thou then, of them any surviving?
69:9: And came Pharaoh and those before him and the cities over-thrown, with evil
69:10: And they disobeyed the Apostle of their Lord, so He seized them with an increasing seizure
69:11: Verily, We, when rose the water (of Noah’s flood) surpassed the (ordinary) limits, bore you up (O’ mankind) in the Ark made to float
69:12: That We may make it unto you a Reminder, and that retaining ears might retain it
69:13: And when is blown by the Trumpet, a single blast
69:14: And the earth and the mountains shall be borne away and crushed with a single crushing
69:15: On that Day shall come to pass the Great Event (of Reckoning)
69:16: And shall cleave asunder the heaven, so that on that Day it shall be (mere) frail
69:17: And the angels shall be on the sides of it; and above them shall bear that Day ‘Arsh’ (the Throne of Authority) of thy Lord, eight (of them)
69:18: On the Day ye shall be exposed, (and) shall remain not hidden any secret of yours
69:19: Then he, who is given the (Record) Book (of his deeds) in his right hand, will say: ‘Lo! read ye my book!
69:20: Verily, I did feel that I shall meet my account
69:21: So shall he be in a life (of bliss), pleased (with it)
69:23: The fruits of it being low and near at hand
69:24: (It will be said unto them): “Eat ye and drink ye for health and pleasure, for what goodness ye sent before you, in the days past!
69:25: But he, who is given the (Record) Book (of deeds) in his left hand, will say: “O’ that the Book had not been given me!
69:26: And I had not known what my account was
69:27: O’ would that it had made an end (of me)!
69:29: And hath gone from me (all) my power!
69:30: (It will he said unto him)’. “Seize him ye (angels)” and fetter him!
69:31: Then into the blazing fire burn him!
69:32: Then into a chain, of the length of cubits, tie him into!
69:33: Verily he used not to believe in God, the Great!
69:34: And he urged not the feeding of the poor
69:35: So for him here today there is not a friend
69:36: And no food is for him save the refuse of the wash of wounds!
69:37: Which shall eat none but the sinners!
69:38: So, I swear by what ye see!
69:40: Verily, it is the word of the most honoured Apostle!
69:41: And it is not the word of a poet; (How) little it is what ye believe?
69:42: Nor the word of a soothsayer; (How) little it is what ye reflect?
69:43: It is a despatch descended from the Lord of the worlds
69:44: And if (Our Apostle Muhammad) had fabricated against Us any of the sayings
69:45: Certainly, would We have seized him by the right hand
69:46: Then certainly would We have cut off his aorta
69:47: And of you not one could have withheld (Us) against him
69:48: And verily, it is a reminder unto the pious ones.
69:49: And verily know We that some of you are the beliers
69:50: And verily it is a great grief unto the disbelievers
69:51: And verily, it is the very Truth, fully assured
69:52: So Hallow by the name of thy Lord, The Great!
70:1: Demanded, a demander, the chastisement inevitable
70:2: For the disbelievers against it, there is no repeller
70:3: From God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent
70:4: Unto Him ascend the angels and the spirit in a day of the measure of fifty thousand years
70:5: So be thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad) patient with an excellent patience
70:6: Verily, they regard it to be far distant
70:8: On the Day the heaven shall be like molten brass
70:9: And the mountain shall be as (flakes of) wool
70:10: And will enquire not a friend of (his) friend
70:11: (Though) they will be given sight of each other; The guilty one would fain redeem himself from the punishment of that Day at the price of his (own) children
70:12: And his wife and his brother
70:13: And his kindred who gave him shelter
70:14: And all that are in the earth, (if) then that deliver him
70:15: By no means! Verily, it is the flaming (Hell) fire
70:17: Claiming him who turned his back and went away (from the Truth)
70:18: And amassed (wealth), and shut it up
70:20: When afflicteth him any evil, he is fretful
70:21: When reacheth him any good, he is niggardly
70:22: Save those who offer (the regular) prayers
70:23: Those who are ever constant at their prayers
70:24: And those in whose wealth is (realized) the right declared (by Us)
70:25: For him who asketh and him who is prevented (by shame to ask)
70:26: And those who testify the truth about the day of Judgment
70:27: And those who are afraid of the chastisement of their Lord
70:28: Verily, the chastisement of their Lord is not to be felt secure of
70:29: And those who guard their private parts
70:30: Save unto their wives or those whom their right hands possess for then verily they are not to be blamed
70:31: But whoso seeketh beyond this, these are they who are the transgressors
70:32: And those who, unto their pledges and covenants, are faithful
70:33: And those who in their testimonies are firm
70:34: And those who, at their (regular) prayers careful
70:35: Those shall be in the gardens, (duly) honoured
70:36: But what hath happened unto the disbelievers that they hasten on around you
70:37: On the right hand and on the left hand, in groups?
70:38: What! Coveteth every man of them to enter the Garden of Bliss?
70:39: By no means! for We have created them of (the base matter) what they know!
70:40: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, (that) We are certainly able
70:41: To substitute (in their stead) better ones than them, and We shall not be overtaken
70:42: So thou leave them (to themselves) to remain in discoursing (in falsehood), and in (vanity) sporting, until they come face to face on the Day which has been promised (unto them)
70:43: On that Day they shall come forth from their graves in haste, as if they were hastening unto a signpost
70:44: With their eyes cast down, disgrace covering them; That is the Day which they were promised!
71:1: Verily, sent We Noah unto his people, saying: “Warn then thy people? ere cometh there upon them a painful chastisement
71:2: Said he: “O’ ye my people! Verily, I am unto you an open warner!
71:3: That worship ye God (alone), Fear Him, and Obey me
71:4: He will forgive you of your sins and respite you unto an appointed term; Verily, the term (fixed) of God, when it cometh, shall not be put back, if ye but knew (this)!
71:5: Said he: “O’ my Lord! Verily I called my people by night and by day!
71:6: But increased not (for) them my call but (their) flight (from the Right Way)
71:7: Whenever I called them, that Thou mayest forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and covered themselves in their garments, and persist (in their error), and are puffed with pride
71:8: Then verily I called unto them aloud (too)
71:9: Then verily spake I openly unto them, and I confided unto them in secret (too)
71:10: Then said I: “Seek ye the forgiveness of your Lord! Verily He is the Most-Forgiving
71:11: He will send (down) upon you the cloud raining in torrents
71:12: And help you with wealth and sons (children) and make (grow) for you gardens, and make for you rivers
71:13: What hath happened unto you that ye consider not for God any greatness?
71:14: While indeed He created you through regular stages
71:15: See ye not how hath created God the seven heavens (in layers) one above the other?
71:16: And made the moon, in it a light, and the sun as a lamp
71:17: And God made you grow of the earth as a growth (of a plant)
71:18: Then He returneth you therein, and again will He bringeth you forth a new’ bringing (at the Resurrection)
71:19: And verily God hath made for you the earth outstretched
71:20: That ye may walk therein along paths wide (convenient)
71:21: Said Noah: “O’ my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but follow they him whose riches and children increase not unto him but loss
71:22: And they have plotted a great plot
71:23: And say they (unto each other) -. “Forsake not ye your gods, and forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa; neither Yaghus, and Ya’uq and Nasr!
71:24: And indeed, have they led astray many, and then increase not unto the unjust (aught) but error
71:25: Because of their (own) sins they were drowned, and were made to enter the fire, and (then) they found not any helper for them besides God
71:26: And said Noah! “O’ my Lord! leave Thou not on the earth, of the unjust ones, a single dweller (alive)?
71:27: Verily if Thou leaveth them (alive), they will lead astray Thy servants, and will not beget they but immoral ingrates!
71:28: O’ my Lord! Forgive Thou me and my parents and him who entereth my abode believing (in Thee), and the believer- men and the believer-women, and increase not unto the unjust ones in aught save perdition!
72:1: Say “It hast been revealed unto me that a party of the jinn hath heard (the Qur’an) and said: “Verily, we have heard a Recital (Qur’an) (which is) Wonderful
72:2: Guideth it unto the Right (Way), wherefore believe we in it; and never will we associate anyone with our Lord!
72:3: And that He, exalted is the Majesty of our Lord! hath taken not a wife nor a son
72:4: And that want to speak the foolish ones amongst us, against God, atrocious things
72:5: And that thought we that never utter the humans and jinn any falsehood against God
72:6: And that individuals from among the humans used to seek protection of the individuals from among the jinn so they increased them (only) in rebellion (against God)
72:7: And that they (too) thought, as ye think, never would God raise (from the dead) any one!
72:8: And that we sought the heavens, but we found it filled with strong guards and flaming darts
72:9: And that sat we on some of the seats (there) to (steal) a hearing; but any who would (try now to) listen, findeth a flaming dart in wait for him
72:10: And that we understand not (by this) whether evil be meant for them that are on the earth, or whether willeth their Lord to guide them aright
72:11: And that some amongst us are good ones, and the others of us are other than that; we are sects following different ways
72:12: And that knew we that never can we defeat (the will of) God in the earth, and never can we defeat Him (in His will) by flight
72:13: And that, when heard we the guidance, believed we in it; and whosoever believeth in his Lord, he thereafter feareth neither loss nor oppression,
72:14: And that, of us some are Muslims and of us are the others who are the deviators (from the right path), and whoever submit these pursue the right guidance
72:15: And as for the deviators, they shall be for the hell, a fuel
72:16: And that if they be steadfast on the right way, We would certainly give them water (A sustenance) in abundance
72:17: That we may prove them thereby, but whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord, him will He make undergo a severe chastisement
72:18: And that, the places for Sajdah (prostration) are for (the remembrance only of) God, so call ye not (therein) any one with God!
72:19: And that, when the servant of God (Muhammad) standeth praying unto Him, they surrounded around him, almost stifling
72:20: Say thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) “I only pray unto my Lord, and I associate not with Him, anyone
72:21: Say thou “I own not for you any evil or good
72:22: Say: “Never can protect me against God any one, and never find I besides Him, any place of refuge
72:23: Save a delivery (of the message) from God, and His messages; and whosoever disobeyeth God and His Apostle, verily, for him shall be the fire of hell, they shall abide in it for ever
72:24: Until when see they what they are promised, and then shall they know, who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number
72:25: Say: “I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh or if my Lord hath appointed for it a distant term
72:26: (He alone is) the “Knower of the unseen, and nor doth he reveal his secrets unto any (one else)
72:27: Save unto that one of the Apostles whom He chooseth for verily He causeth a guard to march before him and after him
72:28: That He may know that indeed they have delivered the messages of their Lord, and He encompasseth (by His knowledge) all that is with them, and taketh account of everything
73:1: O’ thou the Wrapped up in thy mantle!
73:2: Rise thou in the night to pray but a little! (and not for the whole night)
73:3: Half of it or curtail of it a little!
73:4: Or add to it, and intone the Qur’an in a regulated tone!
73:5: Verily soon will We send down upon thee (some) weighty words
73:6: Verily the rising at night when impression is intense and straightest in words
73:7: Verily thou hast in the day long occupation
73:8: And remember thou, the name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him with an exclusive devotion
73:9: The Lord of the East and the West, there is no god but He, take Him then as the Protector!
73:10: And be thou patient against whatever they say and avoid them with a decorous avoidance
73:11: And leave Me (to deal), and the beliers, the possessors of the bounties, and respite them a little
73:12: Verily with Us are strong fetters and the flaming fire
73:13: The food that choketh, and a painful chastisement
73:14: On the day when the earth and mountains shall be shaken and mountains shall become heaps of sand, rendered loose
73:15: Verily, we have sent unto you an Apostle, a witness against you, as sent We an Apostle unto Pharaoh
73:16: But Pharaoh disobeyed the Apostle, whereupon We seized him with a severe seizure
73:17: How, then, will ye guard yourselves, if ye disbelieve, against the day which shall turn children greyheaded?
73:18: The heaven shall be rent asunder by it; His promise is always made to be fulfilled
73:19: Verily this is a reminder, let him, whoso will, adopt unto his Lord, the (Right) way!
73:20: Verily, thy Lord knowest that thou standest up (in the Night- Prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, and (sometimes) half of it, and (sometimes) a third of it, and a group of those with thee; and God measureth (well) the night and the day; Knoweth He that never can ye take (correct) account of it, so turneth He unto you (mercifully), so recite ye whatever be easy (in the prayers) to be read of the Qur’an; Knoweth He that there may be among you sick, and others travelling in the earth seeking of the grace of God, and others fighting in the way of God, so recite ye as much as it can easily be done of it, and establish ye the (regular) prayers, and pay ye the (prescribed) poor-rate, and offer ye unto God a goodly- loan; and whatsoever of good ye send on beforehand for your-selves, ye will (surely) find it with God, That is the best and the greatest recompense; and seek ye the forgiveness of God; Verily, God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful!
74:1: O’ thou (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) covered under thy mantle!
74:5: And every kind of abomination, Shun it!
74:6: And bestow not favours (expecting) that thou mayest receive them back increased
74:7: And for (the sake of) thy Lord (endure every hardship) in patience!
74:8: For when the Trumpet is beaten
74:9: That, that shall be the Day of distress (for those who disbelieve)
74:10: Unto the disbelievers (it shall be) anything other than ease!
74:11: Leave Me (to deal with) him whom I created (bare and) alone!
74:12: And unto whom I granted wealth in abundance!
74:13: And sons abiding in his presence!
74:14: And unto whom I made (life) adjustably smooth!
74:15: And yet desireth he that I should further add!
74:16: Never (it shall be)! for unto Our signs he was a foe!
74:17: Soon will I make him afflicted of a severe punishment
74:19: But may he be ruined how he determined
74:20: Again may be he ruined how he determined!
74:23: Then turned he his back and swelled in pride!
74:24: Then said he: “This is naught but sorcery from of old!
74:25: This is naught but the word of a human being!
74:26: Soon will I cast him into hell!
74:27: And what will make him realize what hell is?
74:28: It leaveth not nor it spareth (aught)
74:31: We have made not the guardians of the fire other than angels, and We have made not the number save as a trial for those who disbelieve, that certain may be those who have been given the book, and may increase those who believe in (their) faith, and may doubt not those who have been given the book and the believers, and that say those in whose hearts is a distress and the disbelievers: “What meaneth God by this similitude?” Thus doth God alloweth to stray whomsoever He willeth, and guideth He whom He willeth, And knoweth not (any one) the hosts of God save He Himself; And this is naught but a reminder unto mankind
74:33: And by the night when it retreateth!
74:34: And by the morn when it brighteneth!
74:35: Verily it (the Hell) is one of the grievous woes!
74:37: Unto him among you who desireth to go forward (in goodness) or to remain behind
74:38: Every soul, for what it earned, is held in pledge!
74:39: Save the people of the Right hand
74:40: In gardens shall they be, asking each other
74:42: What hath brought you into the hell!
74:43: They shall say: “We were not of those who offered the regular prayers (to God)
74:44: And we used not to feed the poor!
74:45: And used we to talk vanities with the vain talkers!
74:46: And used we to belie the Day of Judgment!
74:47: Till came upon us the Certainty (death)
74:48: So, shall avail them not the intercession of the intercessors!
74:49: What hath happened then (unto them) that they turn aside from the warning
74:50: As if they were asses affrighted
74:52: Nay! But willeth every one of them that he may be given (the heavenly book) in open pages spread out
74:53: Nay! But they fear not the hereafter!
74:54: Nay! Verily it is a Reminder!
74:55: So whosoever willeth may mind it
74:56: They will mind it not unless God willeth; Worthy is He to be feared. And worthy is He to seek refuge to
75:1: Nay! I swear by the Day of Resurrection!
75:2: Nay! I swear by the Self- Accusing self!
75:3: What! thinketh man that never will We assemble his bones?
75:4: Yea! We can put in complete order even his very finger tips (with the prints thereon)!
75:5: Nay! but willeth man (always) to do evil (even) before him
75:6: Asketh he: “When is the Day of Resurrection (to come)?
75:7: So when confounded shall be the eye
75:8: And when darkened shall be the moon
75:9: And shall be brought together the sun and the moon
75:10: Man shall cry that day: “Where is place to flee to?
75:11: By no means! No place shall there be of any refuge!
75:12: Unto thy Lord (alone) shall be the place of rest!
75:13: Man shall be informed on that day of whatsoever he put before and whatsoever he put behind!
75:14: Nay! (there is no need as) man against his own self shall be a witness!
75:15: And even if he put forth his excuses!
75:16: (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) Move not thy tongue with it (the Qur’an) in haste!
75:17: Verily, on Us is the collection of it and the recital of it!
75:18: So, when We have recited it, then follow thou the recital!
75:19: Again, it is on Us the explaining of it!
75:20: Nay! But ye love the fleeing life!
75:22: (Some?) faces on that day shall be resplendent!
75:23: Unto their Lord (they will be) attentive!
75:24: And (other) faces on that day shall be despondent
75:25: Thinking that would befall them some great calamity
75:26: Nay! When it (life) shall reach the throat
75:27: And it will be said: “Who is the charmer ”?
75:28: And realiseth man that it is the (hour of) parting!
75:29: And when one leg (will twist) with the other leg, (When the agony is heaped on agony)
75:30: Unto thy Lord on that day shall be the drive!
75:31: For he believed not in the Truth, nor did he offer the regular prayers
75:32: But belied the Truth and turned he away
75:33: Then went he unto his people in haughtiness
75:34: Nearer unto thee (O’ man!) is destruction and nearer still!
75:35: Again, nearer unto thee (O’ man!) the destruction and nearer still!
75:36: What! Thinkest man that he will be left uncontrolled?
75:37: Was he not a (mere) drop of sperm emitted?
75:38: Then was he a clot of blood, then He created (him), and (He) made (him) proportioned
75:39: Then made He of him of two kinds, the male and the female
75:40: What! Is not He potent enough to give life (again) unto the dead?
76:1: Surely did come over Man to pass an occasion of time when he was nothing, mentioned of?
76:2: Verily We created man from a (small insignificant) life drop of inter-mingled life germ (of both sexes); in order that We put him to trial, so We endowed him with hearing, seeing!
76:3: Verily, have We shown him the (Right) way, be he grateful or ungrateful!
76:4: Verily have We prepared for the disbelievers chains, and shackles and a flaming fire!
76:5: Verily, the righteous ones shall drink of a cup tempered at the fountain ‘Kafoor’ (Camphor)!
76:6: The fountain whereof shall wherever drink the servants of God, they shall cause it to flow a desirable flow
76:7: They who fulfil their vows, and fear the day the woe of which stretcheth far and wide
76:8: And (while needing it for themselves) they give away food, out of love for Him, to the poor and the orphan and the captive
76:9: (Saying): “We feed you only for God’s sake, we intend not of you any recompense, nor (even) thanks (thereof)!
76:10: Verily, we dread from our Lord, a stern day of distress
76:11: So will God guard them from the evil of that day and cause them to meet freshness and pleasure
76:12: And shall recompense them, for what they endured with patience, with garden (to abide) and silk (to wear)
76:13: Reclining therein on exalted couches, they shall find not therein (the excessive heat of) the sun, nor any (intense) cold
76:14: And close low over them (shall be) its shades, and the clustered fruits thereof (shall be) bowing down (in easy reach)
76:15: And shall pass round among them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal (glass)
76:16: Bright as glass, made of silver; measure they to a well-measure
76:17: And they shall be supplied with the drink therein of a cup tempered with ‘Zanjabil’ (ginger)
76:18: (It is the water of) a spring therein named ‘Salsabeel’ (The Soft Flowing)
76:19: And around them in their service shall be boys (graced) with eternal youth; when thou seest them thou wilt deem them as pearls scattered about
76:20: And when thou seest there, thou shalt see bounties (abundant) and a kingdom magnificent
76:21: Upon them shall be robes of fine green silk and rich brocade, and they shall be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord give them to drink a drink, pure (and wholesome)
76:22: (Saying unto them) “Verily this is unto you a recompense, and your endeavour is accepted (with appreciation)
76:23: Verily, We ourselves have sent down unto thee (O’ Our Apostle Muhammad!) the Qur’an, in a proper descension
76:24: Await then with patience the command of thy Lord, and obey not from among them a sinner or an ungrateful one
76:25: And remember thou the name of thy Lord at morn and at even
76:26: And during a part of the night prostrate thou in obeisance unto Him and celebrate His praise long night through
76:27: Verily, these (people) love the fleeting present, and (neglect) putting away behind them the Day (which shall be) hard
76:28: We Ourselves created them and made them strong in their parts, and when We will, with the like of them, will We replace them
76:29: Verily this is a Reminder, so whosoever pleaseth, taketh unto his Lord the (Right) way
76:30: And ye desire not save what God desireth; Verily God is All-Knowing, the All-Wise
76:31: He admitteth whosoever He willeth into His mercy; and (as for) the unjust ones, He hath prepared for them a painful chastisement
77:1: By those sent forth with goodness, one after another
77:2: Which then rage in violent rage
77:3: And by those which spread (goodness) far and wide
77:4: Then by those that separate them from one another
77:5: Then by those that give forth the Reminder
77:6: Either justify (the punishment), or to warn
77:7: Verily, what hath been promised unto you shall come to pass
77:8: So, when the stars shall be caused to cease radiating
77:9: And when the heaven shall be rent asunder
77:10: And when the mountains shall be carried away like the dust
77:11: And when the messengers are made to reach their appointed time
77:12: To what day is the appointment (fixed)?
77:14: And what will make thee know what the Day of Decision is?
77:15: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
77:16: What! Destroyed We not the former people?
77:17: Then did We make the later people follow them
77:18: Thus, We deal with the guilty ones
77:19: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
77:20: Did We not create you from a fluid despicable?
77:21: Then We placed it in a safe place
77:23: So We planned then how Excellent are (We) the planners
77:24: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
77:25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle?
77:26: For the living and (also for) the dead ones
77:27: And made We therein mountains high, and given you to drink water sweet?
77:28: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
77:29: Begone ye unto that which ye belied!
77:30: Begone ye unto the shadow having three columns
77:31: (Which yieldeth) no shade (for coolness) nor availing against the flames
77:32: Verily, it sendeth up sparks like a palace
77:33: As if they are tawny camels
77:34: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
77:35: This is the day when they shall speak not
77:36: And it shall not be permitted unto them so that they may offer excuses
77:37: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
77:38: This is the Day of decision; We will gather you and (all) those of yore
77:39: If ye have any device, try ye that device (now)!
77:40: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
77:41: Verily the pious ones shall be amid shades and springs
77:42: And fruits whatsoever they may desire
77:43: (Unto them will be said)’. “Eat ye and drink ye in health and delight, as meed for what ye used to do
77:44: Verily, thus We recompense the doers of good
77:45: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
77:46: Eat ye and enjoy yourselves a little, for verily ye are the guilty ones
77:47: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
77:48: And when it is said unto them “Bow ye down!” they bow not down
77:49: Woe on that Day unto the beliers!
77:50: In what other word after this will they believe?
78:1: Of what ask they one another?
78:4: Verily! they shall soon come to know
78:5: Verily, Verily, they shall soon come to know
78:6: What! Made We not the earth a wide expanse?
78:8: And We created you in pairs
78:9: And cause your sleep a rest
